examples.en: This shop's steamed buns are delicious.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jǐ ge bāozi?
examples.en: How many buns would you like?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ hěn báo.
examples.en: This paper is very thin.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài báo.
examples.en: This shirt is too thin.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bīng hěn báo.
examples.en: The ice is very thin.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chībǎo le.
examples.en: I've had enough to eat.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chībǎo le ma?
examples.en: Have you eaten enough?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chī de hěn bǎo.
examples.en: We ate until we were very full.

examples.pinyin: Bǎobèi, gāi chīfàn le.
examples.en: Sweetheart, it's time to eat.

examples.zh: 这个旧盒子是我的宝贝。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiù hézi shì wǒ de bǎobèi.
examples.en: This old box is my treasure.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège xiǎo bǎobèi zhēn kě'ài!
examples.en: You little darling are so cute!

examples.pinyin: Bǎochí wēixiào hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: Keeping a smile on your face matters.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎochí liánxì.
examples.en: Let's keep in touch.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān zěnyàng bǎochí jiànkāng?
examples.en: How do you stay healthy every day?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn bǎocún hǎo.
examples.en: Please save the file properly.

examples.zh: 这些照片我要好好保存。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn wǒ yào hǎohāo bǎocún.
examples.en: I'm going to keep these photos carefully.

examples.zh: 这种食物可以保存一个星期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shíwù kěyǐ bǎocún yí ge xīngqī.
examples.en: This food can be kept for a week.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wénjiàn qǐng nǐ bǎoguǎn hǎo.
examples.en: Please keep these documents safe.

examples.pinyin: Yàoshi yóu wǒ bǎoguǎn.
examples.en: I'm looking after the keys.

examples.zh: 你放心，东西我会保管好的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, dōngxi wǒ huì bǎoguǎn hǎo de.
examples.en: Don't worry, I'll look after your things.

examples.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn bǎoguì.
examples.en: Time is precious.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnglì duì wǒ hěn bǎoguì.
examples.en: This experience is very valuable to me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de jiànyì hěn bǎoguì.
examples.en: Your suggestion is very valuable.

examples.zh: 这个房间的空气已经饱和了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān de kōngqì yǐjīng bǎohé le.
examples.en: The air in this room is saturated.

examples.zh: 市场上的同类产品已经饱和。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng de tónglèi chǎnpǐn yǐjīng bǎohé.
examples.en: The market is saturated with similar products.

examples.zh: 这种饱和的颜色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bǎohé de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This saturated color is beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.en: We should protect the environment.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎohù hǎo nǐ de shēntǐ.
examples.en: Please look after your health.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shù xūyào bǎohù.
examples.en: These trees need protecting.

examples.zh: 老人饱经沧桑，但脸上总是带着笑。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén bǎo jīng cāngsāng, dàn liǎn shàng zǒngshì dàizhe xiào.
examples.en: The old man has lived through many hardships, yet always wears a smile.

examples.zh: 这座老房子饱经沧桑，却很有味道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo fángzi bǎo jīng cāngsāng, què hěn yǒu wèidao.
examples.en: This old house has weathered many changes, yet it has real character.

examples.zh: 他的眼神里有一种饱经沧桑的平静。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnshén lǐ yǒu yì zhǒng bǎo jīng cāngsāng de píngjìng.
examples.en: There is a calm in his eyes that comes from a life of hardship.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn wǒ yào bǎoliú zhe.
examples.en: I'm going to keep this photo.

examples.zh: 这个座位已经保留给他了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zuòwèi yǐjīng bǎoliú gěi tā le.
examples.en: This seat has already been reserved for him.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái bǎoliú zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.en: I still reserve my own opinion.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing bìxū bǎomì.
examples.en: This matter must be kept confidential.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng bǎomì.
examples.en: The company requires staff to keep things confidential.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎomì ma?
examples.en: Can you keep this to yourself for me?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā qǐng le yí wèi bǎomǔ.
examples.en: We have hired a nanny.

examples.zh: 保姆每天帮忙做饭和打扫。
examples.pinyin: Bǎomǔ měitiān bāngmáng zuòfàn hé dǎsǎo.
examples.en: The housekeeper helps with cooking and cleaning every day.

examples.pinyin: Háizi hěn xǐhuan tā de bǎomǔ.
examples.en: The child loves their nanny very much.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào bǎoshǒu.
examples.en: His ideas are rather conservative.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎoshǒu zhège mìmì.
examples.en: Please keep this secret.

examples.zh: 这家店的装修风格很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de zhuāngxiū fēnggé hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.en: This shop's décor is very conservative.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎowèi zìjǐ de jiā.
examples.en: We must defend our own home.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá bǎowèi zhe zhè zuò dàlóu.
examples.en: Police guard this building.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yào gòngtóng bǎowèi huánjìng.
examples.en: Everyone should protect the environment together.

examples.zh: 这份保险包括医疗费用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bǎoxiǎn bāokuò yīliáo fèiyòng.
examples.en: This insurance policy covers medical costs.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi bǎoxiǎn le ma?
examples.en: Did you buy insurance?

examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò bǐjiào bǎoxiǎn.
examples.en: Doing it this way is safer.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē bǎoyǎng de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This car has been well maintained.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yào zhùyì bǎoyǎng pífū.
examples.en: In winter, take good care of your skin.

examples.zh: 他每天早睡早起，注意身体保养。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, zhùyì shēntǐ bǎoyǎng.
examples.en: He goes to bed and gets up early every day and looks after his health.

examples.zh: 公司为员工提供医疗保障。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi yuángōng tígōng yīliáo bǎozhàng.
examples.en: The company provides medical cover for its staff.

examples.zh: 交通安全需要有制度保障。
examples.pinyin: Jiāotōng ānquán xūyào yǒu zhìdù bǎozhàng.
examples.en: Road safety needs to be backed by rules.

examples.zh: 这份合同保障了我们的权益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong bǎozhàng le wǒmen de quányì.
examples.en: This contract protects our rights.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎozhèng míngtiān zhǔnshí dào.
examples.en: I promise to arrive on time tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bǎozhèng ma?
examples.en: Can you guarantee it?

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎozhèng bú huì zài chídào.
examples.en: He promised he wouldn't be late again.

examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, nǐ yào bǎozhòng shēntǐ.
examples.en: It's getting cold, so take care of your health.

examples.pinyin: Lù shàng xiǎoxīn, duō bǎozhòng.
examples.en: Take care on the way.

examples.zh: 你一个人在外面，一定要保重。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yí ge rén zài wàimiàn, yídìng yào bǎozhòng.
examples.en: You're on your own abroad, so please take care.

examples.pinyin: Māma bào le bào háizi.
examples.en: Mom gave the child a hug.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bào le tā yíxià.
examples.en: I gave him a quick hug.

examples.pinyin: Tā bào le yì zhī māo.
examples.en: He picked up a cat in his arms.

examples.zh: 他这次赢了，算是给上次的失败报仇了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì yíng le, suànshì gěi shàng cì de shībài bàochóu le.
examples.en: He won this time, which counts as getting back at him for last time's defeat.

examples.zh: 比赛输了，不要想着报仇，下次再努力。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài shū le, bú yào xiǎngzhe bàochóu, xiàcì zài nǔlì.
examples.en: You lost the match, so don't dwell on revenge; try harder next time.

examples.zh: 他们在游戏里互相报仇，玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài yóuxì lǐ hùxiāng bàochóu, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: They took turns getting their revenge on each other in the game and had a great time.

examples.zh: 这份工作的报酬很不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de bàochou hěn bú cuò.
examples.en: The pay for this job is quite good.

examples.zh: 他帮忙搬家，不要任何报酬。
examples.pinyin: Tā bāngmáng bānjiā, bú yào rènhé bàochou.
examples.en: He helped us move house and wanted no payment at all.

examples.zh: 老师的报酬虽然不高，但她很热爱工作。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de bàochou suīrán bù gāo, dàn tā hěn rè'ài gōngzuò.
examples.en: The teacher's pay isn't high, but she loves her work.

examples.zh: 我一定会报答你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yídìng huì bàodá nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.en: I will certainly repay your help.

examples.zh: 父母的辛苦，我们应该好好报答。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de xīnkǔ, wǒmen yīnggāi hǎohǎo bàodá.
examples.en: We should repay our parents for all their hard work.

examples.zh: 他用努力工作来报答老板的信任。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng nǔlì gōngzuò lái bàodá lǎobǎn de xìnrèn.
examples.en: He repays his boss's trust by working hard.

examples.pinyin: Xīnshēng jīntiān dào xuéxiào bàodào.
examples.en: New students check in at school today.

examples.zh: 你明天上午九点去公司报到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn qù gōngsī bàodào.
examples.en: Report to the company at nine tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 报到时别忘了带上身份证。
examples.pinyin: Bàodào shí bié wàng le dàishàng shēnfènzhèng.
examples.en: Don't forget to bring your ID card when you check in.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bàodào hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.en: This report is very interesting.

examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shang yǒu yì piān bàodào.
examples.en: There is an article in the newspaper.

examples.zh: 你看了关于这件事的报道吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn le guānyú zhè jiàn shì de bàodào ma?
examples.en: Have you read the report about this matter?

examples.zh: 火山突然爆发了，大家都吓坏了。
examples.pinyin: Huǒshān tūrán bàofā le, dàjiā dōu xiàhuài le.
examples.en: The volcano suddenly erupted, and everyone was terrified.

examples.zh: 争吵突然爆发，场面一下子乱了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēngchǎo tūrán bàofā, chǎngmiàn yíxiàzi luàn le.
examples.en: The quarrel broke out all at once, and the scene quickly turned chaotic.

examples.zh: 他的灵感突然爆发，写出了一首好诗。
examples.pinyin: Tā de línggǎn tūrán bàofā, xiěchū le yì shǒu hǎo shī.
examples.en: His inspiration suddenly burst forth, and he wrote a fine poem.

examples.zh: 你不要因为一时生气，就想着报复别人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú yào yīnwèi yìshí shēngqì, jiù xiǎngzhe bàofù biérén.
examples.en: Don't think about getting back at people just because you're angry for a moment.

examples.zh: 他的报复心理很强，很难原谅别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bàofù xīnlǐ hěn qiáng, hěn nán yuánliàng biérén.
examples.en: He has a strong urge for payback and finds it hard to forgive others.

examples.zh: 我们不应该用报复来解决问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi yòng bàofù lái jiějué wèntí.
examples.en: We shouldn't use revenge to solve problems.

examples.zh: 他有远大的抱负，想成为一名医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yuǎndà de bàofù, xiǎng chéngwéi yì míng yīshēng.
examples.en: He has great ambitions and wants to become a doctor.

examples.zh: 年轻人应该有自己的抱负。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yīnggāi yǒu zìjǐ de bàofù.
examples.en: Young people should have ambitions of their own.

examples.zh: 她的抱负是开一家自己的书店。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bàofù shì kāi yì jiā zìjǐ de shūdiàn.
examples.en: Her ambition is to open her own bookshop.

examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ ràng wǒ xiě yí fèn bàogào.
examples.en: The manager asked me to write a report.

examples.zh: 老师在礼堂做了一个报告。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài lǐtáng zuò le yí ge bàogào.
examples.en: The teacher gave a talk in the hall.

examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí qǐng jíshí bàogào.
examples.en: Please report any problems promptly.

examples.zh: 这张照片的曝光时间太长了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn de bàoguāng shíjiān tài cháng le.
examples.en: The exposure time for this photo was too long.

examples.zh: 这条新闻一曝光，大家就知道了真相。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xīnwén yī bàoguāng, dàjiā jiù zhīdàole zhēnxiàng.
examples.en: As soon as this story was made public, everyone learned the truth.

examples.pinyin: Xiàngjī de bàoguāng yào tiáozhěng hǎo.
examples.en: The camera's exposure needs to be set properly.

examples.zh: 学校反对任何形式的暴力。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fǎnduì rènhé xíngshì de bàolì.
examples.en: The school opposes every form of violence.

examples.zh: 她说过，解决问题不能靠暴力。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōguo, jiějué wèntí bù néng kào bàolì.
examples.en: She once said that problems cannot be solved by force.

examples.zh: 他从不使用暴力，只靠讲道理。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng bù shǐyòng bàolì, zhǐ kào jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.en: He never uses force, he only relies on reasoning.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhōngyú bàolù le.
examples.en: The truth finally came out.

examples.zh: 他不想暴露自己的弱点。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng bàolù zìjǐ de ruòdiǎn.
examples.en: He doesn't want to reveal his weak points.

examples.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下对皮肤不好。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān bàolù zài yángguāng xià duì pífū bù hǎo.
examples.en: Being exposed to sunlight for long periods is bad for your skin.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bàomíng le ma?
examples.en: Have you signed up?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bàomíng xuéxí Zhōngwén.
examples.en: I want to sign up for Chinese classes.

examples.pinyin: Bàomíng de rén hěn duō.
examples.en: Many people have signed up.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ hěn bàoqiàn.
examples.en: Sorry, I really apologize.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chídào le, hěn bàoqiàn.
examples.en: I was late, and I'm sorry about that.

examples.pinyin: Bàoqiàn, wǒ bù néng qù.
examples.en: Sorry, I can't go.

examples.zh: 他在一家报社工作，负责写新闻。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā bàoshè gōngzuò, fùzé xiě xīnwén.
examples.en: He works at a newspaper office, writing the news.

examples.zh: 这篇文章已经投给了报社。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǐjīng tóu gěi le bàoshè.
examples.en: This article has been sent to the newspaper office.

examples.zh: 我姐姐毕业后就进了报社。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie bìyè hòu jiù jìn le bàoshè.
examples.en: My older sister joined a newspaper office after graduating.

examples.zh: 出差的车费可以找公司报销。
examples.pinyin: Chūchāi de chēfèi kěyǐ zhǎo gōngsī bàoxiāo.
examples.en: You can ask the company to reimburse your travel costs.

examples.zh: 这张发票可以用来报销。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng fāpiào kěyǐ yòng lái bàoxiāo.
examples.en: This receipt can be used for reimbursement.

examples.zh: 下个月我要把这些费用拿去报销。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ yào bǎ zhèxiē fèiyòng ná qù bàoxiāo.
examples.en: Next month I'm going to claim back these expenses.

examples.pinyin: Bié zǒngshì bàoyuàn tiānqì bù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't keep complaining about the bad weather.

examples.zh: 大家都在抱怨工作太忙。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài bàoyuàn gōngzuò tài máng.
examples.en: Everyone is complaining that work is too busy.

examples.zh: 他从来不抱怨，总是笑着面对困难。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bú bàoyuàn, zǒngshì xiào zhe miànduì kùnnan.
examples.en: He never complains; he always faces difficulties with a smile.

examples.zh: 气球突然爆炸了，吓了我一跳。
examples.pinyin: Qìqiú tūrán bàozhà le, xià le wǒ yí tiào.
examples.en: The balloon suddenly popped and gave me a fright.

examples.zh: 他的脑袋像要爆炸一样，头疼得厉害。
examples.pinyin: Tā de nǎodai xiàng yào bàozhà yíyàng, tóuténg de lìhai.
examples.en: His head felt like it was about to explode, and the headache was terrible.

examples.zh: 夏天的汽水放在车里，容易爆炸。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de qìshuǐ fàng zài chē lǐ, róngyì bàozhà.
examples.en: Soda left in a car in summer can easily burst.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.en: I read the newspaper every day.

examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: The newspaper is on the table.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.en: He is reading the newspaper.

examples.zh: 他的故事让人感到悲哀。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gùshi ràng rén gǎndào bēi āi.
examples.en: His story leaves people feeling sad.

examples.zh: 这种悲哀的表情很少见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bēi āi de biǎoqíng hěn shǎo jiàn.
examples.en: Such a sorrowful look is rare.

examples.zh: 别为过去悲哀，向前看吧。
examples.pinyin: Bié wèi guòqù bēi āi, xiàng qián kàn ba.
examples.en: Don't grieve over the past; look ahead.

examples.zh: 他用卑鄙的办法骗了朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng bēibǐ de bànfǎ piàn le péngyou.
examples.en: He used despicable tricks to cheat his friend.

examples.zh: 偷看别人的日记是很卑鄙的行为。
examples.pinyin: Tōukàn biérén de rìjì shì hěn bēibǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.en: Reading other people's diaries in secret is a contemptible thing to do.

examples.zh: 我不相信他会做出卑鄙的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiāngxìn tā huì zuòchū bēibǐ de shì.
examples.en: I don't believe he would do anything so despicable.

examples.zh: 那部电影的结局很悲惨。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng de jiéjú hěn bēicǎn.
examples.en: The ending of that film is tragic.

examples.zh: 这个孩子的童年很悲惨。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi de tóngnián hěn bēicǎn.
examples.en: This child had a miserable childhood.

examples.zh: 他把悲惨的经历讲给我听。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ bēicǎn de jīnglì jiǎng gěi wǒ tīng.
examples.en: He told me about his miserable experiences.

examples.pinyin: Tā duì wèilái hěn bēiguān.
examples.en: He is very pessimistic about the future.

examples.zh: 别太悲观，事情会好起来的。
examples.pinyin: Bié tài bēiguān, shìqing huì hǎo qǐlai de.
examples.en: Don't be so pessimistic; things will get better.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zhème bēiguān?
examples.en: Why are you so pessimistic?

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bēizi hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This cup is very pretty.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bēizi zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: My cup is on the table.

examples.pinyin: Bēizi lǐ yǒu shuǐ.
examples.en: There's water in the cup.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài běifāng.
examples.en: My home is in the north.

examples.pinyin: Běifāng dōngtiān hěn lěng.
examples.en: Winters in the north are very cold.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì běifāngrén.
examples.en: He's from the north.

examples.pinyin: Běijí de tiānqì fēicháng lěng.
examples.en: The weather at the North Pole is extremely cold.

examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dòngwù shēnghuó zài Běijí fùjìn.
examples.en: Many animals live near the Arctic.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào běijíxióng ma?
examples.en: Do you know about polar bears?

examples.en: I want to go to Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Běijīng de tiānqì lěng bu lěng?
examples.en: Is the weather in Beijing cold?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài Běijīng.
examples.en: I was in Beijing yesterday.

examples.zh: 这辆车的价格是那辆的两倍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de jiàgé shì nà liàng de liǎng bèi.
examples.en: This car costs twice as much as that one.

examples.zh: 我每天的工作量是以前的三倍。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān de gōngzuòliàng shì yǐqián de sān bèi.
examples.en: My workload is three times what it used to be.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn fàngdà le liǎng bèi.
examples.en: I enlarged this photo twice.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shū bèi tā ná zǒu le.
examples.en: My book was taken away by him.

examples.pinyin: Chuānghu bèi fēng chuī kāi le.
examples.en: The window was blown open by the wind.

examples.pinyin: Bèizi zài chuáng shàng.
examples.en: The quilt is on the bed.

examples.pinyin: Tā bèiduìzhe wǒ, méiyǒu shuō huà.
examples.en: He turned his back to me and said nothing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bèi yǒudiǎn téng.
examples.en: My back hurts a little.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bèi hěn zhí.
examples.en: His back is very straight.

examples.zh: 他总是很被动，不敢主动说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì hěn bèidòng, bù gǎn zhǔdòng shuōhuà.
examples.en: He is always passive and never dares to speak up first.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jù huà shì bèidòngjù ma?
examples.en: Is this sentence in the passive voice?

examples.zh: 我们不能总是被动地等待。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zǒngshì bèidòng de děngdài.
examples.en: We can't just wait around passively all the time.

examples.zh: 重要的文件要做好备份。
examples.pinyin: Zhòngyào de wénjiàn yào zuò hǎo bèifèn.
examples.en: Important files should be properly backed up.

examples.zh: 电脑里的照片，我都有备份。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo lǐ de zhàopiàn, wǒ dōu yǒu bèifèn.
examples.en: I have backups of all the photos on my computer.

examples.zh: 你备份了昨天的资料吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bèifèn le zuótiān de zīliào ma?
examples.en: Did you back up yesterday's material?

examples.pinyin: Bèigào jīntiān méiyǒu chūxí.
examples.en: The defendant did not appear today.

examples.zh: 法官问被告：你有什么要说的吗？
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān wèn bèigào: Nǐ yǒu shénme yào shuō de ma?
examples.en: The judge asked the defendant, "Do you have anything to say?"

examples.zh: 这个案子的被告不是他。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ànzi de bèigào bú shì tā.
examples.en: The defendant in this case is not him.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn de bèijǐng hěn měi.
examples.en: The background of this photo is beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Tā de jiātíng bèijǐng hěn hǎo.
examples.en: His family background is very good.

examples.zh: 你知道这个故事的背景吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao zhège gùshi de bèijǐng ma?
examples.en: Do you know the background of this story?

examples.zh: 海边有很多漂亮的贝壳。
examples.pinyin: Hǎibiān yǒu hěn duō piàoliang de bèiké.
examples.en: There are many pretty shells by the sea.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiǎndào guo bèiké ma?
examples.en: Have you ever picked up shells?

examples.zh: 这个贝壳项链是手工做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bèiké xiàngliàn shì shǒugōng zuò de.
examples.en: This shell necklace was handmade.

examples.pinyin: Tā bèipànle péngyou de xìnrèn.
examples.en: He betrayed his friend's trust.

examples.zh: 她从来没有想过会被朋友背叛。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái méiyǒu xiǎngguo huì bèi péngyou bèipàn.
examples.en: She never imagined a friend would betray her.

examples.zh: 你不能背叛自己的承诺。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng bèipàn zìjǐ de chéngnuò.
examples.en: You mustn't go back on your own promise.

examples.zh: 老师让我们背诵这篇课文。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bèisòng zhè piān kèwén.
examples.en: The teacher asked us to memorise this text.

examples.zh: 我每天早上都背诵单词。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu bèisòng dāncí.
examples.en: Every morning I recite vocabulary words.

examples.pinyin: Tā néng bèisòng zhěng shǒu gǔshī.
examples.en: He can recite a whole classical poem.

examples.zh: 我在备忘录里记下了明天的安排。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài bèiwànglù lǐ jì xià le míngtiān de ānpái.
examples.en: I noted tomorrow's plans in my memo.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着一本备忘录。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe yì běn bèiwànglù.
examples.en: A notebook for reminders sits on the table.

examples.zh: 你的备忘录里有这次会议的时间吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bèiwànglù lǐ yǒu zhè cì huìyì de shíjiān ma?
examples.en: Does your memo list the time for this meeting?

examples.zh: 天冷了，我多盖一床被子。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, wǒ duō gài yì chuáng bèizi.
examples.en: It's cold, so I'm putting on another quilt.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bèizi hěn ruǎn, hěn shūfu.
examples.en: My quilt is very soft and comfortable.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bèizi xǐ le ma?
examples.en: Have you washed your quilt?

examples.zh: 他每天在外面奔波，非常辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān zài wàimiàn bēnbō, fēicháng xīnkǔ.
examples.en: He rushes about outside every day, and it's very hard work.

examples.zh: 为了工作，他常常奔波于各个城市。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gōngzuò, tā chángcháng bēnbō yú gège chéngshì.
examples.en: For work, he often travels between many cities.

examples.zh: 你别再奔波了，休息一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zài bēnbō le, xiūxi yíxià ba.
examples.en: Stop rushing around; take a rest.

examples.pinyin: Cǎoyuán shàng, yì qún mǎ zài bēnchí.
examples.en: On the grassland, a herd of horses is galloping.

examples.zh: 汽车在高速公路上快速奔驰。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē zài gāosù gōnglù shàng kuàisù bēnchí.
examples.en: Cars speed along the motorway.

examples.zh: 你想不想骑着马在草地上奔驰？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng qízhe mǎ zài cǎodì shàng bēnchí?
examples.en: Would you like to ride a horse galloping across the grass?

examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le liǎng běn shū.
examples.en: He bought two books.

examples.zh: 我本来想去，但是不去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù, dànshì bú qù le.
examples.en: I originally wanted to go, but I'm not going now.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì nǐ de ma?
examples.en: Is this book yours?

examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué dú běnkē.
examples.en: He is doing an undergraduate degree at university.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de běnkē shì xué jīngjì de.
examples.en: My undergraduate degree is in economics.

examples.zh: 本科毕业以后，他去工作了。
examples.pinyin: Běnkē bìyè yǐhòu, tā qù gōngzuò le.
examples.en: After graduating, he went to work.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái bù xiǎng qù.
examples.en: I didn't originally want to go.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì běnlái hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: This matter was simple to begin with.

examples.pinyin: Tiān běnlái jiù hěn lěng.
examples.en: The weather was already cold to begin with.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu běnlǐng.
examples.en: He is very capable.

examples.zh: 我要学一些生活的本领。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xué yìxiē shēnghuó de běnlǐng.
examples.en: I want to learn some practical life skills.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de běnlǐng hěn dà.
examples.en: This teacher is very skilled.

examples.zh: 看到危险时，人的本能是逃跑。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào wéixiǎn shí, rén de běnnéng shì táopǎo.
examples.en: When people see danger, their instinct is to run.

examples.pinyin: Yīng'ér yǒu xīshǔn de běnnéng.
examples.en: Babies have an instinct to suckle.

examples.zh: 他本能地接住了那个球。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnnéng de jiēzhùle nà ge qiú.
examples.en: He instinctively caught the ball.

examples.pinyin: Kāidiàn xūyào yídìng de běnqián.
examples.en: Opening a shop requires some capital.

examples.zh: 他没有本钱，只能慢慢来。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu běnqián, zhǐ néng mànmān lái.
examples.en: He has no capital, so he can only take things slowly.

examples.zh: 年轻就是我们最大的本钱。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīng jiùshì wǒmen zuìdà de běnqián.
examples.en: Youth is our greatest asset.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnrén bú tài xǐhuan chī là.
examples.en: Personally, I don't really like spicy food.

examples.en: I will take personal responsibility for this matter.

examples.pinyin: Tā běnrén méi lái, pàile yí ge dàibiǎo.
examples.en: He did not come himself and sent a representative.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí běnshēn bìng bù nán.
examples.en: The problem itself is not difficult.

examples.zh: 学习本身就是一种乐趣。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí běnshēn jiù shì yì zhǒng lèqù.
examples.en: Learning itself is a kind of pleasure.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù běnshēn hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: The cloth itself is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 他很有本事，什么都会做。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu běnshi, shénme dōu huì zuò.
examples.en: He is very capable and can do anything.

examples.zh: 这门手艺需要很大的本事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén shǒuyì xūyào hěn dà de běnshi.
examples.en: This craft takes real skill.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu běnshi jiù lái shìshi.
examples.en: If you're so capable, come and give it a try.

examples.zh: 我们本着诚实的态度工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen běnzhe chéngshí de tàidu gōngzuò.
examples.en: We work with honesty as our guiding principle.

examples.zh: 他本着为大家服务的原则去做事。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnzhe wèi dàjiā fúwù de yuánzé qù zuò shì.
examples.en: He acts on the principle of serving everyone.

examples.zh: 老师本着认真负责的精神批改作业。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī běnzhe rènzhēn fùzé de jīngshen pīgǎi zuòyè.
examples.en: The teacher corrects homework in a conscientious spirit.

examples.en: These two things are fundamentally different.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào kànqīng wèntí de běnzhì.
examples.en: We need to see the real nature of the problem.

examples.pinyin: Tā de běnzhì shì ge hǎo rén.
examples.en: At heart, he is a good person.

examples.en: I'm not smart enough to learn this.

examples.en: This method is too clumsy.

examples.en: Don't call yourself stupid.

examples.en: He awkwardly picked up his chopsticks.

examples.zh: 小熊的动作很笨拙，但很可爱。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo xióng de dòngzuò hěn bènzhuō, dàn hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: The little bear's movements are clumsy, but cute.

examples.zh: 我的手很笨拙，总是打碎东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu hěn bènzhuō, zǒngshì dǎsuì dōngxi.
examples.en: My hands are clumsy; I'm always breaking things.

examples.zh: 连续加班让他快要崩溃。
examples.pinyin: Liánxù jiābān ràng tā kuài yào bēngkuì.
examples.en: Working overtime non-stop is about to break him.

examples.pinyin: Bié zài háizi miànqián bēngkuì.
examples.en: Don't fall apart in front of the kids.

examples.zh: 这个公司的系统经常崩溃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de xìtǒng jīngcháng bēngkuì.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ béng zháojí, mànmàn shuō jiù xíng.
examples.en: Don't worry; just take your time and tell me.

examples.en: It's a small thing, so don't stand on ceremony.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ béng guǎn tā, tā huì zìjǐ jiějué de.
examples.en: Don't bother about him; he'll sort it out himself.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎo tùzi bèng lái bèng qù.
examples.en: The little rabbit hopped about.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zài chuáng shang bèng?
examples.en: Why are you bouncing on the bed?

examples.zh: 孩子们高兴得蹦起来了。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen gāoxìng de bèng qǐlái le.
examples.en: The children jumped up for joy.

examples.zh: 大家的热情迸发出来了。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de rèqíng bèngfā chūlái le.
examples.en: Everyone's enthusiasm burst forth.

examples.zh: 比赛结束时，观众的欢呼声迸发而出。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài jiéshù shí, guānzhòng de huānhūshēng bèngfā ér chū.
examples.en: When the match ended, the crowd's cheers erupted.

examples.pinyin: Línggǎn zài nà yí kè bèngfā le.
examples.en: Inspiration burst forth in that moment.

examples.zh: 不要逼迫孩子做他不喜欢的事。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào bīpò háizi zuò tā bù xǐhuan de shì.
examples.en: Don't force children to do things they don't like.

examples.zh: 他被生活逼迫，只好努力工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi shēnghuó bīpò, zhǐhǎo nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.en: Life pushed him, so he had no choice but to work hard.

examples.zh: 我们不能逼迫别人接受自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng bīpò biérén jiēshòu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: We can't force others to accept our ideas.

examples.zh: 他感冒了，流了很多鼻涕。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǎnmào le, liú le hěn duō bítì.
examples.en: He caught a cold and his nose ran a lot.

examples.zh: 孩子的鼻涕擦干净了吗？

examples.pinyin: Bié yòng shǒu cā bítì, yòng zhǐjīn ba.
examples.en: Don't wipe your nose with your hand; use a tissue.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bízi hěn dà.
examples.en: His nose is very big.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bízi bù shūfu.
examples.en: My nose feels uncomfortable.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bízi zěnme le?
examples.en: What's wrong with your nose?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǐ nǐ dà.
examples.en: I'm older than you.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.
examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge píngguǒ bǐ nà ge dà.
examples.en: This apple is bigger than that one.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǐcǐ hěn shú.
examples.en: We know each other well.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yào bǐcǐ bāngzhù.
examples.en: Everyone should help one another.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen bǐcǐ rènshi ma?
examples.en: Do you know each other?

examples.zh: 比方说，你可以每天多走一万步。
examples.pinyin: Bǐfang shuō, nǐ kěyǐ měitiān duō zǒu yíwàn bù.
examples.en: For example, you could walk ten thousand more steps every day.

examples.zh: 比方这个问题，你怎么看？
examples.pinyin: Bǐfang zhège wèntí, nǐ zěnme kàn?
examples.en: Take this question, for example: what do you think?

examples.pinyin: Tā de bǐfang hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: His analogy is very interesting.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo huài le.
examples.en: My laptop is broken.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bǐjìběn ná chūlái.
examples.en: Please take out your notebook.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn bǐjìběn hěn piányi.
examples.en: This notebook is very cheap.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào nán.
examples.en: This question is fairly hard.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.en: These two are fairly good.

examples.zh: 我觉得这个电影比较好看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège diànyǐng bǐjiào hǎokàn.
examples.en: I think this film is quite good.

examples.pinyin: Nánnǚ de bǐlì chàbuduō.
examples.en: The ratio of men to women is about even.

examples.zh: 这张地图的比例是多少？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú de bǐlì shì duōshao?
examples.en: What is the scale of this map?

examples.zh: 蔬菜在饭里所占的比例很大。
examples.pinyin: Shūcài zài fàn lǐ suǒ zhàn de bǐlì hěn dà.
examples.en: Vegetables make up a large share of the meal.

examples.zh: 我喜欢运动，比如游泳和跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng, bǐrú yóuyǒng hé pǎobù.
examples.en: I like sport, such as swimming and running.

examples.zh: 有很多水果，比如香蕉和苹果。

examples.en: There's lots of fruit, for example bananas and apples.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǐrú shuō yí ge lìzi ba.
examples.en: Give me an example, for instance.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu yì chǎng bǐsài.
examples.en: There's a match tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Bǐsài zài jǐ diǎn?
examples.en: What time is the match?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le yì chǎng zúqiú bǐsài.
examples.en: I watched a football match.

examples.zh: 他用一个比喻解释了这个概念。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yí ge bǐyù jiěshìle zhège gàiniàn.
examples.en: He explained the concept with a metaphor.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jù shī de bǐyù hěn shēngdòng.
examples.en: The metaphor in this line of poetry is very vivid.

examples.en: The title of this article is very eye-catching.

examples.zh: 请给你的报告写一个标题。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi nǐ de bàogào xiě yí ge biāotí.
examples.en: Please write a title for your report.

examples.zh: 新闻的标题写得太夸张了。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén de biāotí xiě de tài kuāzhāng le.
examples.en: The news headline is too sensational.

examples.pinyin: Zhège biāozhì shì hóngsè de.
examples.en: This sign is red.

examples.pinyin: Hóngdēng shì tíngzhǐ de biāozhì.
examples.en: A red light is a sign to stop.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò tǎ shì chéngshì de biāozhì.
examples.en: This tower is the symbol of the city.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de biāozhǔn shì shénme?
examples.en: What's your standard?

examples.pinyin: Zhège biāozhǔn hěn gāo.
examples.en: This standard is very high.

examples.pinyin: Tā de fāyīn hěn biāozhǔn.
examples.en: His pronunciation is very accurate.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng biǎodá nǐ de xiǎngfǎ ma?
examples.en: Can you express your ideas?

examples.zh: 我的意思表达得不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yìsi biǎodá de bù qīngchu.
examples.en: I didn't get my meaning across clearly.

examples.pinyin: Yòng Hànyǔ biǎodá gǎnqíng hěn nán.
examples.en: Expressing feelings in Chinese is hard.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng tiánxiě zhè zhāng biǎogé.
examples.en: Please fill in this form.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng biǎogé yào yòng Zhōngwén tián.
examples.en: This form has to be filled in Chinese.

examples.pinyin: Biǎogé zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: The form is on the table.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā tóngyì jǔshǒu biǎojué.
examples.en: Everyone agreed to vote by a show of hands.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yào zěnme biǎojué?
examples.en: How will this matter be voted on?

examples.pinyin: Biǎojué méiyǒu tōngguò.
examples.en: The vote did not pass.

examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi de biǎomiàn hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: The surface of the table is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Hú de biǎomiàn hěn píng.
examples.en: The surface of the lake is very calm.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào zhǐ kàn biǎomiàn.
examples.en: Don't just look at the surface.

examples.zh: 他的回答表明他很认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá biǎomíng tā hěn rènzhēn.
examples.en: His answer shows that he is very serious.

examples.zh: 这个结果表明我们的方法对。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ biǎomíng wǒmen de fāngfǎ duì.
examples.en: This result shows that our method is right.

examples.zh: 他没有表明自己的态度。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu biǎomíng zìjǐ de tàidu.
examples.en: He did not make his attitude clear.

examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoqíng hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: His expression is very happy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme shì zhè zhǒng biǎoqíng?
examples.en: Why do you have that look on your face?

examples.pinyin: Tā tīngle, liǎn shàng méiyǒu biǎoqíng.
examples.en: She listened, and her face showed no expression.

examples.pinyin: Tā diǎntóu biǎoshì tóngyì.
examples.en: He nodded to show that he agreed.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cí biǎoshì shénme yìsi?
examples.en: What does this word mean?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ biǎoshì huānyíng.
examples.en: I want to express my welcome.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hái méiyǒu biǎotài.
examples.en: The boss hasn't stated his position yet.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng míngquè de biǎotài?
examples.en: Can you state your position clearly?

examples.zh: 他没有当场表态，而是考虑了一下。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu dāngchǎng biǎotài, ér shì kǎolǜ le yíxià.
examples.en: He didn't state his position on the spot; he took some time to think.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān de biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo.
examples.en: His performance today was very good.

examples.zh: 孩子在学校表现怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài xuéxiào biǎoxiàn zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How is the child behaving at school?

examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan biǎoxiàn zìjǐ.
examples.en: He doesn't like showing off.

examples.zh: 今天晚上有一个音乐表演。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang yǒu yí ge yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.en: There's a music performance tonight.

examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: His performance was great to watch.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng kàn biǎoyǎn ma?
examples.en: Do you want to watch a show?

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī biǎoyáng le wǒ.
examples.en: The teacher praised me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo, zhíde biǎoyáng.
examples.en: You did really well and deserve praise.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng shòudào biǎoyáng.
examples.en: He often gets praised.

examples.zh: 学校表彰了优秀的学生。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào biǎozhāng le yōuxiù de xuésheng.
examples.en: The school commended its outstanding students.

examples.zh: 他因为工作努力受到表彰。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò nǔlì shòudào biǎozhāng.
examples.en: He was commended for working hard.

examples.zh: 你为什么没有得到表彰？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme méiyǒu dédào biǎozhāng?
examples.en: Why didn't you receive any commendation?

examples.zh: 我憋了一肚子气，不知道该怎么说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ biē le yí dùzi qì, bù zhīdào gāi zěnme shuō.
examples.en: I've been holding in a load of anger and don't know what to say.

examples.zh: 他憋着一口气，跑到了终点。
examples.pinyin: Tā biē zhe yì kǒu qì, pǎo dào le zhōngdiǎn.
examples.en: He held his breath and ran to the finish line.

examples.zh: 别憋在心里，有话就说出来。
examples.pinyin: Bié biē zài xīnlǐ, yǒu huà jiù shuō chūlái.
examples.en: Don't keep it bottled up; say what's on your mind.

examples.pinyin: Bié qù nàr.
examples.en: Don't go there.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kèqi.
examples.en: Please don't be so polite.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bié mǎi, mǎi nà ge.
examples.en: Don't buy this one, buy that one.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào zǒngshì xiànmù biérén.
examples.en: Don't always envy other people.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的想法，别人不一定要同意。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, biérén bù yídìng yào tóngyì.
examples.en: Everyone has their own ideas, and others don't have to agree.

examples.zh: 你不应该随便批评别人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīnggāi suíbiàn pīpíng biérén.
examples.en: You shouldn't criticise other people so casually.

examples.zh: 他住在郊外的一幢别墅里。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù zài jiāowài de yí zhuàng biéshù lǐ.
examples.en: He lives in a villa on the outskirts of town.

examples.zh: 这座别墅有一个很大的花园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò biéshù yǒu yí ge hěn dà de huāyuán.
examples.en: This villa has a very large garden.

examples.zh: 周末我们去海边的别墅度假。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù hǎibiān de biéshù dùjià.
examples.en: On weekends we go on vacation to a seaside villa.

examples.zh: 这个杯子的设计很别致。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēizi de shèjì hěn biézhì.
examples.en: The design of this cup is very distinctive.

examples.zh: 餐厅的装修很别致，我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Cāntīng de zhuāngxiū hěn biézhì, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: The restaurant's decor is very unusual, and I love it.

examples.zh: 她送了我一个别致的礼物。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòng le wǒ yí ge biézhì de lǐwù.
examples.en: She gave me a unique gift.

examples.zh: 我穿这双鞋走路很别扭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chuān zhè shuāng xié zǒulù hěn bièniu.
examples.en: These shoes feel awkward when I walk.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà yǒudiǎn bièniu.
examples.en: The way he talks is a bit awkward.

examples.zh: 两个人刚认识，相处起来很别扭。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén gāng rènshi, xiāngchǔ qǐlai hěn bièniu.
examples.en: The two of them had only just met, and getting along felt awkward.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài yì jiā bīnguǎn.
examples.en: I'm staying at a guesthouse.

examples.pinyin: Bīnguǎn lí chēzhàn hěn jìn.
examples.en: The hotel is near the station.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn de fúwù hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This hotel has excellent service.

examples.zh: 这种动物已经濒临灭绝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng dòngwù yǐjīng bīnlín mièjué.
examples.en: This animal is on the verge of extinction.

examples.zh: 这家小店因为租金太高，濒临关门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn yīnwèi zūjīn tài gāo, bīnlín guānmén.
examples.en: This little shop is close to closing because the rent is too high.

examples.zh: 那个湖因为污染，已经濒临消失。
examples.pinyin: Nàge hú yīnwèi wūrǎn, yǐjīng bīnlín xiāoshī.
examples.en: That lake is pretty much on the point of disappearing because of pollution.

examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xià le yì chǎng bīngbáo.
examples.en: There was a hailstorm yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Bīngbáo bǎ chēchuāng dǎ huài le.
examples.en: The hail smashed the car window.

examples.zh: 农民担心冰雹会毁了庄稼。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín dānxīn bīngbáo huì huǐ le zhuāngjia.
examples.en: Farmers worry that hail will ruin their crops.

examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu niúnǎi ma?
examples.en: Is there any milk in the fridge?

examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng huài le.
examples.en: The fridge is broken.

examples.pinyin: Bǎ xīguā fàng jìn bīngxiāng ba.
examples.en: Put the watermelon in the fridge.

examples.zh: 我们班分成甲、乙、丙三组。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān fēnchéng jiǎ, yǐ, bǐng sān zǔ.
examples.en: Our class is split into groups A, B and C.

examples.zh: 这次比赛，丙队得了第三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài, bǐng duì dé le dì sān míng.
examples.en: In this competition, team C came third.

examples.pinyin: Dá'àn shì bǐng.
examples.en: The answer is C.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bǐnggān hěn hǎo chī.
examples.en: These biscuits are delicious.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān chī yí kuài bǐnggān.
examples.en: I eat one biscuit every day.

examples.pinyin: Bǐnggān fàng zài guìzi lǐ.
examples.en: The biscuits are in the cupboard.

examples.zh: 新旧两种习惯可以并存。
examples.pinyin: Xīnjiù liǎng zhǒng xíguàn kěyǐ bìngcún.
examples.en: Old and new habits can coexist.

examples.zh: 城市里高楼和老房子并存。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì lǐ gāolóu hé lǎo fángzi bìngcún.
examples.en: Tall buildings and old houses coexist in the city.

examples.zh: 这两种颜色在画里并存得很和谐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng yánsè zài huà lǐ bìngcún de hěn héxié.
examples.en: These two colors sit harmoniously together in the painting.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bìngdú hěn lìhai.
examples.en: This virus is very dangerous.

examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo zhòng le bìngdú.
examples.en: The computer got a virus.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo yǒu bìngdú ma?
examples.en: Does your computer have a virus?

examples.pinyin: Zhè bìng fēi wǒ de běnyì.
examples.en: That is not what I meant.

examples.zh: 他并非不爱学习，只是方法不对。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng fēi bú ài xuéxí, zhǐshì fāngfǎ bú duì.
examples.en: It's not that he doesn't like studying; his method is just wrong.

examples.zh: 成功并非一天就能实现。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng bìng fēi yì tiān jiù néng shíxiàn.
examples.en: Success isn't achieved in a single day.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge xuǎnxiàng shì bìngliè de.
examples.en: These two options are listed side by side.

examples.zh: 他的成绩和我并列第一。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì hé wǒ bìngliè dì yī.
examples.en: He and I tied for first place.

examples.zh: 这些树并列在路的两边。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shù bìngliè zài lù de liǎng biān.
examples.en: These trees line both sides of the road.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, bìngqiě hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: He is clever and also very hardworking.

examples.zh: 我们吃了饭，并且喝了茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chī le fàn, bìngqiě hē le chá.
examples.en: We had a meal and also drank some tea.

examples.zh: 这个房间很大，并且很安静。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn dà, bìngqiě hěn ānjìng.
examples.en: This room is spacious and quiet, too.

examples.zh: 紧急情况请拨打报警电话。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnjí qíngkuàng qǐng bōdǎ bàojǐng diànhuà.
examples.en: In an emergency, dial the police number.

examples.zh: 他拨打了好几次电话，都没有人接。
examples.pinyin: Tā bōdǎ le hǎo jǐ cì diànhuà, dōu méiyǒu rén jiē.
examples.en: He dialled several times, but nobody answered.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bōdǎ de hàomǎ bù cúnzài.
examples.en: The number you dialled does not exist.

examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōfàng xīnwén.
examples.en: The news is being broadcast on TV.

examples.zh: 这首歌我每天都要播放一遍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē wǒ měitiān dōu yào bōfàng yí biàn.
examples.en: I play this song once every day.

examples.zh: 会议开始前，先播放一段视频。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, xiān bōfàng yí duàn shìpín.
examples.en: Before the meeting starts, a short video will be played.

examples.zh: 海面上的波浪越来越大。
examples.pinyin: Hǎimiàn shàng de bōlàng yuè lái yuè dà.
examples.en: The waves on the sea are getting bigger and bigger.

examples.zh: 我们坐在沙滩上，听着波浪的声音。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò zài shātān shàng, tīngzhe bōlàng de shēngyīn.
examples.en: We sat on the beach, listening to the sound of the waves.

examples.zh: 船被大波浪打得摇来摇去。
examples.pinyin: Chuán bèi dà bōlàng dǎ de yáo lái yáo qù.
examples.en: The boat was tossed back and forth by the big waves.

examples.pinyin: Chuānghu shì bōli de.
examples.en: The window is made of glass.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, dì shàng yǒu bōli.
examples.en: Careful, there is glass on the floor.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bōli hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This piece of glass is very clean.

examples.zh: 大海波涛汹涌，我们不敢出海。
examples.pinyin: Dàhǎi bōtāo xiōngyǒng, wǒmen bù gǎn chū hǎi.
examples.en: The sea was churning with huge waves, so we didn't dare go out.

examples.zh: 这几天他的心里波涛汹涌，连饭都吃不下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā de xīnlǐ bōtāo xiōngyǒng, lián fàn dōu chī bu xià.
examples.en: These past few days his mind has been in turmoil, and he can't even eat.

examples.zh: 台风来了，海面波涛汹涌。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng lái le, hǎimiàn bōtāo xiōngyǒng.
examples.en: A typhoon has arrived, and the sea is churning.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù néng bōxuē yuángōng.
examples.en: A boss must not exploit staff.

examples.zh: 这种工作时间太长，简直是剥削。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gōngzuò shíjiān tài cháng, jiǎnzhí shì bōxuē.
examples.en: Working hours this long amount to exploitation.

examples.zh: 他从来不剥削年轻的同事。
examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù bōxuē niánqīng de tóngshì.
examples.en: He has never taken advantage of his younger colleagues.

examples.zh: 春天到了，农民开始播种。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, nóngmín kāishǐ bōzhǒng.
examples.en: Spring has arrived, and the farmers begin sowing.

examples.zh: 我们在阳台上播种了一些青菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yángtái shàng bōzhǒng le yìxiē qīngcài.
examples.en: We sowed some green vegetables on the balcony.

examples.zh: 先播种，再浇水，花才会开得好。
examples.pinyin: Xiān bōzhǒng, zài jiāo shuǐ, huā cái huì kāi de hǎo.
examples.en: Sow the seeds first, then water them, and the flowers will bloom well.

examples.zh: 汉语博大精深，学起来很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Hànyǔ bódà jīngshēn, xué qǐlai hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: Chinese is vast and profound, and it is fun to study.

examples.zh: 这门学科博大精深，我还要多学。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén xuékē bódà jīngshēn, wǒ hái yào duō xué.
examples.en: This subject is vast and deep, and I still have a lot to learn.

examples.pinyin: Zuò cài de xuéwen bódà jīngshēn.
examples.en: The art of cooking is vast and profound.

examples.zh: 他在病床上和病魔搏斗了三年。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bìngchuáng shàng hé bìngmó bódòu le sān nián.
examples.en: He battled his illness from his hospital bed for three years.

examples.zh: 运动员在赛场上与对手搏斗。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán zài sàichǎng shàng yǔ duìshǒu bódòu.
examples.en: The athletes fought hard against their opponents on the court.

examples.zh: 她每天都在为生活搏斗。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zài wèi shēnghuó bódòu.
examples.en: She struggles every day to make ends meet.

examples.zh: 我们去参观了国际博览会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù cānguān le guójì bólǎnhuì.
examples.en: We went to see the international expo.

examples.zh: 这次博览会有很多新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bólǎnhuì yǒu hěn duō xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.en: This expo has many new products.

examples.zh: 你想去看汽车博览会吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù kàn qìchē bólǎnhuì ma?
examples.en: Do you want to go to the car show?

examples.pinyin: Bómǔ zuò de jiǎozi hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: The dumplings my aunt makes are delicious.

examples.zh: 今天我去伯母家吃晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù bómǔ jiā chī wǎnfàn.
examples.en: Today I'm going to my aunt's house for dinner.

examples.pinyin: Bómǔ, nín hǎo!
examples.en: Hello, Auntie!

examples.zh: 我们的英语基础还很薄弱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de Yīngyǔ jīchǔ hái hěn bóruò.
examples.en: Our English foundation is still weak.

examples.zh: 这个地区的经济为什么这么薄弱？
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jīngjì wèishénme zhème bóruò?
examples.en: Why is the economy in this region so weak?

examples.pinyin: Tā de yìzhì bìng bú bóruò.
examples.en: His willpower is not weak at all.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì bóshì.
examples.en: He is a PhD.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài dú bóshì.
examples.en: He is doing a PhD.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dāng bóshì.
examples.en: I want to become a PhD.

examples.zh: 我们周末去博物馆看看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò qù bówùguǎn kànkan.
examples.en: Let's go to the museum this weekend.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn hěn dà.
examples.en: This museum is very big.

examples.zh: 博物馆里有很多古代的东西。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō gǔdài de dōngxi.
examples.en: The museum has many ancient objects.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bózi hěn cháng.
examples.en: His neck is very long.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bózi bù shūfu.
examples.en: My neck feels uncomfortable.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bózi shàng dōu shì hàn.
examples.en: My neck is covered in sweat.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi le tā yì bǐ bǔcháng.
examples.en: The company gave him a compensation payment.

examples.zh: 你打算怎样补偿他的损失？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zěnyàng bǔcháng tā de sǔnshī?
examples.en: How do you plan to make up for his losses?

examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de bǔcháng bìng bú gòu.
examples.en: Such compensation is not enough.

examples.zh: 请你补充一下你的想法。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǔchōng yíxià nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: Please add a bit more about your idea.

examples.zh: 冰箱里的东西该补充了。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de dōngxi gāi bǔchōng le.
examples.en: The fridge needs to be restocked.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào bǔchōng shuǐfèn.
examples.en: We need to replenish our fluids.

examples.zh: 错误已经发生了，我们要尽快补救。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù yǐjīng fāshēng le, wǒmen yào jǐnkuài bǔjiù.
examples.en: The mistake has already happened, so we must fix it quickly.

examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu bǔjiù de bànfǎ ma?
examples.en: Is there still a way to remedy this?

examples.zh: 这次考试没考好，我不知道怎么补救。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme bǔjiù.
examples.en: I did poorly on this exam and don't know how to make it up.

examples.zh: 母猫正在哺乳它的小猫。
examples.pinyin: Mǔmāo zhèngzài bǔrǔ tā de xiǎo māo.
examples.en: The mother cat is nursing her kittens.

examples.zh: 哺乳期的妈妈要多吃些汤。
examples.pinyin: Bǔrǔqī de māma yào duō chī xiē tāng.
examples.en: Mothers who are breastfeeding should eat more soup.

examples.zh: 哺乳动物的宝宝都是喝奶长大的。
examples.pinyin: Bǔrǔ dòngwù de bǎobao dōu shì hē nǎi zhǎngdà de.
examples.en: Baby mammals all grow up drinking milk.

examples.zh: 公司每个月给员工交通补贴。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měi ge yuè gěi yuángōng jiāotōng bǔtiē.
examples.en: The company gives employees a transport allowance every month.

examples.zh: 政府会补贴这些学生的学费吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ huì bǔtiē zhèxiē xuésheng de xuéfèi ma?
examples.en: Will the government subsidize these students' tuition?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bǔtiē bù duō.
examples.en: This kind of subsidy isn't much.

examples.pinyin: Māo zài cǎocóng lǐ bǔzhuō lǎoshǔ.
examples.en: The cat hunts mice in the long grass.

examples.zh: 摄影师捕捉到了一个美丽的瞬间。
examples.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī bǔzhuō dào le yí ge měilì de shùnjiān.
examples.en: The photographer captured a beautiful moment.

examples.zh: 很难捕捉到他说话的真实意思。
examples.pinyin: Hěn nán bǔzhuō dào tā shuōhuà de zhēnshí yìsi.
examples.en: It's hard to pin down what he really means when he speaks.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù hē kāfēi.
examples.en: I don't drink coffee.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù shì lǎoshī.
examples.en: He isn't a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan bu xǐhuan hē chá?
examples.en: Do you like drinking tea?

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù hěn ruǎn.
examples.en: This piece of cloth is very soft.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng bù zuò le yì tiáo qúnzi.
examples.en: She made a skirt out of cloth.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bù shì shénme zuò de?
examples.en: What is this kind of fabric made of?

examples.pinyin: Tā xīnlǐ hěn bù'ān.
examples.en: He felt very uneasy.

examples.zh: 考试结果没出来，他有点儿不安。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì jiéguǒ méi chūlái, tā yǒudiǎnr bù'ān.
examples.en: The exam results aren't out yet, and he feels a bit uneasy.

examples.zh: 孩子生病了，妈妈很不安。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shēngbìng le, māma hěn bù'ān.
examples.en: The child is ill and Mom is very worried.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ búbì zháojí.
examples.en: You don't need to rush.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì búbì gàosu biérén.
examples.en: There's no need to tell others about this.

examples.zh: 你不必来接我，我自己回去。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búbì lái jiē wǒ, wǒ zìjǐ huíqù.
examples.en: You don't need to come and pick me up; I'll go back by myself.

examples.zh: 他不但会说汉语，还会写汉字。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú dàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, hái huì xiě Hànzì.
examples.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.

examples.zh: 这家店不但便宜，还很干净。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn bú dàn piányi, hái hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This shop is not only cheap but also clean.

examples.zh: 他不但没来，还不接电话。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú dàn méi lái, hái bù jiē diànhuà.
examples.en: Not only did he not come, he also won't answer the phone.

examples.zh: 雨太大了，我们不得不回家。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tài dà le, wǒmen bùdébù huí jiā.
examples.en: It's raining so hard that we have no choice but to go home.

examples.zh: 因为没有钱，他不得不找工作。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi méiyǒu qián, tā bùdébù zhǎo gōngzuò.
examples.en: With no money, he had no choice but to look for work.

examples.zh: 时间太晚了，我不得不走。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān tài wǎn le, wǒ bùdébù zǒu.
examples.en: It's too late, so I have to leave.

examples.zh: 今天天气热得不得了，我们别出门了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì rè de bùdéliǎo, wǒmen bié chūmén le.
examples.en: It's incredibly hot today, so let's not go out.

examples.zh: 他的汉语好得不得了，真厉害。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ hǎo de bùdéliǎo, zhēn lìhai.
examples.en: His Chinese is amazingly good, really impressive.

examples.zh: 这个消息让大家高兴得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng dàjiā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.en: This news made everyone incredibly happy.

examples.zh: 我不得已才告诉你这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bùdéyǐ cái gàosu nǐ zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: I only told you because I had no choice.

examples.zh: 他不得已放弃了这次旅行。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùdéyǐ fàngqì le zhè cì lǚxíng.
examples.en: He had no choice but to give up this trip.

examples.zh: 这是不得已的办法，请你理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì bùdéyǐ de bànfǎ, qǐng nǐ lǐjiě.
examples.en: This was a last resort, so please understand.

examples.pinyin: Tā búduàn de xuéxí.
examples.en: He keeps studying nonstop.

examples.pinyin: Chéngshì búduàn fāzhǎn.
examples.en: The city keeps developing.

examples.pinyin: Tā búduàn de gěi wǒ fā xiāoxi.
examples.en: He kept sending me messages.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bùfá hěn wěn.
examples.en: His stride is steady.

examples.zh: 城市建设的步伐越来越快。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì jiànshè de bùfá yuèláiyuè kuài.
examples.en: The pace of urban construction keeps getting faster.

examples.zh: 他迈着轻快的步伐走进教室。
examples.pinyin: Tā màizhe qīngkuài de bùfá zǒujìn jiàoshì.
examples.en: He walked into the classroom with a light step.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùfáng xiān shì yi shì.
examples.en: You might as well try it first.

examples.zh: 有什么不明白，不妨直接问老师。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shénme bù míngbai, bùfáng zhíjiē wèn lǎoshī.
examples.en: If you don't understand something, feel free to ask the teacher directly.

examples.zh: 天气不错，我们不妨出去走走。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen bùfáng chūqù zǒuzou.
examples.en: The weather's nice, so we might as well go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 我喜欢这本书的第一部分。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhè běn shū de dì yī bùfen.
examples.en: I like the first part of this book.

examples.pinyin: Dà bùfen xuésheng dōu lái le.
examples.en: Most of the students have come.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bùfen nèiróng nǐ yào jìzhù.
examples.en: You need to remember this part of the content.

examples.pinyin: Nín tài kuājiǎng wǒ le, bù gǎn dāng.
examples.en: You're too kind, I don't deserve such praise.

examples.zh: 大家都说我厨艺好，我可不敢当。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu shuō wǒ chúyì hǎo, wǒ kě bù gǎn dāng.
examples.en: Everyone says I'm a good cook, but I don't deserve that.

examples.zh: 谢谢您的称赞，我不敢当。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nín de chēngzàn, wǒ bù gǎn dāng.
examples.en: Thank you for the compliment, but I don't deserve it.

examples.zh: 学校门口贴着一张布告。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào ménkǒu tiēzhe yì zhāng bùgào.
examples.en: A notice is posted at the school gate.

examples.pinyin: Bùgào shàng xiězhe míngtiān tíngdiàn.
examples.en: The notice says the power will be cut off tomorrow.

examples.zh: 小区里刚发布告，通知大家检查水管。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoqū lǐ gāng fā bùgào, tōngzhī dàjiā jiǎnchá shuǐguǎn.
examples.en: The community just posted a notice telling everyone to check their water pipes.

examples.zh: 他不顾大雨，还是去上班了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú gù dàyǔ, háishi qù shàngbān le.
examples.en: Ignoring the heavy rain, he still went to work.

examples.zh: 她不顾疲劳，坚持把工作做完。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú gù píláo, jiānchí bǎ gōngzuò zuòwán.
examples.en: Regardless of being tired, she insisted on finishing her work.

examples.zh: 为了朋友，他不顾一切地帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Wèile péngyou, tā bú gù yíqiè de bāngmáng.
examples.en: For his friend, he helped without any regard for himself.

examples.zh: 不管天气怎么样，我都去。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn tiānqì zěnmeyàng, wǒ dōu qù.
examples.en: No matter what the weather is like, I'm going.

examples.zh: 不管你去不去，我都要去。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ qù bu qù, wǒ dōu yào qù.
examples.en: Whether or not you go, I'm going.

examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn duō guì, wǒ dōu xiǎng mǎi.
examples.en: No matter how expensive it is, I want to buy it.

examples.zh: 这个菜不错，不过有点咸。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài búcuò, búguò yǒudiǎn xián.
examples.en: This dish is pretty good, but a bit salty.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù, búguò méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.en: I'd like to go, but I don't have time.

examples.zh: 这个办法不错，不过很贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ búcuò, búguò hěn guì.
examples.en: This idea is not bad, but it's expensive.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù hǎoyìsi máfan nǐ.
examples.en: I feel bad about bothering you.

examples.zh: 这次又让你请客，真不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yòu ràng nǐ qǐngkè, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.en: I feel bad that you're treating me again.

examples.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le.
examples.en: Sorry, I'm late.

examples.pinyin: Piányi de dōngxi bú jiàn de hǎo.
examples.en: Cheap things aren't necessarily good.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de bú jiàn de duì.
examples.en: What he says isn't necessarily right.

examples.zh: 这个时候，他不见得会来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíhou, tā bú jiàn de huì lái.
examples.en: At this time, he may not necessarily come.

examples.zh: 看到孩子的笑脸，妈妈不禁笑了。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào háizi de xiàoliǎn, māma bùjīn xiào le.
examples.en: Seeing the child's smile, Mom couldn't help smiling too.

examples.zh: 听完这个故事，我不禁哭了起来。
examples.pinyin: Tīng wán zhège gùshi, wǒ bùjīn kū le qǐlái.
examples.en: After hearing the story, I couldn't help crying.

examples.zh: 看到他的进步，老师不禁露出了微笑。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tā de jìnbù, lǎoshī bùjīn lùchū le wēixiào.
examples.en: Seeing his progress, the teacher couldn't help but smile.

examples.zh: 这个菜不仅便宜，还很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài bùjǐn piányi, hái hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: This dish is not only cheap but also delicious.

examples.zh: 她不仅会唱歌，还会跳舞。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn huì chànggē, hái huì tiàowǔ.
examples.en: She can not only sing but also dance.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùjǐn yào xué, hái yào liànxí.
examples.en: You have to not only study but also practice.

examples.zh: 这套房子的布局很合理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fángzi de bùjú hěn hélǐ.
examples.en: The layout of this apartment is very sensible.

examples.zh: 这个办公室的布局很现代。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bàngōngshì de bùjú hěn xiàndài.
examples.en: This office's layout is very modern.

examples.zh: 开局的布局对棋手很重要。
examples.pinyin: Kāijú de bùjú duì qíshǒu hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: The opening moves matter a lot to a chess player.

examples.zh: 这里的交通每天都很糟糕，我真的不堪忍受。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng měitiān dōu hěn zāogāo, wǒ zhēn de bù kān rěnshòu.
examples.en: The traffic here is awful every day, and I really can't stand it any more.

examples.zh: 她的衣服破烂不堪，只能扔掉。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yīfu pòlàn bùkān, zhǐ néng rēngdiào.
examples.en: Her clothes were so worn out that they had to be thrown away.

examples.zh: 这间房子很久没人住，破旧不堪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángzi hěn jiǔ méi rén zhù, pòjiù bùkān.
examples.en: This house has been empty for ages and is falling apart.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhēnshi bù kě sī yì.
examples.en: This is truly unbelievable.

examples.zh: 他一个人走了两百公里，真不可思议。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zǒu le liǎngbǎi gōnglǐ, zhēn bù kě sī yì.
examples.en: He walked two hundred kilometres alone, it's incredible.

examples.zh: 手机那么小，却能拍出这么清楚的照片，真不可思议。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàme xiǎo, què néng pāichū zhème qīngchu de zhàopiàn, zhēn bù kě sī yì.
examples.en: The phone is so small, yet it takes such clear photos. Unbelievable.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù! Bù kèqi.
examples.en: Thanks for your help! You're welcome.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuō xièxie, wǒ shuō bù kèqi.
examples.en: She said thank you, and I said you're welcome.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù kèqi, qǐng zuò.
examples.en: Make yourself at home, please sit down.

examples.zh: 他是冠军，不愧是最好的运动员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì guànjūn, búkuì shì zuì hǎo de yùndòngyuán.
examples.en: He's the champion, and he truly is the best athlete.

examples.zh: 这道菜味道很好，不愧是名厨做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèidao hěn hǎo, búkuì shì míngchú zuò de.
examples.en: This dish tastes great, it really deserves its reputation.

examples.zh: 你每天都这么努力，不愧是我们的班长。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu zhème nǔlì, búkuì shì wǒmen de bānzhǎng.
examples.en: You work this hard every day, you truly deserve to be our class monitor.

examples.zh: 我本来以为今天下雨，不料天气很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi jīntiān xià yǔ, bú liào tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I thought it would rain today, but the weather turned out fine.

examples.zh: 他本想早点回家，不料又加班了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā, bú liào yòu jiābān le.
examples.en: He meant to head home early, but unexpectedly had to work overtime again.

examples.zh: 我们准备好了，不料比赛被取消了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi hǎo le, bú liào bǐsài bèi qǔxiāo le.
examples.en: We were all set, but to our surprise the match was canceled.

examples.zh: 他在我们公司的一个部门工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǒmen gōngsī de yí ge bùmén gōngzuò.
examples.en: He works in one of the departments at our company.

examples.zh: 这个部门的人都很努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bùmén de rén dōu hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: Everyone in this department works hard.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen bùmén yǒu jǐ ge rén?
examples.en: How many people are in your department?

examples.zh: 第一次做这件事，他不免紧张。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì zuò zhè jiàn shì, tā bùmiǎn jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: Doing this for the first time, he was bound to be nervous.

examples.zh: 天气这么热，大家不免出汗。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème rè, dàjiā bùmiǎn chū hàn.
examples.en: It's so hot that everyone is bound to sweat.

examples.zh: 在国外生活，不免会想家。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài shēnghuó, bùmiǎn huì xiǎngjiā.
examples.en: Living abroad, you're bound to miss home.

examples.pinyin: Tā děng de bú nàifán le.
examples.en: He's getting impatient from waiting.

examples.pinyin: Bié duì háizi bú nàifán.
examples.en: Don't be impatient with children.

examples.pinyin: Gùkè dōu hěn bú nàifán.
examples.en: The customers are all getting impatient.

examples.pinyin: Kuài zǒu ba, bùrán yào chídào le.
examples.en: Hurry up, or we'll be late.

examples.zh: 你要多穿点儿衣服，不然会冷。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō chuān diǎnr yīfu, bùrán huì lěng.
examples.en: Wear more clothes, otherwise you'll be cold.

examples.zh: 我得回家，不然妈妈会担心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děi huíjiā, bùrán māma huì dānxīn.
examples.en: I have to go home, or Mom will worry.

examples.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ bùrú wǒ hǎo.
examples.en: His Chinese isn't as good as mine.

examples.zh: 今天下雨，不如在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàyǔ, bùrú zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.en: It's raining today, so we'd be better off resting at home.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cài bùrú nàge hǎochī.
examples.en: This dish isn't as tasty as that one.

examples.pinyin: Chuāngwài bùshí chuánlái niǎo jiào shēng.
examples.en: Birdsong drifts in through the window from time to time.

examples.zh: 他工作很忙，不时打电话回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn máng, bùshí dǎ diànhuà huí jiā.
examples.en: He's busy with work, but he calls home now and then.

examples.zh: 天气变化很快，风不时地吹过来。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, fēng bùshí de chuī guòlái.
examples.en: The weather changes quickly, with gusts of wind blowing in now and then.

examples.zh: 公司正在部署新的计划。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài bùshǔ xīn de jìhuà.
examples.en: The company is rolling out a new plan.

examples.zh: 经理已经部署好了明天的工作。
