examples.en: The ending of this film is very harsh.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de yángguāng fēicháng cànlàn.
examples.en: Today's sunshine is brilliant.

examples.zh: 她笑得很灿烂，像夏天的太阳。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiào de hěn cànlàn, xiàng xiàtiān de tàiyáng.
examples.en: She smiled brightly, like the summer sun.

examples.zh: 烟花在夜空中绽放，十分灿烂。
examples.pinyin: Yānhuā zài yèkōng zhōng zhànfàng, shífēn cànlàn.
examples.en: The fireworks blossomed in the night sky, dazzling and brilliant.

examples.zh: 飞机的货舱里有很多行李。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī de huòcāng lǐ yǒu hěn duō xíngli.
examples.en: The plane's cargo hold is full of luggage.

examples.pinyin: Chuáncāng lǐ hěn mēnrè.
examples.en: The ship's cabin is stuffy and hot.

examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè shì jǐ hào cāng?
examples.en: Excuse me, which cabin number is this?

examples.zh: 他生病以后脸色很苍白。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng yǐhòu liǎnsè hěn cāngbái.
examples.en: He looked very pale after falling ill.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liǎn zěnme zhème cāngbái?
examples.en: Why is your face so pale?

examples.pinyin: Tā de liǎnsè bú zài cāngbái le.
examples.en: Her face is no longer pale.

examples.zh: 他仓促地吃了几口饭就出门了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cāngcù de chī le jǐ kǒu fàn jiù chūmén le.
examples.en: He hurriedly ate a few bites and went out.

examples.zh: 时间很仓促，我们没准备好。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān hěn cāngcù, wǒmen méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
examples.en: We had very little time, so we weren't ready.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào cāngcù de zuò juédìng.
examples.en: Don't make decisions in a rush.

examples.zh: 这些货物都放在仓库里。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē huòwù dōu fàng zài cāngkù lǐ.
examples.en: All these goods are kept in the warehouse.

examples.pinyin: Cāngkù lǐ hěn àn, xūyào kāi dēng.
examples.en: The warehouse is dark, so we need to turn on the light.

examples.zh: 我们要把旧东西搬到仓库。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎ jiù dōngxi bān dào cāngkù.
examples.en: We need to move the old things to the storeroom.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cāochǎng shang wán.
examples.en: The children are playing on the playground.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de cāochǎng hěn dà.
examples.en: The school's sports field is very big.

examples.zh: 我们每天下午在操场跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měi tiān xiàwǔ zài cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.en: We run on the sports field every afternoon.

examples.zh: 妈妈为了家里的事情操劳了一辈子。
examples.pinyin: Māma wèile jiālǐ de shìqing cāoláo le yí bèizi.
examples.en: Mom worked tirelessly for the family all her life.

examples.zh: 奶奶操劳了一辈子，现在该好好休息了。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai cāoláo le yí bèizi, xiànzài gāi hǎohǎo xiūxi le.
examples.en: Grandma has worked hard all her life and now deserves a proper rest.

examples.pinyin: Bié tài cāoláo le, zhùyì shēntǐ.
examples.en: Don't overwork yourself; look after your health.

examples.zh: 运动队每天早上都要操练。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngduì měitiān zǎoshang dōu yào cāoliàn.
examples.en: The sports team trains every morning.

examples.zh: 老师带着学生在操场上操练。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī dài zhe xuésheng zài cāochǎng shàng cāoliàn.
examples.en: The teacher led the pupils through drills on the playground.

examples.zh: 多操练几次，动作就会熟练。
examples.pinyin: Duō cāoliàn jǐ cì, dòngzuò jiù huì shúliàn.
examples.en: Practice a few more times and the moves will become second nature.

examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì wèi háizi cāoxīn.
examples.en: Parents always worry about their children.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié cāoxīn, wǒ néng jiějué.
examples.en: Don't worry; I can sort it out.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cāoxīn gōngzuò de shì.
examples.en: He worries a lot about work.

examples.zh: 这个游戏需要用手柄来操纵角色。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì xūyào yòng shǒubǐng lái cāozòng juésè.
examples.en: In this game you control the character with a controller.

examples.zh: 他能熟练地操纵这架无人机。
examples.pinyin: Tā néng shúliàn de cāozòng zhè jià wúrénjī.
examples.en: He can fly this drone skilfully.

examples.zh: 市场不应该被少数人操纵。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng bù yīnggāi bèi shǎoshù rén cāozòng.
examples.en: The market should not be manipulated by a small number of people.

examples.zh: 请按照说明书的步骤操作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào shuōmíngshū de bùzhòu cāozuò.
examples.en: Please operate it by following the steps in the manual.

examples.zh: 这台机器很简单，一学就会操作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì hěn jiǎndān, yì xué jiù huì cāozuò.
examples.en: This machine is simple; you can learn to operate it straight away.

examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo de cāozuò fāngfǎ bù nán.
examples.en: The way to operate a computer is not hard.

examples.zh: 教室里很嘈杂，我听不清老师的话。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ hěn cáozá, wǒ tīng bu qīng lǎoshī de huà.
examples.en: The classroom is so noisy that I can't hear the teacher clearly.

examples.zh: 市场里人很多，非常嘈杂。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng lǐ rén hěn duō, fēicháng cáozá.
examples.en: The market is crowded and very noisy.

examples.zh: 我们换个安静的地方吧，这里太嘈杂了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huàn ge ānjìng de dìfang ba, zhèlǐ tài cáozá le.
examples.en: Let's go somewhere quieter; it's too noisy here.

examples.pinyin: Cǎodì shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎo niǎo.
examples.en: There is a little bird on the grass.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de cǎo hěn cháng.
examples.en: The grass here is very long.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiězì tài cǎo le.
examples.en: Your handwriting is too sloppy.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn cǎo'àn hái yào xiūgǎi.
examples.en: This draft still needs revising.

examples.zh: 你看过新的法律草案吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kànguo xīn de fǎlǜ cǎo'àn ma?
examples.en: Have you read the new draft law?

examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hái méiyǒu cǎo'àn.
examples.en: This plan doesn't have a draft yet.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuò juédìng tài cǎoshuài le.
examples.en: He made the decision far too hastily.

examples.zh: 这样草率的工作谁能接受？
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng cǎoshuài de gōngzuò shéi néng jiēshòu?
examples.en: Who could accept work this sloppy?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú yào cǎoshuài de huídá.
examples.en: Don't answer carelessly.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tào shū yǒu sān cè.
examples.en: This set of books has three volumes.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yí cè xīn cídiǎn.
examples.en: I bought a new copy of the dictionary.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn huàcè hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This picture album is very beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì tā cèhuà de.
examples.en: He planned this event.

examples.zh: 我们需要一份详细的策划方案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yí fèn xiángxì de cèhuà fāng'àn.
examples.en: We need a detailed plan.

examples.zh: 她擅长策划大型的婚礼。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàncháng cèhuà dàxíng de hūnlǐ.
examples.en: She is good at planning large weddings.

examples.zh: 工人正在测量房间的面积。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrén zhèngzài cèliáng fángjiān de miànjī.
examples.en: The worker is measuring the area of the room.

examples.zh: 请帮我测量一下桌子的长度。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ cèliáng yíxià zhuōzi de chángdù.
examples.en: Please help me measure the length of the table.

examples.zh: 你每天都用体温计测量体温吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu yòng tǐwēnjì cèliáng tǐwēn ma?
examples.en: Do you take your temperature with a thermometer every day?

examples.zh: 我们需要一个新的营销策略。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yí ge xīn de yíngxiāo cèlüè.
examples.en: We need a new marketing strategy.

examples.pinyin: Tā de cèlüè hěn cōngmíng.
examples.en: His tactics are very clever.

examples.zh: 说话要讲究策略，不能太直接。
examples.pinyin: Shuōhuà yào jiǎngjiu cèlüè, bù néng tài zhíjiē.
examples.en: You have to be tactful when you speak; you can't be too blunt.

examples.pinyin: Cóng cèmiàn kàn, zhè zuò lóu hěn gāo.
examples.en: Seen from the side, this building is very tall.

examples.zh: 我们从侧面了解了他的情况。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng cèmiàn liǎojiě le tā de qíngkuàng.
examples.en: We learned about his situation from another angle.

examples.zh: 这张照片拍的是他的侧面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi de shì tā de cèmiàn.
examples.en: This photo shows his profile.

examples.pinyin: Cèsuǒ zài lóuxià.
examples.en: The toilet is downstairs.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge cèsuǒ hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This toilet is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, cèsuǒ zài nǎr?
examples.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu yí cì shùxué cèyàn.
examples.en: We have a math test tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cèyàn wǒ kǎo de bú cuò.
examples.en: I did quite well on this test.

examples.zh: 老师每周都做一次测验。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī měi zhōu dōu zuò yí cì cèyàn.
examples.en: The teacher gives a quiz every week.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù zài sān céng.
examples.en: My home is on the third floor.

examples.pinyin: Zhège lóu yǒu jǐ céng?
examples.en: How many floors does this building have?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù de lóu yígòng qī céng.
examples.en: Our building has seven floors in total.

examples.pinyin: Xīn chǎnpǐn céngchū bùqióng.
examples.en: New products keep appearing endlessly.

examples.zh: 这些问题层出不穷，让人头疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí céngchū bùqióng, ràng rén tóuténg.
examples.en: These problems keep coming up endlessly, which is a headache.

examples.zh: 网上的新游戏层出不穷。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshàng de xīn yóuxì céngchū bùqióng.
examples.en: New online games keep appearing without end.

examples.zh: 这篇文章的层次很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de céngcì hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: The structure of this article is very clear.

examples.zh: 画面有很多层次，很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Huàmiàn yǒu hěn duō céngcì, hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: The painting has many layers and is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 这两个问题的层次不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge wèntí de céngcì bù yíyàng.
examples.en: These two questions are on different levels.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng zài Běijīng zhù guo.
examples.en: I once lived in Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Tā céngjīng shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
examples.en: He used to be my teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ céngjīng qù guo Chángchéng ma?
examples.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huā chā zài huāpíng lǐ.
examples.en: Please put the flowers in the vase.

examples.pinyin: Tā chā le yí jù huà.
examples.en: He chipped in with a remark.

examples.zh: 你的电脑插头插在哪里？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo chātóu chā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.en: Where is your computer plugged in?

examples.zh: 这两个东西有什么差别？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge dōngxi yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.en: What's the difference between these two things?

examples.pinyin: Chéngshì hé nóngcūn chābié hěn dà.
examples.en: There is a big difference between cities and the countryside.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de shuǐpíng méiyǒu chābié.
examples.en: Their level is no different.

examples.zh: 两个班的成绩差距很大。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge bān de chéngjì chājù hěn dà.
examples.en: There is a big gap between the two classes' grades.

examples.zh: 我和他的水平还有差距。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā de shuǐpíng hái yǒu chājù.
examples.en: My level still falls short of his.

examples.zh: 这两款手机的价格差距不小。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng kuǎn shǒujī de jiàgé chājù bù xiǎo.
examples.en: The price gap between these two phones is not small.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bǎ chāzi.
examples.en: Please give me a fork.

examples.pinyin: Chāzi diào zài dì shàng le.
examples.en: The fork fell on the floor.

examples.pinyin: Chī shuǐguǒ kěyǐ yòng chāzi.
examples.en: You can use a fork to eat fruit.

examples.pinyin: Chá hǎo le, qǐng hē.
examples.en: The tea is ready, please drink.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chá zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: My tea is on the table.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì Zhōngguó chá.
examples.en: This is Chinese tea.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá cháhuòle yì pī jiǎhuò.
examples.en: The police seized a batch of fake goods.

examples.zh: 海关查获了一箱过期的食品。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiguān cháhuòle yì xiāng guòqī de shípǐn.
examples.en: Customs seized a crate of expired food.

examples.zh: 市场管理部门查获了很多假冒产品。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng guǎnlǐ bùmén cháhuòle hěn duō jiǎmào chǎnpǐn.
examples.en: Market regulators found and seized many counterfeit products.

examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn de lù yǒu yí ge chà.
examples.en: There's a fork in the road ahead.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà zǒng ài chàkāi huàtí.
examples.en: He always likes to change the subject when he talks.

examples.pinyin: Bié dǎchà, ràng tā bǎ huà shuō wán.
examples.en: Don't interrupt; let him finish what he's saying.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chéngjì hěn chà.
examples.en: My grades are poor.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn chà.
examples.en: The weather is terrible today.

examples.pinyin: Chàbuduō le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.en: That's about enough, let's go.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ chàbuduō gāo.
examples.en: The two of us are about the same height.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge dōngxi chàbuduō.
examples.en: These two things are much the same.

examples.pinyin: Chàbuduō le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.en: That's about enough, let's go.

examples.zh: 刹那间，烟花照亮了夜空。
examples.pinyin: Chànà jiān, yānhuā zhàoliàng le yèkōng.
examples.en: In an instant, fireworks lit up the night sky.

examples.zh: 那一刹那，我忘记了一切。
examples.pinyin: Nà yí chànà, wǒ wàngjì le yíqiè.
examples.en: In that split second, I forgot everything.

examples.zh: 他的笑容只持续了一刹那。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiàoróng zhǐ chíxù le yí chànà.
examples.en: His smile lasted only an instant.

examples.zh: 他听到这个消息，非常诧异。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, fēicháng chàyì.
examples.en: He was very astonished to hear the news.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zhème chàyì?
examples.en: Why are you so astonished?

examples.zh: 大家都不诧异他的决定。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bú chàyì tā de juédìng.
examples.en: Nobody was surprised by his decision.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ jiù fángzi chāi le.
examples.en: We tore down the old house.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ chāikāi zhège bāoguǒ.
examples.en: Please help me open this parcel.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo wǒ chāi bu kāi.
examples.en: I can't take this computer apart.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yòng de shì cháiyóu.
examples.en: This truck runs on diesel.

examples.pinyin: Cháiyóu de jiàgé yòu zhǎng le.
examples.en: The price of diesel has gone up again.

examples.zh: 汽车加油站有柴油和汽油。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē jiāyóuzhàn yǒu cháiyóu hé qìyóu.
examples.en: The petrol station sells both diesel and petrol.

examples.zh: 老人家走路不稳，需要有人搀着。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorénjia zǒulù bù wěn, xūyào yǒu rén chān zhe.
examples.en: The elderly woman walks unsteadily and needs someone to hold her arm.

examples.zh: 他小心地搀着奶奶过马路。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎoxīn de chān zhe nǎinai guò mǎlù.
examples.en: He carefully helped Grandma across the road by the arm.

examples.zh: 妈妈搀着孩子的手，走进了学校。
examples.pinyin: Māma chān zhe háizi de shǒu, zǒu jìn le xuéxiào.
examples.en: Mom held the child's hand and walked into the school.

examples.zh: 他在背后馋人，大家都很讨厌他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bèihòu chán rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tǎoyàn tā.
examples.en: He slanders people behind their backs, and everyone dislikes him.

examples.zh: 别听他的馋言，那是假的。
examples.pinyin: Bié tīng tā de chányán, nà shì jiǎ de.
examples.en: Don't listen to his slander; it's false.

examples.zh: 他总爱馋人，我们都不信他的话。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒng ài chán rén, wǒmen dōu bú xìn tā de huà.
examples.en: He always slanders people, so none of us believe him.

examples.pinyin: Shéngzi chánrào zài shùzhī shang.
examples.en: The rope is wound around the branch.

examples.pinyin: Téngwàn chánràozhe zhěng miàn qiáng.
examples.en: Vines wind around the entire wall.

examples.zh: 他被问题缠绕了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi wèntí chánràole yì zhěng tiān.
examples.en: He was tangled up in problems all day.

examples.zh: 这是我们公司的新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.en: This is our company's new product.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn hěn piányi.
examples.en: This product is very cheap.

examples.zh: 我们要提高产品的质量。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tígāo chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng.
examples.en: We need to improve the quality of our products.

examples.zh: 这个问题是怎么产生的？
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shì zěnme chǎnshēng de?
examples.en: How did this problem arise?

examples.zh: 这部电影让我产生了兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng ràng wǒ chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
examples.en: This film sparked my interest.

examples.zh: 好的习惯会产生好的结果。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo de xíguàn huì chǎnshēng hǎo de jiéguǒ.
examples.en: Good habits produce good results.

examples.zh: 他在会上阐述了自己的观点。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huì shàng chǎnshù le zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
examples.en: He laid out his views at the meeting.

examples.zh: 老师用例子阐述了这个道理。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng lìzi chǎnshù le zhège dàolǐ.
examples.en: The teacher illustrated the principle with examples.

examples.zh: 请你用几句话阐述你的想法。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ yòng jǐ jù huà chǎnshù nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: Please explain your idea in a few sentences.

examples.zh: 这个城市的主要产业是旅游。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de zhǔyào chǎnyè shì lǚyóu.
examples.en: The main industry in this city is tourism.

examples.pinyin: Tā jìchéng le fùqīn de chǎnyè.
examples.en: He inherited his father's property.

examples.zh: 这个地区发展了很多新产业。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū fāzhǎn le hěn duō xīn chǎnyè.
examples.en: This area has developed many new industries.

examples.zh: 他冷得身体不停地颤抖。
examples.pinyin: Tā lěng de shēntǐ bù tíng de chàndǒu.
examples.en: He was so cold his body kept shivering.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn zài chàndǒu.
examples.en: Her voice was trembling.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他的手开始颤抖。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā de shǒu kāishǐ chàndǒu.
examples.en: On hearing the news, his hands began to tremble.

examples.zh: 这个骗子非常猖狂，竟敢在大街上行骗。
examples.pinyin: Zhège piànzi fēicháng chāngkuáng, jìnggǎn zài dàjiē shàng xíngpiàn.
examples.en: This swindler is so brazen that he dares to cheat people on the street.

examples.zh: 他说话很猖狂，根本不把别人放在眼里。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn chāngkuáng, gēnběn bù bǎ biérén fàng zài yǎn lǐ.
examples.en: He talks so arrogantly that he doesn't respect anyone.

examples.zh: 雨下得很猖狂，几乎看不见路。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ xià de hěn chāngkuáng, jīhū kànbújiàn lù.
examples.en: The rain was so fierce that you could barely see the road.

examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jīngjì chāngshèng.
examples.en: The economy of this country is thriving.

examples.zh: 这座小镇在过去几十年里逐渐昌盛起来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎozhèn zài guòqù jǐ shí nián lǐ zhújiàn chāngshèng qǐlái.
examples.en: Over the past few decades this small town has gradually become prosperous.

examples.zh: 希望我们的公司越来越昌盛。
examples.pinyin: Xīwàng wǒmen de gōngsī yuèláiyuè chāngshèng.
examples.en: I hope our company keeps growing more prosperous.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ cháng yi cháng zhège tāng.
examples.en: Have a taste of this soup.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi cháng guo Zhōngguó cài.
examples.en: I haven't yet tried Chinese food.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chángchang zhège dàngāo ba.
examples.en: Go on, try this cake.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn cháng.
examples.en: This book is very long.

examples.pinyin: Tā de míngzi hěn cháng.
examples.en: His name is very long.

examples.pinyin: Tā děng le hěn cháng shíjiān.
examples.en: He waited a very long time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn Chángchéng.
examples.en: I'd like to go and see the Great Wall.

examples.pinyin: Chángchéng hěn cháng, zǒu qǐlai hěn lèi.
examples.en: The Great Wall is very long and tiring to walk.

examples.zh: 周末我们一起去爬长城吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù pá Chángchéng ba.
examples.en: Let's climb the Great Wall together this weekend.

examples.zh: 他已经偿还了所有的贷款。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng chánghuán le suǒyǒu de dàikuǎn.
examples.en: He has paid back all of his loans.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì jǐnkuài chánghuán nǐ de qián.
examples.en: I'll pay you back as soon as I can.

examples.zh: 欠别人的钱，早晚要偿还。
examples.pinyin: Qiàn biéren de qián, zǎowǎn yào chánghuán.
examples.en: Money you owe others must be repaid sooner or later.

examples.pinyin: Chángjiāng shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de hé.
examples.en: The Yangtze is the longest river in China.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zuò chuán yóu Chángjiāng.
examples.en: I'd like to take a boat trip along the Yangtze.

examples.pinyin: Chángjiāng biān de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.en: The scenery along the Yangtze is beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān shàng chángnián yǒu xuě.
examples.en: This mountain has snow all year round.

examples.pinyin: Zhèli chángnián qìwēn hěn dī.
examples.en: It is cold here all year round.

examples.zh: 我们公司常年招聘新人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī chángnián zhāopìn xīnrén.
examples.en: Our company recruits new staff all year round.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yìbān chángshí.
examples.en: This is common knowledge.

examples.pinyin: Tā quēshǎo jīběn de chángshí.
examples.en: He lacks basic common sense.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chángshí hěn fēngfù.
examples.en: You have a lot of general knowledge.

examples.zh: 我想尝试一下新的方法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chángshì yíxià xīn de fāngfǎ.
examples.en: I'd like to try a new method.

examples.zh: 他第一次尝试做蛋糕，失败了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì zuò dàngāo, shībài le.
examples.en: He tried baking a cake for the first time and failed.

examples.zh: 别害怕，先尝试一次再说。
examples.pinyin: Bié hàipà, xiān chángshì yí cì zài shuō.
examples.en: Don't be scared; just give it one try first.

examples.zh: 我给老家打了一个长途电话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi lǎojiā dǎle yí ge chángtú diànhuà.
examples.en: I made a long-distance call to my hometown.

examples.zh: 他坐了一个小时的长途汽车。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòle yí ge xiǎoshí de chángtú qìchē.
examples.en: He took a long-distance bus for an hour.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ chángtú diànhuà guì bu guì?
examples.en: Are long-distance calls expensive?

examples.zh: 他是公司的常务副经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gōngsī de chángwù fùjīnglǐ.
examples.en: He is the executive deputy manager of the company.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen de chángwù gōngzuò.
examples.en: This is our routine work.

examples.zh: 我们每天都要处理常务事务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān dōu yào chǔlǐ chángwù shìwù.
examples.en: We handle routine affairs every day.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kàn le yì chǎng diànyǐng.
examples.en: I watched a film yesterday.

examples.zh: 下了一场大雨，路上都是水。
examples.pinyin: Xià le yì chǎng dà yǔ, lù shàng dōu shì shuǐ.
examples.en: There was a heavy downpour, and the roads were full of water.

examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài nǐ kàn le ma?
examples.en: Did you watch this match?

examples.zh: 在正式的场合，要穿得整齐一点。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèngshì de chǎnghé, yào chuān de zhěngqí yìdiǎn.
examples.en: On formal occasions, dress a bit more neatly.

examples.zh: 这种场合，你应该说话小心一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǎnghé, nǐ yīnggāi shuōhuà xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn.
examples.en: In a setting like this, you should be careful what you say.

examples.zh: 你今天是什么场合要穿这么漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān shì shénme chǎnghé yào chuān zhème piàoliang?
examples.en: What's the occasion that has you dressed up so nicely today?

examples.zh: 他敞开窗户，让风吹进来。
examples.pinyin: Tā chǎngkāi chuānghu, ràng fēng chuījìnlái.
examples.en: He threw the window wide open and let the breeze in.

examples.zh: 门敞开着，欢迎大家进来。
examples.pinyin: Mén chǎngkāizhe, huānyíng dàjiā jìnlái.
examples.en: The door is wide open, and everyone is welcome to come in.

examples.zh: 我们坐下来，敞开谈了很久。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò xiàlái, chǎngkāi tánle hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: We sat down and talked openly for a long time.

examples.zh: 庆祝活动的场面很壮观。
examples.pinyin: Qìngzhù huódòng de chǎngmiàn hěn zhuàngguān.
examples.en: The celebration was a spectacular sight.

examples.zh: 那个场面让我想起了小时候。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge chǎngmiàn ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le xiǎo shíhou.
examples.en: That scene reminded me of when I was little.

examples.zh: 场面太热闹了，我有点不习惯。
examples.pinyin: Chǎngmiàn tài rènao le, wǒ yǒudiǎn bù xíguàn.
examples.en: It's too lively here, and I'm not used to it.

examples.zh: 图书馆是一个安静的学习场所。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn shì yí ge ānjìng de xuéxí chǎngsuǒ.
examples.en: The library is a quiet place to study.

examples.zh: 公共场所不要大声说话。
examples.pinyin: Gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ bú yào dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't speak loudly in public places.

examples.zh: 你知道附近有没有锻炼的场所？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu duànliàn de chǎngsuǒ?
examples.en: Do you know if there's a place to exercise nearby?

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào chàngdǎo dàjiā duō dúshū.
examples.en: The school encourages everyone to read more.

examples.zh: 这个组织倡导环保生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zǔzhī chàngdǎo huánbǎo shēnghuó.
examples.en: This group promotes an eco-friendly lifestyle.

examples.pinyin: Tā chàngdǎo dàjiā jiéyuē yòngshuǐ.
examples.en: He encourages everyone to save water.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chànggē.
examples.en: I like singing.

examples.pinyin: Tā huì chànggē.
examples.en: She can sing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chànggē ma?
examples.en: Do you sing?

examples.zh: 节假日的时候，高速公路要保持畅通。
examples.pinyin: Jiéjiàrì de shíhou, gāosù gōnglù yào bǎochí chàngtōng.
examples.en: During holidays, motorways need to keep traffic flowing smoothly.

examples.zh: 交警努力让路口保持畅通。
examples.pinyin: Jiāojǐng nǔlì ràng lùkǒu bǎochí chàngtōng.
examples.en: Traffic police work hard to keep the junction clear.

examples.zh: 网络不畅通，我的视频总是卡住。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngluò bú chàngtōng, wǒ de shìpín zǒngshì kǎzhù.
examples.en: The connection is poor, so my video keeps freezing.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū qùnián fēicháng chàngxiāo.
examples.en: This book sold extremely well last year.

examples.zh: 这款饮料很畅销，经常卖断货。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yǐnliào hěn chàngxiāo, jīngcháng màiduànhuò.
examples.en: This drink sells very well and often runs out of stock.

examples.zh: 他写的小说很畅销，已经再版了好几次。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiě de xiǎoshuō hěn chàngxiāo, yǐjīng zàibǎn le hǎo jǐ cì.
examples.en: His novel is a bestseller and has been reprinted several times.

examples.zh: 他向大家提出了一个倡议。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dàjiā tíchū le yí ge chàngyì.
examples.en: He put forward a proposal to everyone.

examples.zh: 这项倡议得到了很多人的支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng chàngyì dédào le hěn duō rén de zhīchí.
examples.en: This initiative won the support of many people.

examples.zh: 学生会倡议大家一起打扫校园。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēnghuì chàngyì dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo xiàoyuán.
examples.en: The student union proposed that everyone clean up the campus together.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè duàn huà chāo xiàlái.
examples.en: Please copy down this passage.

examples.zh: 考试的时候不能抄别人的答案。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou bù néng chāo biérén de dá'àn.
examples.en: You can't copy other people's answers during an exam.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shēngcí chāo le sān biàn.
examples.en: He copied the new words three times.

examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì chāoguò le wǒ.
examples.en: His grades surpassed mine.

examples.zh: 今天的温度超过三十度。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de wēndù chāoguò sānshí dù.
examples.en: Today's temperature is over thirty degrees.

examples.pinyin: Bié chāoguò wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.en: Don't go over fifty kuai.

examples.zh: 这家超市的东西超级便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de dōngxi chāojí piányi.
examples.en: The things in this supermarket are super cheap.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī chāojí kuài ma?
examples.en: Is your phone super fast?

examples.zh: 他不是超级英雄，只是个普通人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì chāojí yīngxióng, zhǐshì ge pǔtōng rén.
examples.en: He isn't a superhero, just an ordinary person.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chāopiào shì jiǎ de ma?
examples.en: Is this banknote fake?

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ chāopiào fàng jìn le qiánbāo.
examples.en: He put the bills into his wallet.

examples.zh: 这些钞票都是新的，很干净。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē chāopiào dōu shì xīn de, hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: These bills are all new and clean.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi.
examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy things.

examples.pinyin: Chāoshì jīntiān kāi mén ma?
examples.en: Is the supermarket open today?

examples.pinyin: Chāoshì lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
examples.en: The supermarket is very close to my home.

examples.zh: 他的成绩超越了所有人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì chāoyuè le suǒyǒu rén.
examples.en: His results surpassed everyone's.

examples.zh: 你有没有想过超越自己？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo chāoyuè zìjǐ?
examples.en: Have you ever thought about surpassing yourself?

examples.zh: 这项技术还没有超越对手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù hái méiyǒu chāoyuè duìshǒu.
examples.en: This technology has not yet overtaken its rivals.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān cháo nán.
examples.en: My room faces south.

examples.pinyin: Tā cháo wǒ zǒu guòlái le.
examples.en: He walked towards me.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cháodài hěn cháng.
examples.en: This dynasty lasted a long time.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō cháodài.
examples.en: China has had many dynasties.

examples.zh: 这座古城的历史跨越多个朝代。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng de lìshǐ kuàyuè duō ge cháodài.
examples.en: The history of this ancient city spans several dynasties.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao nǎxiē cháodài?
examples.en: Which dynasties do you know?

examples.zh: 这件衣服很符合现在的潮流。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn fúhé xiànzài de cháoliú.
examples.en: This piece of clothing is very much in line with current trends.

examples.pinyin: Niánqīng rén xǐhuan zhuīsuí cháoliú.
examples.en: Young people like to follow the latest trends.

examples.zh: 随着潮流的变化，人们的审美也变了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe cháoliú de biànhuà, rénmen de shěnměi yě biàn le.
examples.en: As trends change, people's sense of beauty changes too.

examples.zh: 这个房间很潮湿，不适合住人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn cháoshī, bú shìhé zhù rén.
examples.en: This room is damp and not fit for living in.

examples.zh: 南方的梅雨季节，空气非常潮湿。
examples.pinyin: Nánfāng de méiyǔ jìjié, kōngqì fēicháng cháoshī.
examples.en: In the plum rain season in the south, the air is very humid.

examples.zh: 衣服放久了，有点潮湿，快晒一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Yīfu fàng jiǔ le, yǒudiǎn cháoshī, kuài shài yíxià ba.
examples.en: The clothes have been sitting too long and are a bit damp, so hang them out to dry.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme yào cháoxiào biéren?
examples.en: Why do you laugh at other people?

examples.zh: 他被同学嘲笑了，心里很难过。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi tóngxué cháoxiào le, xīnlǐ hěn nánguò.
examples.en: He was teased by his classmates and felt very hurt.

examples.zh: 大家都嘲笑他的新发型，他却一点也不在意。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu cháoxiào tā de xīn fàxíng, tā què yìdiǎn yě bú zàiyì.
examples.en: Everyone laughed at his new hairstyle, but he didn't care at all.

examples.pinyin: Bié chǎo le, wǒ zài kàn shū.
examples.en: Stop making noise, I'm reading.

examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài chǎo le.
examples.en: It's too noisy outside.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen wèishénme chǎo?
examples.en: Why are you arguing?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma xǐhuan chǎo qīngcài.
examples.en: My mom likes stir-fried green vegetables.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chúfáng lǐ chǎo fàn.
examples.en: He is frying rice in the kitchen.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì chǎo jīdàn?
examples.en: Can you make scrambled eggs?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bié chǎojià le.
examples.en: Let's stop arguing.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi xiǎoshì chǎojià.
examples.en: They quarrel over trifles.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ gēn tā chǎojià le ma?
examples.en: Did you have a fight with him?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chē tíng zài chēkù lǐ.
examples.en: My car is parked in the garage.

examples.pinyin: Chēkù de mén huài le.
examples.en: The garage door is broken.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chēkù yǒu duō dà?
examples.en: How big is your garage?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài chēxiāng de zhōngjiān.
examples.en: I'm sitting in the middle of the carriage.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jié chēxiāng hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This carriage is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Chēxiāng lǐ rén hěn duō.
examples.en: The carriage is very crowded.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào chèdǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān.
examples.en: We need to clean the room thoroughly.

examples.pinyin: Tā chèdǐ gǎibiàn le xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: He completely changed his mind.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào chèdǐ xiǎng yi xiǎng.
examples.en: You should think it through thoroughly.

examples.zh: 面对竞争，他们决定暂时撤退。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì jìngzhēng, tāmen juédìng zhànshí chètuì.
examples.en: Faced with the competition, they decided to pull back for now.

examples.zh: 公司在这个市场上撤退了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zài zhège shìchǎng shàng chètuì le.
examples.en: The company has pulled out of this market.

examples.pinyin: Tuìcháo hòu, hǎishuǐ mànmàn chètuì.
examples.en: After the tide turns, the seawater slowly recedes.

examples.zh: 公司撤销了这项不合理的规定。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī chèxiāo le zhè xiàng bù hélǐ de guīdìng.
examples.en: The company scrapped this unreasonable rule.

examples.zh: 这个申请已经被撤销了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shēnqǐng yǐjīng bèi chèxiāo le.
examples.en: This application has been withdrawn.

examples.zh: 按下这个键，可以撤销刚才的操作。
examples.pinyin: Àn xià zhège jiàn, kěyǐ chèxiāo gāngcái de cāozuò.
examples.en: Press this key to undo your last action.

examples.zh: 水放久了，底部会有沉淀。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ fàng jiǔ le, dǐbù huì yǒu chéndiàn.
examples.en: If water is left standing for long, sediment forms at the bottom.

examples.zh: 经过几年的生活，他的想法慢慢沉淀了下来。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de shēnghuó, tā de xiǎngfǎ mànmàn chéndiànle xiàlái.
examples.en: After years of living, his thinking gradually settled.

examples.zh: 这些经验需要慢慢沉淀。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jīngyàn xūyào mànmàn chéndiàn.
examples.en: These experiences need time to settle into wisdom.

examples.zh: 这间屋子的家具很陈旧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān wūzi de jiājù hěn chénjiù.
examples.en: The furniture in this room is very old.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ yǒudiǎn chénjiù le.
examples.en: This idea is a bit outdated.

examples.zh: 他的衣服虽然陈旧，但很干净。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yīfu suīrán chénjiù, dàn hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: His clothes are old, but they're clean.

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着很多古代的瓷器。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ chénliè zhe hěn duō gǔdài de cíqì.
examples.en: The museum displays many ancient porcelain pieces.

examples.zh: 橱窗里陈列着新款的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Chúchuāng lǐ chénliè zhe xīnkuǎn de yīfu.
examples.en: New-style clothes are on display in the shop window.

examples.zh: 这些照片陈列在走廊里。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn chénliè zài zǒuláng lǐ.
examples.en: These photos are hung along the hallway.

examples.zh: 会议室里的气氛很沉闷。
examples.pinyin: Huìyìshì lǐ de qìfēn hěn chénmèn.
examples.en: The atmosphere in the meeting room is stifling.

examples.zh: 今天天气闷热，人们都觉得很沉闷。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì mēnrè, rénmen dōu juéde hěn chénmèn.
examples.en: It is muggy today and everyone feels oppressed.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn yǒuxiē chénmèn.
examples.en: His voice sounds a bit muffled.

examples.pinyin: Tā chénmò le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: He was silent for a long time.

examples.zh: 大家的沉默让我很紧张。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de chénmò ràng wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: Everyone's silence made me nervous.

examples.zh: 他对这个问题保持沉默。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège wèntí bǎochí chénmò.
examples.en: He kept quiet about this issue.

examples.zh: 他向法官陈述了事情的经过。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng fǎguān chénshù le shìqing de jīngguò.
examples.en: He described to the judge how the matter unfolded.

examples.zh: 请你简单陈述一下你的理由。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jiǎndān chénshù yíxià nǐ de lǐyóu.
examples.en: Please briefly state your reasons.

examples.zh: 老师让我们陈述自己的观点。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen chénshù zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.
examples.en: The teacher asked us to state our views.

examples.zh: 他坐在窗前，静静地沉思。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò zài chuāng qián, jìngjìng de chénsī.
examples.en: He sat by the window, quietly lost in thought.

examples.zh: 她沉思了很久，没有说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā chénsīle hěn jiǔ, méiyǒu shuōhuà.
examples.en: She fell silent in thought for a long time without speaking.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yìxiē shíjiān chénsī.
examples.en: I need some time to reflect.

examples.zh: 这个箱子太沉重了，我搬不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi tài chénzhòng le, wǒ bān bú dòng.
examples.en: This box is too heavy and I can't move it.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他的心情很沉重。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā de xīnqíng hěn chénzhòng.
examples.en: On hearing the news, he felt heavy-hearted.

examples.zh: 我们面临的任务十分沉重。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen miànlín de rènwu shífēn chénzhòng.
examples.en: The task we face is very heavy.

examples.zh: 他遇到紧急情况也很沉着。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng yě hěn chénzhuó.
examples.en: He stays calm even in an emergency.

examples.pinyin: Tā huídá wèntí shí hěn chénzhuó.
examples.en: She stays composed when answering questions.

examples.zh: 比赛中要保持沉着，不要紧张。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng yào bǎochí chénzhuó, bú yào jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: During the match, stay calm and don't get nervous.

examples.pinyin: Chèn rè bǎ tāng hē le ba.
examples.en: Drink the soup while it's hot.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chèn tiānqì hǎo qù páshān.
examples.en: We'll go hiking while the weather is good.

examples.zh: 你趁现在有空，把房间收拾一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chèn xiànzài yǒu kòng, bǎ fángjiān shōushi yíxià.
examples.en: Use your free time now to tidy up the room a bit.

examples.pinyin: Tā chuān zhe yí jiàn bái chènshān.
examples.en: He is wearing a white shirt.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chènshān hěn piányi.
examples.en: This shirt is very cheap.

examples.pinyin: Chènshān tài dà le.
examples.en: The shirt is too big.

examples.zh: 这份工作终于让他称心如意了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò zhōngyú ràng tā chènxīnrúyì le.
examples.en: This job finally made him completely happy.

examples.zh: 一切都称心如意，我很满足。
examples.pinyin: Yíqiè dōu chènxīnrúyì, wǒ hěn mǎnzú.
examples.en: Everything went exactly as I wished, and I'm very content.

examples.zh: 事情不可能总是称心如意。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing bù kěnéng zǒngshì chènxīnrúyì.
examples.en: Things can't always go exactly the way we want.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chēng yíxià zhège xīguā.
examples.en: I want to weigh this watermelon.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chēng guo zìjǐ de tǐzhòng ma?
examples.en: Have you weighed yourself?

examples.pinyin: Zhè dài mǐ chēng le yíxià.
examples.en: I weighed this bag of rice.

examples.zh: 他获得了最佳员工的称号。
examples.pinyin: Tā huòdéle zuì jiā yuángōng de chēnghào.
examples.en: He earned the title of Best Employee.

examples.zh: 她的称号是班长，大家都这样叫她。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chēnghào shì bānzhǎng, dàjiā dōu zhè yàng jiào tā.
examples.en: Her title is class monitor, and everyone calls her that.

examples.zh: 这个称号对他来说很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chēnghào duì tā lái shuō hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: This title means a lot to him.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zěnme chēnghu tā?
examples.en: What should you call him?

examples.zh: 对老师的称呼要有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Duì lǎoshī de chēnghu yào yǒu lǐmào.
examples.en: The way you address your teacher should be polite.

examples.zh: 我不知道该怎么称呼你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdao gāi zěnme chēnghu nǐ.
examples.en: I don't know what to call you.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī chēngzàn le tā de zuòyè.
examples.en: The teacher praised his homework.

examples.zh: 大家都称赞她的字写得好。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu chēngzàn tā de zì xiě de hǎo.
examples.en: Everyone praised her handwriting.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi chēngzàn biérén.
examples.en: You should praise others.

examples.pinyin: Tā chéng huǒchē qù Shànghǎi.
examples.en: He took the train to Shanghai.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chéng dìtiě qù ba.
examples.en: Let's take the subway.

examples.pinyin: Chéngkè qǐng zài zhèli páiduì.
examples.en: Passengers, please queue here.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī chéngzi.
examples.en: I like eating oranges.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu shì chéngsè de.
examples.en: This piece of clothing is orange.

examples.zh: 夕阳把天空染成了橙色。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng bǎ tiānkōng rǎnchéngle chéngsè.
examples.en: The setting sun turned the sky orange.

examples.zh: 盛汤的时候，小心别烫到手。
examples.pinyin: Chéng tāng de shíhou, xiǎoxīn bié tàng dào shǒu.
examples.en: When you ladle out the soup, be careful not to burn your hand.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ chéng yì wǎn fàn.
examples.en: Please help me scoop out a bowl of rice.

examples.zh: 她把汤盛在碗里，端给客人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ tāng chéng zài wǎn lǐ, duān gěi kèrén.
examples.en: She ladled the soup into bowls and served it to the guests.

examples.zh: 这次会议由我们公司承办。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì yóu wǒmen gōngsī chéngbàn.
examples.en: Our company is organizing this meeting.

examples.zh: 这个婚礼是由专业团队承办的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hūnlǐ shì yóu zhuānyè tuánduì chéngbàn de.
examples.en: This wedding was organized by a professional team.

examples.zh: 我们能承办大型活动吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen néng chéngbàn dàxíng huódòng ma?
examples.en: Can we take on large-scale events?

examples.zh: 他承包了村里的一片果园。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngbāo le cūn lǐ de yí piàn guǒyuán.
examples.en: He has contracted a fruit orchard in the village.

examples.zh: 这项工程已经承包给了别的公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngchéng yǐjīng chéngbāo gěi le biéde gōngsī.
examples.en: This project has already been contracted out to another company.

examples.zh: 他们承包房屋装修，已经做了五年。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen chéngbāo fángwū zhuāngxiū, yǐjīng zuò le wǔ nián.
examples.en: They have been doing house renovation contracts for five years.

examples.zh: 那座古老的城堡很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò gǔlǎo de chéngbǎo hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: That ancient castle is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 孩子们最喜欢听城堡里的故事。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zuì xǐhuan tīng chéngbǎo lǐ de gùshi.
examples.en: The children love hearing stories about castles.

examples.zh: 我们去参观了一个中世纪城堡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù cānguān le yí ge zhōngshìjì chéngbǎo.
examples.en: We visited a medieval castle.

examples.zh: 这台机器的成本太高了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì de chéngběn tài gāo le.
examples.en: The cost of this machine is too high.

examples.zh: 降低成本是公司的重要目标。
examples.pinyin: Jiàngdī chéngběn shì gōngsī de zhòngyào mùbiāo.
examples.en: Lowering costs is an important goal for the company.

examples.zh: 你算过这次出国旅行的成本吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ suàn guò zhè cì chūguó lǚxíng de chéngběn ma?
examples.en: Have you worked out what this overseas trip will cost?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chéngdān zérèn.
examples.en: I'll take responsibility for this matter.

examples.zh: 公司承担了所有的费用。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī chéngdān le suǒyǒu de fèiyong.
examples.en: The company covered all the costs.

examples.zh: 他不愿意承担这个工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì chéngdān zhège gōngzuò.
examples.en: He doesn't want to take on this job.

examples.zh: 你的汉语水平是什么程度？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng shì shénme chéngdù?
examples.en: What level is your Chinese?

examples.zh: 这件事的严重程度很高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de yánzhòng chéngdù hěn gāo.
examples.en: This matter is very serious.

examples.zh: 他做饭的程度已经很高了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòfàn de chéngdù yǐjīng hěn gāo le.
examples.en: His cooking skill has already reached a high level.

examples.zh: 这个学生因为迟到受到了惩罚。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuésheng yīnwèi chídào shòudào le chéngfá.
examples.en: This student was punished for being late.

examples.pinyin: Tōu dōngxi shì yào shòu chéngfá de.
examples.en: Stealing will be punished.

examples.zh: 老师没有惩罚他，只是让他道歉。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī méiyǒu chéngfá tā, zhǐshì ràng tā dàoqiàn.
examples.en: The teacher didn't punish him; she just asked him to apologize.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yào de chéngfèn shì shénme?
examples.en: What are the ingredients of this medicine?

examples.zh: 这种饮料的成分很简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào de chéngfèn hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: The ingredients of this drink are simple.

examples.pinyin: Shíwù de chéngfèn yào kàn qīngchu.
examples.en: Check the ingredients of food carefully.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chénggōng le!
examples.en: We succeeded!

examples.pinyin: Zhù nǐ chénggōng.
examples.en: Wishing you success.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng hěn chénggōng.
examples.en: This event was a great success.

examples.zh: 这次研究有了很好的成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yánjiū yǒu le hěn hǎo de chéngguǒ.
examples.en: This research has produced good results.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de nǔlì yǒu le chéngguǒ.
examples.en: Our efforts have paid off.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chéngguǒ zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How are your results?

examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: His grades are very good.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì chéngjì zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How did you do on this exam?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chéngjì bǐ nǐ hǎo.
examples.en: My grades are better than yours.

examples.zh: 双方经过讨论，终于成交了。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng jīngguò tǎolùn, zhōngyú chéngjiāo le.
examples.en: After discussion, both sides finally closed the deal.

examples.zh: 价格太高，这笔生意没有成交。
examples.pinyin: Jiàgé tài gāo, zhè bǐ shēngyi méiyǒu chéngjiāo.
examples.en: The price was too high, so the deal fell through.

examples.zh: 这笔交易很快就成交了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ jiāoyì hěn kuài jiù chéngjiāo le.
examples.en: This deal was closed quickly.

examples.pinyin: Tā qǔdé le hěn dà de chéngjiù.
examples.en: He has achieved a great deal.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zuì dà de chéngjiù.
examples.en: This is my greatest achievement.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme chéngjiù?
examples.en: What have you accomplished?

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn chéngkěn de xiàng wǒ dàoqiàn.
examples.en: He apologized to me sincerely.

examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidu hěn chéngkěn.
examples.en: His attitude is sincere.

examples.zh: 你能诚恳地说出你的想法吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng chéngkěn de shuō chū nǐ de xiǎngfǎ ma?
examples.en: Can you honestly tell me what you think?

examples.zh: 这家公司成立于一九九五年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì yú yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián.
examples.en: This company was founded in 1995.

examples.zh: 我们成立了一个俱乐部。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chénglì le yí ge jùlèbù.
examples.en: We set up a club.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ bù chénglì.
examples.en: Your idea doesn't hold water.

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngnuò huì ànshí huán qián.
examples.en: He promised to repay the money on time.

examples.zh: 我们对客户的承诺一定要兑现。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duì kèhù de chéngnuò yídìng yào duìxiàn.
examples.en: We must keep the promises we make to customers.

examples.zh: 说到做到，才是真正的承诺。
examples.pinyin: Shuō dào zuò dào, cái shì zhēnzhèng de chéngnuò.
examples.en: Doing what you say is what a real commitment means.

examples.zh: 我想澄清一下，这件事不是我做的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chéngqīng yíxià, zhè jiàn shì bú shì wǒ zuò de.
examples.en: I want to set the record straight: I didn't do this.

examples.zh: 水放置一段时间就澄清了。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ fàngzhì yí duàn shíjiān jiù chéngqīng le.
examples.en: Left to stand for a while, the water becomes clear.

examples.zh: 他终于澄清了误会，大家都松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú chéngqīng le wùhuì, dàjiā dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
examples.en: He finally cleared up the misunderstanding, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ cuò le.
examples.en: He admitted he was wrong.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi chéngrèn cuòwù.
examples.en: You should admit your mistake.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù chéngrèn zhège jiéguǒ.
examples.en: I don't accept this result.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge chéngshí de rén.
examples.en: He is an honest person.

examples.pinyin: Zuòrén yào chéngshí.
examples.en: Be honest in how you deal with people.

examples.zh: 我相信你的回答很诚实。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ de huídá hěn chéngshí.
examples.en: I believe your answer was honest.

examples.pinyin: Běijīng shì yí ge dà chéngshì.
examples.en: Beijing is a big city.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This city is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dà chéngshì ma?
examples.en: Do you like big cities?

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngshòu le hěn dà de yālì.
examples.en: He bore a lot of pressure.

examples.zh: 这座桥能承受很重的车。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo néng chéngshòu hěn zhòng de chē.
examples.en: This bridge can bear very heavy trucks.

examples.zh: 你能承受这样的批评吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng chéngshòu zhèyàng de pīpíng ma?
examples.en: Can you take this kind of criticism?

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn chéngshú.
examples.en: He is very mature.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shuǐguǒ hái bù chéngshú.
examples.en: This fruit isn't ripe yet.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎng dà le, biàn de hěn chéngshú.
examples.en: You've grown up and become very mature.

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngtiān wán yóuxì, bù xuéxí.
examples.en: He plays games all day long and doesn't study.

examples.zh: 孩子们成天在院子里跑来跑去。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen chéngtiān zài yuànzi lǐ pǎo lái pǎo qù.
examples.en: The children run around the courtyard all day long.

examples.zh: 这么热的天，你成天待在家里干什么？
examples.pinyin: Zhème rè de tiān, nǐ chéngtiān dāi zài jiā lǐ gàn shénme?
examples.en: It's so hot; what are you doing cooped up at home all day?

examples.pinyin: Tā jiānglái xiǎng chéngwéi yīshēng.
examples.en: He wants to become a doctor in the future.

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngwéi le wǒ de péngyou.
examples.en: He became my friend.

examples.pinyin: Zhèli chéngwéi le wǒ de jiā.
examples.en: This place has become my home.

examples.zh: 乘务员请大家系好安全带。
examples.pinyin: Chéngwùyuán qǐng dàjiā jì hǎo ānquándài.
examples.en: The crew ask everyone to fasten their seatbelts.

examples.zh: 火车上的乘务员很热情。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē shàng de chéngwùyuán hěn rèqíng.
examples.en: The train attendants are very friendly.

examples.zh: 我问乘务员，飞机什么时候到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèn chéngwùyuán, fēijī shénme shíhou dào.
examples.en: I asked the flight attendant when the plane would arrive.

examples.zh: 眼前呈现出一片美丽的风景。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnqián chéngxiàn chū yí piàn měilì de fēngjǐng.
examples.en: A beautiful landscape came into view.

examples.zh: 这些数据呈现出一种新的趋势。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù chéngxiàn chū yì zhǒng xīn de qūshì.
examples.en: These figures reveal a new trend.

examples.zh: 秋天的树叶呈现出金黄色。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de shùyè chéngxiàn chū jīnhuángsè.
examples.en: In autumn, the leaves take on a golden color.

examples.zh: 这种新药的疗效很好，成效明显。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn yào de liáoxiào hěn hǎo, chéngxiào míngxiǎn.
examples.en: This new medicine works very well, with clear results.

examples.zh: 改革已经取得了显著的成效。
examples.pinyin: Gǎigé yǐjīng qǔdé le xiǎnzhù de chéngxiào.
examples.en: The reforms have already produced remarkable results.

examples.zh: 我们的努力没有白费，成效很快就出现了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de nǔlì méiyǒu báifèi, chéngxiào hěn kuài jiù chūxiàn le.
examples.en: Our efforts were not wasted; the results soon appeared.

examples.zh: 他不是成心的，你别生气了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì chéngxīn de, nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.en: He didn't do it on purpose, so don't be angry.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chéngxīn gēn wǒ guò bu qù ma?
examples.en: Are you deliberately making things hard for me?

examples.pinyin: Tā chéngxīn bǎ shìqing gǎozá le.
examples.en: He deliberately messed things up.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngxù zěnme yòng?
examples.en: How do you use this program?

examples.pinyin: Kāihuì de chéngxù hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: The meeting procedure is very simple.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao bànlǐ de chéngxù ma?
examples.en: Do you know the procedure?

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngyǔ shì shénme yìsi?
examples.en: What does this idiom mean?

examples.pinyin: Hànyǔ yǒu hěn duō chéngyǔ.
examples.en: Chinese has many idioms.

examples.zh: 你会用这个成语造句吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng zhège chéngyǔ zàojù ma?
examples.en: Can you make a sentence with this idiom?

examples.zh: 他是我们乐队的新成员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen yuèduì de xīn chéngyuán.
examples.en: He is the new member of our band.

examples.zh: 家庭成员应该互相关心。
examples.pinyin: Jiātíng chéngyuán yīnggāi hùxiāng guānxīn.
examples.en: Family members should look out for each other.

examples.pinyin: Wěiyuánhuì yǒu shí'èr míng chéngyuán.
examples.en: The committee has twelve members.

examples.pinyin: Háizi chéngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
examples.en: The child is growing up very fast.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài nóngcūn chéngzhǎng.
examples.en: I grew up in the countryside.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎli chéngzhǎng?
examples.en: Where did you grow up?

examples.zh: 他向大家表示诚挚的感谢。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dàjiā biǎoshì chéngzhì de gǎnxiè.
examples.en: He expressed his sincere thanks to everyone.

examples.zh: 这封信的语气很诚挚吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn de yǔqì hěn chéngzhì ma?
examples.en: Is the tone of this letter sincere?

examples.pinyin: Tā de huà bìng bù chéngzhì.
examples.en: His words were not sincere.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chéngzuò fēijī qù Běijīng.
examples.en: We're flying to Beijing.

examples.zh: 他每天乘坐公交车上班。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān chéngzuò gōngjiāochē shàngbān.
examples.en: He takes the bus to work every day.

examples.pinyin: Chéngzuò diàntī yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: Be careful when you take the lift.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tái chèng hěn zhǔn.
examples.en: This scale is very accurate.

examples.zh: 请帮我用秤称一下这些水果。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ yòng chèng chēng yíxià zhèxiē shuǐguǒ.
examples.en: Please weigh these fruits on the scale for me.

examples.zh: 卖菜的老板把秤放在桌上。
examples.pinyin: Màicài de lǎobǎn bǎ chèng fàng zài zhuō shang.
examples.en: The vegetable seller put the scale on the table.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chī Zhōngguó cài.
examples.en: We eat Chinese food.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chī fàn le ma?
examples.en: Have you eaten?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
examples.en: What do you want to eat?

examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì ràng wǒ hěn chījīng.
examples.en: His results really surprised me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié chījīng.
examples.en: Don't be surprised.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chījīng de kànzhe tā.
examples.en: I stared at him in surprise.

examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yào xuéhuì chīkǔ.
examples.en: Young people need to learn to endure hardship.

examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù chīkǔ, hěn nénggàn.
examples.en: He has been hardworking since childhood and very capable.

examples.pinyin: Wèile mèngxiǎng, wǒ yuànyì chīkǔ.
examples.en: For my dream, I'm willing to put up with hardship.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shēngyi cónglái bù chī kuī.
examples.en: He never comes out behind in business.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì nǐ chī kuī le.
examples.en: You got the short end of the stick this time.

examples.zh: 便宜卖了，我觉得自己吃亏。
examples.pinyin: Piányi mài le, wǒ juéde zìjǐ chī kuī.
examples.en: I sold it too cheap and feel I lost out.

examples.zh: 这本书太难了，我看得很吃力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài nán le, wǒ kàn de hěn chīlì.
examples.en: This book is so hard that I struggle to read it.

examples.zh: 他提着重东西走路，很吃力。
examples.pinyin: Tā tí zhe zhòng dōngxi zǒulù, hěn chīlì.
examples.en: He walks along carrying heavy things, and it's hard work.

examples.zh: 这个工作对他来说有点吃力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò duì tā láishuō yǒudiǎn chīlì.
examples.en: This job is a bit of a strain for him.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ chídào le.
examples.en: Sorry, I'm late.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yòu chídào le.
examples.en: He was late again today.

examples.pinyin: Shàngkè bù néng chídào.
examples.en: You must not be late for class.

examples.pinyin: Lǎorén de dòngzuò yǒuxiē chíhuǎn.
examples.en: The old man's movements are a bit slow.

examples.zh: 他反应迟缓，需要多一点时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnyìng chíhuǎn, xūyào duō yìdiǎn shíjiān.
examples.en: He reacts slowly and needs a little more time.

examples.pinyin: Jīngjì zēngzhǎng biàn de chíhuǎn.
examples.en: Economic growth has become sluggish.

examples.zh: 这种电池的续航很持久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng diànchí de xùháng hěn chíjiǔ.
examples.en: This battery lasts a long time on a charge.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de yǒuyì fēicháng chíjiǔ.
examples.en: Their friendship has lasted a very long time.

examples.zh: 只有坚持不懈，才能获得持久的成功。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jiānchí bú xiè, cái néng huòdé chíjiǔ de chénggōng.
examples.en: Only persistence brings lasting success.

examples.pinyin: Chítáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō jīnyú.
examples.en: There are many goldfish in the pond.

examples.zh: 夏天的晚上，池塘边很凉快。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de wǎnshang, chítáng biān hěn liángkuai.
examples.en: On summer evenings, it is cool by the pond.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài chítáng biān diào yú.
examples.en: The children are fishing by the pond.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ chíxù le sān tiān.
examples.en: The rain lasted three days.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jìnbù huì chíxù xiàqù.
examples.en: This progress will continue.

examples.zh: 我们要保持持续学习的习惯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎochí chíxù xuéxí de xíguàn.
examples.en: We should keep up the habit of continuous learning.

examples.zh: 他迟疑了一下，才回答我。
examples.pinyin: Tā chíyí le yíxià, cái huídá wǒ.
examples.en: He hesitated for a moment before answering me.

examples.zh: 面对这个机会，她有些迟疑。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhège jīhuì, tā yǒuxiē chíyí.
examples.en: She was a little hesitant about this opportunity.

examples.pinyin: Bié chíyí le, kuài zuò juédìng ba!
examples.en: Don't hesitate, make a decision!

examples.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu yí ge xiǎo chízi.
examples.en: There's a small pond in the yard.

examples.pinyin: Chízi lǐ yǒu hěn duō yú.
examples.en: There are many fish in the pond.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài chízi biān wán.
examples.en: The children are playing by the pond.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yì bǎ chǐzi.
examples.en: I need a ruler.

examples.pinyin: Chǐzi shàng yǒu límǐ de kèdù.
examples.en: The ruler has centimeter markings.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chǐzi zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is your ruler?

examples.pinyin: Xiǎo niǎo zhāngkāi chìbǎng fēi le.
examples.en: The little bird spread its wings and flew.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī niǎo de chìbǎng hěn dà.
examples.en: This bird's wings are very large.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duō xīwàng néng yǒu chìbǎng.
examples.en: I wish I had wings.

examples.pinyin: Xīnjiāpō kàojìn chìdào.
examples.en: Singapore is close to the equator.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù guo chìdào fùjìn ma?
examples.en: Have you ever been near the equator?

examples.pinyin: Chìdào fùjìn de tiānqì hěn rè.
examples.en: The weather near the equator is very hot.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián chūxiàn le chìzì.
examples.en: The company is in the red this year.

examples.zh: 政府的赤字为什么增加了？
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ de chìzì wèishénme zēngjiā le?
examples.en: Why has the government's deficit grown?

examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒmen méiyǒu chìzì.
examples.en: We didn't run a deficit this month.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng lěngshuǐ chōng le yíxià liǎn.
examples.en: I rinsed my face with cold water.

examples.pinyin: Tā chōngjìn le jiàoshì.
examples.en: He rushed into the classroom.

examples.zh: 这杯咖啡用热水冲一下就能喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi kāfēi yòng rèshuǐ chōng yíxià jiù néng hē.
examples.en: Just pour hot water over this coffee and you can drink it.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng chōngdāng cáipàn.
examples.en: He acts as the referee in the competition.

examples.zh: 这个箱子充当了临时的桌子。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi chōngdāng le línshí de zhuōzi.
examples.en: This box serves as a temporary table.

examples.zh: 妈妈总是充当我们的好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Māma zǒngshì chōngdāng wǒmen de hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: Mom always acts as our good friend.

examples.zh: 我的充电器忘在家里了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chōngdiànqì wàng zài jiā lǐ le.
examples.en: I left my charger at home.

examples.zh: 这个充电器可以用在很多手机上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge chōngdiànqì kěyǐ yòng zài hěn duō shǒujī shàng.
examples.en: This charger works with many phones.

examples.zh: 我的手机没电了，你有充电器吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le, nǐ yǒu chōngdiànqì ma?
examples.en: My phone is dead; do you have a charger?

examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì tài chōngdòng le.
examples.en: He acts far too impulsively.

examples.zh: 我一时冲动，买了一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìshí chōngdòng, mǎi le yí jiàn yīfu.
examples.en: On an impulse, I bought a piece of clothing.

examples.pinyin: Lěngjìng yìdiǎn, bié chōngdòng.
examples.en: Calm down, and don't act on impulse.

examples.zh: 你要充分准备，再去面试。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào chōngfèn zhǔnbèi, zài qù miànshì.
examples.en: Prepare thoroughly before you go to the interview.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu chōngfèn de shíjiān.
examples.en: We have plenty of time.

examples.zh: 这段话充分说明了问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn huà chōngfèn shuōmíng le wèntí.
examples.en: This passage fully explains the issue.

examples.zh: 这个消息对他的冲击很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi duì tā de chōngjī hěn dà.
examples.en: The news came as a huge shock to him.

examples.zh: 海浪不停地冲击着岸边。
examples.pinyin: Hǎilàng bùtíng de chōngjīzhe àn biān.
examples.en: Waves kept crashing against the shore.

examples.zh: 经济危机冲击了很多公司。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì wēijī chōngjī le hěn duō gōngsī.
examples.en: The economic downturn hit many companies hard.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fángjiān chōngmǎn le yángguāng.
examples.en: This room is full of sunshine.

examples.zh: 他的声音里充满了信心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn lǐ chōngmǎn le xìnxīn.
examples.en: His voice is full of confidence.

examples.zh: 孩子们的笑声充满了院子。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen de xiàoshēng chōngmǎn le yuànzi.
examples.en: The children's laughter filled the yard.

examples.zh: 他精力充沛，每天都很有活力。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīnglì chōngpèi, měitiān dōu hěn yǒu huólì.
examples.en: He is full of energy and lively every day.

examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yǔshuǐ chōngpèi.
examples.en: Summer brings plenty of rain.

examples.zh: 睡足了觉，人就会精神充沛。
examples.pinyin: Shuì zú le jiào, rén jiù huì jīngshen chōngpèi.
examples.en: After a good sleep, you feel full of vigour.

examples.pinyin: Zhè yì nián de shēnghuó hěn chōngshí.
examples.en: This year was a full and satisfying one.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu guò de hěn chōngshí.
examples.en: Every day I live a full life.

examples.pinyin: Duō dúshū kěyǐ chōngshí zìjǐ.
examples.en: Reading more can enrich yourself.

examples.zh: 两个人因为小事发生了冲突。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén yīnwèi xiǎoshì fāshēng le chōngtū.
examples.en: The two of them had a clash over a trivial matter.

examples.zh: 我的工作时间和课程有冲突。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò shíjiān hé kèchéng yǒu chōngtū.
examples.en: My work hours clash with my classes.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yīnggāi bìmiǎn chōngtū.
examples.en: Everyone should try to avoid conflict.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de shíjiān hěn chōngzú.
examples.en: We have plenty of time.

examples.zh: 这间屋子的阳光很充足。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān wūzi de yángguāng hěn chōngzú.
examples.en: This room gets plenty of sunshine.

examples.zh: 他准备得很充足，不用担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi de hěn chōngzú, búyòng dānxīn.
examples.en: He's well prepared, so there's no need to worry.

examples.zh: 很多年轻人崇拜音乐家。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén chóngbài yīnyuèjiā.
examples.en: Many young people idolize musicians.

examples.zh: 他对大自然有一种崇拜。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì dà zìrán yǒu yì zhǒng chóngbài.
examples.en: He has a kind of reverence for nature.

examples.zh: 我不崇拜任何人，只相信自己。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù chóngbài rènhé rén, zhǐ xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
examples.en: I don't idolize anyone; I only trust myself.

examples.zh: 这两件事的时间重叠了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì de shíjiān chóngdié le.
examples.en: The times of these two things overlap.

examples.zh: 这两幅画的颜色有些重叠。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fú huà de yánsè yǒuxiē chóngdié.
examples.en: The colors of these two paintings overlap a little.

examples.zh: 我的课程和他的重叠，不能一起上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de kèchéng hé tā de chóngdié, bù néng yìqǐ shàng.
examples.en: My classes overlap with his, so we can't take them together.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào chóngfù zhè jù huà.
examples.en: Please don't repeat this sentence.

examples.zh: 这篇文章有很多重复的内容。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǒu hěn duō chóngfù de nèiróng.
examples.en: This article has a lot of repeated content.

examples.zh: 你说的话和他说的重复了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de huà hé tā shuō de chóngfù le.
examples.en: What you said repeats what he said.

examples.zh: 帮助别人是一种崇高的品质。
examples.pinyin: Bāngzhù biérén shì yì zhǒng chónggāo de pǐnzhì.
examples.en: Helping others is a noble quality.

examples.pinyin: Tā de lǐxiǎng fēicháng chónggāo.
examples.en: His ideals are very lofty.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò hěn chónggāo.
examples.en: A doctor's work is very noble.

examples.pinyin: Rénmen duì lǎoshī fēicháng chóngjìng.
examples.en: People hold teachers in deep respect.

examples.zh: 他怀着崇敬的心情走进博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Tā huáizhe chóngjìng de xīnqíng zǒu jìn bówùguǎn.
examples.en: He walked into the museum with a feeling of reverence.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā chóngjìng zhè wèi lǎo xiàozhǎng.
examples.en: Everyone reveres this former principal.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chóngxīn kāishǐ ba.
examples.en: Let's start again.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ chóngxīn xiě yí biàn.
examples.en: Please write it out again.

examples.pinyin: Tā chóngxīn zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.en: He found a job again.

examples.zh: 重阳节那天，我们一家人去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Chóngyángjié nà tiān, wǒmen yì jiā rén qù páshān.
examples.en: On the Double Ninth Festival, our family went hiking.

examples.zh: 重阳节要登高，全家一起出门。
examples.pinyin: Chóngyángjié yào dēnggāo, quán jiā yìqǐ chūmén.
examples.en: On the Double Ninth Festival, families go up high places together.

examples.zh: 奶奶每年重阳节都会做糕点。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai měi nián Chóngyángjié dōu huì zuò gāodiǎn.
examples.en: Grandma makes pastries every year for the Double Ninth Festival.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī chǒngwù māo.
examples.en: We have a pet cat at home.

examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xǐhuan yǎng chǒngwù.
examples.en: Many people like keeping pets.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chǒngwù jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.en: What's your pet's name?

examples.zh: 你什么时候能抽空来看看我？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou néng chōukòng lái kànkan wǒ?
examples.en: When can you find time to come and see me?

examples.zh: 我今天很忙，没法抽空吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng, méifǎ chōukòng chī wǔfàn.
examples.en: I'm so busy today that I can't find time for lunch.

examples.zh: 他每周都抽空去健身房锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu chōukòng qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
examples.en: He makes time every week to work out at the gym.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi zài chōuti lǐ.
examples.en: My keys are in the drawer.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ wénjiàn fàng jìn chōuti.
examples.en: Please put the documents in the drawer.

examples.pinyin: Chōuti lǐ méiyǒu zhǐ le.
examples.en: There's no paper left in the drawer.

examples.zh: 这幅画很抽象，我看不懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà hěn chōuxiàng, wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
examples.en: This painting is very abstract; I can't make sense of it.

examples.pinyin: Zhège gàiniàn tài chōuxiàng le.
examples.en: This concept is too abstract.

examples.zh: 你能说得具体一点吗？别这么抽象。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng shuō de jùtǐ yìdiǎn ma? Bié zhème chōuxiàng.
examples.en: Can you be more specific? Don't be so abstract.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bù yào zài zhèli chōuyān.
examples.en: Please don't smoke here.

examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bù chōuyān le.
examples.en: He has already quit smoking.

examples.pinyin: Zhèli bù néng chōuyān.
examples.en: You can't smoke here.

examples.zh: 我们正在筹备一场生日派对。
