examples.zh: 他向学生传授写作的技巧。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng xuésheng chuánshòu xiězuò de jìqiǎo.
examples.en: He teaches students the skills of writing.

examples.zh: 老师把经验传授给年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ jīngyàn chuánshòu gěi niánqīngrén.
examples.en: The teacher passes on her experience to young people.

examples.zh: 这位老人愿意传授手艺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén yuànyì chuánshòu shǒuyì.
examples.en: This old man is willing to pass on his craft.

examples.zh: 这个地方有一个古老的传说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìfang yǒu yí ge gǔlǎo de chuánshuō.
examples.en: There is an ancient legend about this place.

examples.zh: 这个故事是传说还是真的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gùshi shì chuánshuō háishi zhēn de?
examples.en: Is this story a legend or is it true?

examples.zh: 很多人都听过月亮上的传说。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu tīng guo Yuèliang shàng de chuánshuō.
examples.en: Many people have heard the legend about the moon.

examples.zh: 春节是中国的传统节日。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó de chuántǒng jiérì.
examples.en: Spring Festival is a traditional Chinese holiday.

examples.zh: 我们家保留着传统习惯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā bǎoliú zhe chuántǒng xíguàn.
examples.en: Our family keeps some old traditions.

examples.zh: 你喜欢传统音乐还是流行音乐？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan chuántǒng yīnyuè háishi liúxíng yīnyuè?
examples.en: Do you prefer traditional music or pop music?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ fā yí ge chuánzhēn.
examples.en: Please send me a fax.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de chuánzhēn hàomǎ shì duōshao?
examples.en: What's your fax number?

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de chuánzhēn huài le.
examples.en: The company's fax machine is broken.

examples.zh: 他跑得太快，一直在喘气。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de tài kuài, yìzhí zài chuǎnqì.
examples.en: He ran so fast that he kept gasping for breath.

examples.zh: 爬完山，大家都累得直喘气。
examples.pinyin: Pá wán shān, dàjiā dōu lèi de zhí chuǎnqì.
examples.en: After climbing the hill, everyone was too tired to do anything but pant.

examples.zh: 你喘气这么重，是不是病了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuǎnqì zhème zhòng, shì bu shì bìng le?
examples.en: You're breathing so heavily; are you ill?

examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yí chuàn pútao.
examples.en: He bought a bunch of grapes.

examples.zh: 我们在街上吃烤羊肉串。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiē shàng chī kǎo yángròu chuàn.
examples.en: We ate lamb skewers on the street.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yàoshi guà chéng yí chuàn.
examples.en: His keys are hanging together on a ring.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chuānghu guān shàng.
examples.en: Please close the window.

examples.pinyin: Chuānghu wàimiàn yǒu yì kē dà shù.
examples.en: There's a big tree outside the window.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān de chuānghu hěn dà.
examples.en: The window in this room is very large.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chuānglián lā shàng.
examples.en: Please draw the curtains.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chuānglián shì lánsè de.
examples.en: These curtains are blue.

examples.zh: 房间里太亮了，你关上窗帘吧。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ tài liàng le, nǐ guānshang chuānglián ba.
examples.en: The room is too bright, so close the curtains.

examples.zh: 我想换一张干净的床单。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yì zhāng gānjìng de chuángdān.
examples.en: I want to change to a clean bedsheet.

examples.pinyin: Chuángdān yào jīngcháng xǐ.
examples.en: Bedsheets should be washed often.

examples.zh: 这条床单的颜色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo chuángdān de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This sheet is a beautiful color.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chuǎng chū yì tiáo xīn lù.
examples.en: He wants to forge a new path.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng chuǎng hóngdēng.
examples.en: You mustn't run a red light.

examples.pinyin: Tā chuǎngjìnle fángjiān.
examples.en: He barged into the room.

examples.zh: 这家公司是十年前创立的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì shí nián qián chuànglì de.
examples.en: This company was founded ten years ago.

examples.zh: 他创立了一个读书小组。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuànglì le yí ge dúshū xiǎozǔ.
examples.en: He founded a reading group.

examples.zh: 老师希望创立一个新的学习计划。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xīwàng chuànglì yí ge xīn de xuéxí jìhuà.
examples.en: The teacher hopes to set up a new study plan.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào búduàn chuàngxīn.
examples.en: The company needs to keep innovating.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shèjì hěn yǒu chuàngxīn.
examples.en: This design is very innovative.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi gǎnyú chuàngxīn.
examples.en: We should dare to innovate.

examples.zh: 他毕业后就开始创业了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìyè hòu jiù kāishǐ chuàngyè le.
examples.en: After graduating, he started his own business.

examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén chuàngyè xūyào yǒngqì.
examples.en: Young people who start a business need courage.

examples.zh: 他们一起创业，开了一家小咖啡店。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yìqǐ chuàngyè, kāi le yì jiā xiǎo kāfēidiàn.
examples.en: They started a business together and opened a small coffee shop.

examples.zh: 我们要创造一个好环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào chuàngzào yí ge hǎo huánjìng.
examples.en: We want to create a good environment.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu chuàngzàolì.
examples.en: He is very creative.

examples.zh: 这首歌是他自己创造的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē shì tā zìjǐ chuàngzào de.
examples.en: He wrote this song all by himself.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chuàngzuò yì shǒu xīn gē.
examples.en: He is composing a new song.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shì tā de chuàngzuò.
examples.en: This painting is her own creation.

examples.zh: 写小说是一种很有意思的创作。
examples.pinyin: Xiě xiǎoshuō shì yì zhǒng hěn yǒu yìsi de chuàngzuò.
examples.en: Writing novels is a very interesting kind of creative work.

examples.zh: 外面风很大，吹得我头发乱了。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng hěn dà, chuī de wǒ tóufa luàn le.
examples.en: The wind outside is so strong it messed up my hair.

examples.pinyin: Tā huì chuī kǒushào.
examples.en: He can whistle.

examples.pinyin: Bié chuīniú le.
examples.en: Stop bragging.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòu zài chuīniú le, nǐ bié xìn.
examples.en: He's bragging again, so don't believe him.

examples.zh: 我不是吹牛，我真的会游泳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì chuīniú, wǒ zhēn de huì yóuyǒng.
examples.en: I'm not bragging; I really can swim.

examples.zh: 他们喜欢坐在一起吹牛。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xǐhuan zuò zài yìqǐ chuīniú.
examples.en: They like sitting together and chatting.

examples.zh: 他总是吹捧老板，大家都不喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chuīpěng lǎobǎn, dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuan.
examples.en: He always flatters the boss, and nobody likes it.

examples.zh: 别听他吹捧，他的话不能全信。
examples.pinyin: Bié tīng tā chuīpěng, tā de huà bù néng quán xìn.
examples.en: Don't listen to his flattery; you can't believe everything he says.

examples.zh: 你不用吹捧我，我知道自己的水平。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú yòng chuīpěng wǒ, wǒ zhīdào zìjǐ de shuǐpíng.
examples.en: You don't need to flatter me; I know my own level.

examples.zh: 爸爸用锤子把钉子敲进墙里。
examples.pinyin: Bàba yòng chuízi bǎ dīngzi qiāo jìn qiáng lǐ.
examples.en: Dad used a hammer to knock the nail into the wall.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng chuízi xiū hǎo le yǐzi.
examples.en: He fixed the chair with a hammer.

examples.zh: 这个锤子很重，拿起来有点费劲。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chuízi hěn zhòng, náqǐlái yǒudiǎn fèijìn.
examples.en: This hammer is heavy and a bit hard to lift.

examples.zh: 这面墙和地面是垂直的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiáng hé dìmiàn shì chuízhí de.
examples.en: This wall is perpendicular to the floor.

examples.zh: 请把这张画挂得垂直一点。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng huà guà de chuízhí yìdiǎn.
examples.en: Please hang this picture a bit more vertically.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì huà chuízhí de xiàn ma?
examples.en: Can you draw a straight vertical line?

examples.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, huā kāi le.
examples.en: Spring has come and the flowers are out.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chūntiān.
examples.en: I like spring.

examples.pinyin: Chūnjié nǐ huí jiā ma?
examples.en: Are you going home for Spring Festival?

examples.zh: 我这么做纯粹是为了帮你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhème zuò chúncuì shì wèile bāng nǐ.
examples.en: I did this purely to help you.

examples.zh: 这不是纯粹的爱好，而是我的工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì chúncuì de àihào, ér shì wǒ de gōngzuò.
examples.en: This isn't just a hobby; it's my job.

examples.zh: 他的回答纯粹是为了让大家安心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá chúncuì shì wèile ràng dàjiā ānxīn.
examples.en: His answer was purely meant to put everyone at ease.

examples.pinyin: Háizi de yǎnjing hěn chúnjié.
examples.en: A child's eyes are so innocent.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xīndì hěn chúnjié.
examples.en: He has a pure heart.

examples.zh: 雪白的雪花看起来很纯洁。
examples.pinyin: Xuěbái de xuěhuā kàn qǐlai hěn chúnjié.
examples.en: The snowflakes, pure white, look so untouched.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu yì pán cídài.
examples.en: We have a cassette tape at home.

examples.pinyin: Zhè pán cídài shì lǎo gē.
examples.en: This tape has old songs.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái tīng cídài ma?
examples.en: Do you still listen to cassette tapes?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì běn Hànyǔ cídiǎn.
examples.en: I bought a Chinese dictionary.

examples.zh: 查词典可以知道生词的意思。
examples.pinyin: Chá cídiǎn kěyǐ zhīdào shēngcí de yìsi.
examples.en: Looking up a dictionary tells you what new words mean.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn hěn yǒuyòng.
examples.en: This dictionary is very useful.

examples.zh: 学习外语，首先要积累词汇。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ, shǒuxiān yào jīlěi cíhuì.
examples.en: When learning a language, you must first build up your vocabulary.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de cíhuìliàng yǒu duō dà?
examples.en: How big is your vocabulary?

examples.zh: 这篇文章的词汇不太难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de cíhuì bú tài nán.
examples.en: The vocabulary in this article isn't too difficult.

examples.zh: 奶奶的脸上总是带着慈祥的笑容。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai de liǎn shàng zǒngshì dài zhe cíxiáng de xiàoróng.
examples.en: Grandma always wears a kind smile.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoyéye de yǎnshén hěn cíxiáng.
examples.en: The old grandpa has a kindly look in his eyes.

examples.zh: 她是一位慈祥的老师，我们都喜欢她。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi cíxiáng de lǎoshī, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: She is a kind teacher, and we all like her.

examples.zh: 这两只鸟很难分清雌雄。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhī niǎo hěn nán fēnqīng cíxióng.
examples.en: It's hard to tell these two birds apart by sex.

examples.pinyin: Bǐsài hái méiyǒu fēnchū cíxióng.
examples.en: The contest has not yet decided a winner.

examples.zh: 两人为了争第一，决一雌雄。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng rén wèile zhēng dì yī, jué yī cíxióng.
examples.en: The two of them faced off to decide who was the better one.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cíyǔ shì shénme yìsi?
examples.en: What does this word mean?

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cíyǔ wǒ dōu bú rènshi.
examples.en: I don't know any of these words.

examples.zh: 这个词语很难，我不明白。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cíyǔ hěn nán, wǒ bù míngbai.
examples.en: This word is hard, I don't understand it.

examples.zh: 他因为身体不好辞职了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo cízhí le.
examples.en: He resigned because his health wasn't good.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme yào cízhí?
examples.en: Why do you want to resign?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng cízhí.
examples.en: I don't want to quit my job.

examples.pinyin: Cǐwài, wǒ hái xiǎng mǎi yì běn shū.
examples.en: I also want to buy a book.

examples.zh: 这里有很多好吃的，此外风景也很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de, cǐwài fēngjǐng yě hěn hǎo.
examples.en: There's lots of good food here; besides, the scenery is lovely.

examples.pinyin: Cǐwài, nǐ hái yǒu shénme wèntí?
examples.en: Apart from that, do you have any other questions?

examples.pinyin: Méiguīhuā shàng yǒu hěn duō cì.
examples.en: Rose stems are covered in thorns.

examples.zh: 这根刺扎进了我的手指。
examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn cì zhājìn le wǒ de shǒuzhǐ.
examples.en: This splinter has gone into my finger.

examples.pinyin: Tā de huà hěn cì'ěr.
examples.en: His words grated on me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shuō yí cì.
examples.en: I'll say it once more.

examples.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ lái, tā dōu zài jiā.
examples.en: Every time I come, he's at home.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen qù Běijīng.
examples.en: This time we're going to Beijing.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的服务员伺候得很周到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwùyuán cìhou de hěn zhōudào.
examples.en: The waiters at this restaurant look after you very attentively.

examples.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，需要人伺候。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai niánjì dà le, xūyào rén cìhou.
examples.en: Grandma is old now and needs someone to look after her.

examples.zh: 他每天都细心地伺候花草。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu xìxīn de cìhou huācǎo.
examples.en: He carefully tends his plants every day.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn cìjī.
examples.en: This movie is very thrilling.

examples.pinyin: Là de dōngxi huì cìjī wèi.
examples.en: Spicy food can irritate the stomach.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāoxi cìjī le tā.
examples.en: This news really stirred him up.

examples.pinyin: Zhè pī chǎnpǐn yǒu hěn duō cìpǐn.
examples.en: This batch of products has many defective items.

examples.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de cìpǐn dōu dǎle zhé.
examples.en: All the seconds in the shop are on sale.

examples.zh: 检查时发现了几件次品。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎnchá shí fāxiànle jǐ jiàn cìpǐn.
examples.en: A few defective pieces were found during inspection.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào cìxù páiduì.
examples.en: Please queue in order.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge zì de cìxù bú duì.
examples.en: The order of these characters is wrong.

examples.zh: 我们要按照时间次序整理照片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào ànzhào shíjiān cìxù zhěnglǐ zhàopiàn.
examples.en: We need to sort the photos into chronological order.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì cìyào de.
examples.en: This matter is secondary.

examples.zh: 我们先解决主要问题，次要的以后再说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān jiějué zhǔyào wèntí, cìyào de yǐhòu zài shuō.
examples.en: Let's solve the main problems first and deal with the minor ones later.

examples.zh: 颜色是次要的，关键是质量。
examples.pinyin: Yánsè shì cìyào de, guānjiàn shì zhìliàng.
examples.en: Color matters less; quality is what counts.

examples.pinyin: Tā cōngmáng de pǎo chū le mén.
examples.en: He rushed out the door.

examples.zh: 早上很匆忙，我忘了吃早饭。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang hěn cōngmáng, wǒ wàng le chī zǎofàn.
examples.en: The morning was so rushed that I forgot to eat breakfast.

examples.pinyin: Bié zhème cōngmáng, mànmàn lái.
examples.en: Don't be in such a rush; take your time.

examples.zh: 他是一个很聪明的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge hěn cōngming de háizi.
examples.en: He is a very clever child.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn cōngming!
examples.en: You're really clever!

examples.pinyin: Cōngmíng de rén bú huì zhèyàng zuò.
examples.en: A clever person wouldn't do it this way.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng Běijīng lái.
examples.en: I come from Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào chēzhàn yuǎn bu yuǎn?
examples.en: Is it far from here to the station?

examples.zh: 我从明天开始学习汉语。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng míngtiān kāishǐ xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I will start studying Chinese from tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu yì cóng zhúzi.
examples.en: There is a clump of bamboo in the yard.

examples.pinyin: Yì cóng cǎo zhǎng zài shítou pángbiān.
examples.en: A tuft of grass grows beside the rock.

examples.pinyin: Shù xià yǒu yì cóng huā.
examples.en: There is a cluster of flowers under the tree.

examples.zh: 从此以后，我每天都早起。
examples.pinyin: Cóngcǐ yǐhòu, wǒ měi tiān dōu zǎo qǐ.
examples.en: From now on, I get up early every day.

examples.zh: 他们从此再也没有见面。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóngcǐ zài yě méiyǒu jiànmiàn.
examples.en: They never saw each other again after that.

examples.pinyin: Cóngcǐ, wǒ kāishǐ xǐhuan pǎobù.
examples.en: From then on, I started to enjoy running.

examples.pinyin: Duō liànxí, cóng'ér tígāo kǒuyǔ.
examples.en: Practice more, and thereby improve your speaking.

examples.zh: 我们互相帮助，从而更容易完成工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hùxiāng bāngzhù, cóng'ér gèng róngyì wánchéng gōngzuò.
examples.en: We help each other, which makes the work easier to finish.

examples.zh: 他早点睡，从而精神更好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǎo diǎn shuì, cóng'ér jīngshen gèng hǎo.
examples.en: He goes to bed early, so he feels better.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi chī guo zhège.
examples.en: I have never eaten this.

examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái bù chídào.
examples.en: He is never late.

examples.zh: 你从来没有去过上海吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cónglái méiyǒu qù guo Shànghǎi ma?
examples.en: Have you never been to Shanghai?

examples.zh: 从前这里是一个小村子。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián zhèlǐ shì yí ge xiǎo cūnzi.
examples.en: This used to be a small village.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóngqián bù xǐhuan hē kāfēi.
examples.en: I didn't used to like coffee.

examples.pinyin: Cóngqián de shēnghuó hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.en: Life used to be very hard.

examples.zh: 他面对记者的提问，从容不迫地回答。
examples.pinyin: Tā miànduì jìzhě de tíwèn, cóngróng bú pò de huídá.
examples.en: Facing the journalist's questions, he answered calmly.

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shí tā hěn cóngróng bú pò.
examples.en: He stayed very calm during the exam.

examples.zh: 老师从容不迫地讲完了课。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī cóngróng bú pò de jiǎng wán le kè.
examples.en: The teacher finished the lesson calmly and without hurry.

examples.pinyin: Tā cóngshì jiàoyù gōngzuò.
examples.en: She works in education.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge cóngshì xiāoshòu gōngzuò.
examples.en: My older brother works in sales.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cóngshì shénme gōngzuò?
examples.en: What kind of work do you want to do?

examples.zh: 房间虽然小，但我们可以凑合住。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān suīrán xiǎo, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ còuhe zhù.
examples.en: The room is small, but we can make do with it.

examples.zh: 今天的饭菜还可以，凑合吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de fàncài hái kěyǐ, còuhe chī ba.
examples.en: Today's food is passable, so let's just eat it.

examples.zh: 没有合适的东西，只能凑合用一下。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu héshì de dōngxi, zhǐ néng còuhe yòng yíxià.
examples.en: There's nothing suitable, so I'll just have to make do.

examples.zh: 他说话很粗鲁，大家都不喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn cūlǔ, dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuan.
examples.en: He talks rudely, and nobody likes it.

examples.zh: 不要用粗鲁的语言和别人说话。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào yòng cūlǔ de yǔyán hé biérén shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't speak to people with rude language.

examples.zh: 这个司机的态度很粗鲁。
examples.pinyin: Zhège sījī de tàidu hěn cūlǔ.
examples.en: This driver was very rude.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn cūxīn.
examples.en: He is very careless in what he does.

examples.zh: 我的作业又因为粗心错了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zuòyè yòu yīnwèi cūxīn cuò le.
examples.en: I got my homework wrong again because I was careless.

examples.zh: 别这么粗心，仔细检查一下。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhème cūxīn, zǐxì jiǎnchá yíxià.
examples.en: Don't be so careless; check it carefully.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cài yào fàng yìdiǎn cù.
examples.en: This dish needs a little vinegar.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī miàntiáo jiā cù.
examples.en: I like my noodles with vinegar.

examples.pinyin: Zhè píng cù shì bu shì guòqī le?
examples.en: Has this bottle of vinegar expired?

examples.pinyin: Yùndòng néng cùjìn jiànkāng.
examples.en: Exercise helps promote good health.

examples.zh: 多交流能促进大家的了解。
examples.pinyin: Duō jiāoliú néng cùjìn dàjiā de liǎojiě.
examples.en: More communication helps people understand each other better.

examples.pinyin: Hǎo de xíguàn néng cùjìn xuéxí.
examples.en: Good habits help learning along.

examples.zh: 老师的鼓励促使我努力学习。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de gǔlì cùshǐ wǒ nǔlì xuéxí.
examples.en: The teacher's encouragement pushed me to study harder.

examples.zh: 这次失败促使他重新考虑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài cùshǐ tā chóngxīn kǎolǜ.
examples.en: This failure prompted him to reconsider.

examples.zh: 一场大雨促使大家提前回家。
examples.pinyin: Yì chǎng dà yǔ cùshǐ dàjiā tíqián huí jiā.
examples.en: A heavy rain made everyone head home early.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshǔ cóng dòng lǐ cuànle chūlai.
examples.en: A mouse scurried out of the hole.

examples.zh: 一只猫从草丛里窜过去。
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī māo cóng cǎocóng lǐ cuànguòqu.
examples.en: A cat darted through the grass.

examples.zh: 小猫在屋子里窜来窜去。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo māo zài wūzi lǐ cuàn lái cuàn qù.
examples.en: The kitten scampered back and forth around the room.

examples.pinyin: Māma cuī wǒ kuài diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: Mom keeps urging me to get up quickly.

examples.pinyin: Bié cuī wǒ, wǒ mǎshàng jiù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't rush me; I'll be ready in a moment.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn cuī wǒmen jiāo bàogào.
examples.en: The boss is pressing us to hand in the report.

examples.zh: 长期的熬夜会摧残身体。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de áoyè huì cuīcán shēntǐ.
examples.en: Staying up late for a long time wrecks your health.

examples.zh: 不要让坏习惯摧残你的健康。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào ràng huài xíguàn cuīcán nǐ de jiànkāng.
examples.en: Don't let bad habits ruin your health.

examples.zh: 严寒摧残了园子里的花。
examples.pinyin: Yánhán cuīcán le yuánzi lǐ de huā.
examples.en: The harsh cold destroyed the flowers in the garden.

examples.zh: 这种瓷器很脆弱，要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cíqì hěn cuìruò, yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: This porcelain is fragile, so be careful.

examples.zh: 他的心很脆弱，经不起批评。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīn hěn cuìruò, jīng bu qǐ pīpíng.
examples.en: He's very sensitive and can't take criticism.

examples.zh: 小树苗还很脆弱，需要照顾。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shùmiáo hái hěn cuìruò, xūyào zhàogù.
examples.en: The young sapling is still fragile and needs looking after.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yínháng cún qián.
examples.en: I'm going to the bank to deposit money.

examples.zh: 这些东西可以存在冰箱里。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi kěyǐ cún zài bīngxiāng lǐ.
examples.en: These things can be stored in the fridge.

examples.zh: 你把照片存在电脑上了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zhàopiàn cún zài diànnǎo shàng le ma?
examples.en: Did you save the photos on your computer?

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yìzhí cúnzài.
examples.en: This problem has always existed.

examples.zh: 房间里存在一些小问题。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ cúnzài yìxiē xiǎo wèntí.
examples.en: There are some small problems in the room.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde wàixīngrén cúnzài ma?
examples.en: Do you think aliens exist?

examples.zh: 洗手的时候，要用肥皂搓一搓。
examples.pinyin: Xǐshǒu de shíhou, yào yòng féizào cuō yi cuō.
examples.en: When you wash your hands, rub them with soap.

examples.zh: 他把两手搓热，给孩子暖手。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ liǎng shǒu cuō rè, gěi háizi nuǎn shǒu.
examples.en: He rubbed his hands together to warm them for the child.

examples.pinyin: Nǎinai yòng shǒu cuō zhe shéngzi.
examples.en: Grandma was twisting the rope in her hands.

examples.zh: 双方正在磋商合作的细节。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zhèngzài cuōshāng hézuò de xìjié.
examples.en: Both sides are discussing the details of the cooperation.

examples.zh: 我们需要和供应商磋商价格。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào hé gōngyìngshāng cuōshāng jiàgé.
examples.en: We need to negotiate prices with the supplier.

examples.zh: 这件事还要再磋商一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hái yào zài cuōshāng yíxià.
examples.en: This matter needs further discussion.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò cuò le.
examples.en: I did it wrong.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō cuò le.
examples.en: You said it wrong.

examples.pinyin: Méi cuò, jiù shì zhèr.
examples.en: That's right, it's here.

examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le xīn de cuòshī.
examples.en: The government has taken new measures.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào cǎiqǔ ānquán cuòshī.
examples.en: We need to take safety measures.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cuòshī xiàoguǒ bú cuò.
examples.en: These measures are working well.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cuòwù hěn xiǎo.
examples.en: This mistake is very small.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fànle yí ge cuòwù.
examples.en: We made a mistake.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de dá'àn yǒu cuòwù ma?
examples.en: Does your answer have any mistakes?

examples.pinyin: Rénshēng nánmiǎn huì yùdào cuòzhé.
examples.en: Setbacks are inevitable in life.

examples.zh: 他没有被这次挫折打倒。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu bèi zhè cì cuòzhé dǎdǎo.
examples.en: He was not knocked down by this setback.

examples.zh: 经历了几次挫折以后，他变得更成熟了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglì le jǐ cì cuòzhé yǐhòu, tā biàn de gèng chéngshú le.
examples.en: After several setbacks, he became more mature.

examples.zh: 我们在院子里搭了一个帐篷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yuànzi lǐ dā le yí ge zhàngpeng.
examples.en: We put up a tent in the yard.

examples.zh: 这件衣服和裤子搭在一起很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hé kùzi dā zài yìqǐ hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This top and these trousers look good together.

examples.zh: 请你帮我把毛巾搭在椅子上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ máojīn dā zài yǐzi shàng.
examples.en: Please drape the towel over the chair for me.

examples.zh: 他和同事是多年的搭档。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé tóngshì shì duō nián de dādàng.
examples.en: He and his colleague have been partners for many years.

examples.zh: 在这次项目里，我们要互相搭档。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì xiàngmù lǐ, wǒmen yào hùxiāng dādàng.
examples.en: On this project, we'll work together as a team.

examples.zh: 找一个好搭档，工作会轻松很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo yí ge hǎo dādàng, gōngzuò huì qīngsōng hěn duō.
examples.en: Find a good partner and the work will be much easier.

examples.zh: 这条裙子和那双鞋很搭配。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi hé nà shuāng xié hěn dāpèi.
examples.en: This skirt goes really well with those shoes.

examples.zh: 午饭可以搭配一些蔬菜，营养更均衡。
examples.pinyin: Wǔfàn kěyǐ dāpèi yìxiē shūcài, yíngyǎng gèng jūnhéng.
examples.en: Lunch can include some vegetables for a more balanced diet.

examples.zh: 公司把两个部门的人员搭配在一起。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bǎ liǎng ge bùmén de rényuán dāpèi zài yìqǐ.
examples.en: The company paired up staff from the two departments.

examples.pinyin: Tā dāying le wǒ de qǐngqiú.
examples.en: He agreed to my request.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dāying wǒ de shì yào zuòdào.
examples.en: You must keep what you promised me.

examples.pinyin: Tā dāying míngtiān lái.
examples.en: She promised to come tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de dá'àn shì duōshao?
examples.en: What's the answer to this question?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ dá'àn xiě zài zhèli.
examples.en: Please write your answer here.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: I don't know the answer.

examples.zh: 他下个月要去参加论文答辩。
examples.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè yào qù cānjiā lùnwén dábiàn.
examples.en: He's going to defend his thesis next month.

examples.zh: 答辩的时候，老师问了我很多问题。
examples.pinyin: Dábiàn de shíhou, lǎoshī wènle wǒ hěn duō wèntí.
examples.en: During my defense, the teachers asked me lots of questions.

examples.zh: 你的论文答辩准备得怎么样了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lùnwén dábiàn zhǔnbèi de zěnmeyàng le?
examples.en: How are your preparations for the thesis defense going?

examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le xiéyì.
examples.en: The two sides have finally reached an agreement.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen néng dáchéng gòngshí ma?
examples.en: Can you reach a consensus?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen méiyǒu dáchéng yízhì.
examples.en: We haven't reached an agreement.

examples.zh: 他的成绩达到了我的要求。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì dádàole wǒ de yāoqiú.
examples.en: His results met my requirements.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de mùbiāo hěn nán dádào.
examples.en: Our goal is hard to reach.

examples.zh: 这样做没有达到你想要的效果吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò méiyǒu dádào nǐ xiǎng yào de xiàoguǒ ma?
examples.en: Didn't doing it this way get the result you wanted?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jǐnkuài dáfù wǒ.
examples.en: Please reply to me as soon as possible.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hái méiyǒu gěi wǒ dáfù.
examples.en: The company hasn't given me an answer yet.

examples.zh: 你的问题，我明天给你答复。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de wèntí, wǒ míngtiān gěi nǐ dáfù.
examples.en: I'll get back to you about your question tomorrow.

examples.zh: 她每天都打扮得很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu dǎban de hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: She dresses up beautifully every day.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎban de zhēn hǎokàn.
examples.en: You look really nice.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan dǎban zìjǐ.
examples.en: He really enjoys dressing himself up.

examples.zh: 服务员，请帮我把剩菜打包。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ shèngcài dǎbāo.
examples.en: Waiter, please pack the leftovers up for me.

examples.zh: 行李已经打包好了，明天就能出发。
examples.pinyin: Xíngli yǐjīng dǎbāo hǎo le, míngtiān jiù néng chūfā.
examples.en: The luggage is packed, so we can leave tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我们在饭店打包了两份甜点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài fàndiàn dǎbāo le liǎng fèn tiándiǎn.
examples.en: We had two desserts packed up to take away from the restaurant.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiā dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I'm making a phone call from home.

examples.pinyin: Māma, wǒ míngtiān dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Mom, I'll call you tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: He's on the phone right now.

examples.pinyin: Tā dàxué shí zài fànguǎn dǎgōng.
examples.en: He worked part-time at a restaurant during university.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ měi zhōu dǎgōng jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
examples.en: How many hours a week do you work part-time?

examples.zh: 我不想打工，想好好学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng dǎgōng, xiǎng hǎohao xuéxí.
examples.en: I don't want a part-time job; I want to focus on studying.

examples.zh: 两家公司因为合同纠纷打官司。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī yīnwèi hétong jiūfēn dǎ guānsi.
examples.en: The two companies are suing each other over a contract dispute.

examples.zh: 他决定打官司，要为自己讨回公道。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng dǎ guānsi, yào wèi zìjǐ tǎohuí gōngdào.
examples.en: He decided to take it to court to win back justice for himself.

examples.zh: 为这点小事打官司，太不值得了。
examples.pinyin: Wèi zhè diǎn xiǎo shì dǎ guānsi, tài bù zhíde le.
examples.en: Going to court over such a small matter isn't worth it.

examples.zh: 这次失败对他是个很大的打击。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài duì tā shì ge hěn dà de dǎjī.
examples.en: This failure was a huge blow to him.

examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yào yánlì dǎjī jiǎhuò.
examples.en: The government will crack down hard on fake goods.

examples.zh: 他被裁员后，情绪受到了打击。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi cáiyuán hòu, qíngxù shòudào le dǎjī.
examples.en: After being laid off, his mood took a hit.

examples.zh: 他们俩经常为小事打架。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ jīngcháng wèi xiǎo shì dǎjià.
examples.en: The two of them often fall out over trifles.

examples.zh: 孩子们在操场上打架，老师马上过去拉开了他们。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cāochǎng shàng dǎjià, lǎoshī mǎshàng guòqù lākāi le tāmen.
examples.en: The children started squabbling on the playground, so the teacher quickly stepped in to separate them.

examples.zh: 别跟别人打架，有话好好说。
examples.pinyin: Bié gēn biérén dǎjià, yǒu huà hǎohǎo shuō.
examples.en: Don't get into fights with people; talk things through properly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan gēn tā dǎjiāodào.
examples.en: I don't like dealing with him.

examples.zh: 她经常跟外国人打交道。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng gēn wàiguó rén dǎjiāodào.
examples.en: She often deals with foreigners.

examples.zh: 这份工作需要经常打交道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò xūyào jīngcháng dǎjiāodào.
examples.en: This job means dealing with people all the time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.
examples.en: I like playing basketball.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ dǎ lánqiú ba.
examples.en: Let's play basketball this afternoon.

examples.pinyin: Dìdi bù huì dǎ lánqiú.
examples.en: My younger brother can't play basketball.

examples.zh: 她上下打量着这个陌生人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngxià dǎliang zhe zhège mòshēng rén.
examples.en: She looked the stranger up and down.

examples.zh: 他打量了一下房间，觉得很满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎliang le yíxià fángjiān, juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.en: He looked the room over and was pleased with it.

examples.zh: 第一次见面，别随便打量别人。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì jiànmiàn, bié suíbiàn dǎliang biérén.
examples.en: When you first meet someone, don't stare at them.

examples.zh: 这片森林以前是人们打猎的地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín yǐqián shì rénmen dǎliè de dìfang.
examples.en: This forest used to be where people went hunting.

examples.zh: 爷爷年轻时经常去山里打猎。
examples.pinyin: Yéye niánqīng shí jīngcháng qù shān lǐ dǎliè.
examples.en: Grandpa often went hunting in the mountains when he was young.

examples.zh: 现在很多地方都禁止打猎了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō dìfang dōu jìnzhǐ dǎliè le.
examples.en: Hunting is now banned in many places.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, yìzhí dǎ pēntì.
examples.en: I have a cold and keep sneezing.

examples.zh: 他一打喷嚏，大家都看他。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì dǎ pēntì, dàjiā dōu kàn tā.
examples.en: Whenever he sneezes, everyone looks at him.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme dǎ pēntì?
examples.en: Why are you sneezing?

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dǎrǎo nǐ le.
examples.en: Sorry to disturb you.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng dǎrǎo nǐ.
examples.en: I don't want to bother you.

examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò shí bié dǎrǎo wǒ.
examples.en: Don't interrupt me while I'm working.

examples.pinyin: Xīngqītiān wǒ dǎsǎo fángjiān.
examples.en: On Sunday I clean my room.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chúfáng dǎsǎo gānjìng.
examples.en: Please clean the kitchen thoroughly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎsǎo jiàoshì ba.
examples.en: Let's clean the classroom together.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuan zuò shénme?
examples.en: What are you planning to do?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuan míngnián xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I plan to study Chinese next year.

examples.zh: 这个周末你打算干什么？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ dǎsuan gàn shénme?
examples.en: What do you plan to do this weekend?

examples.zh: 我去打听一下火车几点开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù dǎting yíxià huǒchē jǐ diǎn kāi.
examples.en: I'll go and find out what time the train leaves.

examples.pinyin: Tā dǎting dào le xīn de xiāoxi.
examples.en: He found out some new information.

examples.pinyin: Bié dàochù dǎting biérén de shì.
examples.en: Don't go around prying into other people's business.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ dǎyìn zhè fèn cáiliào.
examples.en: Please print this material for me.

examples.pinyin: Dǎyìnjī huài le.
examples.en: The printer is broken.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎyìn le jǐ fèn?
examples.en: How many copies did you print?

examples.zh: 两家公司为了争夺客户，在市场上打仗。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī wèile zhēngduó kèhù, zài shìchǎng shàng dǎzhàng.
examples.en: The two companies are fighting it out in the market for customers.

examples.zh: 为了一个项目，两个部门天天打仗。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yí ge xiàngmù, liǎng ge bùmén tiāntiān dǎzhàng.
examples.en: Over one project, the two departments squabbled every day.

examples.zh: 小时候我们经常为了玩具打仗。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shíhou wǒmen jīngcháng wèile wánjù dǎzhàng.
examples.en: When we were little we often squabbled over toys.

examples.zh: 他看见我，笑着跟我打招呼。
examples.pinyin: Tā kànjiàn wǒ, xiàozhe gēn wǒ dǎ zhāohu.
examples.en: He saw me and said hello with a smile.

examples.zh: 进办公室前，先跟大家打招呼。
examples.pinyin: Jìn bàngōngshì qián, xiān gēn dàjiā dǎ zhāohu.
examples.en: Say hello to everyone before you go into the office.

examples.zh: 你怎么不跟老师打招呼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bù gēn lǎoshī dǎ zhāohu?
examples.en: Why didn't you say hello to the teacher?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu dǎzhé ma?
examples.en: Is this piece of clothing on sale?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn jīntiān dǎzhé.
examples.en: This shop has a sale today.

examples.pinyin: Mǎi liǎng jiàn kěyǐ dǎzhé.
examples.en: You get a discount if you buy two.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù dǎzhēn.
examples.en: I have to go for an injection this afternoon.

examples.pinyin: Dǎzhēn téng ma?
examples.en: Does it hurt to get an injection?

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi tā dǎzhēn.
examples.en: The doctor gave him an injection.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān hěn dà.
examples.en: My room is very big.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā, nǐmen hǎo!
examples.en: Hello, everyone!

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie bǐ wǒ dà.
examples.en: My older sister is older than me.

examples.pinyin: Dàbuliǎo zài chónglái yí cì.
examples.en: At worst, we'll just start over again.

examples.zh: 别担心，考不好大不了再考一次。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, kǎo bù hǎo dàbuliǎo zài kǎo yí cì.
examples.en: Don't worry; if you do badly, you can always take the test again.

examples.zh: 你怕什么？大不了就是失败。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pà shénme? Dàbuliǎo jiùshì shībài.
examples.en: What are you afraid of? The worst that can happen is failure.

examples.zh: 古代的大臣每天都要上朝。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài de dàchén měitiān dōu yào shàng cháo.
examples.en: In ancient times, ministers had to attend court every day.

examples.zh: 这部历史电视剧里有很多忠心的大臣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù lìshǐ diànshìjù lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhōngxīn de dàchén.
examples.en: This historical drama has many loyal ministers.

examples.zh: 故事里的大臣很聪明，帮皇帝解决了问题。
examples.pinyin: Gùshi lǐ de dàchén hěn cōngmíng, bāng huángdì jiějué le wèntí.
examples.en: The minister in the story is clever and solves the emperor's problem.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn dàfang, chángcháng qǐngkè.
examples.en: He is generous and often treats people.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà dàfang, bù hàixiū.
examples.en: She speaks confidently and isn't shy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bú dàfang yìdiǎn?
examples.en: Why aren't you a bit more generous?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgài qī diǎn dào.
examples.en: I'll probably arrive around seven.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàgài zhīdao tā shì shéi ba?
examples.en: You probably know who he is, right?

examples.pinyin: Tā dàgài bù lái le.
examples.en: He probably isn't coming.

examples.pinyin: Dàhuǒr yìqǐ qù chīfàn ba.
examples.en: Let's all go and eat together.

examples.zh: 大伙儿都累了，休息一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuǒr dōu lèi le, xiūxi yíxià ba.
examples.en: Everyone's tired, so let's take a break.

examples.zh: 大伙儿觉得这个主意怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Dàhuǒr juéde zhège zhǔyi zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: What does everyone think of this idea?

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì xuésheng.
examples.en: Hello everyone, I'm a student.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yìqǐ chī fàn ba.
examples.en: Everyone, let's eat together.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu lái le.
examples.en: Everyone has come.

examples.zh: 我的办公室在一座大厦的十八层。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bàngōngshì zài yí zuò dàshà de shíbā céng.
examples.en: My office is on the eighteenth floor of a tower block.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàshà yòu gāo yòu piàoliang.
examples.en: This building is tall and beautiful.

examples.zh: 从大厦里走出来，外面下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng dàshà lǐ zǒu chūlái, wàimiàn xiàyǔ le.
examples.en: When I walked out of the building, it was raining outside.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān qù dàshǐguǎn.
examples.en: I'm going to the embassy tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Dàshǐguǎn zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the embassy?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàshǐguǎn hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This embassy is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 很多商店在节日前大肆打折。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō shāngdiàn zài jiérì qián dàsì dǎzhé.
examples.en: Many shops slash their prices heavily before the holidays.

examples.zh: 广告里大肆宣传这个新产品。
examples.pinyin: Guǎnggào lǐ dàsì xuānchuán zhège xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.en: The ads hype this new product on a massive scale.

examples.zh: 不要大肆谈论别人的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào dàsì tánlùn biéren de shìqing.
examples.en: Don't go around gossiping widely about other people's business.

examples.zh: 这份计划大体上没问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn jìhuà dàtǐ shàng méi wèntí.
examples.en: This plan is generally fine.

examples.zh: 我大体明白了你的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàtǐ míngbai le nǐ de yìsi.
examples.en: I more or less understand what you mean.

examples.zh: 大体来说，这次活动很成功。
examples.pinyin: Dàtǐ lái shuō, zhè cì huódòng hěn chénggōng.
examples.en: On the whole, this event was a success.

examples.pinyin: Dàxiàng de bízi hěn cháng.
examples.en: An elephant's trunk is very long.

examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu yì zhī dàxiàng.
examples.en: There is an elephant in the zoo.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiàn guo dàxiàng ma?
examples.en: Have you ever seen an elephant?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge dàxíng shāngchǎng.
examples.en: This is a large shopping center.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jǔbàn le dàxíng huódòng.
examples.en: The school held a large-scale event.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dàxíng de gǒu ma?
examples.en: Do you like large dogs?

examples.zh: 我只听懂了这段话的大意。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ tīng dǒng le zhè duàn huà de dàyì.
examples.en: I only got the gist of this passage.

examples.zh: 请你用一句话说一下文章的大意。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ yòng yí jù huà shuō yíxià wénzhāng de dàyì.
examples.en: Please summarise the main idea of the article in one sentence.

examples.zh: 考试的时候千万别大意。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou qiānwàn bié dàyì.
examples.en: Whatever you do, don't be careless during the exam.

examples.zh: 我们大约等了一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dàyuē děng le yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: We waited for about an hour.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bāo dàyuē duōshao qián?
examples.en: About how much is this bag?

examples.zh: 大约下午三点，我们到了。
examples.pinyin: Dàyuē xiàwǔ sān diǎn, wǒmen dào le.
examples.en: We arrived at around three in the afternoon.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàzhì zhīdao zěnme zǒu.
examples.en: I roughly know the way.

examples.zh: 这个问题的答案大致是这样的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de dá'àn dàzhì shì zhèyàng de.
examples.en: The answer to this question is roughly like this.

examples.zh: 你能大致估计一下需要多少钱吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng dàzhì gūjì yíxià xūyào duōshao qián ma?
examples.en: Can you roughly estimate how much money we'll need?

examples.zh: 他听到这个消息，呆住了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhè ge xiāoxi dāizhù le.
examples.en: When he heard the news, he was stunned.

examples.pinyin: Bié dāi zài jiā lǐ, chūqù zǒuzou.
examples.en: Don't stay cooped up at home; go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 那个小孩看起来有点呆。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xiǎohái kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn dāi.
examples.en: That kid looks a bit dazed.

examples.zh: 电影里的歹徒最后还是被抓住了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de dǎitú zuìhòu háishi bèi zhuāzhùle.
examples.en: The bad guy in the film was caught in the end.

examples.zh: 警察提醒大家要小心歹徒。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá tíxǐng dàjiā yào xiǎoxīn dǎitú.
examples.en: The police remind everyone to be careful of criminals.

examples.zh: 这个小区安装了监控，防止歹徒进入。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū ānzhuāngle jiānkòng, fángzhǐ dǎitú jìnrù.
examples.en: This neighborhood installed cameras to keep criminals out.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài qián le ma?
examples.en: Did you bring any money?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dài nǐ qù kànkan.
examples.en: I'll take you to have a look.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān bié wàng le dài shū.
examples.en: Don't forget to bring your book tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dài yǎnjìng ma?
examples.en: Do you wear glasses?

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān dài le yì dǐng màozi.
examples.en: She wore a hat today.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān chūmén yào dài shǒutào.
examples.en: Wear gloves when you go out in winter.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen bān de dàibiǎo.
examples.en: He is our class representative.

examples.pinyin: Hóngsè dàibiǎo shénme?
examples.en: What does red stand for?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàibiǎo dàjiā xiàng nǐ wènhǎo.
examples.en: I'm speaking on behalf of everyone to say hello to you.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá dàibǔ le nà ge xiǎotōu.
examples.en: The police arrested the thief.

examples.zh: 法官批准后，警察才能逮捕嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān pīzhǔn hòu, jǐngchá cái néng dàibǔ xiányírén.
examples.en: Only after the judge approves can the police arrest a suspect.

examples.zh: 那个逃犯已经被逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge táofàn yǐjīng bèi dàibǔ le.
examples.en: That fugitive has already been arrested.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù kàn dàifu.
examples.en: I need to go see a doctor.

examples.pinyin: Dàifu, wǒ tóu téng.
examples.en: Doctor, my head hurts.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi dàifu hěn héqi.
examples.en: This doctor is very kind.

examples.pinyin: Chénggōng xūyào fùchū dàijià.
examples.en: Success comes at a cost.

examples.zh: 不管付出多大代价，我都要完成它。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn fùchū duō dà dàijià, wǒ dōu yào wánchéng tā.
examples.en: Whatever it costs, I will finish it.

examples.zh: 这个错误的代价太大了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cuòwù de dàijià tài dà le.
examples.en: This mistake has cost far too much.

examples.zh: 他们向银行贷款买了房子。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xiàng yínháng dàikuǎn mǎile fángzi.
examples.en: They took out a bank loan to buy a flat.

examples.pinyin: Mǎi fángzi yào dàikuǎn ma?
examples.en: Do you need a loan to buy a house?

examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ dàikuǎn yào huán duō jiǔ?
examples.en: How long do I have to repay this loan?

examples.zh: 他是这家公司的代理人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zhè jiā gōngsī de dàilǐrén.
examples.en: He is this company's agent.

examples.zh: 经理出差了，副经理代理他的工作。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ chūchāi le, fù jīnglǐ dàilǐ tā de gōngzuò.
examples.en: The manager is away on business, so the deputy is covering his work.

examples.zh: 我们和一家代理商签了合同。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hé yì jiā dàilǐshāng qiān le hétong.
examples.en: We signed a contract with a distributor.

examples.zh: 老师带领我们参观博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī dàilǐng wǒmen cānguān bówùguǎn.
examples.en: The teacher led us on a visit to the museum.

examples.zh: 他带领团队做这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā dàilǐng tuánduì zuò zhège xiàngmù.
examples.en: He leads the team on this project.

examples.zh: 在她的带领下，我们学会了包饺子。
examples.pinyin: Zài tā de dàilǐng xià, wǒmen xuéhuì le bāo jiǎozi.
examples.en: Under her guidance, we learned to make dumplings.

examples.zh: 客人来了，我们不能怠慢。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén lái le, wǒmen bù néng dàimàn.
examples.en: When guests arrive, we mustn't neglect them.

examples.zh: 别怠慢远道而来的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Bié dàimàn yuǎndào ér lái de péngyou.
examples.en: Don't slight friends who have come from far away.

examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duì kèrén hěn dàimàn.
examples.en: The waiter was dismissive toward the guests.

examples.pinyin: Tā dàitì lǎoshī shàngkè.
examples.en: He is teaching the class in the teacher's place.

examples.zh: 用苹果代替香蕉，可以吗？
examples.pinyin: Yòng píngguǒ dàitì xiāngjiāo, kěyǐ ma?
examples.en: Can I use apples instead of bananas?

examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng dàitì nǐ.
examples.en: No one can take your place.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de dàiyù hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This job pays very well.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de dàiyù yíyàng.
examples.en: Our treatment is the same.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì dàiyù mǎnyì ma?
examples.en: Are you happy with your pay?

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétong yóu yínháng dānbǎo.
examples.en: This contract is guaranteed by the bank.

examples.zh: 我可以为他担保，他是个可靠的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ wèi tā dānbǎo, tā shì ge kěkào de rén.
examples.en: I can vouch for him; he is a reliable person.

examples.zh: 没有人愿意为你的贷款担保。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén yuànyì wèi nǐ de dàikuǎn dānbǎo.
examples.en: Nobody is willing to guarantee your loan.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn dānchún.
examples.en: Her thinking is very simple and innocent.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng bāngmáng.
examples.en: I simply wanted to help.

examples.zh: 他是一个单纯善良的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge dānchún shànliáng de rén.
examples.en: He is an innocent and kind-hearted person.

examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn yīnyuè hěn dāndiào.
examples.en: This piece of music is very monotonous.

examples.pinyin: Měi tiān de shēnghuó tài dāndiào le.
examples.en: Every day's life is too monotonous.

examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò dāndiào, dàn hěn wěndìng.
examples.en: The work is repetitive, but it's stable.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ dāndú gēn wǒ tántan.
examples.en: Please come and talk to me privately.

examples.zh: 他一个人单独住在山上。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén dāndú zhù zài shān shàng.
examples.en: He lives alone up in the mountains.

examples.zh: 这个问题需要单独解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí xūyào dāndú jiějué.
examples.en: This problem needs to be solved separately.

examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.en: He serves as the company's manager.

examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn wǒmen bān de bānzhǎng.
examples.en: She is the class monitor.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyi dānrèn zhìyuànzhě ma?
examples.en: Would you be willing to be a volunteer?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de dānwèi zài shìzhōngxīn.
examples.en: My workplace is in the city center.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dānwèi shì shénme yìsi?
examples.en: What does this unit mean?

examples.pinyin: Yì gōnglǐ shì jùlí de dānwèi.
examples.en: One kilometer is a unit of distance.

examples.pinyin: Bié dānwu shíjiān.
examples.en: Don't waste time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò bèi dānwu le.
examples.en: My work was delayed.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dānwu nǐ yíxià.
examples.en: Sorry to take up a moment of your time.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dānxīn.
examples.en: Don't worry.

examples.pinyin: Māma hěn dānxīn nǐ.
examples.en: Mom is worried about you.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dānxīn míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
examples.en: I'm worried it'll rain tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这篇课文是第三单元的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān kèwén shì dì sān dānyuán de.
examples.en: This text is from Unit 3.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù zài sān dānyuán wǔ lóu.
examples.en: My home is in Entrance 3, on the fifth floor.

examples.zh: 这本书一共有十个单元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng yǒu shí ge dānyuán.
examples.en: This book has ten units in total.

examples.zh: 他有点儿胆怯，不敢上台。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒudiǎnr dǎnqiè, bù gǎn shàng tái.
examples.en: He's a bit timid and doesn't dare go on stage.

examples.pinyin: Bié dǎnqiè, nǐ yídìng néng zuò hǎo.
examples.en: Don't be scared; you can definitely do it well.

examples.zh: 小猫躲在角落里，显得很胆怯。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo māo duǒ zài jiǎoluò lǐ, xiǎnde hěn dǎnqiè.
examples.en: The kitten hid in a corner, looking timid.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zuò dǎnxiǎoguǐ.
examples.en: Don't be a coward.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge dǎnxiǎoguǐ.
examples.en: He's a scaredy-cat.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì dǎnxiǎoguǐ.
examples.en: I'm not a coward.

examples.pinyin: Zhège tāng de wèidao hěn dàn.
examples.en: This soup tastes very mild.

examples.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe dàn lánsè de chènshān.
examples.en: He is wearing a pale blue shirt.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan tài dàn de chá.
examples.en: I don't like tea that's too weak.

examples.zh: 鸡蛋和牛奶里都有蛋白质。
examples.pinyin: Jīdàn hé niúnǎi lǐ dōu yǒu dànbáizhì.
examples.en: Both eggs and milk contain protein.

examples.zh: 你每天吃足够的蛋白质吗？

examples.zh: 这几年市场动荡，很多人都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián shìchǎng dòngdàng, hěn duō rén dōu hěn dānxīn.
examples.en: Markets have been turbulent these past few years, and many people are worried.

examples.zh: 股票价格的动荡让人很紧张。
examples.pinyin: Gǔpiào jiàgé de dòngdàng ràng rén hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: The swings in share prices make people nervous.

examples.zh: 他的生活经历了很多动荡。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēnghuó jīnglì le hěn duō dòngdàng.
examples.en: His life went through a lot of upheaval.

examples.zh: 孩子们很喜欢看动画片。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen hěn xǐhuan kàn dònghuàpiān.
examples.en: Kids love watching cartoons.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù dònghuàpiān hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: This cartoon is really fun.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shíhou cháng kàn dònghuàpiān.
examples.en: I often watched cartoons when I was little.

examples.zh: 他的动机很简单，就是想帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā de dòngjī hěn jiǎndān, jiùshì xiǎng bāngmáng.
examples.en: His motive is simple: he just wants to help.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xuéxí de dòngjī shì shénme?
examples.en: What motivates you to study?

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huáiyí tā de dòngjī.
examples.en: Everyone doubts his motives.

examples.pinyin: Héshuǐ zài dōngtiān dòngjié le.
examples.en: The river froze over in winter.

examples.pinyin: Yínháng dòngjié le tā de zhànghù.
examples.en: The bank froze his account.

examples.zh: 工资被冻结了，今年不会涨。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzī bèi dòngjié le, jīnnián bú huì zhǎng.
examples.en: Wages have been frozen, so there will be no raise this year.

examples.pinyin: Lóushàng yǒu shénme dòngjing?
examples.en: What's that noise upstairs?

examples.zh: 我没听到屋里有任何动静。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngdào wū lǐ yǒu rènhé dòngjing.
examples.en: I didn't hear any sound from inside the house.

examples.zh: 这件事没有什么新动静。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì méiyǒu shénme xīn dòngjing.
examples.en: There's no fresh news on this matter.

examples.pinyin: Mèngxiǎng shì tā qiánjìn de dònglì.
examples.en: His dream is what drives him forward.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de dònglì hěn qiáng.
examples.en: This car has a powerful engine.

examples.zh: 有了奖励，大家都有了工作的动力。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiǎnglì, dàjiā dōu yǒu le gōngzuò de dònglì.
examples.en: With the rewards, everyone felt motivated to work.

examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ bǎohù dòngmài.
examples.en: Exercise can help protect the arteries.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le tā de dòngmài.
examples.en: The doctor checked his arteries.

examples.zh: 多运动有利于动脉健康。
examples.pinyin: Duō yùndòng yǒulìyú dòngmài jiànkāng.
examples.en: Regular exercise is good for arterial health.

examples.zh: 我们明天早上七点动身。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang qī diǎn dòngshēn.
examples.en: We set off at seven tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 你什么时候动身去机场？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou dòngshēn qù jīchǎng?
examples.en: When are you leaving for the airport?

examples.zh: 飞机快要起飞了，我们得赶紧动身。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī kuài yào qǐfēi le, wǒmen děi gǎnjǐn dòngshēn.
examples.en: The plane is about to take off, so we have to leave straight away.

examples.zh: 你来帮忙，我们一起动手做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái bāngmáng, wǒmen yìqǐ dòngshǒu zuò.
examples.en: Come and help; let's get started together.

examples.zh: 这个玩具需要自己动手组装。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wánjù xūyào zìjǐ dòngshǒu zǔzhuāng.
examples.en: This toy has to be assembled by hand yourself.

examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan dòngshǒu xiū dōngxi.
examples.en: He likes fixing things with his own hands.

examples.zh: 你关注一下公司的最新动态。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ guānzhù yíxià gōngsī de zuìxīn dòngtài.
examples.en: Keep an eye on the company's latest developments.

examples.zh: 他一直关注行业的动态。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí guānzhù hángyè de dòngtài.
examples.en: He keeps up with developments in the industry.

examples.zh: 这个小区的动态你知道吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū de dòngtài nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.en: Do you know what has been happening in this neighborhood?

examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù.
examples.en: The zoo has lots of animals.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiǎo dòngwù.
examples.en: I like small animals.

examples.pinyin: Gǒu shì dòngwù ma?
examples.en: Is a dog an animal?

examples.zh: 我们在山里发现了一个很大的洞穴。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān lǐ fāxiàn le yí ge hěn dà de dòngxué.
examples.en: We found a very big cave in the mountains.

examples.pinyin: Dòngxué lǐ hěn hēi, yě hěn liángkuai.
examples.en: It's dark inside the cave, but also cool.

examples.zh: 小时候我们常去那个洞穴玩。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou wǒmen cháng qù nàge dòngxué wán.
examples.en: When we were little, we often went to play in that cave.

examples.zh: 老师动员我们参加比赛。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī dòngyuán wǒmen cānjiā bǐsài.
examples.en: The teacher encouraged us to take part in the competition.

examples.pinyin: Māma dòngyuán wǒ zǎo diǎn shuìjiào.
examples.en: Mom urged me to go to bed earlier.

examples.zh: 全班同学都被动员起来打扫教室。
examples.pinyin: Quán bān tóngxué dōu bèi dòngyuán qǐlai dǎsǎo jiàoshì.
examples.en: The whole class was rallied to clean the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Tā de dòngzuò hěn kuài.
examples.en: His movements are very quick.

examples.zh: 请你再做一次这个动作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài zuò yí cì zhège dòngzuò.
examples.en: Please do this movement once more.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dòngzuò hěn nán.
examples.en: This action is hard.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒujī fàng jìn kùdōu lǐ.
examples.en: He put his phone in his trouser pocket.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de dōu lǐ yǒu yì bǎ yàoshi.
examples.en: There's a key in my pocket.

examples.zh: 买菜的时候，我用布兜装东西。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi cài de shíhou, wǒ yòng bùdōu zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.en: When shopping for vegetables, I carry things in a cloth bag.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì xuésheng.
examples.en: We are all students.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: Everyone is very happy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen dōu lái ma?
examples.en: Are you all coming?

examples.zh: 这座山很陡峭，爬起来很累。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān hěn dǒuqiào, pá qǐlái hěn lèi.
examples.en: This mountain is very steep, and it's tiring to climb.

examples.zh: 山路陡峭，我们走得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Shānlù dǒuqiào, wǒmen zǒu de hěn màn.
examples.en: The mountain path is steep, so we walked slowly.

examples.zh: 这条楼梯很陡峭，要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lóutī hěn dǒuqiào, yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: This staircase is very steep, so be careful.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì dòu háizi xiào.
examples.en: He is very good at making children laugh.

examples.pinyin: Bié dòu xiǎo gǒu le.
examples.en: Stop teasing the puppy.

examples.en: Are you pulling my leg?

examples.en: I like stir-fried tofu.

examples.en: There is tofu in this bowl of soup.

examples.pinyin: Dòufu bù xīnxiān, bié mǎi le.
examples.en: The tofu isn't fresh, so don't buy it.

examples.zh: 他一直在和自己的懒惰斗争。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài hé zìjǐ de lǎnduò dòuzhēng.
examples.en: He has always been battling his own laziness.

examples.zh: 学习就是一场和困难的斗争。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí jiù shì yì chǎng hé kùnnan de dòuzhēng.
examples.en: Studying is a struggle against difficulties.

examples.zh: 经过长时间的斗争，他终于减肥成功了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de dòuzhēng, tā zhōngyú jiǎnféi chénggōng le.
examples.en: After a long struggle, he finally succeeded in losing weight.

examples.zh: 妈妈每天督促我写作业。
examples.pinyin: Māma měitiān dūcù wǒ xiě zuòyè.
examples.en: Mom urges me to do my homework every day.

examples.zh: 经理督促大家按时完成任务。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ dūcù dàjiā ànshí wánchéng rènwu.
examples.en: The manager urges everyone to finish the task on time.

examples.zh: 没有人督促，他就不愿意学习。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén dūcù, tā jiù bú yuànyi xuéxí.
examples.en: Without anyone pushing him, he doesn't want to study.

examples.pinyin: Dūshì de shēnghuó jiézòu hěn kuài.
examples.en: City life moves at a fast pace.

examples.zh: 周末，我喜欢去都市里的公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò, wǒ xǐhuan qù dūshì lǐ de gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.en: On weekends I like to take walks in the city parks.

examples.zh: 这个小镇和大都市完全不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo zhèn hé dà dūshì wánquán bù yíyàng.
examples.en: This small town is completely different from a big city.

examples.en: He runs things autocratically and never listens to anyone else's opinion.

examples.zh: 在家里搞独裁，是不会让人服气的。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiā lǐ gǎo dúcái, shì bú huì ràng rén fúqì de.
examples.en: Trying to rule the household like a dictator won't win anyone's respect.

examples.zh: 独裁的老板很难留住好员工。

examples.en: A domineering boss finds it hard to keep good staff.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ'ér hěn dúlì.

examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng néng dúlì shēnghuó le.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng dúlì wánchéng zuòyè ma?
examples.en: Can you finish your homework on your own?

examples.zh: 学校教育学生远离毒品。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiàoyù xuésheng yuǎnlí dúpǐn.
examples.en: The school teaches students to stay away from drugs.

examples.zh: 宣传册上提醒大家远离毒品。
examples.pinyin: Xuānchuáncè shàng tíxǐng dàjiā yuǎnlí dúpǐn.
examples.en: The leaflet reminds everyone to stay away from drugs.

examples.zh: 医生说，毒品对大脑的伤害很严重。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, dúpǐn duì dànǎo de shānghài hěn yánzhòng.
examples.en: The doctor said that drugs cause serious harm to the brain.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shèjì hěn dútè.
examples.en: This design is very unique.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn dútè.
examples.en: His voice is very distinctive.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège cài dútè ma?
examples.en: Do you think this dish is unique?

examples.en: He doesn't like gambling.

examples.pinyin: Dǔbó shì yì zhǒng bù hǎo de xíguàn.
examples.en: Gambling is a bad habit.

examples.en: We don't gamble at home.

examples.en: Traffic was jammed today, so I was late.

examples.pinyin: Shàngbān shí jīngcháng dǔchē ma?
examples.en: Is there often traffic on your commute?

examples.zh: 我们不想堵车，坐地铁吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù xiǎng dǔchē, zuò dìtiě ba.
examples.en: We don't want to get stuck in traffic, so let's take the subway.

examples.en: The drain is blocked, and the water won't flow away.

examples.zh: 路上车太多，交通都堵塞了。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng chē tài duō, jiāotōng dōu dǔsè le.
examples.en: There are so many cars on the road that traffic is jammed.

examples.zh: 你的鼻子堵塞了吗？多喝点热水吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bízi dǔsè le ma? Duō hē diǎn rè shuǐ ba.
examples.en: Is your nose blocked? Drink some hot water.

examples.zh: 我们愉快地度过了假期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yúkuài de dùguò le jiàqī.
examples.en: We spent a happy holiday.

examples.en: He spent his childhood in Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme dùguò zhōumò?
examples.en: How do you plan to spend the weekend?

examples.en: We must put an end to waste.

examples.zh: 学校努力杜绝考试作弊。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào nǔlì dùjué kǎoshì zuòbì.
examples.en: The school is working hard to stop cheating in exams.

examples.zh: 我们应该杜绝乱扔垃圾的行为。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi dùjué luàn rēng lājī de xíngwéi.
examples.en: We should put a stop to littering.

examples.en: My stomach hurts.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi chīfàn, dùzi hěn è.
examples.en: I skipped breakfast today and I'm starving.

examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō, dùzi bù shūfu.
examples.en: I ate too much and my stomach feels off.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè wǎn tāng duān dào zhuōzi shang.
examples.en: Please carry this bowl of soup to the table.

examples.zh: 他站在桥的一端，等我过去。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài qiáo de yì duān, děng wǒ guòqù.
examples.en: He stood at one end of the bridge, waiting for me to come over.

examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duānlái le liǎng bēi rè chá.
examples.en: The waiter brought over two cups of hot tea.

examples.zh: 端午节那天，家人一起吃粽子。
examples.pinyin: Duānwǔjié nà tiān, jiārén yìqǐ chī zòngzi.
examples.en: On the Dragon Boat Festival, the family eats zongzi together.

examples.zh: 今年的端午节是什么时候？
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de Duānwǔjié shì shénme shíhou?
examples.en: When is the Dragon Boat Festival this year?

examples.zh: 我们一起去看了端午节的龙舟比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù kànle Duānwǔjié de lóngzhōu bǐsài.
examples.en: We went together to watch the dragon boat races for the festival.

examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidu hěn duānzhèng.
examples.en: His attitude is very proper.

examples.zh: 请你坐端正，不要歪着身子。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zuò duānzhèng, bú yào wāizhe shēnzi.
examples.en: Please sit up straight and don't slouch.

examples.pinyin: Zì yào xiě de duānzhèng yìxiē.
examples.en: Write your characters a bit more neatly.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kùzi tài duǎn le.
examples.en: These trousers are too short.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiànmiàn shíjiān hěn duǎn.
examples.en: We only met for a short time.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de báitiān hěn duǎn.
examples.en: Winter days are short.

examples.zh: 他发出一声短促的笑声。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāchū yì shēng duǎncù de xiàoshēng.
examples.en: He let out a short, sharp laugh.

examples.zh: 这次假期太短促了，我们都没玩够。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jiàqī tài duǎncù le, wǒmen dōu méi wán gòu.
examples.en: The holiday was far too short; none of us got enough fun out of it.

examples.en: His answer was curt, as if he didn't want to say more.

examples.en: Please send me a text message.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù huí duǎnxìn ma?
examples.en: Aren't you replying to the text?

examples.pinyin: Shùzhī duàn le.
examples.en: The branch snapped.

examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn xiàn duàn le.
examples.en: This thread has snapped.

examples.en: The rain has stopped, let's go out.

examples.pinyin: Zhè yí duàn huà hěn cháng.
examples.en: This paragraph is very long.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiūxi yí duàn shíjiān ba.
examples.en: Let's rest for a while.

examples.pinyin: Zhè yí duàn lù hěn nán zǒu.
examples.en: This stretch of road is hard to walk.

examples.zh: 警察断定这是一场意外。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá duàndìng zhè shì yì chǎng yìwài.
examples.en: The police concluded it was an accident.

examples.zh: 我不能断定他会不会来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng duàndìng tā huì bu huì lái.
examples.en: I can't be sure whether he will come.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng duàndìng tā zhǐshì gǎnmào.
examples.en: The doctor concluded he only had a cold.

examples.zh: 他的声音断断续续的，信号很差。

examples.en: His voice kept cutting out because the signal was poor.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ duànduànxùxù de xiàle yì zhěng tiān.
examples.en: It rained on and off all day.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duànduànxùxù de liáole jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: We chatted off and on for several hours.

examples.en: He cut off contact with his family.

examples.en: These two friends have stopped seeing each other.

examples.zh: 他不想断绝和朋友的关系。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng duànjué hé péngyou de guānxi.
examples.en: He does not want to cut ties with his friends.

examples.en: I thought he would be angry, but he laughed instead.

examples.zh: 我帮了他，他反倒不高兴了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bāng le tā, tā fǎndào bù gāoxìng le.
examples.en: I helped him, yet he ended up unhappy.

examples.zh: 天气本来很热，晚上反倒冷了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì běnlái hěn rè, wǎnshang fǎndào lěng le.
examples.en: It was hot earlier, but it actually turned cold in the evening.

examples.zh: 那个老人的想法很反动，不接受新事物。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén de xiǎngfǎ hěn fǎndòng, bù jiēshòu xīn shìwù.
examples.en: That old man's thinking is very reactionary; he won't accept anything new.

examples.zh: 不要用反动的眼光看待新的东西。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào yòng fǎndòng de yǎnguāng kàndài xīn de dōngxi.
examples.en: Don't look at new things with a reactionary mindset.

examples.zh: 他说话很反动，大家都不喜欢听。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn fǎndòng, dàjiā dōu bù xǐhuan tīng.
examples.en: His remarks are so reactionary that nobody likes to listen.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ fǎnduì zhège zhǔyi.
examples.en: I'm against this idea.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu fǎnduì tā.
examples.en: Everyone opposes him.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ fǎnduì ma?
examples.en: Do you object?

examples.zh: 他越解释，我反而越生气。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuè jiěshì, wǒ fǎn'ér yuè shēngqì.
examples.en: The more he explained, the angrier I got instead.

examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜，身体反而更好。
examples.pinyin: Duō chī shūcài, shēntǐ fǎn'ér gèng hǎo.
examples.en: Eating more vegetables actually makes your body healthier.

examples.zh: 我不但没生气，反而笑了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér xiào le.
examples.en: Far from getting angry, I actually laughed.

examples.zh: 这个问题我们反复讨论过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí wǒmen fǎnfù tǎolùn guo.
examples.en: We've discussed this problem over and over.

examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnfù kàn zhè běn shū.
examples.en: He read this book again and again.

examples.zh: 天气很反复，一会儿晴一会儿雨。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn fǎnfù, yíhuìr qíng yíhuìr yǔ.
examples.en: The weather keeps changing: sunny one moment, rainy the next.

examples.zh: 我很反感别人在我背后说闲话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn fǎngǎn biérén zài wǒ bèihòu shuō xiánhuà.
examples.en: I really resent people gossiping behind my back.

examples.zh: 他的态度让大家很反感。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidu ràng dàjiā hěn fǎngǎn.
examples.en: His attitude annoyed everyone.

examples.zh: 这种广告太多，让人很反感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guǎnggào tài duō, ràng rén hěn fǎngǎn.
examples.en: There are too many of these ads, and people find them really irritating.

examples.zh: 小猫被抱起来时一直反抗。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo māo bèi bào qǐlai shí yìzhí fǎnkàng.
examples.en: The kitten kept struggling when it was picked up.

examples.zh: 孩子开始反抗父母的管教。
examples.pinyin: Háizi kāishǐ fǎnkàng fùmǔ de guǎnjiào.
examples.en: The child started to push back against his parents' discipline.

examples.zh: 他不敢反抗老板的安排。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù gǎn fǎnkàng lǎobǎn de ānpái.
examples.en: He doesn't dare to defy the boss's arrangements.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā gěi wǒ yìxiē fǎnkuì.
examples.en: Please give me some feedback.

examples.zh: 老师很快就给了我反馈。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn kuài jiù gěi le wǒ fǎnkuì.
examples.en: The teacher gave me feedback very quickly.

examples.zh: 我们会认真听取用户的反馈。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huì rènzhēn tīngqǔ yònghù de fǎnkuì.
examples.en: We will listen carefully to users' feedback.

examples.pinyin: Yìngbì yǒu zhèngmiàn, yě yǒu fǎnmiàn.
examples.en: A coin has a front side and a back side.

examples.zh: 这张纸的反面也写着字。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ de fǎnmiàn yě xiě zhe zì.
examples.en: There is writing on the back of this sheet too.

examples.zh: 事情都有反面，我们要全面看。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing dōu yǒu fǎnmiàn, wǒmen yào quánmiàn kàn.
examples.en: Every matter has two sides, so we should look at the whole picture.

examples.zh: 光照在镜子上会发生反射。
examples.pinyin: Guāng zhào zài jìngzi shàng huì fāshēng fǎnshè.
examples.en: Light reflects off a mirror.

examples.zh: 膝盖被敲的时候会有反射。
examples.pinyin: Xīgài bèi qiāo de shíhou huì yǒu fǎnshè.
examples.en: Your knee gives a reflex when it's tapped.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le wǒ de fǎnshè.
examples.en: The doctor checked my reflexes.

examples.zh: 我们要学会反思自己的行为。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuéhuì fǎnsī zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.en: We need to learn to reflect on our own behavior.

examples.zh: 这次失败让我反思了很久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài ràng wǒ fǎnsī le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: This failure made me reflect for a long time.

examples.zh: 你有没有反思过这件事？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu fǎnsīguo zhè jiàn shì?
examples.en: Have you ever reflected on this matter?

examples.zh: 他没有直接回答，而是反问了我一句。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá, érshì fǎnwèn le wǒ yí jù.
examples.en: He didn't answer directly but asked me a question back.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì zài fǎnwèn wǒ ma?
examples.en: Are you asking me that rhetorically?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jù huà shì yí ge fǎnwènjù.
examples.en: This sentence is a rhetorical question.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de fǎnyìng zhēn kuài.
examples.en: You react really fast.

examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè jiàn shì méiyǒu fǎnyìng.
examples.en: He didn't respond to this matter.

examples.pinyin: Huàxué fǎnyìng xūyào shíjiān.
examples.en: Chemical reactions take time.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí fǎnyìng le shénme?
examples.en: What do these problems reflect?

examples.zh: 他的话反映了他的想法。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huà fǎnyìng le tā de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: His words reflect what he thinks.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiàng lǎoshī fǎnyìng yíxià.
examples.en: Please report it to the teacher.

examples.zh: 反正我不去，你自己去吧。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng wǒ bú qù, nǐ zìjǐ qù ba.
examples.en: Anyway, I'm not going; you go by yourself.

examples.zh: 反正已经晚了，明天再说吧。
examples.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng yǐjīng wǎn le, míngtiān zài shuō ba.
examples.en: It's late anyway; let's talk about it tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你反正没事，就来帮我吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fǎnzhèng méi shì, jiù lái bāng wǒ ba.
examples.en: You're free anyway, so come and help me.

examples.zh: 努力学习，成绩就会提高。反之，成绩就会下降。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì xuéxí, chéngjì jiù huì tígāo. Fǎnzhī, chéngjì jiù huì xiàjiàng.
examples.en: Study hard and your grades will improve. Otherwise, they will drop.

examples.zh: 你尊重别人，别人才会尊重你，反之则不会。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zūnzhòng biérén, biérén cái huì zūnzhòng nǐ, fǎnzhī zé bú huì.
examples.en: Respect others and they will respect you; if not, they won't.

examples.zh: 他喜欢安静，反之，我喜欢热闹。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan ānjìng, fǎnzhī, wǒ xǐhuan rènao.
examples.en: He likes quiet; I, on the other hand, like noise.

examples.zh: 这个问题不属于语法的范畴。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bù shǔyú yǔfǎ de fànchóu.
examples.en: This question doesn't fall within the scope of grammar.

examples.zh: 你的想法属于哪个范畴？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ shǔyú nǎge fànchóu?
examples.en: Which category does your idea fall under?

examples.zh: 这两种水果属于同一个范畴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng shuǐguǒ shǔyú tóng yí ge fànchóu.
examples.en: These two fruits belong to the same category.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: The food at this restaurant is great.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù fànguǎn chī fàn ba.
examples.en: Let's go to a restaurant to eat.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fànguǎn hěn dà.
examples.en: This restaurant is very big.

examples.pinyin: Dàyǔ guòhòu, héshuǐ fànlàn le.
examples.en: After the heavy rain, the river overflowed its banks.

examples.zh: 网上的假消息到处泛滥。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshàng de jiǎ xiāoxi dàochù fànlàn.
examples.en: Fake news is spreading everywhere online.

examples.zh: 你觉得网上的广告是不是太泛滥了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde wǎngshàng de guǎnggào shì bu shì tài fànlàn le?
examples.en: Don't you think there are too many ads online?

examples.zh: 这家店贩卖新鲜的蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn fànmài xīnxiān de shūcài.
examples.en: This shop sells fresh vegetables.

examples.zh: 你们在市场上贩卖什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài shìchǎng shang fànmài shénme?
examples.en: What do you sell at the market?

examples.zh: 他不允许别人在这里贩卖。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù yǔnxǔ biérén zài zhèli fànmài.
examples.en: He doesn't allow others to peddle things here.

examples.zh: 这个问题不在我们的范围里。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bú zài wǒmen de fànwéi lǐ.
examples.en: This question is outside our scope.

examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán de fànwéi hěn dà.
examples.en: This park covers a large area.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fànwéi hěn dà.
examples.en: This exam covers a wide range of material.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān shì fāng de.
examples.en: This room is square-shaped.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì fāngzhuō.
examples.en: This table is square.

examples.pinyin: Tā wéirén hěn fāng zhèng.
examples.en: He is an upright person.

examples.zh: 我们需要一个新的方案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yí ge xīn de fāng'àn.
examples.en: We need a new plan.

examples.zh: 这个方案你觉得怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: What do you think of this proposal?

examples.zh: 大家讨论了好几个方案。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā tǎolùn le hǎo jǐ ge fāng'àn.
examples.en: Everyone discussed several options.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: Getting around here is very convenient.

examples.zh: 你方便的时候给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fāngbiàn de shíhou gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Call me when it's convenient for you.

examples.zh: 住在地铁站附近很方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài dìtiězhàn fùjìn hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: It's very convenient to live near the subway station.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: This method is very simple.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo fāngfǎ ma?
examples.en: Do you have a good way of doing it?

examples.zh: 学汉语要找一个好方法。
examples.pinyin: Xué Hànyǔ yào zhǎo yí ge hǎo fāngfǎ.
examples.en: To study Chinese, you need to find a good method.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
examples.en: I have a lot of experience in this area.

examples.zh: 这件事在很多方面都很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zài hěn duō fāngmiàn dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This matter is good in many respects.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎ fāngmiàn xūyào bāngzhù?
examples.en: What area do you need help with?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huàn ge fāngshì xuéxí ba.
examples.en: Let's try a different way of studying.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēnghuó fāngshì hěn jiànkāng.
examples.en: His way of life is very healthy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan nǎ zhǒng fùkuǎn fāngshì?
examples.en: Which payment method do you prefer?

examples.zh: 请告诉我这个房间的方位。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ zhège fángjiān de fāngwèi.
examples.en: Please tell me where this room is located.

examples.zh: 指南针可以帮我们辨别方位。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐnánzhēn kěyǐ bāng wǒmen biànbié fāngwèi.
examples.en: A compass helps us tell which direction is which.

examples.zh: 他在城市的东南方位买了房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chéngshì de dōngnán fāngwèi mǎile fángzi.
examples.en: He bought a house in the southeast part of the city.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu cuò le fāngxiàng.
examples.en: We went in the wrong direction.

examples.zh: 你知道去车站的方向吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao qù chēzhàn de fāngxiàng ma?
examples.en: Do you know the way to the station?

examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dōngbian de fāngxiàng zǒu le.
examples.en: He walked off towards the east.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de shì jiāxiāng de fāngyán.
examples.en: He is speaking the dialect of his hometown.

examples.zh: 很多广东人在家说方言。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō Guǎngdōng rén zài jiā shuō fāngyán.
examples.en: Many people from Guangdong speak dialect at home.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng de dǒng zhè zhǒng fāngyán ma?
examples.en: Can you understand this dialect?

examples.zh: 公司的方针是以客户为中心。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de fāngzhēn shì yǐ kèhù wéi zhōngxīn.
examples.en: The company's guiding principle is to put customers first.

examples.zh: 学校制定了新的教学方针。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhìdìngle xīn de jiàoxué fāngzhēn.
examples.en: The school has set a new teaching policy.

examples.zh: 我们要按照这个方针去做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào ànzhào zhège fāngzhēn qù zuò.
examples.en: We should act according to this guideline.

examples.zh: 大声说话会妨碍别人学习。
examples.pinyin: Dàshēng shuōhuà huì fáng'ài biérén xuéxí.
examples.en: Speaking loudly disturbs other people's study.

examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ bù fáng'ài wǒmen chūmén.
examples.en: The rain won't stop us from going out.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bāo fáng'ài zǒulù ma?
examples.en: Is your bag in the way when you walk?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángdōng rén hěn hǎo.
examples.en: My landlord is very nice.

examples.zh: 房东每个月都来收房租。
examples.pinyin: Fángdōng měi ge yuè dōu lái shōu fángzū.
examples.en: The landlord comes to collect the rent every month.

examples.zh: 你能跟房东说说修水管的事吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng gēn fángdōng shuōshuo xiū shuǐguǎn de shì ma?
examples.en: Can you talk to the landlord about fixing the pipes?

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where's the room?

examples.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: His room is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 我们可以住一个房间吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ zhù yí ge fángjiān ma?
examples.en: Can we share one room?

examples.zh: 这支球队的防守很严密。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì de fángshǒu hěn yánmì.
examples.en: This team's defense is very tight.

examples.zh: 他负责防守，不让对方进球。
examples.pinyin: Tā fùzé fángshǒu, bú ràng duìfāng jìnqiú.
examples.en: He is in charge of defense and won't let the other side score.

examples.zh: 我们要防守好自己的阵地。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fángshǒu hǎo zìjǐ de zhèndì.
examples.en: We must hold our own ground.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zuò hǎo le fángyì gōngzuò.
examples.en: The school has done a good job with epidemic prevention.

examples.zh: 冬天要注意防疫，勤洗手。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yào zhùyì fángyì, qín xǐshǒu.
examples.en: In winter, pay attention to disease prevention and wash your hands often.

examples.zh: 社区组织了防疫知识讲座。
examples.pinyin: Shèqū zǔzhī le fángyì zhīshi jiǎngzuò.
examples.en: The community held a lecture on disease prevention.

examples.zh: 身体的免疫系统是一种防御。
examples.pinyin: Shēntǐ de miǎnyì xìtǒng shì yì zhǒng fángyù.
examples.en: The immune system is a kind of defense for the body.

examples.zh: 这座城墙有很好的防御作用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngqiáng yǒu hěn hǎo de fángyù zuòyòng.
examples.en: This city wall has a good defensive function.

examples.zh: 狗在家里起到了防御小偷的作用。
examples.pinyin: Gǒu zài jiā lǐ qǐdào le fángyù xiǎotōu de zuòyòng.
examples.en: The dog served as a defense against thieves at home.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng dài hǎo tóukuī, fángzhǐ shòushāng.
examples.en: Wear your helmet properly to prevent injury.

examples.zh: 我们应该采取措施防止污染。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi cǎiqǔ cuòshī fángzhǐ wūrǎn.
examples.en: We should take measures to prevent pollution.

examples.zh: 为了防止忘记，我把它写下来了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fángzhǐ wàngjì, wǒ bǎ tā xiě xiàlái le.
examples.en: So that I wouldn't forget, I wrote it down.

examples.zh: 防治感冒，要多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Fángzhì gǎnmào, yào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi.
examples.en: To prevent and treat colds, drink plenty of water and rest more.

examples.zh: 政府重视疾病防治工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhòngshì jíbìng fángzhì gōngzuò.
examples.en: The government takes disease prevention and treatment work seriously.

examples.zh: 我们小区的蚊子防治做得很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎoqū de wénzi fángzhì zuò de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Our neighborhood does a good job of controlling mosquitoes.

examples.pinyin: Tā fǎngfú zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: He seems to know the answer.

examples.pinyin: Shíjiān fǎngfú guò de hěn kuài.
examples.en: Time seems to fly by.

examples.zh: 听到这首歌，我仿佛回到了小时候。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhè shǒu gē, wǒ fǎngfú huídào le xiǎo shíhou.
examples.en: Hearing this song, I felt as if I were back in childhood.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fǎngwèn le yí wèi lǎoshī.
examples.en: We visited a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Tā lái Zhōngguó fǎngwèn.
examples.en: He came to China for a visit.

examples.zh: 每天有很多人访问这个网站。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān yǒu hěn duō rén fǎngwèn zhège wǎngzhàn.
examples.en: Many people visit this website every day.

examples.zh: 这座城市的纺织业很发达。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de fǎngzhīyè hěn fādá.
examples.en: This city's textile industry is very developed.

examples.zh: 她的母亲是个纺织工人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mǔqīn shì ge fǎngzhī gōngrén.
examples.en: Her mother was a textile worker.

examples.zh: 纺织品的价格最近上涨了。
examples.pinyin: Fǎngzhīpǐn de jiàgé zuìjìn shàngzhǎng le.
