examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài chēzhàn gàobié.
examples.en: We said goodbye at the station.

examples.zh: 他向大家告别，然后走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dàjiā gàobié, ránhòu zǒu le.
examples.en: He said goodbye to everyone and then left.

examples.pinyin: Gàobié guòqù, kāishǐ xīn shēnghuó.
examples.en: Say goodbye to the past and start a new life.

examples.zh: 时间不早了，我该告辞了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ gāi gàocí le.
examples.en: It's getting late, so I should be going.

examples.zh: 他向主人告辞，然后离开了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng zhǔrén gàocí, ránhòu líkāi le.
examples.en: He took his leave of the host and then left.

examples.zh: 他们走的时候才向我告辞。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zǒu de shíhou cái xiàng wǒ gàocí.
examples.en: They only said goodbye to me when they were leaving.

examples.pinyin: Māma gàojiè wǒ bú yào wán huǒ.
examples.en: Mom warned me not to play with fire.

examples.zh: 老师告诫大家考试不能作弊。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gàojiè dàjiā kǎoshì bù néng zuòbì.
examples.en: The teacher warned everyone that cheating in exams is not allowed.

examples.pinyin: Tā de huà shì duì wǒ de gàojiè.
examples.en: His words were a warning to me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ gàosu wǒ ba.
examples.en: Go on, tell me.

examples.pinyin: Tā gàosu wǒ, míngtiān bù lái.
examples.en: He told me he wouldn't come tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gàosu māma.
examples.en: I didn't tell Mom.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ gē yíxià zhè kuài ròu.
examples.en: Please cut this piece of meat for me.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn gēpò le shǒuzhǐ.
examples.en: He accidentally cut his finger.

examples.pinyin: Nóngmín zài tián lǐ gē màizi.
examples.en: Farmers are harvesting wheat in the fields.

examples.zh: 把这些东西先搁在桌子上吧。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ zhèxiē dōngxi xiān gē zài zhuōzi shàng ba.
examples.en: Put these things on the table for now.

examples.zh: 这件事先搁一搁，等有时间再处理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xiān gē yi gē, děng yǒu shíjiān zài chǔlǐ.
examples.en: Let's put this aside for now and deal with it when we have time.

examples.zh: 他把计划搁下了，一直没有再提。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ jìhuà gē xià le, yìzhí méiyǒu zài tí.
examples.en: He shelved the plan and never brought it up again.

examples.pinyin: Tā de gēbo hěn yǒulì.
examples.en: His arms are very strong.

examples.pinyin: Tā wǎnzhe wǒ de gēbo.
examples.en: She linked her arm with mine.

examples.pinyin: Gēbo yǒudiǎn tòng.
examples.en: My arm aches a bit.

examples.zh: 他的脸上生了一个小疙瘩。
examples.pinyin: Tā de liǎn shàng shēng le yí ge xiǎo gēda.
examples.en: A small bump has come up on his face.

examples.zh: 这个问题在我心里是个疙瘩，一直解不开。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zài wǒ xīnlǐ shì ge gēda, yìzhí jiě bu kāi.
examples.en: This question has been a knot in my mind that I can't untangle.

examples.zh: 我们之间有个小疙瘩，需要坐下来好好聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān yǒu ge xiǎo gēda, xūyào zuò xiàlái hǎohāo liáoliao.
examples.en: There's a small rift between us, so we should sit down and talk it through.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yīshēng.
examples.en: My older brother is a doctor.

examples.pinyin: Gēge zài Běijīng gōngzuò.
examples.en: My older brother works in Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Gēge hé mèimei dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: My older brother and younger sister are both happy.

examples.zh: 这首诗歌颂了母亲的爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shī gēsòngle mǔqīn de ài.
examples.en: This poem praises a mother's love.

examples.zh: 很多作家歌颂大自然的美。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō zuòjiā gēsòng dà zìrán de měi.
examples.en: Many writers praise the beauty of nature.

examples.zh: 人们常用诗歌来歌颂友谊。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen cháng yòng shīgē lái gēsòng yǒuyì.
examples.en: People often use poems to celebrate friendship.

examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō gēzi.
examples.en: There are lots of pigeons in the park.

examples.pinyin: Gēzi zài dì shàng zhǎo chī de.
examples.en: The pigeons are hunting for food on the ground.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèiguo gēzi ma?
examples.en: Have you ever fed pigeons?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài gébì.
examples.en: My room is next door.

examples.pinyin: Gébì de xiǎohái hěn chǎo.
examples.en: The kid next door is very noisy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi gébì de rén ma?
examples.en: Do you know the people next door?

examples.zh: 两个人之间有了隔阂，说话也少了。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén zhījiān yǒu le géhé, shuōhuà yě shǎo le.
examples.en: A rift grew between the two of them, and they talked less.

examples.zh: 我们要消除彼此之间的隔阂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiāochú bǐcǐ zhījiān de géhé.
examples.en: We need to clear away the mistrust between us.

examples.pinyin: Duō gōutōng, cái néng jiǎnshǎo géhé.
examples.en: Only by communicating more can we reduce misunderstandings.

examples.zh: 这座城市的格局很合理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de géjú hěn hélǐ.
examples.en: The layout of this city is very sensible.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de géjú hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The layout of this flat is very good.

examples.zh: 公司需要改变现在的格局。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào gǎibiàn xiànzài de géjú.
examples.en: The company needs to change its current setup.

examples.zh: 生病的人应该和家人隔离一段时间。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de rén yīnggāi hé jiārén gélí yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.en: A sick person should be kept apart from family for a while.

examples.zh: 玻璃把两个房间隔离开了。
examples.pinyin: Bōlí bǎ liǎng ge fángjiān gélí kāi le.
examples.en: Glass separates the two rooms.

examples.zh: 这种材料可以隔离噪音。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào kěyǐ gélí zàoyīn.
examples.en: This material can block out noise.

examples.zh: 手机的出现带来了一场革命。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī de chūxiàn dàilaile yì chǎng gémìng.
examples.en: The arrival of cell phones brought about a revolution.

examples.zh: 他的发明是一次技术革命。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fāmíng shì yí cì jìshù gémìng.
examples.en: His invention was a technological revolution.

examples.zh: 这不是革命，只是一个小变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì gémìng, zhǐ shì yí ge xiǎo biànhuà.
examples.en: This isn't a revolution, just a small change.

examples.zh: 请按照规定的格式写作业。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào guīdìng de géshì xiě zuòyè.
examples.en: Please write the homework in the required format.

examples.zh: 这份文件的格式有问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn de géshì yǒu wèntí.
examples.en: There is a problem with the format of this document.

examples.zh: 电子邮件的格式要正确。
examples.pinyin: Diànzǐ yóujiàn de géshì yào zhèngquè.
examples.en: The format of the email needs to be correct.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de yuèliang géwài míngliàng.
examples.en: The moon is especially bright tonight.

examples.pinyin: Tā duì háizi géwài guānxīn.
examples.en: She is especially caring towards the children.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngtiān géwài lěng.
examples.en: This winter is unusually cold.

examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng ge bēizi.
examples.en: There are two cups on the table.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge rén shì wǒ péngyou.
examples.en: This person is my friend.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge píngguǒ.
examples.en: I want to buy an apple.

examples.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué, zǎoshang hǎo!
examples.en: Good morning, everyone!

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gè yǒu yí ge píngguǒ.
examples.en: Each of us has an apple.

examples.pinyin: Gègè guójiā de rén dōu lái le.
examples.en: People from every country came.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu gèbié tóngxué chídào le.
examples.en: Only a few classmates were late.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì gèbié qíngkuàng.
examples.en: This is just an isolated case.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gèbié de wèn le tāmen.
examples.en: The teacher asked them one by one.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de gèrén yìjiàn.
examples.en: This is my personal opinion.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shì gèrén de shìqing.
examples.en: This is a personal matter.

examples.pinyin: Gèrén juéde zhèyàng bú tài hǎo.
examples.en: Personally, I don't think this is a good idea.

examples.zh: 讨论的时候，大家各抒己见。
examples.pinyin: Tǎolùn de shíhou, dàjiā gè shū jǐ jiàn.
examples.en: During the discussion, everyone aired their own views.

examples.zh: 我们可以在会上各抒己见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ zài huì shàng gè shū jǐ jiàn.
examples.en: We can each voice our own opinions at the meeting.

examples.zh: 老师鼓励学生各抒己见。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì xuésheng gè shū jǐ jiàn.
examples.en: The teacher encouraged students to share their own views.

examples.zh: 每个个体都有自己的特点。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge gètǐ dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tèdiǎn.
examples.en: Each individual has their own traits.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīngyíng yì jiā gètǐ xiǎo diàn.
examples.en: He runs a small privately owned shop.

examples.zh: 社会是由许多个体组成的。
examples.pinyin: Shèhuì shì yóu xǔduō gètǐ zǔchéng de.
examples.en: Society is made up of many individuals.

examples.pinyin: Tā de gèxìng hěn qiáng.
examples.en: She has a strong personality.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的个性。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de gèxìng.
examples.en: Everyone has their own individuality.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shèjì hěn yǒu gèxìng.
examples.en: This design has a lot of character.

examples.zh: 下课以后，大家各自回家。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, dàjiā gèzì huí jiā.
examples.en: After class, everyone went home by themselves.

examples.en: Each of us prepared a gift.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen gèzì yǒu bùtóng de àihào.
examples.en: Each of them has different hobbies.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde tā de gèzi zěnmeyàng?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi le yì bēi chá.

examples.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: He phoned me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ gěi wǒ yí ge píngguǒ ba.
examples.en: Give me an apple, will you?

examples.pinyin: Zhè kē shù de gēn hěn shēn.
examples.en: This tree has deep roots.

examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn shéngzi tài duǎn le.
examples.en: This rope is too short.

examples.en: He gave me a banana.

examples.en: I'm going to Beijing with him.

examples.en: Who are you talking to?

examples.en: The puppy follows me.

examples.en: I simply have no idea about this.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de gēnběn yuányīn shì shénme?

examples.en: He didn't come to work at all.

examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhège dìtú, chēzhàn zài nàr.
examples.en: According to this map, the station is over there.

examples.zh: 根据你的话，我们应该早点走。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù nǐ de huà, wǒmen yīnggāi zǎodiǎn zǒu.
examples.en: Going by what you said, we should leave earlier.

examples.zh: 我们根据老师的要求做作业。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gēnjù lǎoshī de yāoqiú zuò zuòyè.
examples.en: We do our homework as the teacher requires.

examples.pinyin: Háizi pǎo dào māma gēnqián.
examples.en: The child ran up to his mom.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng zhàn dào wǒ gēnqián lái ma?
examples.en: Can you come and stand in front of me?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú zài lǎoshī gēnqián, suǒyǐ méi tīngjiàn.
examples.en: I wasn't near the teacher, so I didn't hear.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng guānniàn zài tā xīnlǐ gēnshēndìgù.
examples.en: This belief is deeply rooted in his mind.

examples.zh: 要改变根深蒂固的想法不容易。

examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu gēnsuí zhe zhǔrén zǒu.
examples.en: The puppy followed its owner.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng gēnsuí wǒmen yìqǐ qù ma?
examples.en: Can you come along with us?

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu gēnsuí lǎoshī zǒujìn le jiàoshì.
examples.en: Everyone followed the teacher into the classroom.

examples.zh: 懒惰是很多失败的根源。
examples.pinyin: Lǎnduò shì hěn duō shībài de gēnyuán.
examples.en: Laziness is the root of many failures.

examples.zh: 我们要找到事故的根源。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǎodào shìgù de gēnyuán.
examples.en: We need to find the root cause of the accident.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá gēnzōng le nà liàng qìchē.
examples.en: The police followed that car.

examples.zh: 你有没有跟踪过包裹的进度？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu gēnzōng guo bāoguǒ de jìndù?
examples.en: Have you tracked the progress of the package?

examples.pinyin: Bú yào gēnzōng biérén, zhèyàng bù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't follow people around; that isn't right.

examples.pinyin: Nóngmín měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù gēngdì.
examples.en: Farmers go out to plough the fields every morning.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn gēngdì hěn féiwò.
examples.en: This arable land is very fertile.

examples.zh: 城市扩大后，很多耕地都消失了。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì kuòdà hòu, hěn duō gēngdì dōu xiāoshī le.
examples.en: After the city expanded, a lot of farmland disappeared.

examples.zh: 请及时更新你的手机系统。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jíshí gēngxīn nǐ de shǒujī xìtǒng.
examples.en: Please update your phone's system promptly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hùzhào yào gēngxīn le.
examples.en: My passport needs to be renewed.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng gēngxīnle càidān.
examples.en: This restaurant has updated its menu.

examples.zh: 报纸第二天更正了这个错误。
examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ dì'èr tiān gēngzhèngle zhège cuòwù.
examples.en: The newspaper corrected this mistake the next day.

examples.zh: 请你更正一下你的信息。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gēngzhèng yíxià nǐ de xìnxī.
examples.en: Please correct your information.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fāyīn xūyào gēngzhèng.
examples.en: My pronunciation needs correcting.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ gèng gāo.
examples.en: He is taller than me.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang gèng ānjìng.
examples.en: This place is quieter.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gèng xǐhuan hē chá.
examples.en: I like drinking tea even more.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì gèngjiā lěng le.
examples.en: The weather has become even colder.

examples.pinyin: Tā de kǒuyǔ gèngjiā liúlì le.
examples.en: His spoken language is even more fluent.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā gèngjiā nǔlì de xuéxí.
examples.en: Everyone is studying even harder.

examples.pinyin: Tā qù gōng'ānjú bàn shì.
examples.en: He went to the Public Security Bureau on some business.

examples.zh: 我的钱包丢了，去公安局报了案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, qù gōng'ānjú bào le àn.
examples.en: I lost my wallet, so I went to the Public Security Bureau to report it.

examples.zh: 公安局就在这条街的尽头。
examples.pinyin: Gōng'ānjú jiù zài zhè tiáo jiē de jìntóu.
examples.en: The Public Security Bureau is right at the end of this street.

examples.pinyin: Chéngjì shénme shíhou gōngbù?

examples.zh: 老师已经公布了考试结果。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yǐjīng gōngbù le kǎoshì jiéguǒ.
examples.en: The teacher has already published the exam results.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gōngbù le xīn de guīdìng.
examples.en: The company announced new rules.

examples.en: During the holidays, train tickets are in short supply.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba zài gōngchǎng gōngzuò.
examples.en: My dad works in a factory.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn qìchē.
examples.en: This factory makes cars.

examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng lí zhèli yuǎn ma?
examples.en: Is the factory far from here?

examples.en: The engineer is checking the machine.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng dāng gōngchéngshī ma?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de jiàgé hěn gōngdào.
examples.en: This shop's prices are reasonable.

examples.pinyin: Zuòrén yào jiǎng gōngdào.
examples.en: You should always be fair to people.

examples.zh: 你觉得这个价格公道吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège jiàgé gōngdào ma?
examples.en: Do you think this price is fair?

examples.zh: 故宫是一座很大的宫殿。

examples.pinyin: Bān dào xīn chéngshì hòu, tā chángcháng gǎndào gūdú.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié gūdú, wǒmen jīngcháng liánxì ba.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào gūlì zìjǐ, duō hé péngyou jiāoliú.

examples.pinyin: Hǎo ba, gūqiě xiāngxìn nǐ yí cì.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì gǔdài de lìshǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù.

examples.pinyin: Gǔdōngmen jīntiān zài huìyìshì kāihuì.
examples.en: The shareholders are holding a meeting in the boardroom today.

examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi gǔdōng, nǐ yǒu quán cānjiā tóupiào.
examples.en: As a shareholder, you have the right to vote.

examples.zh: 这个花瓶是古董，很值钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huāpíng shì gǔdǒng, hěn zhíqián.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔdòng tóngxuémen cānjiā bǐsài.
examples.en: The teacher urged the classmates to join the competition.

examples.zh: 别鼓动他去做危险的事。
examples.pinyin: Bié gǔdòng tā qù zuò wēixiǎn de shì.
examples.en: Don't egg him on to do something dangerous.

examples.zh: 广告鼓动大家买新手机。
examples.pinyin: Guǎnggào gǔdòng dàjiā mǎi xīn shǒujī.
examples.en: The ad encouraged everyone to buy a new phone.

examples.zh: 这辆车的刹车有故障，要马上修。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de shāchē yǒu gùzhàng, yào mǎshàng xiū.
examples.en: This car's brakes are faulty and need fixing right away.

examples.en: No wonder you're so tired; you have too much work.

examples.en: No wonder he didn't come; it turns out he was sick.

examples.pinyin: Xīwàng wǒmen yǐhòu hái néng hézuò.
examples.en: I hope we can work together again in the future.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì hézuò hěn yúkuài.
examples.en: This collaboration was very pleasant.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yīfu shì hēi de.
examples.en: My clothes are black.

examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn hēi, nǐ bié zǒu.
examples.en: It's very dark outside, so don't go.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan hēisè háishi báisè?
examples.en: Do you prefer black or white?

examples.pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zài zhèlǐ!
examples.en: Hey, there you are!

examples.pinyin: Hēi, bié zǒu, děng děng wǒ!
examples.en: Hey, don't go; wait for me!

examples.zh: 嘿，你知道他去哪里了吗？
examples.pinyin: Hēi, nǐ zhīdao tā qù nǎlǐ le ma?
examples.en: Hey, do you know where he went?

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě zì.
examples.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng yǒu hěn duō zì.
examples.en: There are a lot of characters on the blackboard.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng kàn qīngchu hēibǎn ma?
examples.en: Can you see the blackboard clearly?

examples.pinyin: Qiáng shàng hái liúzhe yí dào hénjì.
examples.en: A mark is still left on the wall.

examples.zh: 桌子上有咖啡的痕迹，擦不掉了。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu kāfēi de hénjì, cābudiào le.
examples.en: There's a coffee stain on the table that won't come off.

examples.zh: 雨停了，地上没有留下任何痕迹。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, dìshang méiyǒu liúxià rènhé hénjì.
examples.en: The rain stopped, and no traces were left on the ground.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie nǐ.
examples.en: I'm fine, thanks.

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn máng.
examples.en: He is very busy today.

examples.pinyin: Běijīng hěn dà, rén hěn duō.
examples.en: Beijing is very big, with lots of people.

examples.zh: 他狠心地把旧玩具都扔掉了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěnxīn de bǎ jiù wánjù dōu rēngdiào le.
examples.en: He callously threw away all the old toys.

examples.zh: 你怎么这么狠心，连一句话都不跟我说？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème hěnxīn, lián yí jù huà dōu bù gēn wǒ shuō?
examples.en: How could you be so heartless as not to say a single word to me?

examples.zh: 她狠心地拒绝了朋友的请求。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěnxīn de jùjué le péngyou de qǐngqiú.
examples.en: She coldly turned down her friend's request.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hèn zhè zhǒng tiānqì.
examples.en: I hate this kind of weather.

examples.zh: 他很后悔，恨自己没早点说。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn hòuhuǐ, hèn zìjǐ méi zǎo diǎn shuō.
examples.en: He regrets it and is angry with himself for not speaking sooner.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hèn bu hèn wǒ?
examples.en: Do you hate me?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hèn bu dé mǎshàng huí jiā.
examples.en: I'm dying to go home right now.

examples.zh: 他恨不得一天就学会中文。
examples.pinyin: Tā hèn bu dé yì tiān jiù xuéhuì Zhōngwén.
examples.en: He wishes he could master Chinese in a single day.

examples.zh: 看到新玩具，孩子恨不得立刻拿到手。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào xīn wánjù, háizi hèn bu dé lìkè nádào shǒu.
examples.en: Seeing the new toy, the child wanted to grab it right away.

examples.pinyin: Tā hēng zhe gē zǒu jìn le fángjiān.
examples.en: He walked into the room humming a song.

examples.pinyin: Hēng, wǒ cái bù xiāngxìn nǐ ne!
examples.en: Humph, I don't believe you at all!

examples.pinyin: Tā hēng le yì shēng, zhuǎn shēn zǒu le.
examples.en: She snorted and turned away.

examples.pinyin: Tā héngzhe zǒu guò le mǎlù.
examples.en: He walked across the road.

examples.pinyin: Bǎ shū héng zhe fàng zài zhuō shang.
examples.en: Lay the book flat on the table.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé héngchuān chéngshì.
examples.en: This river runs across the city.

examples.zh: 他一句话说完，全班哄堂大笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí jù huà shuō wán, quán bān hōngtáng dàxiào.
examples.en: As soon as he finished his line, the whole class burst out laughing.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā hōngrán jiàohǎo.
examples.en: Everyone burst into cheers.

examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wèishénme hōngtáng dàxiào?
examples.en: Why was everyone roaring with laughter just now?

examples.pinyin: Māma zài kǎoxiāng lǐ hōng bǐnggān.
examples.en: Mom is baking biscuits in the oven.

examples.zh: 把湿衣服放在暖气旁边烘干。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ shī yīfu fàng zài nuǎnqì pángbiān hōnggān.
examples.en: Put the wet clothes by the radiator to dry them.

examples.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ hōng de hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.en: The room is nice and warm.

examples.zh: 这部电影在当地引起了轰动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài dāngdì yǐnqǐ le hōngdòng.
examples.en: This film caused a sensation locally.

examples.zh: 他的新书为什么这么轰动？
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīn shū wèishénme zhème hōngdòng?
examples.en: Why has his new book created such a stir?

examples.zh: 这件事没有轰动，很快就过去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì méiyǒu hōngdòng, hěn kuài jiù guòqù le.
examples.en: This didn't cause much of a stir; it soon passed.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hóngsè.
examples.en: I like red the most.

examples.pinyin: Zhège píngguǒ hěn hóng.
examples.en: This apple is very red.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yīfu zěnme zhème hóng?
examples.en: Why is your shirt so red?

examples.zh: 春节的时候，长辈会给小孩子发红包。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié de shíhou, zhǎngbèi huì gěi xiǎo háizi fā hóngbāo.
examples.en: During the Spring Festival, elders give children red envelopes of money.

examples.zh: 公司年底发了红包，大家都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī niándǐ fāle hóngbāo, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: At year-end the company handed out bonuses, and everyone was happy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào hóngbāo le ma?
examples.en: Did you get your red envelope?

examples.zh: 我们要从宏观的角度看问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào cóng hóngguān de jiǎodù kàn wèntí.
examples.en: We need to look at the problem from a big-picture perspective.

examples.pinyin: Tā shàncháng hóngguān fēnxī.
examples.en: He is good at big-picture analysis.

examples.zh: 你先看一下宏观的情况，再看细节。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān kàn yíxià hóngguān de qíngkuàng, zài kàn xìjié.
examples.en: Look at the overall picture first, then the details.

examples.zh: 洪水把村子里的房子都冲坏了。
examples.pinyin: Hóngshuǐ bǎ cūnzi lǐ de fángzi dōu chōnghuài le.
examples.en: The flood washed away the houses in the village.

examples.zh: 大雨下了三天，河里的洪水越来越高。
examples.pinyin: Dàyǔ xià le sān tiān, hé lǐ de hóngshuǐ yuè lái yuè gāo.
examples.en: It rained hard for three days, and the floodwater in the river kept rising.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiàn guo zhēnzhèng de hóngshuǐ ma?
examples.en: Have you ever seen a real flood?

examples.pinyin: Nà zuò gōngdiàn fēicháng hóngwěi.
examples.en: That palace is truly magnificent.

examples.zh: 这座大桥的设计很宏伟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo de shèjì hěn hóngwěi.
examples.en: This bridge has a grand design.

examples.zh: 这座博物馆的外形很宏伟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn de wàixíng hěn hóngwěi.
examples.en: The museum's exterior is very imposing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hóulong yǒudiǎn téng.
examples.en: My throat is a bit sore.

examples.zh: 天气干燥，喉咙很不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì gānzào, hóulong hěn bù shūfu.
examples.en: The air is dry, and my throat feels uncomfortable.

examples.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ, kěyǐ bǎohù hóulong.
examples.en: Drinking plenty of water helps protect your throat.

examples.pinyin: Hóuzi zài shù shang.
examples.en: The monkey is in the tree.

examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ yǒu hóuzi.
examples.en: There are monkeys in the zoo.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī hóuzi hěn cōngmíng.
examples.en: This monkey is very clever.

examples.zh: 他生气的时候总爱大吼。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngqì de shíhou zǒng ài dàhǒu.
examples.en: He always shouts when he gets angry.

examples.pinyin: Gǒu zài yuànzi lǐ dàshēng hǒujiào.
examples.en: The dog barked loudly in the yard.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié hǒu, wǒ tīng de jiàn.
examples.en: Don't yell; I can hear you.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn hòu.
examples.en: This book is very thick.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yào chuān hòu yīfu.
examples.en: In winter you should wear thick clothes.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhǐ hěn hòu.
examples.en: This sheet of paper is thick.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de hòudài zhù zài Běijīng.
examples.en: Their descendants live in Beijing.

examples.zh: 这种鸟的后代越来越多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng niǎo de hòudài yuèláiyuè duō.
examples.en: The offspring of this kind of bird are growing in number.

examples.zh: 我们要为后代保护环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wèi hòudài bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.en: We should protect the environment for future generations.

examples.zh: 有了这份工作，他就没有后顾之忧了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le zhè fèn gōngzuò, tā jiù méiyǒu hòugù zhī yōu le.
examples.en: With this job, he no longer has to worry about his family.

examples.zh: 孩子照顾好了，我们就没有后顾之忧。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhàogù hǎo le, wǒmen jiù méiyǒu hòugù zhī yōu.
examples.en: Once the children are looked after, we have nothing to worry about at home.

examples.zh: 你放心去吧，家里有我，你没有后顾之忧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn qù ba, jiālǐ yǒu wǒ, nǐ méiyǒu hòugù zhī yōu.
examples.en: Go with peace of mind; I'm at home, so you have no worries about the family.

examples.pinyin: Bù nǔlì de hòuguǒ hěn yánzhòng.
examples.en: The consequences of not trying are serious.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiǎngxiang hòuguǒ.
examples.en: You should think about the consequences.

examples.pinyin: Chī tài duō de hòuguǒ shì pàng.
examples.en: The result of eating too much is putting on weight.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ méiyǒu qù.
examples.en: I regret not going.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hòuhuǐ ma?
examples.en: Do you regret it?

examples.pinyin: Tā bú hòuhuǐ zìjǐ de xuǎnzé.
examples.en: He doesn't regret his choice.

examples.pinyin: Hòulái tāmen jiéhūn le.
examples.en: Later on, they got married.

examples.zh: 我一开始不喜欢，后来就喜欢了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì kāishǐ bù xǐhuan, hòulái jiù xǐhuan le.
examples.en: At first I didn't like it, but later I did.

examples.pinyin: Hòulái, yǔ tíng le.
examples.en: Later on, the rain stopped.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zuòwèi zài jiàoshì hòumiàn.
examples.en: My seat is at the back of the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zǒu zài wǒ hòumiàn.
examples.en: Please walk behind me.

examples.pinyin: Hòumiàn hái yǒu shénme jiémù?
examples.en: What's coming up next in the program?

examples.zh: 他负责公司的后勤工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā fùzé gōngsī de hòuqín gōngzuò.
examples.en: He is in charge of the company's logistics.

examples.zh: 后勤部门的人每天都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Hòuqín bùmén de rén měitiān dōu hěn máng.
examples.en: The logistics staff are busy every day.

examples.zh: 这次活动的后勤你准备好了吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng de hòuqín nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
examples.en: Have you finished arranging the logistics for this event?

examples.zh: 我们需要挑选候选的地点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tiāoxuǎn hòuxuǎn de dìdiǎn.
examples.en: We need to pick the shortlisted venues.

examples.zh: 这份名单上有三个候选人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn míngdān shàng yǒu sān ge hòuxuǎnrén.
examples.en: There are three candidates on this list.

examples.zh: 他是这次比赛的候选人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zhè cì bǐsài de hòuxuǎnrén.
examples.en: He is one of the candidates for this competition.

examples.zh: 别忽略身体发出的信号。
examples.pinyin: Bié hūlüè shēntǐ fāchū de xìnhào.
examples.en: Don't ignore the signals your body sends.

examples.zh: 这个细节很容易被忽略。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xìjié hěn róngyì bèi hūlüè.
examples.en: This detail is easily overlooked.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng hūlüè tā de gǎnshòu.
examples.en: I often overlook how he feels.

examples.pinyin: Hūrán xià yǔ le.
examples.en: Suddenly it started to rain.

examples.pinyin: Tā hūrán bú jiàn le.
examples.en: He suddenly disappeared.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hūrán xiǎngqǐ le yí jiàn shì.
examples.en: I suddenly remembered something.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào hūshì shēntǐ de jiànkāng.
examples.en: Don't neglect your health.

examples.pinyin: Tā hūshì le wǒ de jiànyì.
examples.en: He ignored my suggestion.

examples.zh: 你为什么忽视这个问题？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme hūshì zhège wèntí?
examples.en: Why are you ignoring this problem?

examples.pinyin: Shēn hūxī yíxià, fàngsōng.
examples.en: Take a deep breath and relax.

examples.zh: 这里的空气好，呼吸很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì hǎo, hūxī hěn shūfu.
examples.en: The air here is good, and breathing feels great.

examples.pinyin: Tā hūxī hěn jícù.
examples.en: He was breathing hard.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de fēng zài chuāng wài hūxiào.
examples.en: Winter wind howls outside the window.

examples.zh: 火车呼啸着驶过了山谷。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē hūxiàozhe shǐguò le shāngǔ.
examples.en: The train whistled as it roared through the valley.

examples.zh: 你听，外面的风声呼啸得很厉害。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, wàimiàn de fēngshēng hūxiào de hěn lìhai.
examples.en: Listen, the wind outside is howling really hard.

examples.zh: 学校呼吁大家节约用水。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào hūyù dàjiā jiéyuē yòngshuǐ.
examples.en: The school urges everyone to save water.

examples.zh: 他呼吁同学们一起保护环境。
examples.pinyin: Tā hūyù tóngxuémen yìqǐ bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.en: He called on his classmates to protect the environment together.

examples.zh: 大家的呼吁得到了很多人的支持。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de hūyù dédào le hěn duō rén de zhīchí.
examples.en: The appeal won support from many people.

examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì hú chá.
examples.en: There is a pot of tea on the table.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shāo yì hú shuǐ ba.
examples.en: Let's boil another pot of water.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ hú shì shénme zuò de?
examples.en: What is this pot made of?

examples.pinyin: Huā shàng tíngzhe yì zhī húdié.
examples.en: A butterfly is resting on the flower.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen zhuīzhe húdié pǎo.
examples.en: The children run chasing the butterflies.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kànjiàn nà zhī húdié le ma?
examples.en: Did you see that butterfly?

examples.zh: 他胡乱吃了几口饭就走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā húluàn chīle jǐ kǒu fàn jiù zǒu le.
examples.en: He wolfed down a few mouthfuls and left.

examples.zh: 你别胡乱猜测，先问清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié húluàn cāicè, xiān wènqīng chu.
examples.en: Don't guess carelessly; ask first.

examples.zh: 房间很乱，东西胡乱地堆在地上。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān hěn luàn, dōngxi húluàn de duī zài dì shang.
examples.en: The room is messy, with things piled up on the floor at random.

examples.zh: 这个湖泊有上百年的历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhège húpō yǒu shàng bǎi nián de lìshǐ.
examples.en: This lake has a history of more than a hundred years.

examples.zh: 湖泊周围的风景非常美。
examples.pinyin: Húpō zhōuwéi de fēngjǐng fēicháng měi.
examples.en: The scenery around the lake is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 我们坐船到湖泊中间去看日出。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò chuán dào húpō zhōngjiān qù kàn rìchū.
examples.en: We took a boat to the middle of the lake to watch the sunrise.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié húshuō le.
examples.en: Stop talking nonsense.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòu zài húshuō.
examples.en: He's talking nonsense again.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē huà dōu shì húshuō.
examples.en: These words are all nonsense.

examples.pinyin: Běijīng yǒu hěn duō lǎo hútòng.
examples.en: Beijing has many old alleys.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài yì tiáo xiǎo hútòng lǐ.
examples.en: I live in a small alley.

examples.pinyin: Hútòng lǐ hěn ānjìng.
examples.en: The alley is very quiet.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn hútu.
examples.en: I'm a bit muddled today.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié hútu le.
examples.en: Don't be so foolish.

examples.zh: 这个问题把我弄糊涂了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǎ wǒ nòng hútu le.
examples.en: This question has confused me.

examples.pinyin: Yéye de húxū hěn cháng.
examples.en: Grandpa's beard is very long.

examples.pinyin: Tā liú le húxū.
examples.en: He grew a beard.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de húxū gāi guā le.
examples.en: Your beard needs shaving.

examples.zh: 现在人们经常用互联网购物。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài rénmen jīngcháng yòng hùliánwǎng gòuwù.
examples.en: People often shop online these days.

examples.zh: 互联网让世界变得更小了。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng ràng shìjiè biàn de gèng xiǎo le.
examples.en: The internet has made the world feel smaller.

examples.zh: 你的网速很慢，是不是互联网出问题了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de wǎngsù hěn màn, shì bu shì hùliánwǎng chū wèntí le?
examples.en: Your connection is slow, is there a problem with the internet?

examples.pinyin: Hùshi duì wǒ hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The nurse was very kind to me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma shì hùshi.
examples.en: My mom is a nurse.

examples.pinyin: Hùshi ràng wǒ děng yíxià.
examples.en: The nurse asked me to wait a moment.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.en: We should help each other.

examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen hùxiāng rènshi.
examples.en: The classmates know each other.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hùxiāng xuéxí.
examples.en: We learn from each other.

examples.pinyin: Chūguó yào dài hùzhào.
examples.en: You need to bring your passport when you go abroad.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hùzhào zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is my passport?

examples.zh: 请给我看一下你的护照。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yíxià nǐ de hùzhào.
examples.en: Could I see your passport, please?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.en: I spent fifty kuai.

examples.en: Do you find this city's night view dazzling?

examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lìshǐ bìng bù huīhuáng.
examples.en: This period of history is not glorious.

examples.zh: 他把父亲留下的钱都挥霍光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ fùqin liú xià de qián dōu huīhuò guāng le.
examples.en: He squandered all the money his father left him.

examples.zh: 年轻人不应该挥霍时间。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén bù yīnggāi huīhuò shíjiān.
examples.en: Young people shouldn't waste their time.

examples.pinyin: Jiéyuē yìdiǎn, bié zǒngshì huīhuò.
examples.en: Be a bit thriftier and stop splurging all the time.

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, tā hěn huīxīn.
examples.en: He was discouraged after doing badly on the exam.

examples.pinyin: Bié huīxīn, xià cì zài nǔlì.
examples.en: Don't lose heart; try harder next time.

examples.pinyin: Shībài le yě bú yào huīxīn.
examples.en: Don't be discouraged even if you fail.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān huí jiā.
examples.en: I'll go home tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou huílai?
examples.en: When will you come back?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng huídá wǒ, hǎo ma?
examples.en: Please answer me, okay?

examples.zh: 他帮了我很多，我一定要好好回报他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bāng le wǒ hěn duō, wǒ yídìng yào hǎohǎo huíbào tā.
examples.en: He has helped me so much, and I must repay him properly.

examples.zh: 努力工作，一定会有回报的。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì gōngzuò, yídìng huì yǒu huíbào de.
examples.en: Hard work will always pay off.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, yǒu shénme huíbào?
examples.en: What do you get back from doing this?

examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì huíbì zhège wèntí.
examples.en: He always avoids this question.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīnggāi huíbì kùnnan.
examples.en: You shouldn't shy away from difficulties.

examples.zh: 他看到我就回避，不跟我说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàndào wǒ jiù huíbì, bù gēn wǒ shuōhuà.
examples.en: Whenever he sees me, he steers clear and won't talk to me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de huídá hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Your answer is very good.

examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu huídá wǒ.
examples.en: He didn't answer me.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge huídá duì ma?
examples.en: Is this answer right?

examples.zh: 我们一起回顾了这一年的工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ huígù le zhè yì nián de gōngzuò.
examples.en: We looked back together on this year's work.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长回顾了学校的历史。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng, xiàozhǎng huígù le xuéxiào de lìshǐ.
examples.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal reviewed the school's history.

examples.zh: 你能回顾一下今天的学习内容吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng huígù yíxià jīntiān de xuéxí nèiróng ma?
examples.en: Can you go over what we studied today?

examples.pinyin: Jiù zhǐ yào fàng dào huíshōuxiāng lǐ.
examples.en: Old paper should go in the recycling bin.

examples.zh: 这些塑料瓶可以回收利用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē sùliàopíng kěyǐ huíshōu lìyòng.
examples.en: These plastic bottles can be recycled and reused.

examples.zh: 我们要回收垃圾，保护环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào huíshōu lājī, bǎohù huánjìng.
examples.en: We should recycle our rubbish to protect the environment.

examples.zh: 我常常回忆小时候的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng huíyì xiǎo shíhou de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I often recall my life as a child.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái jìde zhège huíyì ma?
examples.en: Do you still remember this memory?

examples.zh: 这张照片让我想起了很多回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le hěn duō huíyì.
examples.en: This photo brings back many memories.

examples.zh: 他为自己的错误感到悔恨。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zìjǐ de cuòwù gǎndào huǐhèn.
examples.en: He deeply regrets his own mistakes.

examples.zh: 年轻时没好好学习，我很悔恨。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīng shí méi hǎohǎo xuéxí, wǒ hěn huǐhèn.
examples.en: I regret not studying hard when I was young.

examples.zh: 这种悔恨让他夜里睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huǐhèn ràng tā yè lǐ shuì bù zháo.
examples.en: This regret kept him awake at night.

examples.zh: 错误的决定可能会毁灭整个计划。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù de juédìng kěnéng huì huǐmiè zhěnggè jìhuà.
examples.en: A wrong decision could ruin the whole plan.

examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn huǐmièle hěn duō fángwū.
examples.en: The earthquake destroyed many houses.

examples.zh: 不要让一时的冲动毁灭你的未来。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào ràng yìshí de chōngdòng huǐmiè nǐ de wèilái.
examples.en: Don't let a moment of impulse ruin your future.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I can speak Chinese.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù huì zuò fàn.
examples.en: He can't cook.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì xiě zì ma?
examples.en: Can you write characters?

examples.zh: 明天我要向经理汇报工作。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào xiàng jīnglǐ huìbào gōngzuò.
examples.en: Tomorrow I have to report on my work to the manager.

examples.zh: 请你把调查结果汇报给老师。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ diàochá jiéguǒ huìbào gěi lǎoshī.
examples.en: Please report the survey results to the teacher.

examples.zh: 他每周都要做一次工作汇报。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu yào zuò yí cì gōngzuò huìbào.
examples.en: He gives a work report once a week.

examples.pinyin: Shōushòu huìlù shì wéifǎ de.
examples.en: Accepting bribes is illegal.

examples.pinyin: Tā jùjué le duìfāng de huìlù.
examples.en: He refused the other side's bribe.

examples.zh: 我们不能用礼物去贿赂老师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng yòng lǐwù qù huìlù lǎoshī.
examples.en: We can't use gifts to bribe the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì duōshao?
examples.en: What is today's exchange rate?

examples.pinyin: Huìlǜ biànhuà hěn kuài.
examples.en: Exchange rates change very quickly.

examples.zh: 出国前我先查了一下汇率。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó qián wǒ xiān chá le yíxià huìlǜ.
examples.en: Before going abroad, I checked the exchange rate.

examples.zh: 两位朋友约好下午在咖啡馆会晤。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi péngyou yuē hǎo xiàwǔ zài kāfēiguǎn huìwù.
examples.en: The two friends arranged to meet at the café in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 他们会晤后，决定一起合作。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen huìwù hòu, juédìng yìqǐ hézuò.
examples.en: After meeting, they decided to work together.

examples.zh: 老板和客户进行了一次会晤。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hé kèhù jìnxíng le yí cì huìwù.
examples.en: The boss and the client held a meeting.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu yí ge huìyì.
examples.en: There's a meeting tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Huìyìshì zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the meeting room?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de huìyì hěn cháng.
examples.en: Our meeting is very long.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le péngyou de hūnlǐ.
examples.en: I went to my friend's wedding.

examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shàng de yīnyuè hěn hǎotīng.
examples.en: The music at the wedding was lovely.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou jǔxíng hūnlǐ?
examples.en: When will your wedding take place?

examples.zh: 他突然晕倒，昏迷了一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán yūndǎo, hūnmíle yíhuìr.
examples.en: He suddenly fainted and lost consciousness for a while.

examples.zh: 病人昏迷了三天，医生很担心。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén hūnmíle sān tiān, yīshēng hěn dānxīn.
examples.en: The patient was unconscious for three days and the doctor was worried.

examples.zh: 天气太热，他差点儿昏迷。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, tā chàdiǎnr hūnmí.
examples.en: It was so hot that he nearly passed out.

examples.pinyin: Hūnyīn xūyào shuāngfāng nǔlì.
examples.en: A marriage needs effort from both sides.

examples.pinyin: Tā de hūnyīn hěn xìngfú.
examples.en: His marriage is very happy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì hūnyīn yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
examples.en: What are your views on marriage?

examples.pinyin: Tā pǎowán bù, húnshēn dōu shì hàn.
examples.en: After his run he was drenched in sweat all over.

examples.zh: 一进屋，我就觉得浑身发冷。
examples.pinyin: Yí jìn wū, wǒ jiù juéde húnshēn fā lěng.
examples.en: As soon as I walked in, I felt cold all over.

examples.pinyin: Tā húnshēn shītòu le, hái zài xiào.
examples.en: He was soaked from head to toe, and still laughing.

examples.zh: 把面粉和水混合在一起，搅拌均匀。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ miànfěn hé shuǐ hùnhé zài yìqǐ, jiǎobàn jūnyún.
examples.en: Mix the flour and water together and stir until smooth.

examples.zh: 这种颜色是红色和黄色混合的结果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yánsè shì hóngsè hé huángsè hùnhé de jiéguǒ.
examples.en: This color is the result of mixing red and yellow.

examples.zh: 这家小店的装修混合了中西风格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de zhuāngxiū hùnhé le Zhōng Xī fēnggé.
examples.en: The decor of this small shop blends Chinese and Western styles.

examples.zh: 地铁站里人很多，场面非常混乱。
examples.pinyin: Dìtiězhàn lǐ rén hěn duō, chǎngmiàn fēicháng hùnluàn.
examples.en: The subway station was packed, and the scene was chaotic.

examples.zh: 房间里很混乱，你能帮我收拾一下吗？
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ hěn hùnluàn, nǐ néng bāng wǒ shōushi yíxià ma?
examples.en: The room is a mess. Could you help me tidy it up?

examples.zh: 会议上大家意见不同，讨论得很混乱。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì shàng dàjiā yìjiàn bùtóng, tǎolùn de hěn hùnluàn.
examples.en: Everyone disagreed at the meeting, and the discussion was chaotic.

examples.zh: 这两个词很像，别把它们混淆了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge cí hěn xiàng, bié bǎ tāmen hùnxiáo le.
examples.en: These two words look alike, so don't mix them up.

examples.zh: 请不要混淆事实和观点。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào hùnxiáo shìshí hé guāndiǎn.
examples.en: Please don't confuse facts with opinions.

examples.zh: 这两种颜色很接近，容易混淆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng yánsè hěn jiējìn, róngyì hùnxiáo.
examples.en: These two colors are so close that they are easy to confuse.

examples.pinyin: Héshuǐ hěn hùnzhuó, bù néng hē.
examples.en: The river water is muddy, so it's not drinkable.

examples.zh: 雨停了，水坑里的水还是很混浊。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, shuǐkēng lǐ de shuǐ háishi hěn hùnzhuó.
examples.en: The rain has stopped, but the water in the puddle is still murky.

examples.zh: 把泥沙放进去，水就变得混浊了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ níshā fàng jìnqù, shuǐ jiù biàn de hùnzhuó le.
examples.en: Once you put sand in, the water turns cloudy.

examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen yǒu yí ge huódòng.
examples.en: We have an event this weekend.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào huódong yíxià.
examples.en: I need to get some exercise every day.

examples.pinyin: Zhège huódòng hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.en: This event is very interesting.

examples.zh: 你不听话，被雨淋湿了，活该！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù tīnghuà, bèi yǔ lín shī le, huógāi!
examples.en: You wouldn't listen, and now you're soaked. Serves you right!

examples.zh: 他把钱都花光了，现在没钱吃饭，活该。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián dōu huā guāng le, xiànzài méi qián chī fàn, huógāi.
examples.en: He spent all his money, so now he has none left for food. Serves him right.

examples.zh: 他天天熬夜玩手机，上课迟到了，活该！
examples.pinyin: Tā tiāntiān áo yè wán shǒujī, shàngkè chídào le, huógāi!
examples.en: He stays up late on his phone every night and now he's late for class. Serves him right!

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo chéng chōngmǎn le huólì.
examples.en: This small town is full of energy.

examples.zh: 他虽然七十岁了，但是身上还很有活力。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán qīshí suì le, dànshì shēn shàng hái hěn yǒu huólì.
examples.en: He is seventy, but he still has a lot of vitality.

examples.zh: 孩子们一下课就跑出去，活力十足。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen yí xiàkè jiù pǎo chūqù, huólì shízú.
examples.en: As soon as class ends, the kids run outside, full of energy.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái hěn huópo.
examples.en: This little girl is very lively.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xìnggé hěn huópo.
examples.en: He has a lively personality.

examples.pinyin: Huópo de háizi hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: Lively children are very lovable.

examples.pinyin: Bān lǐ de qìfēn hěn huóyuè.
examples.en: The class atmosphere is very lively.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài bān lǐ hěn huóyuè.
examples.en: He's very active in class.

examples.zh: 这个城市的夜生活很活跃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de yèshēnghuó hěn huóyuè.
examples.en: The city's nightlife is very lively.

examples.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ yǒu huǒ.
examples.en: There is a fire in the kitchen.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù.
examples.en: We go by train.

examples.zh: 冬天我们喜欢坐在火边。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒmen xǐhuan zuò zài huǒ biān.
examples.en: In winter we like to sit by the fire.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de huǒbàn.
examples.en: He is my best buddy.

examples.zh: 我们是多年的工作伙伴。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì duōnián de gōngzuò huǒbàn.
examples.en: We have been work partners for years.

examples.zh: 你需要一个学习伙伴吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào yí ge xuéxí huǒbàn ma?
examples.en: Do you need a study partner?

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng huǒchái diǎnzháo le làzhú.
examples.en: He lit the candle with a match.

examples.pinyin: Huǒchaihé shì kōng de.
examples.en: The matchbox is empty.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ ná yì gēn huǒchái.
examples.en: Please pass me a match.

examples.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the train station?

examples.zh: 我们坐出租车去火车站。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò chūzūchē qù huǒchēzhàn.
examples.en: We'll take a taxi to the train station.

examples.zh: 火车站前面有一个商店。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn qiánmiàn yǒu yí ge shāngdiàn.
examples.en: There's a shop in front of the train station.

examples.zh: 火箭升空的时候，声音非常大。
examples.pinyin: Huǒjiàn shēngkōng de shíhou, shēngyīn fēicháng dà.
examples.en: The noise is very loud when a rocket lifts off.

examples.zh: 我小时候特别想当宇航员，坐火箭去太空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou tèbié xiǎng dāng yǔhángyuán, zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng.
examples.en: As a child I really wanted to be an astronaut and ride a rocket into space.

examples.zh: 这枚火箭的发射很成功。
examples.pinyin: Zhè méi huǒjiàn de fāshè hěn chénggōng.
examples.en: The launch of this rocket was a success.

examples.zh: 蜡烛的火焰在风里摇来摇去。
examples.pinyin: Làzhú de huǒyàn zài fēng lǐ yáolái yáoqù.
examples.en: The candle flame flickers back and forth in the wind.

examples.zh: 火焰越来越大，大家赶紧跑出去。
examples.pinyin: Huǒyàn yuè lái yuè dà, dàjiā gǎnjǐn pǎo chūqù.
examples.en: The flames grew bigger and bigger, so everyone hurried outside.

examples.zh: 他用打火机点燃了蜡烛，火焰亮了起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng dǎhuǒjī diǎnrán le làzhú, huǒyàn liàng le qǐlai.
examples.en: He lit the candle with a lighter, and the flame flared up.

examples.pinyin: Gǔdài rén fāmíng le huǒyào.
examples.en: The ancient Chinese invented gunpowder.

examples.zh: 火药是中国古代的重要发明。
examples.pinyin: Huǒyào shì Zhōngguó gǔdài de zhòngyào fāmíng.
examples.en: Gunpowder was an important invention in ancient China.

examples.zh: 这个玩具里面没有火药，你放心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wánjù lǐmiàn méiyǒu huǒyào, nǐ fàngxīn.
examples.en: There's no gunpowder in this toy, so don't worry.

examples.zh: 不同的国家使用不同的货币。
examples.pinyin: Bùtóng de guójiā shǐyòng bùtóng de huòbì.
examples.en: Different countries use different currencies.

examples.zh: 你去过的国家用什么货币？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù guo de guójiā yòng shénme huòbì?
examples.en: What currency is used in the countries you've been to?

examples.zh: 这种货币在国外不能用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huòbì zài guówài bù néng yòng.
examples.en: This currency can't be used abroad.

examples.pinyin: Tā huòdé le dìyī míng.
examples.en: He won first place.

examples.zh: 他获得了很多朋友的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Tā huòdé le hěn duō péngyou de bāngzhù.
examples.en: He received a lot of help from his friends.

examples.zh: 你能获得这个机会，真不容易。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng huòdé zhège jīhuì, zhēn bù róngyì.
examples.en: Getting this chance is really not easy.

examples.zh: 或许明天会下雨，你带把伞吧。
examples.pinyin: Huòxǔ míngtiān huì xiàyǔ, nǐ dài bǎ sǎn ba.
examples.en: It may rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.

examples.pinyin: Tā huòxǔ yǐjīng huí jiā le.
examples.en: He may have already gone home.

examples.zh: 你问问他，或许他知道答案。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wènwen tā, huòxǔ tā zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: Ask him; maybe he knows the answer.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá huòzhě kāfēi?
examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 明天或者后天我来找你。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān huòzhě hòutiān wǒ lái zhǎo nǐ.
examples.en: I'll come and find you tomorrow or the day after.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò chē, huòzhě zǒulù.
examples.en: You can take a bus or walk.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīběnshàng měi tiān dōu hē chá.
examples.en: I drink tea almost every day.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì xuéxí de jīběn fāngfǎ.
examples.en: This is the basic method for studying.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīběn dōu dǒng le ma?
examples.en: Do you pretty much understand it all?

examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the airport?

examples.pinyin: Fēijī zài jīchǎng.
examples.en: The plane is at the airport.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang qù jīchǎng.
examples.en: We're going to the airport tomorrow morning.

examples.en: The quality of this product must be checked.

examples.zh: 请你简要说明一下情况。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jiǎnyào shuōmíng yíxià qíngkuàng.
examples.en: Please briefly explain the situation.

examples.zh: 他用几句话做了简要的介绍。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jǐ jù huà zuòle jiǎnyào de jièshào.
examples.en: He gave a short introduction in a few sentences.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào xiě de hěn jiǎnyào.
examples.en: This report is written very concisely.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jiǎnzhí tài měi le.
examples.en: This place is simply beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiǎnzhí tài cōngming!
examples.en: You are incredibly smart.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí jiǎnzhí tài nán le.
examples.en: This question is ridiculously hard.

examples.zh: 汽车开过水坑，把我的裤子溅湿了。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē kāi guò shuǐkēng, bǎ wǒ de kùzi jiàn shī le.
examples.en: A car drove through a puddle and splashed my trousers.

examples.pinyin: Shuǐ jiàn dào le wǒ de liǎn shàng.
examples.en: Water splashed onto my face.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, rè yóu huì jiàn chūlái.
examples.en: Be careful, hot oil can splatter out.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This piece of clothing looks good.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dōngxi shì wǒ de.
examples.en: This item is mine.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jiàn dōngxi gěi nǐ.
examples.en: I've got something for you.

examples.zh: 这位专家能鉴别真假古董。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā néng jiànbié zhēnjiǎ gǔdǒng.
examples.en: This expert can tell real antiques from fake ones.

examples.zh: 购买前要学会鉴别产品的质量。
examples.pinyin: Gòumǎi qián yào xuéhuì jiànbié chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng.
examples.en: Learn to tell good products from bad before you buy.

examples.zh: 我很难鉴别这两种茶的区别。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn nán jiànbié zhè liǎng zhǒng chá de qūbié.
examples.en: I find it hard to tell the difference between these two teas.

examples.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个间谍的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì yí ge jiàndié de gùshi.
examples.en: This movie tells the story of a spy.

examples.zh: 侦探小说里总有一个神秘的间谍。
examples.pinyin: Zhēntàn xiǎoshuō lǐ zǒng yǒu yí ge shénmì de jiàndié.
examples.en: Detective novels always have a mysterious spy.

examples.pinyin: Tā kàn le hěn duō jiàndié diànyǐng.
examples.en: He has watched many spy movies.

examples.zh: 专家正在鉴定这幅画的年代。
examples.pinyin: Zhuānjiā zhèngzài jiàndìng zhè fú huà de niándài.
examples.en: Experts are determining the age of this painting.

examples.zh: 医生需要做检查，才能鉴定病因。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào zuò jiǎnchá, cái néng jiàndìng bìngyīn.
examples.en: The doctor has to run tests before determining the cause of the illness.

examples.zh: 这份报告需要经过鉴定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào xūyào jīngguò jiàndìng.
examples.en: This report needs to be formally evaluated.

examples.zh: 他去过很多国家，真是见多识广。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù guo hěn duō guójiā, zhēn shì jiàn duō shí guǎng.
examples.en: He has been to many countries; he is really worldly-wise.

examples.zh: 你为什么能这么见多识广？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme néng zhème jiàn duō shí guǎng?
examples.en: How did you become so knowledgeable?

examples.zh: 老人并不见多识广，但很有智慧。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén bìng bú jiàn duō shí guǎng, dàn hěn yǒu zhìhuì.
examples.en: The old man hasn't seen much of the world, but he is very wise.

examples.zh: 两班车之间的间隔是十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng bān chē zhījiān de jiàngé shì shí fēnzhōng.
examples.en: The interval between two buses is ten minutes.

examples.zh: 这两棵树之间有一定的间隔。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng kē shù zhījiān yǒu yídìng de jiàngé.
examples.en: There is a certain gap between these two trees.

examples.zh: 每次考试之间要有适当的间隔。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kǎoshì zhījiān yào yǒu shìdàng de jiàngé.
examples.en: There should be a suitable break between each exam.

examples.zh: 我是从朋友那里间接听说的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng péngyou nàlǐ jiànjiē tīngshuō de.
examples.en: I heard about it indirectly, through a friend.

examples.pinyin: Jiànjiē yuányīn yǒu hěn duō.
examples.en: There are many indirect causes.

examples.zh: 他的回答很间接，没有直接说出答案。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá hěn jiànjiē, méiyǒu zhíjiē shuōchū dá'àn.
examples.en: His answer was indirect and didn't state the answer outright.

examples.zh: 你对这个问题有什么见解？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì zhège wèntí yǒu shénme jiànjiě?
examples.en: What is your view on this question?

examples.pinyin: Tā de jiànjiě hěn dútè.
examples.en: His views are very distinctive.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tóngyì nǐ de jiànjiě.
examples.en: I don't agree with your view.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng ma?
examples.en: Are you healthy?

examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào.
examples.en: Health matters most.

examples.pinyin: Duō duànliàn, shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.en: Exercise often and stay healthy.

examples.zh: 我们要建立一个新团队。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiànlì yí ge xīn tuánduì.
examples.en: We want to set up a new team.

examples.zh: 他们建立了很好的关系。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiànlì le hěn hǎo de guānxi.
examples.en: They have built a good relationship.

examples.zh: 你想建立什么样的习惯？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng jiànlì shénme yàng de xíguàn?
examples.en: What kind of habit do you want to build?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān jiànmiàn ba.
examples.en: Let's meet tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou hé tā jiànmiàn?
examples.en: When are you meeting him?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen sān tiān méi jiànmiàn le.
examples.en: We haven't met for three days.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jiànpán hěn hǎoyòng.
examples.en: This keyboard is easy to use.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiànpán huài le.
examples.en: My keyboard is broken.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xīn de jiànpán?
examples.en: Do you have a new keyboard?

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ hěn jiànquán.
examples.en: He is physically sound.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jiànquán de zhìdù.
examples.en: We need a sound system of rules.

examples.zh: 这个社区的服务设施很健全。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèqū de fúwù shèshī hěn jiànquán.
examples.en: This community has very complete services.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de jiànshè hěn kuài.
examples.en: Construction in this city is moving quickly.

examples.zh: 我们要建设一个漂亮的花园。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiànshè yí ge piàoliang de huāyuán.
examples.en: We want to build a beautiful garden.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài jiànshè xīn fángzi ma?
examples.en: Are you building a new house?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu qù liǎng cì jiànshēnfáng.
examples.en: I go to the gym twice a week.

examples.zh: 这家健身房的设备很新。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiànshēnfáng de shèbèi hěn xīn.
examples.en: This gym has very new equipment.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn ma?
examples.en: Do you go to the gym to work out?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào jiàntà cǎopíng.
examples.en: Please don't trample the lawn.

examples.zh: 你怎么能践踏别人的感情？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme néng jiàntà biérén de gǎnqíng?
examples.en: How could you trample on other people's feelings?

examples.pinyin: Cǎodì shang méiyǒu bèi jiàntà de hénjì.
examples.en: There's no sign of trampling on the grass.

examples.en: Several naval vessels are docked at the port.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiàntǐng de sùdù hěn kuài.
examples.en: These warships are very fast.

examples.pinyin: Jiàntǐng zài hǎi shang xúnluó ma?
examples.en: Do the naval vessels patrol at sea?

examples.zh: 旅行可以增加我们的见闻。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng kěyǐ zēngjiā wǒmen de jiànwén.
examples.en: Travel can broaden our horizons.

examples.zh: 你有什么有趣的见闻吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yǒuqù de jiànwén ma?
examples.en: Do you have any interesting experiences to share?

examples.zh: 他的见闻不多，很少出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiànwén bù duō, hěn shǎo chūmén.
examples.en: He hasn't seen much, since he rarely goes out.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge jiànyì.
examples.en: I have a suggestion.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiànyì wǒ duō dú shū.
examples.en: The teacher suggested that I read more.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de jiànyì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Your suggestion is very good.

examples.zh: 他见义勇为，帮助了那位老人。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiàn yì yǒng wéi, bāngzhù le nà wèi lǎorén.
examples.en: He stepped in bravely to help that old man.

examples.zh: 你觉得见义勇为的人值得尊敬吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde jiàn yì yǒng wéi de rén zhíde zūnjìng ma?
examples.en: Do you think people who act bravely for what's right deserve respect?

examples.zh: 我们应该学习见义勇为的精神。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuéxí jiàn yì yǒng wéi de jīngshén.
examples.en: We should learn from the spirit of standing up for what's right.

examples.zh: 鉴于天气不好，比赛推迟了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàn yú tiānqì bù hǎo, bǐsài tuīchí le.
examples.en: In view of the bad weather, the match was postponed.

examples.zh: 鉴于你的表现，我们决定录取你。
examples.pinyin: Jiàn yú nǐ de biǎoxiàn, wǒmen juédìng lùqǔ nǐ.
examples.en: In view of your performance, we have decided to admit you.

examples.zh: 鉴于大家的意见，我们修改了计划。
examples.pinyin: Jiàn yú dàjiā de yìjiàn, wǒmen xiūgǎi le jìhuà.
examples.en: Taking everyone's opinions into account, we revised the plan.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò jiànzhù hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This building is very beautiful.

examples.en: I like looking at old buildings.

examples.en: Did you study architecture?

examples.en: This book is close to five hundred pages.

examples.en: While playing xiangqi, he suddenly put me in check.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn zài lìshǐ shū lǐ hěn yǒumíng.
examples.en: This general is well known in history books.

examples.en: He wanted to check me, but I captured his rook first.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiānglái xiǎng zuò shénme?

examples.en: We will be better off in the future.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiānglái xiǎng qù guówài liúxué.
examples.en: I hope to study abroad someday.

examples.zh: 天太冷，我的手都僵硬了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài lěng, wǒ de shǒu dōu jiāngyìng le.
examples.en: It was so cold that my hands went stiff.

examples.zh: 他坐了很久，腿有点僵硬。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò le hěn jiǔ, tuǐ yǒudiǎn jiāngyìng.
examples.en: He sat for a long time, and his legs have gone a bit stiff.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de miànliào hěn jiāngyìng.
examples.en: The fabric of this garment is very stiff.

examples.pinyin: Chuánfū yòng jiǎng huáchuán.
examples.en: The boatman rows with oars.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ jiǎng tài zhòng le.
examples.en: This oar is too heavy.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ jiǎng fàng zài chuán shàng.
examples.en: We put the oars on the boat.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài jiǎng kè.
examples.en: The teacher is giving a lesson.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài jiǎng yí biàn.
examples.en: Please explain it once more.

examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎng de hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: He explains things very clearly.

examples.en: He is very particular about food and only eats fresh things.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá hěn jiǎngjiu.
examples.en: This tea is very refined.

examples.zh: 你做事为什么不讲究一点？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuòshì wèishénme bù jiǎngjiu yìdiǎn?
examples.en: Why aren't you a bit more careful in what you do?

examples.zh: 老师给表现好的学生一个奖励。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi biǎoxiàn hǎo de xuésheng yí ge jiǎnglì.
examples.en: The teacher gave a reward to the students who behaved well.

examples.en: The company gives rewards after the work is finished.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yào shénme yàng de jiǎnglì?

examples.zh: 他找到了丢失的钱包，得到了一笔奖赏。

examples.en: He found the lost wallet and received a reward.

examples.zh: 这次比赛的奖赏很丰厚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài de jiǎngshǎng hěn fēnghòu.
examples.en: The prize for this competition is very generous.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò de hǎo, yīnggāi yǒu jiǎngshǎng.
examples.en: You did well, so you should get a reward.

examples.en: There is a lecture at the school tonight.

examples.en: This lecture is very interesting.

examples.en: Are you going to attend the lecture?

examples.en: Please lower your voice.

examples.en: This shop has lowered its prices.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng le, wēndù jiàngdī le.
examples.en: It's turned cold, and the temperature has dropped.

examples.zh: 夜幕降临了，街上的灯亮起来。

examples.en: Night fell, and the street lights came on.

examples.pinyin: Chūntiān zhōngyú jiànglín le.

examples.pinyin: Fēijī zhèngzài jiàngluò.

examples.pinyin: Zuò cài de shíhou yào jiā yìdiǎn jiàngyóu.
examples.en: When cooking, add a little soy sauce.

examples.pinyin: Zhè píng jiàngyóu shì xīn de.
examples.en: This bottle of soy sauce is new.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi jiàngyóu le ma?
examples.en: Did you buy the soy sauce?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
examples.en: Please hand your homework in to the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiāo le yí ge xīn péngyou.
examples.en: I've made a new friend.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jiāo duōshao qián?
examples.en: How much money do you have to pay?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu gěi huā jiāo shuǐ.
examples.en: I water the flowers every day.

examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ le, bié zài wàimiàn jiāo huā le.
examples.en: It's raining, so don't water the plants outside.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng rè shuǐ jiāo zài liǎn shang.
examples.en: He poured hot water on his face.

examples.pinyin: Tā jiāo wǒ Hànyǔ.
examples.en: He teaches me Chinese.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiāo wǒ zuòfàn ba.
examples.en: Teach me how to cook, will you?

examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào jiāo shùxué.
examples.en: She teaches math at school.

examples.zh: 他考了第一名，非常骄傲。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎo le dìyī míng, fēicháng jiāo'ào.
examples.en: He came first and is very proud.

examples.pinyin: Bié tài jiāo'ào le.
examples.en: Don't get too full of yourself.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ gǎndào jiāo'ào.
examples.en: I'm proud of you.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo lù zài zhèlǐ jiāochā.
examples.en: These two roads cross here.

examples.zh: 这里是两条路的交叉口。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì liǎng tiáo lù de jiāochākǒu.
examples.en: This is the junction of two roads.

examples.pinyin: Shùzhī hùxiāng jiāochā zài yìqǐ.
examples.en: The branches cross over each other.

examples.zh: 他临走前交代我照顾好猫。
examples.pinyin: Tā línzǒu qián jiāodài wǒ zhàogù hǎo māo.
examples.en: Before leaving, he asked me to look after the cat.

examples.en: You need to explain exactly what happened.

examples.zh: 这件事成了新闻的焦点。

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì kè bù róng huǎn, nǐ kuài qù chǔlǐ.
examples.en: This matter is urgent, so go and deal with it quickly.

examples.zh: 病人的情况刻不容缓，要赶紧送医院。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén de qíngkuàng kè bù róng huǎn, yào gǎnjǐn sòng yīyuàn.
examples.en: The patient's condition is critical, so take him to hospital at once.

examples.zh: 这学期我选了三门课程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī wǒ xuǎnle sān mén kèchéng.
examples.en: I signed up for three courses this term.

examples.pinyin: Kèchéng shénme shíhou kāishǐ?
examples.en: When does the course start?

examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kèchéng bú tài nán.
examples.en: This course isn't too hard.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yídìng néng kèfú kùnnan.
examples.en: We can definitely overcome the difficulties.

examples.zh: 他终于克服了害怕的心理。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú kèfú le hàipà de xīnlǐ.
examples.en: He finally got over his fear.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí hěn nán kèfú.
examples.en: This problem is hard to overcome.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào kèguān de kàn wèntí.
examples.en: We should look at problems objectively.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yìjiàn hěn kèguān.
examples.en: His opinion is very objective.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng kèguān de shuō yíxià ma?
examples.en: Can you give an objective account?

examples.zh: 这位客户今天下午来公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kèhù jīntiān xiàwǔ lái gōngsī.
examples.en: This client is coming to the office this afternoon.

examples.zh: 我们要为客户提供好服务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wèi kèhù tígōng hǎo fúwù.
examples.en: We have to give our customers good service.

examples.zh: 他是我们最重要的客户。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen zuì zhòngyào de kèhù.
examples.en: He is our most important client.

examples.pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn kèkǔ.
examples.en: He studies very hard.

examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān kèkǔ liànxí gāngqín.
examples.en: She practices the piano diligently every day.

examples.zh: 刻苦学习的人，一定会有进步。
examples.pinyin: Kèkǔ xuéxí de rén, yídìng huì yǒu jìnbù.
examples.en: Those who study hard will always make progress.

examples.pinyin: Jiā lǐ lái le kèrén.
examples.en: We have a guest at home.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de kèrén hěn duō.
examples.en: We have a lot of guests.

examples.pinyin: Kèrén lái le, kuài qǐng jìn.
examples.en: The guest has arrived, please come in.

examples.zh: 这个课题对我们很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kètí duì wǒmen hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: This research topic is very important to us.

examples.zh: 你选了什么课题做研究？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xuǎn le shénme kètí zuò yánjiū?
examples.en: What topic did you choose for your research?

examples.pinyin: Zhège kètí hái méiyǒu jiélùn.
examples.en: This research project has no conclusion yet.

examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐ yǒu yì tái diànshì.
examples.en: There is a TV in the living room.

examples.en: The guests are sitting in the living room.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de kètīng yǒu duō dà?
examples.en: How big is your living room?

examples.en: The puppy is gnawing a bone.

examples.zh: 他一边走路一边啃苹果。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān kěn píngguǒ.
examples.en: He eats an apple while walking.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kěn zhǐjia le.
examples.en: Stop biting your nails.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěndìng huì lái de.
examples.en: I'm sure I'll come.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěndìng lèi le ba?
examples.en: You must be tired, right?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù kěndìng, nǐ zài kànkan ba.
examples.en: I'm not sure, so take another look.

examples.zh: 他恳切地请求我的原谅。
examples.pinyin: Tā kěnqiè de qǐngqiú wǒ de yuánliàng.
examples.en: He sincerely asked for my forgiveness.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de jiànyì hěn kěnqiè.
examples.en: The teacher's advice was sincere.

examples.pinyin: Tā kěnqiè de xīwàng nǐ néng lái.
examples.en: She earnestly hopes you can come.

examples.pinyin: Lù shàng yǒu ge dà kēng, xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: There's a big pothole on the road, so be careful.

examples.zh: 你别被网上的假货坑了。

examples.en: Don't let fake goods online cheat you.

examples.en: This speech sounds hollow.

examples.en: There's a hole in the wall.

examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá hěn kōngdòng, méiyǒu shénme nèiróng.
examples.en: His answer was vague and had no real substance.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān de kōngjiān hěn dà.

examples.pinyin: Zhèli de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.
examples.en: The air here is very fresh.

examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de kōngqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The air in the park is very good.

examples.zh: 房间里空气不好，开一下窗户吧。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ kōngqì bù hǎo, kāi yíxià chuānghu ba.
examples.en: The air in the room is stale, so let's open a window.

examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de chénggōng zhēn shì kōngqián juéhòu.
examples.en: A success like this is truly unprecedented.

examples.zh: 他的歌唱得好，大家都说是空前绝后。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gē chàng de hǎo, dàjiā dōu shuō shì kōngqián juéhòu.
examples.en: He sings so well that everyone says nobody will ever match him.

examples.zh: 这个发明空前绝后，以后不会再有了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāmíng kōngqián juéhòu, yǐhòu bú huì zài yǒu le.
examples.en: This invention is one of a kind; nothing like it will come again.

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ hěn rè, kāi kōngtiáo ba.
examples.en: It's hot in the room, let's turn on the air conditioner.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā méiyǒu kōngtiáo.
examples.en: My home has no air conditioning.

examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang nǐ kāi kōngtiáo ma?
examples.en: Do you turn on the air conditioning at night?

examples.pinyin: Bié kōngxiǎng le, kuài qù nǔlì ba.
examples.en: Stop daydreaming and go and work hard!

examples.pinyin: Tā zhěngtiān kōngxiǎngzhe fā dàcái.
examples.en: He spends all day daydreaming about getting rich.

examples.zh: 这只是空想，不是真的计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì kōngxiǎng, bú shì zhēn de jìhuà.
examples.en: That's just a fantasy, not a real plan.

examples.pinyin: Líkāi jiā yǐhòu, tā chángcháng juéde kōngxū.
examples.en: After leaving home, he often felt empty inside.

examples.zh: 没有目标的生活让人感到空虚。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu mùbiāo de shēnghuó ràng rén gǎndào kōngxū.
examples.en: A life without goals leaves people feeling empty.

examples.zh: 他心里很空虚，却不愿意说出来。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīnli hěn kōngxū, què bú yuànyi shuō chūlái.
examples.en: He feels very empty inside, but he won't say so.

examples.pinyin: Wàzi shàng pò le yí ge kǒng.
examples.en: There's a hole in the sock.

examples.zh: 这个瓶子的孔太小了，水倒不进去。

examples.en: The opening of this bottle is too small, so water won't pour in.

examples.zh: 墙上有一个小孔，光从那里照进来。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shàng yǒu yí ge xiǎo kǒng, guāng cóng nàlǐ zhào jìn lái.
examples.en: There's a tiny hole in the wall, and light comes through it.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn kǒngbù.
examples.en: This movie is very scary.

examples.zh: 我昨晚做了一个恐怖的梦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuówǎn zuò le yí ge kǒngbù de mèng.
examples.en: I had a terrifying dream last night.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hàipà kǒngbùpiàn ma?
examples.en: Are you scared of horror films?

examples.pinyin: Bú yào yòng guài huà kǒnghè háizi.
examples.en: Don't scare children with spooky talk.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànhuà lǐ kǒnghè wǒ.
examples.en: He threatened me on the phone.

examples.pinyin: Hēi àn ràng háizi gǎndào kǒngjù.
examples.en: Darkness makes the child feel afraid.

examples.zh: 他很难克服对高处的恐惧。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn nán kèfú duì gāochù de kǒngjù.

examples.en: It's probably going to rain.

examples.en: This matter is probably very hard.

examples.en: This form still has lots of blank spaces.

examples.en: Please sign in the blank space.

examples.en: This period of history is still a blank.

examples.pinyin: Shūjià shang de shū zhījiān méiyǒu kòngxì.
examples.en: There are no gaps between the books on the shelf.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhuāzhù kòngxì, wènle tā yí ge wèntí.
examples.en: I seized a gap in the conversation and asked him a question.

examples.pinyin: Tā máng de méiyǒu kòngxì chī wǔfàn.
examples.en: He was too busy to find a moment to eat lunch.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yǒu kòngxián ma?
examples.en: Do you have any free time today?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò dōu hěn kòngxián.
examples.en: I'm free every weekend.

examples.pinyin: Děng nǐ kòngxián de shíhou, gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Call me when you have some free time.

examples.en: Please control your emotions.

examples.en: I took a sip of water.

examples.en: His tone was rather harsh.

examples.zh: 你用这种口气跟妈妈说话，不太好。

examples.zh: 听他的口气，好像不太高兴。

examples.en: From his tone, he doesn't seem very happy.

examples.pinyin: Shuāyá kěyǐ bǎohù kǒuqiāng jiànkāng.
examples.en: Brushing your teeth helps keep your mouth healthy.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchá le wǒ de kǒuqiāng.
examples.en: The doctor examined my mouth.

examples.zh: 口腔里长了一个小泡，吃饭很疼。

examples.en: I have a small sore inside my mouth, and eating hurts.

examples.zh: 这件事只是口头约定，没有写下来。

examples.en: This was only an oral agreement, never written down.

examples.zh: 你不要光说口头上的话，要行动。

examples.en: Don't just make promises with your mouth; take action.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme kǒuwèi de?
examples.en: What flavor do you like?

examples.zh: 我们家的口味比较清淡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā de kǒuwèi bǐjiào qīngdàn.
examples.en: Our family's taste is fairly light.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de cài kǒuwèi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This shop's dishes taste really good.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuō pǔtōnghuà méiyǒu kǒuyīn.
examples.en: He speaks Mandarin without any accent.

examples.zh: 你的口音很重，我听不太懂。

examples.en: You have a strong accent, and I can't really follow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de kǒuyīn shì nǎlǐ de?
examples.en: Where is your accent from?

examples.pinyin: Tā wèi shénme kū?
examples.en: Why is she crying?

examples.zh: 河水枯竭了，河床上只剩下石头。
examples.pinyin: Héshuǐ kūjié le, héchuáng shàng zhǐ shèngxià shítou.
examples.en: The river has dried up, and only stones are left on the riverbed.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de línggǎn yǐjīng kūjié le.
examples.en: My inspiration has run dry.

examples.zh: 这个矿的资源快要枯竭了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kuàng de zīyuán kuàiyào kūjié le.
examples.en: The resources of this mine are about to run out.

examples.pinyin: Zhè mén kè tài kūzào le.
examples.en: This course is really dull.

examples.zh: 工作每天都一样，很枯燥。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò měitiān dōu yíyàng, hěn kūzào.
examples.en: The work is the same every day and very dull.

examples.zh: 读这本书让我觉得很枯燥。
examples.pinyin: Dú zhè běn shū ràng wǒ juéde hěn kūzào.
examples.en: Reading this book feels very dull to me.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yào hěn kǔ.
examples.en: This medicine is very bitter.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shíhou guò de hěn kǔ.
examples.en: He had a hard life as a child.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīnkǔ le, kuài xiūxi ba.
examples.en: You've worked hard, so go and rest.

examples.zh: 经历了这么多困难，我们终于苦尽甘来。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglì le zhème duō kùnnan, wǒmen zhōngyú kǔjìn gānlái.
examples.en: After all these hardships, our bitter days have finally given way to sweet ones.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiāngxìn kǔjìn gānlái ma?
examples.en: Do you believe that bitter times will give way to sweet ones?

examples.zh: 他们一家人苦尽甘来，生活越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yì jiā rén kǔjìn gānlái, shēnghuó yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.en: His family has come through hardship, and life keeps getting better.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de kùzi tài cháng le.
examples.en: My trousers are too long.

examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì tiáo xīn kùzi.
examples.en: He bought a pair of new trousers.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de kùzi shì hēi de ma?
examples.en: Are your trousers black?

examples.en: The teacher praised my writing.

examples.zh: 你别夸他了，他会骄傲的。

examples.en: I have one yuan.

examples.en: Three yuan, OK?

examples.en: I'm very happy today.
