examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de lìhài nǐ yào xiǎng qīngchu.
examples.en: You need to think through the pros and cons of this matter.

examples.zh: 他很清楚其中的利害关系。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn qīngchu qízhōng de lìhài guānxi.
examples.en: He understands the stakes clearly.

examples.zh: 你要分清利害，再做选择。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào fēnqīng lìhài, zài zuò xuǎnzé.
examples.en: Weigh the pros and cons before you choose.

examples.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ hěn lìhai.
examples.en: His Chinese is amazing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ tài lìhai le!
examples.en: You're amazing!

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gǎnmào hěn lìhai.
examples.en: My cold is really bad.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng lìjí líkāi zhèlǐ.
examples.en: Please leave here immediately.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lìjí chūfā.
examples.en: We set off immediately.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng lìjí huífù ma?
examples.en: Can you reply straight away?

examples.zh: 前面有一座立交桥，我们从那里走。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu yí zuò lìjiāoqiáo, wǒmen cóng nàlǐ zǒu.
examples.en: There's a flyover ahead; let's go that way.

examples.zh: 这座立交桥每天都很堵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lìjiāoqiáo měitiān dōu hěn dǔ.
examples.en: This flyover is jammed every day.

examples.zh: 开车的时候要注意立交桥的标志。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou yào zhùyì lìjiāoqiáo de biāozhì.
examples.en: When driving, watch the signs on the flyover.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ lìkè huíjiā.
examples.en: Please go home right away.

examples.pinyin: Tā yì tīngdào jiù lìkè xiào le.
examples.en: As soon as he heard it, he laughed.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng lìkè gàosu wǒ ma?
examples.en: Can you tell me right away?

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ lìlái tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The weather here has always been good.

examples.pinyin: Tā lìlái bù xǐhuan chī là de.
examples.en: He has never liked spicy food.

examples.zh: 我们历来都是这样做的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lìlái dōu shì zhèyàng zuò de.
examples.en: We have always done it this way.

examples.pinyin: Tā de lìliang hěn dà.
examples.en: He is very strong.

examples.pinyin: Tuánjié jiù shì lìliang.
examples.en: Unity is strength.

examples.zh: 运动可以增加身体的力量。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ zēngjiā shēntǐ de lìliang.
examples.en: Exercise can build up your physical strength.

examples.zh: 银行的利率最近下降了。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng de lìlǜ zuìjìn xiàjiàng le.
examples.en: Bank interest rates have fallen recently.

examples.zh: 买房子的时候，利率很重要。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi fángzi de shíhou, lìlǜ hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: When buying a house, the interest rate matters a lot.

examples.zh: 你知道现在的存款利率是多少吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài de cúnkuǎn lìlǜ shì duōshao ma?
examples.en: Do you know what the current deposit interest rate is?

examples.pinyin: Tā de lìqi hěn dà.
examples.en: He's very strong.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu lìqi le.
examples.en: I have no strength left.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng le hěn dà de lìqi.
examples.en: He used a lot of strength.

examples.zh: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, lìrú píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
examples.en: I like fruit, for example apples and bananas.

examples.zh: 你可以做很多事，例如看书。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò hěn duō shì, lìrú kàn shū.
examples.en: You can do many things, for example reading.

examples.zh: 有些动物，例如猫和狗，很可爱。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē dòngwù, lìrú māo hé gǒu, hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: Some animals, such as cats and dogs, are very cute.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de lìrùn hěn gāo.
examples.en: This shop makes a high profit.

examples.zh: 公司今年的利润增加了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de lìrùn zēngjiā le.
examples.en: The company's profits rose this year.

examples.zh: 降低成本才能提高利润。
examples.pinyin: Jiàngdī chéngběn cáinéng tígāo lìrùn.
examples.en: Only by cutting costs can you raise profits.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan lìshǐ.
examples.en: I like history.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de lìshǐ hěn cháng.
examples.en: China has a very long history.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xué lìshǐ ma?
examples.en: Do you study history?

examples.zh: 我愿意帮忙，但只能做力所能及的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì bāngmáng, dàn zhǐ néng zuò lìsuǒnéngjí de shì.
examples.en: I'm happy to help, but I can only do what is within my power.

examples.zh: 家务活我们都要做力所能及的部分。
examples.pinyin: Jiāwù huó wǒmen dōu yào zuò lìsuǒnéngjí de bùfen.
examples.en: With housework, each of us should take on the part we can manage.

examples.zh: 他总是做力所能及的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zuò lìsuǒnéngjí de shìqing.
examples.en: He always does whatever he is capable of.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà kàn qǐlai hěn lìtǐ.
examples.en: This painting looks very three-dimensional.

examples.zh: 我想买一个立体的拼图。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge lìtǐ de pīntú.
examples.en: I'd like to buy a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

examples.zh: 这张地图是立体的，可以看到山的高度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú shì lìtǐ de, kěyǐ kàndào shān de gāodù.
examples.en: This map is three-dimensional, so you can see how high the mountains are.

examples.zh: 他力图把这件事做得更好。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìtú bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuò de gèng hǎo.
examples.en: He is striving to do this better.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lìtú jiǎnshǎo làngfèi.
examples.en: We are trying hard to cut down on waste.

examples.zh: 这所学校力图让每个学生都进步。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào lìtú ràng měi ge xuésheng dōu jìnbù.
examples.en: This school strives to help every student improve.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo guīdìng méiyǒu lìwài.
examples.en: This rule has no exceptions.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǐ shì lìwài.
examples.en: You're the only exception.

examples.zh: 每个人都要遵守规则，没有例外。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yào zūnshǒu guīzé, méiyǒu lìwài.
examples.en: Everyone must follow the rules, without exception.

examples.pinyin: Yínháng de lìxī hěn dī.
examples.en: Bank interest rates are very low.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián měinián yǒu lìxī.
examples.en: This money earns interest every year.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiè qián yào fù lìxī ma?
examples.en: Do you have to pay interest when you borrow money?

examples.zh: 这件事不能只考虑个人利益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bù néng zhǐ kǎolǜ gèrén lìyì.
examples.en: We shouldn't consider only personal interests in this matter.

examples.zh: 大家的利益要放在第一位。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de lìyì yào fàng zài dìyī wèi.
examples.en: Everyone's interests should come first.

examples.zh: 这样做对我们没有利益。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò duì wǒmen méiyǒu lìyì.
examples.en: Doing this brings us no benefit.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào lìyòng hǎo shíjiān.
examples.en: We should make good use of our time.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì lìyòng zhōumò xuéxí.
examples.en: He is very good at using weekends to study.

examples.zh: 你可以利用网络查资料。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ lìyòng wǎngluò chá zīliào.
examples.en: You can use the internet to look up information.

examples.zh: 我们要力争拿到第一名。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào lìzhēng nádào dì yī míng.
examples.en: We will fight hard to take first place.

examples.zh: 他力争每天都早点起床。
examples.pinyin: Tā lìzhēng měitiān dōu zǎo diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: He tries hard to get up early every day.

examples.zh: 大家都在力争提高成绩。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài lìzhēng tígāo chéngjì.
examples.en: Everyone is striving to improve their results.

examples.zh: 他刚到这个城市，还没有立足的地方。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng dào zhège chéngshì, hái méiyǒu lìzú de dìfang.
examples.en: He has just arrived in this city and doesn't yet have a place to settle.

examples.zh: 没有好成绩，很难在这个行业立足。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu hǎo chéngjì, hěn nán zài zhège hángyè lìzú.
examples.en: Without good results, it's hard to gain a foothold in this industry.

examples.zh: 他靠努力才在公司立足了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kào nǔlì cái zài gōngsī lìzú le.
examples.en: He only established himself at the company through hard work.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: The two of us are good friends.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen liǎ yìqǐ qù ba.
examples.en: You two go together.

examples.pinyin: Tā liǎ dōu hěn gāo.
examples.en: They're both very tall.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ lián yí ge zì dōu bú rènshi.
examples.en: I don't even recognize a single character.

examples.pinyin: Tā lián fàn dōu méi chī.
examples.en: He didn't even eat.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lián wǒ dōu néng kàndǒng.
examples.en: Even I can understand this book.

examples.zh: 这两家公司联合起来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī liánhé qǐlai le.
examples.en: These two companies have joined forces.

examples.zh: 我们联合起来做这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liánhé qǐlai zuò zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Let's work together on this.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge liánhé de huódòng.
examples.en: This is a joint event.

examples.zh: 我们班下周要举行一次联欢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān xiàzhōu yào jǔxíng yí cì liánhuān.
examples.en: Our class is holding a get-together next week.

examples.zh: 晚会上有很多精彩的联欢节目。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì shang yǒu hěn duō jīngcǎi de liánhuān jiémù.
examples.en: There are many great performances at the party.

examples.zh: 大家在联欢会上唱歌跳舞。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zài liánhuānhuì shang chàng gē tiào wǔ.
examples.en: Everyone sang and danced at the get-together.

examples.pinyin: Tā wéirén liánjié, cóng bù shōu lǐ.
examples.en: He is honest and never accepts gifts.

examples.zh: 我们要做一个廉洁的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zuò yí ge liánjié de rén.
examples.en: We should be people of integrity.

examples.pinyin: Liánjié de rén ràng rén xìnrèn.
examples.en: Honest people earn trust.

examples.pinyin: Yǒu shì qǐng nǐ jíshí liánluò wǒ.
examples.en: If anything comes up, please get in touch with me promptly.

examples.zh: 我一直在和他联络，但他没回。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zài hé tā liánluò, dàn tā méi huí.
examples.en: I've been trying to contact him, but he hasn't replied.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu tā de liánluò fāngshì ma?
examples.en: Do you have his contact details?

examples.zh: 他一看见我，连忙站起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí kànjiàn wǒ, liánmáng zhàn qǐlai.
examples.en: As soon as he saw me, he quickly stood up.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ liánmáng dàoqiàn.
examples.en: I apologized at once.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme liánmáng zǒu le?
examples.en: Why did you leave in such a hurry?

examples.zh: 几家公司组成了一个联盟。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ jiā gōngsī zǔchéngle yí ge liánméng.
examples.en: Several companies formed an alliance.

examples.zh: 他们是互相帮助的联盟。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì hùxiāng bāngzhù de liánméng.
examples.en: They form an alliance of mutual support.

examples.zh: 几个社区联合起来，成立了一个联盟。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ ge shèqū liánhé qǐlai, chénglìle yí ge liánméng.
examples.en: Several neighborhoods joined forces to form an alliance.

examples.zh: 这里连年丰收，大家都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ liánnián fēngshōu, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: This place has had good harvests year after year, and everyone is happy.

examples.zh: 公司连年亏损，很难维持下去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī liánnián kuīsǔn, hěn nán wéichí xiàqù.
examples.en: The company has been losing money for years and is hard to keep going.

examples.zh: 他连年参加比赛，经验很丰富。
examples.pinyin: Tā liánnián cānjiā bǐsài, jīngyàn hěn fēngfù.
examples.en: He has entered competitions year after year and has a wealth of experience.

examples.zh: 这家超市是连锁店，全国都有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì shì liánsuǒdiàn, quánguó dōu yǒu.
examples.en: This supermarket is a chain with stores all over the country.

examples.zh: 一家饭店关门，引起了连锁反应。
examples.pinyin: Yì jiā fàndiàn guānmén, yǐnqǐ le liánsuǒ fǎnyìng.
examples.en: One restaurant closing set off a chain reaction.

examples.zh: 这家咖啡店开了很多连锁分店。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēidiàn kāi le hěn duō liánsuǒ fēndiàn.
examples.en: This café chain has opened many branches.

examples.zh: 他连同行李一起搬进了新房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā liántóng xínglǐ yìqǐ bān jìn le xīn fángzi.
examples.en: He moved into the new house along with his luggage.

examples.zh: 这张票连同包装一起寄给你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào liántóng bāozhuāng yìqǐ jì gěi nǐ.
examples.en: I'll mail you this ticket together with its packaging.

examples.zh: 我把蛋糕连同盒子一起拿走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dàngāo liántóng hézi yìqǐ názǒu le.
examples.en: I took the cake away along with its box.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīngcháng liánxì.
examples.en: We keep in touch often.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu tā de liánxì fāngshì ma?
examples.en: Do you have his contact details?

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì méiyǒu liánxì.
examples.en: These two matters have no connection.

examples.zh: 看到大海，我联想到了童年。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào dàhǎi, wǒ liánxiǎngdàole tóngnián.
examples.en: Seeing the sea made me think back to my childhood.

examples.zh: 这幅画让人产生很多联想。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà ràng rén chǎnshēng hěn duō liánxiǎng.
examples.en: This painting sparks many associations in people's minds.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liánxiǎng nénglì hěn qiáng.
examples.en: You have a strong imagination.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang kàn liánxùjù.
examples.en: I watch a TV series every evening.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù liánxùjù hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This TV series is very good.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kànguo zhège liánxùjù ma?
examples.en: Have you watched this series?

examples.pinyin: Tā de liǎn hóng le.
examples.en: His face turned red.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liǎn zěnme le?
examples.en: What's wrong with your face?

examples.pinyin: Tā de liǎn hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: She has a pretty face.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài dàxué lǐ liàn'ài le.
examples.en: They fell in love at university.

examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén xǐhuan liàn'ài.
examples.en: Young people enjoy romance.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài liàn'ài ma?
examples.en: Are you in a relationship right now?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liànxí xiě Hànzì.
examples.en: I practice writing Chinese characters every day.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ liànxí de zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How is your practice going?

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de liànxí nán ma?
examples.en: Is today's exercise hard?

examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì hěn liánghǎo.
examples.en: His grades are very good.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de guānxì hěn liánghǎo.
examples.en: We have a good relationship.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de kōngqì hěn liánghǎo.
examples.en: The air here is very good.

examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang hěn liángkuai.
examples.en: It's nice and cool in the evening.

examples.zh: 我们去树下凉快凉快吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù shù xià liángkuai liángkuai ba.
examples.en: Let's go under the tree and cool off.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn liángkuai.
examples.en: This room is very cool.

examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de liángshi hěn duō.
examples.en: There's a lot of grain this year.

examples.zh: 这里的人靠种粮食生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén kào zhòng liángshi shēnghuó.
examples.en: People here make a living by growing grain.

examples.pinyin: Liángshi gòu chī ma?
examples.en: Is there enough food?

examples.pinyin: Zuòrén yào yǒu liángxīn.
examples.en: A person should have a conscience.

examples.zh: 他的良心不安，所以承认了错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā de liángxīn bù'ān, suǒyǐ chéngrèn le cuòwù.
examples.en: His conscience was troubled, so he owned up to his mistake.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liángxīn bú huì tòng ma?
examples.en: Doesn't your conscience ever hurt?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng ge háizi.
examples.en: I have two children.

examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén yìqǐ zhù.
examples.en: Two people live together.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎng diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: Our meeting is at two o'clock.

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ hěn liàng.
examples.en: The room is very bright.

examples.zh: 天已经亮了，我们起床吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān yǐjīng liàng le, wǒmen qǐchuáng ba.
examples.en: It's already light, let's get up.

examples.pinyin: Dēng hěn liàng, wǒ kàn bu qīngchu.
examples.en: The light is so bright I can't see clearly.

examples.pinyin: Ménkǒu tíng zhe yí liàng chē.
examples.en: A car is parked at the entrance.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē shì wǒ de.
examples.en: This bicycle is mine.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng liàng chē.
examples.en: My family has two cars.

examples.zh: 妈妈把衣服晾在阳台上。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ yīfu liàng zài yángtái shàng.
examples.en: Mom hung the clothes out to dry on the balcony.

examples.zh: 洗完的被子要晾干再盖。
examples.pinyin: Xǐwán de bèizi yào liànggān zài gài.
examples.en: Air the quilt until it is dry before using it.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shī yīfu yào liàng yi liàng.
examples.en: These wet clothes need to be aired out a bit.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ néng liàngjiě wǒ.
examples.en: I hope you can understand and forgive me.

examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zhōngyú dáchéng le liàngjiě.
examples.en: Both sides have finally reached an understanding.

examples.zh: 他没有谅解自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu liàngjiě zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.en: He has not forgiven himself for his mistake.

examples.pinyin: Cǎoyuán liáokuò, yí wàng wú jì.
examples.en: The grassland is vast and stretches as far as the eye can see.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn hǎiyáng duōme liáokuò a!
examples.en: How vast this ocean is!

examples.zh: 这个国家的土地并不辽阔。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de tǔdì bìng bú liáokuò.
examples.en: The land of this country is not especially vast.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò liáotiān ba.
examples.en: Let's chat on the weekend.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan hé péngyou liáotiān.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān liù hào.
examples.en: Today is the sixth.

examples.pinyin: Liù diǎn wǒmen chī fàn.
examples.en: We eat at six o'clock.

examples.pinyin: Liù kuài qián, tài piányi le.
examples.en: Six yuan, so cheap!

examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shàng yǒu yì tiáo lóng.
examples.en: There is a dragon in this painting.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan huà lóng.
examples.en: Children like drawing dragons.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǔ lóng ma?
examples.en: Were you born in the year of the dragon?

examples.zh: 这所学校专门教育聋哑儿童。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào zhuānmén jiàoyù lóngyǎ értóng.
examples.en: This school specialises in educating deaf and mute children.

examples.zh: 聋哑人也可以通过手语交流。
examples.pinyin: Lóngyǎrén yě kěyǐ tōngguò shǒuyǔ jiāoliú.
examples.en: Deaf and mute people can also communicate through sign language.

examples.zh: 她是聋哑人，学会了手语。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì lóngyǎrén, xuéhuìle shǒuyǔ.
examples.en: She is deaf and mute, and she has learned sign language.

examples.zh: 学校举行了隆重的开学典礼。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jǔxíng le lóngzhòng de kāixué diǎnlǐ.
examples.en: The school held a grand opening ceremony.

examples.zh: 婚礼非常隆重，来了很多客人。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ fēicháng lóngzhòng, lái le hěn duō kèrén.
examples.en: The wedding was very grand, with many guests.

examples.zh: 我们隆重地欢迎新同学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lóngzhòng de huānyíng xīn tóngxué.
examples.en: We warmly welcomed the new classmates.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī lǒngduàn le shìchǎng.
examples.en: This company dominates the market.

examples.zh: 这种产品的生产被少数企业垄断。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn de shēngchǎn bèi shǎoshù qǐyè lǒngduàn.
examples.en: Production of this product is controlled by a few firms.

examples.zh: 我们不应该让一家公司垄断这个行业。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi ràng yì jiā gōngsī lǒngduàn zhège hángyè.
examples.en: We shouldn't let one company monopolise this industry.

examples.pinyin: Zhěng zuò shān dōu bèi wù lǒngzhàozhe.
examples.en: The whole mountain is shrouded in fog.

examples.zh: 一层淡淡的月光笼罩着小镇。
examples.pinyin: Yì céng dàndàn de yuèguāng lǒngzhàozhe xiǎo zhèn.
examples.en: A faint layer of moonlight blankets the little town.

examples.zh: 大家都被紧张的气氛笼罩着。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bèi jǐnzhāng de qìfēn lǒngzhàozhe.
examples.en: Everyone was gripped by a tense atmosphere.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài sān lóu.
examples.en: I live on the third floor.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lóu hěn gāo.
examples.en: This building is very tall.

examples.pinyin: Lóu xià yǒu yí ge chāoshì.
examples.en: There's a supermarket downstairs.

examples.zh: 妈妈搂着孩子，轻轻地拍着他的背。
examples.pinyin: Māma lǒu zhe háizi, qīngqīng de pāi zhe tā de bèi.
examples.en: Mom hugged the child and gently patted his back.

examples.zh: 他一把搂住朋友的肩膀。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì bǎ lǒu zhù péngyou de jiānbǎng.
examples.en: He threw an arm around his friend's shoulders.

examples.zh: 她搂着一大堆书，走进了图书馆。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǒu zhe yí dà duī shū, zǒu jìn le túshūguǎn.
examples.en: She carried a big pile of books in her arms into the library.

examples.pinyin: Wūdǐng lòu yǔ le.
examples.en: The roof is leaking.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bēizi lòu shuǐ.
examples.en: This cup leaks.

examples.pinyin: Bié lòudiào rènhé yí ge xìjié.
examples.en: Don't leave out any detail.

examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zài lúzào pángbiān chǎocài.
examples.en: Grandma is stir-frying next to the stove.

examples.zh: 炉灶上的水开了，快去关火。
examples.pinyin: Lúzào shàng de shuǐ kāi le, kuài qù guān huǒ.
examples.en: The water on the stove is boiling, so hurry and turn off the flame.

examples.zh: 这个老炉灶已经用了三十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎo lúzào yǐjīng yòng le sānshí nián.
examples.en: This old stove has been used for thirty years.

examples.pinyin: Zhè lù hěn yuǎn.
examples.en: This road is very long.

examples.pinyin: Lù shàng màn diǎnr.
examples.en: Take it slow on the road.

examples.pinyin: Zhè lù shàng chē duō ma?
examples.en: Is there a lot of traffic on this road?

examples.pinyin: Cǎo shàng yǒu hěn duō lùshuǐ.
examples.en: There is a lot of dew on the grass.

examples.pinyin: Tā lùchūle xiàoliǎn.
examples.en: He broke into a smile.

examples.pinyin: Bié bǎ dōngxi lù zài wàimiàn.
examples.en: Don't leave things out in the open.

examples.pinyin: Chuán zhōngyú kàojìnle lùdì.
examples.en: The boat finally came close to land.

examples.pinyin: Lùdì shàng de dòngwù hěn duō.
examples.en: There are many animals on land.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan lùdì háishi hǎibiān?
examples.en: Do you prefer land or the seaside?

examples.pinyin: Tā bèi dàxué lùqǔ le.
examples.en: He was admitted to university.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lùqǔ le sān ge rén.
examples.en: The company hired three people.

examples.zh: 你什么时候知道是否录取？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou zhīdao shìfǒu lùqǔ?
examples.en: When will you find out whether you're accepted?

examples.pinyin: Kèrén lùxù dào le.
examples.en: The guests arrived one after another.

examples.pinyin: Rénmen lùxù líkāile jiàoshì.
examples.en: People gradually left the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Zuòyè lùxù jiāo shànglai le ma?
examples.en: Have the homework assignments been handed in bit by bit?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ lǎoshī de huà lùyīn le.
examples.en: I recorded the teacher's words.

examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lùyīn hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: This recording is very clear.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu lùyīn de shèbèi ma?
examples.en: Do you have recording equipment?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān hěn luàn.
examples.en: My room is very messy.

examples.pinyin: Bié luàn shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't talk nonsense.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zì xiě de hěn luàn.
examples.en: His handwriting is very messy.

examples.pinyin: Zhè sōu lúnchuán míngtiān chūfā.
examples.en: This steamship sets off tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò guo lúnchuán ma?
examples.en: Have you ever traveled by ferry?

examples.pinyin: Lúnchuán shang de rén hěn duō.
examples.en: There are a lot of people on the ship.

examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù shān de lúnkuò hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: The outline of the distant mountains is very clear.

examples.zh: 你能看清楚那个人的轮廓吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng kànqīngchu nà ge rén de lúnkuò ma?
examples.en: Can you make out the outline of that person?

examples.zh: 这幅画只有简单的轮廓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà zhǐyǒu jiǎndān de lúnkuò.
examples.en: This painting has only simple outlines.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lúnliú xǐ wǎn.
examples.en: We take turns doing the dishes.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen lúnliú wán qiú.
examples.en: The kids take turns playing with the ball.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen lúnliú kāichē ma?
examples.en: Do you take turns driving?

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de lúntāi gāi huàn le.
examples.en: The tires on this car need replacing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lúntāi qì gòu ma?
examples.en: Do your tires have enough air?

examples.zh: 轮胎没有坏，只是有点旧。
examples.pinyin: Lúntāi méiyǒu huài, zhǐshì yǒudiǎn jiù.
examples.en: The tire isn't broken, just a bit old.

examples.zh: 我在网上的论坛看到了这个消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎngshàng de lùntán kàndào le zhège xiāoxi.
examples.en: I saw this news on an online forum.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīngcháng guàng lùntán ma?
examples.en: Do you often browse forums?

examples.zh: 这个论坛的讨论不太热烈。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùntán de tǎolùn bú tài rèliè.
examples.en: The discussions on this forum are not very lively.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiě bìyè lùnwén.
examples.en: He is writing his graduation thesis.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piān lùnwén hěn cháng.
examples.en: This thesis is very long.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lùnwén shénme shíhou jiāo?
examples.en: When are you handing in your thesis?

examples.pinyin: Tā de lùnzhèng hěn yǒu shuōfúlì.
examples.en: His argument is very convincing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng lùnzhèng nǐ de guāndiǎn ma?
examples.en: Can you back up your point of view?

examples.zh: 这个结论没有充分的论证。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiélùn méiyǒu chōngfèn de lùnzhèng.
examples.en: This conclusion lacks sufficient argument.

examples.zh: 他做事很啰唆，总要说好几遍。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn luōsuo, zǒng yào shuō hǎo jǐ biàn.
examples.en: He's fussy about everything and always repeats himself several times.

examples.zh: 你别啰唆了，快去做作业。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié luōsuo le, kuài qù zuò zuòyè.
examples.en: Stop going on and on; go and do your homework.

examples.zh: 这封信写得太啰唆，看不懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn xiě de tài luōsuo, kàn bu dǒng.
examples.en: This letter is so wordy that I can't follow it.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn yǒu luójí.
examples.en: His thinking is very logical.

examples.zh: 这篇文章的逻辑不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng de luójí bù qīngchu.
examples.en: The logic of this article isn't clear.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège luójí bú duì.
examples.en: Your reasoning is wrong.

examples.zh: 这个桌子用螺丝钉固定。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhuōzi yòng luósīdīng gùdìng.
examples.en: This table is fixed in place with screws.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu luósīdīng?
examples.en: Do you have any screws?

examples.pinyin: Luósīdīng diào zài dì shang le.
examples.en: A screw has fallen onto the floor.

examples.zh: 新的图书馆下个月落成。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de túshūguǎn xià ge yuè luòchéng.
examples.en: The new library will be completed next month.

examples.zh: 这座大楼什么时候落成？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàlóu shénme shíhou luòchéng?
examples.en: When will this building be finished?

examples.pinyin: Tǐyùguǎn hái méiyǒu luòchéng.
examples.en: The gymnasium is not finished yet.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ luòhòu le, nǐmen xiān zǒu ba.
examples.en: I'm behind, you all go ahead.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang hěn luòhòu.
examples.en: This place is very backward.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng luòhòu.
examples.en: I don't want to fall behind.

examples.zh: 这个计划需要尽快落实。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà xūyào jǐnkuài luòshí.
examples.en: This plan needs to be carried out as soon as possible.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yìjiàn luòshí le ma?
examples.en: Has your suggestion been put into practice?

examples.zh: 会议的决定还没有落实。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì de juédìng hái méiyǒu luòshí.
examples.en: The decisions from the meeting have not yet been put into practice.

examples.zh: 节日的时候，游客络绎不绝。
examples.pinyin: Jiérì de shíhou, yóukè luòyì bùjué.
examples.en: During the holiday, visitors kept coming in an endless stream.

examples.zh: 这家店的门口人来人往，络绎不绝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de ménkǒu rén lái rén wǎng, luòyì bùjué.
examples.en: People kept coming and going at the shop entrance in a steady stream.

examples.pinyin: Lái mǎi piào de rén luòyì bùjué.
examples.en: An endless stream of people came to buy tickets.

examples.zh: 他屡次迟到，老板很生气。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǚcì chídào, lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì.
examples.en: He was late again and again, and the boss got angry.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǚcì quàn tā, tā dōu bù tīng.
examples.en: I urged him again and again, but he wouldn't listen.

examples.zh: 这个问题屡次出现，我们必须解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí lǚcì chūxiàn, wǒmen bìxū jiějué.
examples.en: This problem keeps coming up, so we must solve it.

examples.zh: 我们要履行合同上的义务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào lǚxíng hétong shàng de yìwù.
examples.en: We must fulfill our obligations under the contract.

examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu lǚxíng chéngnuò.
examples.en: He didn't keep his promise.

examples.zh: 每个员工都要履行自己的职责。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge yuángōng dōu yào lǚxíng zìjǐ de zhízé.
examples.en: Every employee must carry out their duties.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
examples.en: I like traveling in China.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān qù Běijīng lǚyóu.
examples.en: We're going to Beijing for a trip tomorrow.

examples.zh: 和朋友一起旅游很快乐。
examples.pinyin: Hé péngyou yìqǐ lǚyóu hěn kuàilè.
examples.en: Traveling with friends is a joy.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn cǎodì hěn lǜ.
examples.en: This patch of grass is very green.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan lǜsè de yīfu.
examples.en: I like green clothes.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qúnzi shì lǜ de ma?
examples.en: Is your skirt green?

examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi lǜshī.
examples.en: He is a lawyer.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào zhǎo yí ge lǜshī.
examples.en: I need to find a lawyer.

examples.pinyin: Lǜshī shuō zhè jiàn shì hěn nán bàn.
examples.en: The lawyer says this matter is hard to handle.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīyuán bèi guòdù lüèduó.
examples.en: These resources have been overexploited.

examples.zh: 别让贪心掠夺了你的快乐。
examples.pinyin: Bié ràng tānxīn lüèduó le nǐ de kuàilè.
examples.en: Don't let greed rob you of your happiness.

examples.zh: 森林资源不能被随意掠夺。
examples.pinyin: Sēnlín zīyuán bù néng bèi suíyì lüèduó.
examples.en: Forest resources must not be plundered at will.

examples.zh: 我略微有点累，想休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lüèwēi yǒudiǎn lèi, xiǎng xiūxi yíxià.
examples.en: I'm a little tired and want to rest for a moment.

examples.zh: 这件衣服略微大了一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu lüèwēi dà le yìdiǎn.
examples.en: This piece of clothing is a bit too big.

examples.zh: 他略微想了一下，就答应了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lüèwēi xiǎng le yíxià, jiù dāyìng le.
examples.en: He thought about it for a moment and then agreed.

examples.pinyin: Māma, wǒ huílai le!
examples.en: Mom, I'm back!

examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma shì lǎoshī.
examples.en: My mom is a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Māma, nǐ chī fàn le ma?
examples.en: Mom, have you eaten?

examples.zh: 他的手因为受伤而麻痹了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒu yīnwèi shòushāng ér mábì le.
examples.en: His hand went numb from the injury.

examples.zh: 工作上的小错误不能麻痹大意。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò shàng de xiǎo cuòwù bù néng mábì dàyì.
examples.en: Small mistakes at work should not make us careless.

examples.zh: 我们不能因为成功而麻痹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng yīnwèi chénggōng ér mábì.
examples.en: We must not become complacent because of our success.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, máfan nǐ le.
examples.en: Sorry to trouble you.

examples.pinyin: Bié máfan biérén.
examples.en: Don't bother other people.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn máfan.
examples.en: This problem is a real nuisance.

examples.zh: 长时间坐着，我的腿都麻木了。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān zuò zhe, wǒ de tuǐ dōu mámù le.
examples.en: After sitting for a long time, my legs have gone numb.

examples.zh: 他对这些事情已经很麻木了。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhèxiē shìqing yǐjīng hěn mámù le.
examples.en: He has become quite indifferent to these things.

examples.zh: 手指冻得麻木，写字很困难。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuzhǐ dòng de mámù, xiě zì hěn kùnnan.
examples.en: My fingers went numb from the cold, so writing was hard.

examples.zh: 医生给病人打了麻醉药。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén dǎ le mázuìyào.
examples.en: The doctor gave the patient an anesthetic.

examples.zh: 手术前，医生要先麻醉病人。
examples.pinyin: Shǒushù qián, yīshēng yào xiān mázuì bìngrén.
examples.en: Before surgery, the doctor must first anesthetize the patient.

examples.zh: 他不该用游戏来麻醉自己。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù gāi yòng yóuxì lái mázuì zìjǐ.
examples.en: He shouldn't use games to numb himself.

examples.pinyin: Mǎ pǎo de hěn kuài.
examples.en: The horse runs very fast.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qí mǎ.
examples.en: I want to ride a horse.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì qí mǎ ma?
examples.en: Can you ride a horse?

examples.pinyin: Zuòshì bú yào mǎhu.
examples.en: Don't be careless in what you do.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiě zì hěn mǎhu.
examples.en: His handwriting is sloppy.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ tài mǎhu le.
examples.en: I was far too careless in this exam.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng lái.
examples.en: I'll be right there.

examples.pinyin: Tā mǎshàng jiù huílái.
examples.en: He'll be back right away.

examples.pinyin: Huǒchē mǎshàng yào kāi le.
examples.en: The train is about to leave.

examples.zh: 这个码头很大，我们在这里等船。
examples.pinyin: Zhège mǎtóu hěn dà, wǒmen zài zhèlǐ děng chuán.
examples.en: This pier is big; we're waiting for the boat here.

examples.zh: 那艘大船已经停在码头边。
examples.pinyin: Nà sōu dà chuán yǐjīng tíng zài mǎtóu biān.
examples.en: That big ship has already docked by the pier.

examples.zh: 码头上有很多卖鱼的人吗？
examples.pinyin: Mǎtóu shàng yǒu hěn duō mài yú de rén ma?
examples.en: Are there many fish sellers on the wharf?

examples.pinyin: Bié suíbiàn mà rén.
examples.en: Don't swear at people carelessly.

examples.pinyin: Tā bèi māma màle yí dùn.
examples.en: He got a telling-off from his mom.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme mà tā?
examples.en: Why did you yell at him?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì lǎoshī ma?
examples.en: Are you a teacher?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá ma?
examples.en: Do you drink tea?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān hǎo ma?
examples.en: How are you today?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì péngyou ma, bié kèqi.
examples.en: We're friends, so don't be polite about it.

examples.zh: 这么好的天气，出去走走嘛。
examples.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de tiānqì, chūqù zǒuzou ma.
examples.en: The weather is so nice, why not go out for a walk?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháojí ma, mànmàn lái.
examples.en: Don't rush, take your time.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草丛里埋伏，准备吓朋友一跳。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎocóng lǐ máifú, zhǔnbèi xià péngyou yí tiào.
examples.en: The kids are hiding in the grass, planning to give their friend a fright.

examples.zh: 猫在树后面埋伏着，等老鼠出来。
examples.pinyin: Māo zài shù hòumiàn máifú zhe, děng lǎoshǔ chūlái.
examples.en: The cat is crouching behind the tree, waiting for the mouse to come out.

examples.zh: 游戏里他总喜欢埋伏在门后面。
examples.pinyin: Yóuxì lǐ tā zǒng xǐhuan máifú zài mén hòumiàn.
examples.en: In the game, he always likes to hide behind the door.

examples.zh: 他的才华不应该被埋没。
examples.pinyin: Tā de cáihuá bù yīnggāi bèi máimò.
examples.en: His talent shouldn't go unrecognised.

examples.zh: 这个小画家的作品差一点就被埋没了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo huàjiā de zuòpǐn chà yìdiǎn jiù bèi máimò le.
examples.en: This young painter's work nearly went unnoticed.

examples.zh: 他努力了这么久，不能就这样被埋没。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le zhème jiǔ, bù néng jiù zhèyàng bèi máimò.
examples.en: He has worked so hard for so long; he mustn't be overlooked like this.

examples.zh: 旧的习惯已经被埋葬了。
examples.pinyin: Jiù de xíguàn yǐjīng bèi máizàng le.
examples.en: The old habits have been buried.

examples.zh: 那段不愉快的回忆，我们应该埋葬在心里。
examples.pinyin: Nà duàn bù yúkuài de huíyì, wǒmen yīnggāi máizàng zài xīnlǐ.
examples.en: Let's bury that unhappy memory deep in our hearts.

examples.zh: 这个秘密他埋葬了很多年。
examples.pinyin: Zhège mìmì tā máizàng le hěn duō nián.
examples.en: He kept this secret hidden for many years.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge shǒubiǎo.
examples.en: I want to buy a wristwatch.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi shénme?
examples.en: What are you buying?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān méi mǎi dōngxi.
examples.en: I didn't buy anything today.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shāngdiàn mài shuǐguǒ.
examples.en: This shop sells fruit.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mài le wǒ de diànnǎo.
examples.en: I sold my computer.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ mài duōshao qián?
examples.en: How much are these apples?

examples.pinyin: Tā mài kāi dà bù xiàng qián zǒu.
examples.en: He strode forward with long steps.

examples.zh: 他终于迈进了大学的门槛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú mài jìn le dàxué de ménkǎn.
examples.en: He finally stepped across the threshold of university.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mài chū le dì yī bù.
examples.en: We took the first step.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng mōle mō tā de màibó.
examples.en: The doctor felt his pulse.

examples.zh: 跑完步以后，我的脉搏跳得很快。
examples.pinyin: Pǎowán bù yǐhòu, wǒ de màibó tiào de hěn kuài.
examples.en: After running, my pulse was racing.

examples.zh: 紧张的时候，我的脉搏会加快。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnzhāng de shíhou, wǒ de màibó huì jiākuài.
examples.en: When I'm nervous, my pulse speeds up.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ màikèfēng gěi wǒ.
examples.en: Please pass me the microphone.

examples.pinyin: Màikèfēng huài le, shēngyīn hěn xiǎo.
examples.en: The microphone is broken and the sound is very quiet.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng màikèfēng ma?
examples.en: Do you know how to use a microphone?

examples.pinyin: Zǎofàn wǒ chīle yí ge mántou.
examples.en: I had a steamed bun for breakfast.

examples.pinyin: Mántou hěn ruǎn, hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: The steamed buns are soft and tasty.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī mántou háishi mǐfàn?
examples.en: Do you want a steamed bun or rice?

examples.zh: 他埋怨我不早点告诉他。
examples.pinyin: Tā mányuàn wǒ bù zǎo diǎn gàosu tā.
examples.en: He complained that I didn't tell him earlier.

examples.zh: 别埋怨别人，先想想自己的问题。
examples.pinyin: Bié mányuàn biéren, xiān xiǎngxiang zìjǐ de wèntí.
examples.en: Don't blame others; think about your own problems first.

examples.zh: 雨下个不停，大家都在埋怨天气。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ xià ge bù tíng, dàjiā dōu zài mányuàn tiānqì.
examples.en: The rain kept falling, and everyone was grumbling about the weather.

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ mǎn le rén.
examples.en: The room is packed with people.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bēizi mǎn le.
examples.en: My cup is full.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì tiān de gōngzuò hěn mǎn.
examples.en: My day's schedule is very full.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎnyì ma?
examples.en: Are you satisfied?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège fángjiān hěn mǎnyì.
examples.en: I'm very happy with this room.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì wǒ de zuòyè.
examples.en: The teacher is pleased with my homework.

examples.zh: 他终于满足了我的要求。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú mǎnzú le wǒ de yāoqiú.
examples.en: He finally met my request.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ ràng wǒ hěn mǎnzú.
examples.en: I'm very happy with this result.

examples.pinyin: Chībǎo fàn, wǒ hěn mǎnzú.
examples.en: Having had a full meal, I'm content.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ màn diǎn shuō.
examples.en: Please speak more slowly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ shuō de hěn màn.
examples.en: I speak Chinese very slowly.

examples.pinyin: Fàn hěn rè, màn màn chī.
examples.en: The food is hot, so eat slowly.

examples.zh: 冬天的夜晚显得特别漫长。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de yèwǎn xiǎnde tèbié màncháng.
examples.en: Winter nights seem especially long.

examples.zh: 等待录取结果的日子非常漫长。
examples.pinyin: Děngdài lùqǔ jiéguǒ de rìzi fēicháng màncháng.
examples.en: The days spent waiting for admission results drag on forever.

examples.zh: 这段旅程并不漫长，只要两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lǚchéng bìng bú màncháng, zhǐyào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: The journey isn't long at all, just two hours.

examples.zh: 我喜欢看漫画，尤其是搞笑的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn mànhuà, yóuqí shì gǎoxiào de.
examples.en: I like reading comics, especially funny ones.

examples.zh: 他画了一幅漫画，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
examples.pinyin: Tā huà le yì fú mànhuà, dòu de dàjiā hāhā dàxiào.
examples.en: He drew a cartoon that had everyone laughing out loud.

examples.zh: 这本漫画的故事很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn mànhuà de gùshi hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: The story in this comic book is very interesting.

examples.zh: 他患有慢性胃炎，要按时吃药。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn yǒu mànxìng wèiyán, yào ànshí chī yào.
examples.en: He has chronic gastritis and must take his medicine on time.

examples.zh: 长期熬夜会引起慢性疲劳。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì yǐnqǐ mànxìng píláo.
examples.en: Staying up late for long periods can cause chronic fatigue.

examples.zh: 慢性病需要长期治疗，不能着急。
examples.pinyin: Mànxìngbìng xūyào chángqī zhìliáo, bù néng zháojí.
examples.en: Chronic illnesses need long-term treatment, so don't rush.

examples.zh: 火势很快就蔓延到了隔壁。
examples.pinyin: Huǒshì hěn kuài jiù mànyán dào le gébì.
examples.en: The fire quickly spread to the building next door.

examples.zh: 草在院子里蔓延得很快吗？
examples.pinyin: Cǎo zài yuànzi lǐ mànyán de hěn kuài ma?
examples.en: Is the grass spreading quickly in the yard?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù bú huì mànyán.
examples.en: This plant will not spread.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng.
examples.en: I'm very busy today.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān máng bu máng?
examples.en: Are you busy tomorrow?

examples.pinyin: Máng le yì tiān, wǒmen huí jiā ba.
examples.en: We've been busy all day; let's go home.

examples.pinyin: Māma měitiān dōu hěn mánglù.
examples.en: Mom is busy every single day.

examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qián, jiē shàng yí piàn mánglù.
examples.en: Before Spring Festival, the streets are bustling.

examples.zh: 这段时间他工作很忙碌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān tā gōngzuò hěn mánglù.
examples.en: He has been swamped with work lately.

examples.zh: 茫茫的大海上，一艘船也没有。
examples.pinyin: Mángmáng de dàhǎi shàng, yì sōu chuán yě méiyǒu.
examples.en: On the boundless sea, there was not a single boat.

examples.zh: 茫茫人海中，我找不到你。
examples.pinyin: Mángmáng rénhǎi zhōng, wǒ zhǎo bu dào nǐ.
examples.en: I couldn't find you in the vast sea of people.

examples.zh: 这片草原茫茫，看不到尽头吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn cǎoyuán mángmáng, kàn bu dào jìntóu ma?
examples.en: Is this grassland so vast you can't see where it ends?

examples.pinyin: Bú yào mángmù de xiāngxìn guǎnggào.
examples.en: Don't blindly believe ads.

examples.zh: 他盲目地跟着朋友买衣服，结果花了很多钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā mángmù de gēnzhe péngyou mǎi yīfu, jiéguǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: He blindly followed his friends shopping for clothes and ended up spending a lot.

examples.zh: 做决定之前要冷静，不能盲目行动。
examples.pinyin: Zuò juédìng zhīqián yào lěngjìng, bù néng mángmù xíngdòng.
examples.en: Stay calm before making a decision, and don't act blindly.

examples.zh: 他听了这个消息，茫然地站在那里。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīng le zhège xiāoxi, mángrán de zhàn zài nàlǐ.
examples.en: On hearing the news, he stood there in a daze.

examples.zh: 面对这个问题，我感到很茫然。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhège wèntí, wǒ gǎndào hěn mángrán.
examples.en: Faced with this question, I felt completely lost.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yì liǎn mángrán?
examples.en: Why do you look so bewildered?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo xǐhuan hē niúnǎi.
examples.en: My cat likes drinking milk.

examples.pinyin: Māo zài shuìjiào.
examples.en: The cat is sleeping.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu māo ma?
examples.en: Do you have a cat at home?

examples.zh: 这只小狗身上的毛很软。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu shēnshang de máo hěn ruǎn.
examples.en: This puppy's fur is very soft.

examples.pinyin: Yīfu shang diào le yì gēn máo.
examples.en: A hair fell onto my clothes.

examples.pinyin: Máobǐ zì xiě de hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: The calligraphy written with a brush looks very nice.

examples.pinyin: Tā de máobìng shì ài chídào.
examples.en: His bad habit is being late.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo yǒudiǎn máobìng.
examples.en: This computer has a bit of a fault.

examples.zh: 你有什么毛病，快去看医生。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme máobìng, kuài qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.en: If something is wrong with you, go and see a doctor quickly.

examples.pinyin: Tā de huà yǒu máodùn.
examples.en: His words are contradictory.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou yǒu máodùn.
examples.en: My friend and I have a conflict.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shìqing hěn máodùn.
examples.en: These two things contradict each other.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì tiáo máojīn.
examples.en: Please give me a towel.

examples.pinyin: Máojīn zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the towel?

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo máojīn hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: This towel is very clean.

examples.zh: 有人冒充银行的工作人员打电话。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén màochōng yínháng de gōngzuò rényuán dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Someone posing as a bank employee called.

examples.zh: 请不要冒充别人的名字。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào màochōng biérén de míngzi.
examples.en: Please don't pretend to be someone else.

examples.pinyin: Tā màochōng shì lǎobǎn de érzi.
examples.en: He pretended to be the boss's son.

examples.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ de huācǎo hěn màoshèng.
examples.en: The flowers and plants in the yard are lush.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn sēnlín zhǎng de màoshèng ma?
examples.en: Is this forest growing lush?

examples.zh: 冬天到了，树叶就不茂盛了。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān dào le, shùyè jiù bú màoshèng le.
examples.en: When winter comes, the leaves are no longer lush.

examples.pinyin: Màoxiǎn de shìqing wǒ bù gǎn zuò.
examples.en: I don't dare to take such risks.

examples.zh: 他喜欢冒险，经常去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan màoxiǎn, jīngcháng qù páshān.
examples.en: He loves taking risks and often goes mountain climbing.

examples.zh: 这次旅行很有冒险的感觉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng hěn yǒu màoxiǎn de gǎnjué.
examples.en: This trip felt really adventurous.

examples.zh: 这两个国家的贸易很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā de màoyì hěn duō.
examples.en: Trade between these two countries is large.

examples.zh: 他在国际贸易公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guójì màoyì gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.en: He works at an international trading company.

examples.pinyin: Màoyì de fāzhǎn hěn kuài.
examples.en: Trade is developing quickly.

examples.pinyin: Tā de màozi hěn dà.
examples.en: His hat is very big.

examples.pinyin: Zhège màozi hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This hat looks nice.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de màozi zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is your hat?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu qián.
examples.en: I don't have any money.

examples.pinyin: Tā méi chī fàn.
examples.en: She hasn't eaten.

examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ méi qù xuéxiào.
examples.en: I didn't go to school yesterday.

examples.zh: 这枚硬币是一百年前的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè méi yìngbì shì yìbǎi nián qián de.
examples.en: This coin is a hundred years old.

examples.zh: 他收集了一枚很漂亮的徽章。
examples.pinyin: Tā shōujíle yì méi hěn piàoliang de huīzhāng.
examples.en: He collected a very beautiful badge.

examples.pinyin: Zhè méi jièzhi shì sònggěi nǐ de.
examples.en: This ring is for you.

examples.pinyin: Méi guānxi, màn màn chī.
examples.en: It's fine, eat slowly.

examples.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ tīng dǒng le.
examples.en: It doesn't matter, I understood.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ bù hǎo, méi guānxi.
examples.en: My Chinese isn't good, but that's OK.

examples.zh: 电视是一种重要的媒介。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shì yì zhǒng zhòngyào de méijiè.
examples.en: Television is an important medium.

examples.zh: 语言是人们交流的媒介。
examples.pinyin: Yǔyán shì rénmen jiāoliú de méijiè.
examples.en: Language is the medium people use to communicate.

examples.zh: 你觉得什么是最好的学习媒介？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde shénme shì zuì hǎo de xuéxí méijiè?
examples.en: What do you think is the best medium for learning?

examples.pinyin: Tā de méimao hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: Her eyebrows are very pretty.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhòu qǐ le méimao.
examples.en: He frowned.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de méimao zěnme le?
examples.en: What happened to your eyebrows?

examples.pinyin: Méitàn shì hěn zhòngyào de néngyuán.
examples.en: Coal is a very important energy source.

examples.pinyin: Nà liàng kǎchē zhuāngmǎn le méitàn.
examples.en: That truck was loaded full of coal.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā dōngtiān yòng méitàn ma?
examples.en: Does your family use coal in winter?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bèi méitǐ bàodào le.
examples.en: The story was reported in the media.

examples.zh: 社交媒体上的消息传得很快。
examples.pinyin: Shèjiāo méitǐ shàng de xiāoxi chuán de hěn kuài.
examples.en: News spreads very fast on social media.

examples.zh: 你平时通过什么媒体了解新闻？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ píngshí tōngguò shénme méitǐ liǎojiě xīnwén?
examples.en: Which media do you usually use to follow the news?

examples.zh: 这道题太难了，我真没辙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài nán le, wǒ zhēn méi zhé.
examples.en: This question is too hard, and I'm really stumped.

examples.zh: 孩子哭个不停，妈妈没辙了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi kū ge bù tíng, māma méi zhé le.
examples.en: The child would not stop crying, and Mom was at her wit's end.

examples.zh: 面对这种情况，我真的没辙。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng, wǒ zhēnde méi zhé.
examples.en: Faced with this situation, I really have no way out.

examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yì běn shū.
examples.en: Everyone has a book.

examples.pinyin: Měi ge xīngqī wǒ dōu qù xuéxiào.
examples.en: I go to school every week.

examples.zh: 每天早上，我喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshang, wǒ hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.en: Every morning I drink a cup of coffee.

examples.zh: 这个房间装修得很美观。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zhuāngxiū de hěn měiguān.
examples.en: This room is decorated very attractively.

examples.zh: 这张海报设计得既美观又实用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng hǎibào shèjì de jì měiguān yòu shíyòng.
examples.en: This poster is both attractive and practical.

examples.zh: 树木种在路边，既美观又能遮阴。
examples.pinyin: Shùmù zhòng zài lù biān, jì měiguān yòu néng zhēyīn.
examples.en: Trees planted along the road look nice and give shade.

examples.pinyin: Zhèli de fēngjǐng hěn měilì.
examples.en: The scenery here is very beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn měilì.
examples.en: She is very beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngshì hěn měilì.
examples.en: Our city is beautiful.

examples.zh: 他们有一个美满的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yǒu yí ge měimǎn de jiātíng.
examples.en: They have a happy family.

examples.pinyin: Zhù nǐmen hūnyīn měimǎn.
examples.en: Wishing you a happy marriage.

examples.zh: 这个故事有一个美满的结局。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi yǒu yí ge měimǎn de jiéjú.
examples.en: This story has a happy ending.

examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài chuánlái měimiào de yīnyuè.
examples.en: Beautiful music drifted in from outside the window.

examples.zh: 这个周末我们过得很美妙。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen guò de hěn měimiào.
examples.en: We had a wonderful weekend.

examples.zh: 这顿晚饭的味道真美妙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn wǎnfàn de wèidao zhēn měimiào.
examples.en: This dinner tasted wonderful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan shàng měishù kè.
examples.en: I like art class.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì měishù lǎoshī.
examples.en: She is an art teacher.

examples.pinyin: Tā de měishù hěn hǎo.
examples.en: His art is very good.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì hěn yǒu mèilì.
examples.en: This city has a lot of charm.

examples.zh: 他的魅力很大，很多人喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèilì hěn dà, hěn duō rén xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: He has great charm, and many people like him.

examples.zh: 你觉得这首歌有魅力吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè shǒu gē yǒu mèilì ma?

examples.zh: 我们学校讨论问题很民主。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào tǎolùn wèntí hěn mínzhǔ.
examples.en: Our school discusses issues very democratically.

examples.pinyin: Bān lǐ de xuǎnjǔ shì mínzhǔ de.
examples.en: The class election was democratic.

examples.zh: 大家应该民主地做决定。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yīnggāi mínzhǔ de zuò juédìng.
examples.en: Everyone should make decisions democratically.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō mínzú.
examples.en: China has many ethnic groups.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì nǎ ge mínzú de?
examples.en: Which ethnic group is he from?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan mínzú yīnyuè.
examples.en: I enjoy traditional folk music.

examples.zh: 他的皮肤很敏感，不能用太强的香皂。
examples.pinyin: Tā de pífū hěn mǐngǎn, bù néng yòng tài qiáng de xiāngzào.
examples.en: His skin is sensitive, so he can't use very strong soap.

examples.zh: 她对别人的态度特别敏感。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì biérén de tàidu tèbié mǐngǎn.
examples.en: She is very sensitive to other people's attitudes.

examples.zh: 这个话题比较敏感，我们最好别谈。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huàtí bǐjiào mǐngǎn, wǒmen zuìhǎo bié tán.
examples.en: This topic is rather sensitive, so we'd better not bring it up.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo dòngzuò hěn mǐnjié.
examples.en: This little cat moves very nimbly.

examples.zh: 他反应敏捷，总能很快想到办法。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnyìng mǐnjié, zǒng néng hěn kuài xiǎngdào bànfǎ.
examples.en: He reacts quickly and can always think of a solution fast.

examples.zh: 运动员的身手非常敏捷。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán de shēnshǒu fēicháng mǐnjié.
examples.en: The athlete's movements are extremely agile.

examples.zh: 她观察事情很敏锐，总能发现问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā guānchá shìqing hěn mǐnruì, zǒng néng fāxiàn wèntí.
examples.en: She is very perceptive, and she always spots problems.

examples.zh: 这位记者的洞察力非常敏锐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě de dòngchálì fēicháng mǐnruì.
examples.en: This reporter has an extremely keen insight.

examples.zh: 他对颜色的变化很敏锐。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yánsè de biànhuà hěn mǐnruì.
examples.en: He is very keen to notice changes in color.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngbai le ma?
examples.en: Do you understand?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài míngbai nǐ de yìsi.
examples.en: I don't quite understand what you mean.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de hěn míngbai.
examples.en: The teacher explained it very clearly.

examples.zh: 这次考试我的名次比上次高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ de míngcì bǐ shàng cì gāo.
examples.en: My ranking in this exam is higher than last time.

examples.zh: 你知道比赛的最后名次吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao bǐsài de zuìhòu míngcì ma?
examples.en: Do you know the final rankings of the competition?

examples.zh: 他在班里的名次不太好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bān lǐ de míngcì bù tài hǎo.
examples.en: His ranking in the class isn't very good.

examples.zh: 这次出国学习的名额只有五个。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūguó xuéxí de míng'é zhǐ yǒu wǔ ge.
examples.en: There are only five places for this overseas study trip.

examples.zh: 报名的人很多，名额却很少。
examples.pinyin: Bàomíng de rén hěn duō, míng'é què hěn shǎo.
examples.en: Many people signed up, but there are very few places.

examples.pinyin: Hái yǒu míng'é ma?
examples.en: Are there still places left?

examples.zh: 这家老店果然名副其实，菜很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn guǒrán míngfùqíshí, cài hěn hǎo chī.
examples.en: This old restaurant really lives up to its name; the food is great.

examples.zh: 他是一位名副其实的好老师。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi míngfùqíshí de hǎo lǎoshī.
examples.en: He is a teacher who truly deserves the title.

examples.zh: 你觉得这家饭店名副其实吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè jiā fàndiàn míngfùqíshí ma?
examples.en: Do you think this restaurant lives up to its name?

examples.zh: 明明是你的错，为什么不承认？
examples.pinyin: Míngmíng shì nǐ de cuò, wèishénme bù chéngrèn?
examples.en: It's obviously your fault, so why won't you admit it?

examples.zh: 他明明知道答案，却不说。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngmíng zhīdào dá'àn, què bù shuō.
examples.en: He obviously knows the answer but won't say it.

examples.zh: 天明明很热，你却穿这么多。
examples.pinyin: Tiān míngmíng hěn rè, nǐ què chuān zhème duō.
examples.en: It is obviously very hot, yet you are wearing so many layers.

examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chuān míngpái yīfu.
examples.en: He always wears designer clothes.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bāo shì míngpái ma?
examples.en: Is this bag a famous brand?

examples.pinyin: Míngpái bù yídìng jiù zhìliàng hǎo.
examples.en: A famous brand doesn't always mean good quality.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de míngpiàn.
examples.en: This is my business card.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng míngpiàn.
examples.en: Please give me a business card.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ míngpiàn fàng zài bāo lǐ le.
examples.en: I put the business card in my bag.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng míngquè nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: Please make your idea clear.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒu míngquè de mùbiāo.
examples.en: We need clear goals.

examples.zh: 老师明确地说了作业要求。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī míngquè de shuō le zuòyè yāoqiú.
examples.en: The teacher stated the homework requirements clearly.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu hěn duō míngshèng gǔjì.
examples.en: There are many famous historical sites here.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù cānguān míngshèng gǔjì.
examples.en: We're going to visit historic sites.

examples.zh: 这个城市的名胜古迹很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge chéngshì de míngshèng gǔjì hěn duō.
examples.en: This city has many historic sights.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒmen qù xuéxiào.
examples.en: We're going to school tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ lái wǒ jiā ba.
examples.en: Come to my place tomorrow, OK?

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The weather will be nice tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Tā de jìnbù hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.en: His progress is very clear.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cuòwù hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.en: This mistake is obvious.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì míngxiǎn biàn lěng le.
examples.en: The weather has clearly turned cold.

examples.zh: 我给妈妈寄了一张明信片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi māma jì le yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn.
examples.en: I sent Mom a postcard.

examples.zh: 这张明信片是北京的风景。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng míngxìnpiàn shì Běijīng de fēngjǐng.
examples.en: This postcard shows scenery from Beijing.

examples.zh: 旅行的时候我喜欢买明信片。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de shíhou wǒ xǐhuan mǎi míngxìnpiàn.
examples.en: When I travel, I like to buy postcards.

examples.zh: 他是一位很有名的电影明星。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi hěn yǒumíng de diànyǐng míngxīng.
examples.en: He is a very famous film star.

examples.pinyin: Zhège míngxīng hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: This star is very popular.

examples.pinyin: Hěn duō háizi xiǎng dāng míngxīng.
examples.en: Many children want to become stars.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de míngyù.
examples.en: He cares a lot about his reputation.

examples.zh: 他的行为影响了公司的名誉。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi yǐngxiǎng le gōngsī de míngyù.
examples.en: His behavior damaged the company's reputation.

examples.zh: 你这样做，对你的名誉不好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, duì nǐ de míngyù bù hǎo.
examples.en: Acting like this is bad for your reputation.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de míngzi shì shénme?
examples.en: What is your name?

examples.pinyin: Míngzi wǒ huì xiě.
examples.en: I can write the name.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de míngzi.
examples.en: Please tell me your name.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī mìnglìng wǒmen ānjìng.
examples.en: The teacher ordered us to be quiet.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù tīng māma de mìnglìng.
examples.en: He doesn't obey his mom's orders.

examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo ànzhào mìnglìng yùnxíng.
examples.en: The computer runs according to the commands.

examples.zh: 我们正在给新公园命名。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài gěi xīn gōngyuán mìngmíng.
examples.en: We are naming the new park.

examples.zh: 这种新药还没有正式命名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn yào hái méiyǒu zhèngshì mìngmíng.
examples.en: This new medicine has not been formally named yet.

examples.zh: 你给你的宠物命名了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gěi nǐ de chǒngwù mìngmíng le ma?
examples.en: Have you named your pet yet?

examples.pinyin: Mìngyùn shì kěyǐ gǎibiàn de.
examples.en: Fate can be changed.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn mìngyùn.
examples.en: I believe in fate.

examples.pinyin: Tā de mìngyùn hěn bù hǎo.
examples.en: His fate was not kind to him.

examples.pinyin: Tā mō le mō háizi de tóu.
examples.en: He gently touched the child's head.

examples.pinyin: Hēi'àn zhōng wǒ mōdào le kāiguān.
examples.en: In the dark I felt for the switch.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi mō qǐlai hěn ruǎn.
examples.en: This thing feels soft to the touch.

examples.zh: 他在黑暗中摸索着找到了开关。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài hēi'àn zhōng mōsuo zhe zhǎodào le kāiguān.
examples.en: He felt his way through the dark and found the switch.

examples.zh: 新手要多摸索，慢慢就会熟练。
examples.pinyin: Xīnshǒu yào duō mōsuo, mànmàn jiù huì shúliàn.
examples.en: Beginners should experiment a lot, and they will soon become skilled.

examples.zh: 我们还在摸索适合自己的学习方法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hái zài mōsuo shìhé zìjǐ de xuéxí fāngfǎ.
examples.en: We are still feeling our way towards a study method that suits us.

examples.zh: 鸡蛋壳里面有一层薄膜。
examples.pinyin: Jīdàn ké lǐmiàn yǒu yì céng bómó.
examples.en: Inside the eggshell there is a thin membrane.

examples.zh: 手机屏幕上贴了一层保护膜。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī píngmù shang tiēle yì céng hùmó.
examples.en: A protective film has been stuck on the phone screen.

examples.zh: 眼睛里的膜很薄，要小心保护。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjing lǐ de mó hěn báo, yào xiǎoxīn bǎohù.
examples.en: The membrane in the eye is very thin, so protect it carefully.

examples.zh: 鞋底和地面之间有摩擦。
examples.pinyin: Xiédǐ hé dìmiàn zhījiān yǒu mócā.
examples.en: There is friction between the sole of a shoe and the ground.

examples.zh: 两家公司之间产生了一些摩擦。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī zhījiān chǎnshēng le yìxiē mócā.
examples.en: Some friction has arisen between the two companies.

examples.zh: 双手摩擦可以让手变暖。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngshǒu mócā kěyǐ ràng shǒu biàn nuǎn.
examples.en: Rubbing your hands together can warm them up.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì yì míng mófàn yuángōng.
examples.en: He is a model employee.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì bān lǐ de xuéxí mófàn.
examples.en: She is a model student in the class.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xiàng mófàn xuéxí.
examples.en: We should learn from the role models.

examples.pinyin: Háizi xǐhuan mófǎng dàrén.
examples.en: Children like to imitate adults.

examples.pinyin: Tā mófǎng lǎoshī de shēngyīn.
examples.en: He imitated the teacher's voice.

examples.zh: 学外语可以先模仿发音。
examples.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ kěyǐ xiān mófǎng fāyīn.
examples.en: When learning a language, you can start by imitating the pronunciation.

examples.zh: 这个孩子调皮得像个小魔鬼。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi tiáopí de xiàng ge xiǎo móguǐ.
examples.en: This child is as mischievous as a little devil.

examples.zh: 他的老板有时候像个魔鬼。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lǎobǎn yǒushíhou xiàng ge móguǐ.
examples.en: His boss is sometimes like a demon.

examples.zh: 这道题的难度像魔鬼一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de nándù xiàng móguǐ yíyàng.
examples.en: This problem is brutally hard.

examples.zh: 新队员需要一段时间跟大家磨合。
examples.pinyin: Xīn duìyuán xūyào yí duàn shíjiān gēn dàjiā móhé.
examples.en: New team members need some time to settle in with everyone.

examples.zh: 两个人刚合作，还在磨合中。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén gāng hézuò, hái zài móhé zhōng.
examples.en: The two of them have just started working together and are still adjusting to each other.

examples.zh: 新车要先磨合，不能开太快。
examples.pinyin: Xīn chē yào xiān móhé, bù néng kāi tài kuài.
examples.en: A new car needs to be broken in first; you can't drive it too fast.

examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn yǒudiǎn móhu.
examples.en: The photo is a bit blurry.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jìyì hěn móhu le.
examples.en: My memory of it has become vague.

examples.zh: 这个问题的答案很模糊。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de dá'àn hěn móhu.
examples.en: The answer to this question is unclear.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xuéxí móshì hěn yǒuxiào.
examples.en: This way of learning is very effective.

examples.zh: 我们要改变传统的工作模式。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào gǎibiàn chuántǒng de gōngzuò móshì.
examples.en: We need to change the traditional way of working.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiāofèi móshì hěn jiànkāng.
examples.en: His spending habits are very healthy.

examples.zh: 他会变魔术，把硬币变不见了。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì biàn móshù, bǎ yìngbì biàn bújiàn le.
examples.en: He can do magic tricks and made the coin disappear.

examples.zh: 孩子们很喜欢看魔术表演。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen hěn xǐhuan kàn móshù biǎoyǎn.
examples.en: The children love watching magic shows.

examples.pinyin: Zhège móshù tài shénqí le!
examples.en: This magic trick is so amazing!

examples.pinyin: Tā qí mótuōchē qù shàngbān.
examples.en: He rides a motorbike to work.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng mótuōchē hěn jiù le.
examples.en: This motorbike is quite old.

examples.pinyin: Qí mótuōchē yào dài tóukuī.
examples.en: You must wear a helmet when riding a motorbike.

examples.zh: 我和爸爸一起做了一个飞机模型。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé bàba yìqǐ zuòle yí ge fēijī móxíng.
examples.en: Dad and I built a model airplane together.

examples.zh: 这个模型可以帮助我们理解原理。
examples.pinyin: Zhège móxíng kěyǐ bāngzhù wǒmen lǐjiě yuánlǐ.
examples.en: This model helps us understand the principle.

examples.zh: 科学家建立了一个新的数学模型。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā jiànlìle yí ge xīn de shùxué móxíng.
examples.en: Scientists built a new mathematical model.

examples.zh: 不能因为一次失败，就抹杀他所有的努力。
examples.pinyin: Bù néng yīnwèi yí cì shībài, jiù mǒshā tā suǒyǒu de nǔlì.
examples.en: You can't write off all his efforts because of one failure.

examples.zh: 他的贡献不应该被抹杀。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gòngxiàn bù yīnggāi bèi mǒshā.
examples.en: His contribution should not be erased.

examples.zh: 时间可以冲淡伤痛，但不能抹杀回忆。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān kěyǐ chōngdàn shāngtòng, dàn bù néng mǒshā huíyì.
examples.en: Time can ease the pain, but it cannot wipe out memories.

examples.zh: 他突然生气了，我莫名其妙。
examples.pinyin: Tā tūrán shēngqì le, wǒ mò míng qí miào.
examples.en: He suddenly got angry, and I was completely baffled.

examples.zh: 你为什么莫名其妙地笑？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme mò míng qí miào de xiào?
examples.en: Why are you laughing for no reason?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhēn shì mò míng qí miào.
examples.en: This whole thing makes no sense at all.

examples.zh: 他默默地工作，从不抱怨。
examples.pinyin: Tā mòmò de gōngzuò, cóng bú bàoyuàn.
examples.en: He works quietly and never complains.

examples.zh: 妈妈默默地为我们准备早饭。
examples.pinyin: Māma mòmò de wèi wǒmen zhǔnbèi zǎofàn.
examples.en: Mom quietly prepared breakfast for us.

examples.zh: 她默默地坐在窗边看书。
examples.pinyin: Tā mòmò de zuò zài chuāng biān kànshū.
examples.en: She sat quietly by the window reading.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hěn mòshēng.
examples.en: I'm not familiar with this city.

examples.pinyin: Yí ge mòshēngrén xiàng wǒ wèn lù.
examples.en: A stranger asked me for directions.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn mòshēng.
examples.en: His voice sounds unfamiliar.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bǐ méiyǒu mòshuǐr le.
examples.en: This pen has run out of ink.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng lánsè mòshuǐr xiězì.
examples.en: I write with blue ink.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de mòshuǐr yòng wán le ma?
examples.en: Have you used up your ink?

examples.zh: 他一直在谋求更好的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài móuqiú gèng hǎo de gōngzuò.
examples.en: He has long been looking for a better job.

examples.zh: 你们谋求什么样的合作？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen móuqiú shénme yàng de hézuò?
examples.en: What kind of cooperation are you seeking?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù móuqiú gèrén lìyì.
examples.en: We are not seeking personal gain.

examples.zh: 某天，我在街上遇见了他。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu tiān, wǒ zài jiē shang yùjiàn le tā.
examples.en: One day I ran into him on the street.

examples.pinyin: Mǒu rén dǎ diànhuà zhǎo nǐ.
examples.en: Someone phoned looking for you.

examples.pinyin: Mǒu ge dìfang de rén hěn rèqíng.
examples.en: People in a certain place are very friendly.

examples.zh: 他小时候的模样我还记得。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshíhou de múyàng wǒ hái jìde.
examples.en: I still remember what he looked like as a child.

examples.zh: 这个城市变了很多，已经不是从前的模样了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì biànle hěn duō, yǐjīng bú shì cóngqián de múyàng le.
examples.en: This city has changed a lot and no longer looks as it once did.

examples.zh: 他看起来一副疲惫的模样。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái yí fù píbèi de múyàng.
examples.en: He looks very tired.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn shì lǎoshī.
examples.en: My mother is a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Mǔqīn hěn ài wǒ.
examples.en: My mother loves me very much.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài lùkǒu, yóuyù de páihuái.

examples.zh: 我们班的同学喜欢打排球。

examples.en: My classmates like playing volleyball.

examples.pinyin: Zhège páiqiú shì xīn de.
examples.en: This volleyball is new.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì dǎ páiqiú ma?
examples.en: Can you play volleyball?

examples.en: The company sent me to Beijing on a business trip.

examples.pinyin: Tā pài rén qù mǎi dōngxi.
examples.en: He sent someone out to buy things.

examples.zh: 我们派了一个代表去开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen pài le yí ge dàibiǎo qù kāihuì.
examples.en: We sent a representative to the meeting.

examples.zh: 这两个派别的观点很不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge pàibié de guāndiǎn hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.en: The views of these two schools of thought are very different.

examples.zh: 我们班的同学没有派别，大家都很友好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān de tóngxué méiyǒu pàibié, dàjiā dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.en: Our classmates don't form cliques; everyone is friendly.

examples.zh: 你更喜欢哪个派别的画风？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gèng xǐhuan nǎge pàibié de huàfēng?
examples.en: Which school of painting do you prefer?

examples.zh: 公司派遣小王去上海出差。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī pàiqiǎn Xiǎo Wáng qù Shànghǎi chūchāi.
examples.en: The company sent Xiao Wang to Shanghai on a business trip.

examples.zh: 学校派遣了两名老师去参加培训。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào pàiqiǎn le liǎng míng lǎoshī qù cānjiā péixùn.
examples.en: The school sent two teachers to attend a training course.

examples.zh: 为什么总公司不派遣别人过来？
examples.pinyin: Wèishénme zǒnggōngsī bù pàiqiǎn biérén guòlái?
examples.en: Why doesn't head office send someone else over?

examples.pinyin: Tāmen yìqǐ pāndēng le shāndǐng.
examples.en: They climbed to the mountain top together.

examples.zh: 攀登高峰需要很强的体力。
examples.pinyin: Pāndēng gāofēng xūyào hěn qiáng de tǐlì.
examples.en: Climbing high peaks takes great physical strength.

examples.zh: 孩子们在树上攀登，玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài shù shàng pāndēng, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: The children climbed the trees and had a great time.

examples.zh: 一只老鹰在天空中盘旋。
examples.pinyin: Yì zhī lǎoyīng zài tiānkōng zhōng pánxuán.
examples.en: An eagle is circling in the sky.

examples.zh: 飞机在机场上空盘旋了很久，才降落。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī zài jīchǎng shàngkōng pánxuán le hěn jiǔ, cái jiàngluò.
examples.en: The plane circled above the airport for a long time before landing.

examples.zh: 路上的山路很弯，车子一直在山间盘旋。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng de shānlù hěn wān, chēzi yìzhí zài shānjiān pánxuán.
examples.en: The mountain road has many bends, and the car winds steadily through the hills.

examples.pinyin: Pánzi lǐ yǒu jǐ ge píngguǒ.
examples.en: There are a few apples on the plate.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ pánzi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: Please put the plate on the table.

examples.pinyin: Zhège pánzi hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: This plate is very pretty.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen zuò zài húpàn liáotiān.
examples.en: They sat chatting by the lake.

examples.zh: 小屋建在河畔，风景很美。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎowū jiàn zài hépàn, fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.en: The little cabin is built by the river, and the scenery is lovely.

examples.zh: 夕阳照在江畔，一片金黄。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng zhào zài jiāngpàn, yí piàn jīnhuáng.
examples.en: The setting sun lights up the riverbank in golden hues.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de pànduàn shì duì de.
examples.en: Your judgement is right.

examples.zh: 我不能判断他说的是不是真的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng pànduàn tā shuō de shì bu shì zhēn de.
examples.en: I can't tell whether what he said is true.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zǐxì pànduàn.
examples.en: Please judge carefully.

examples.pinyin: Fǎguān jīntiān xuānbù le pànjué.
examples.en: The judge announced the verdict today.

examples.zh: 这个判决让大家很意外。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pànjué ràng dàjiā hěn yìwài.
examples.en: This ruling surprised everyone.

examples.zh: 我们要尊重最后的判决。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnzhòng zuìhòu de pànjué.
examples.en: We should respect the final judgment.

examples.zh: 我盼望下个假期快点来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pànwàng xià ge jiàqī kuàidiǎn lái.
examples.en: I'm looking forward to the next holiday coming soon.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen pànwàng xiàyǔ.
examples.en: We're hoping for rain.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ pànwàng shénme?
examples.en: What are you hoping for?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiā zài xuéxiào pángbiān.
examples.en: My home is next to the school.

examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi pángbiān yǒu yí ge bēizi.
examples.en: There's a cup beside the table.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zài wǒ pángbiān.
examples.en: Please sit next to me.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī guīmó hěn pángdà.
examples.en: This company is enormous in size.

examples.zh: 我们面对的是一个庞大的市场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen miànduì de shì yí ge pángdà de shìchǎng.
examples.en: We are facing a huge market.

examples.zh: 这座图书馆藏书很庞大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò túshūguǎn cángshū hěn pángdà.
examples.en: This library has a huge collection of books.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ yǐqián pàng le.
examples.en: He has got fatter than before.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo hěn pàng.
examples.en: This cat is very chubby.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde wǒ pàng ma?
examples.en: Do you think I'm fat?

examples.pinyin: Tā cóng bù pāoqì péngyou.
examples.en: He never abandons his friends.

examples.zh: 不管遇到什么困难，我们都不能抛弃希望。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn yùdào shénme kùnnan, wǒmen dōu bù néng pāoqì xīwàng.
examples.en: No matter what difficulties we face, we must not give up hope.

examples.zh: 这本旧书被主人抛弃在角落里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn jiù shū bèi zhǔrén pāoqì zài jiǎoluò lǐ.
examples.en: This old book was left to gather dust in a corner by its owner.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
examples.en: I go running every morning.

examples.pinyin: Tā pǎobù pǎo de hěn kuài.
examples.en: He runs very fast.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan pǎobù ma?
examples.en: Do you like running?

examples.zh: 洗手的时候，手上有很多泡沫。
examples.pinyin: Xǐshǒu de shíhou, shǒu shàng yǒu hěn duō pàomò.
examples.en: When you wash your hands, there is lots of soap foam on them.

examples.zh: 这杯咖啡上面的泡沫很厚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi kāfēi shàngmiàn de pàomò hěn hòu.
examples.en: The foam on top of this coffee is thick.

examples.pinyin: Fángjià shì bu shì yǒu pàomò?
examples.en: Is there a bubble in house prices?

examples.pinyin: Māma péi wǒ qù yīyuàn.
examples.en: Mom went to the hospital with me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ qù chāoshì ba.
examples.en: I'll go to the supermarket with you.

examples.pinyin: Péngyou péi wǒ liáotiān.
examples.en: My friend kept me company while we chatted.

examples.pinyin: Tā dǎsuìle bōli, yào péicháng.
examples.en: He broke the glass and will have to pay for it.

examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn méiyǒu péicháng wǒ.
examples.en: The shop didn't compensate me.

examples.zh: 这件衣服坏了，你要赔偿吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu huài le, nǐ yào péicháng ma?
examples.en: This clothing is ruined, so will you pay for it?

examples.zh: 公司为新员工安排了培训。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèi xīn yuángōng ānpái le péixùn.
examples.en: The company arranged training for new staff.

examples.zh: 我下个星期要参加一个电脑培训。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge xīngqī yào cānjiā yí ge diànnǎo péixùn.
examples.en: I'm going to attend a computer course next week.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiēshòu guò shénme péixùn?
examples.en: What kind of training have you had?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng péiyǎng yí ge hǎo xíguàn.
examples.en: I want to build a good habit.

examples.zh: 学校培养了很多优秀的人才。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào péiyǎng le hěn duō yōuxiù de réncái.
examples.en: The school has trained many outstanding talents.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng péiyǎng shénme àihào?
examples.en: What hobby would you like to develop?

examples.zh: 农民培育出了新品种的水果。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín péiyù chū le xīn pǐnzhǒng de shuǐguǒ.
examples.en: The farmers developed a new variety of fruit.

examples.zh: 老师非常注意培育学生的兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī fēicháng zhùyì péiyù xuésheng de xìngqù.
examples.en: The teacher takes great care to nurture students' interests.

examples.zh: 这种花很难培育，需要很多耐心。

examples.en: This flower is hard to grow and needs a lot of patience.

examples.pinyin: Xīn bàngōngshì pèibèi le zuì xīn de diànnǎo.
examples.en: The new office is equipped with the latest computers.

examples.zh: 这辆车配备了安全气囊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē pèibèi le ānquán qìnáng.
examples.en: This car comes equipped with airbags.

examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn pèibèi le zúgòu de yīshēng.

examples.en: Everyone admires her patience.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhème kuài jiù xuéhuì le, zhēn ràng rén pèifú.
examples.en: You picked it up so fast; I really admire you.

examples.en: Everyone should cooperate with each other.

examples.en: He works well alongside the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yīfu hé xiézi bú tài pèihé.
examples.en: Your clothes and shoes don't really go together.

examples.en: His spouse is a doctor.

examples.zh: 申请表上需要填写配偶的姓名。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐngbiǎo shàng xūyào tiánxiě pèi'ǒu de xìngmíng.
examples.en: The application form requires the spouse's name.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé pèi'ǒu yìqǐ qù lǚxíng.
examples.en: My spouse and I travel together.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànshì hé yáokòngqì shì pèitào de.
examples.en: This TV and its remote are a matched set.

examples.en: After buying an apartment, the supporting facilities matter a lot.

examples.en: This basin is surrounded by high mountains.

examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de péndì hěn mēnrè, bú tài shūfu.
examples.en: Basins are stuffy and muggy in summer, which is not very pleasant.

examples.zh: 他很喜欢烹饪，每天都会做不同的菜。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan pēngrèn, měitiān dōu huì zuò bùtóng de cài.
examples.en: He loves cooking and makes a different dish every day.

examples.zh: 烹饪课上，老师教我们怎么炒鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: Pēngrèn kè shàng, lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen zěnme chǎo jīdàn.

examples.pinyin: Tā pěng zhe yí shù xiānhuā zǒu jìn le jiàoshì.
examples.en: She walked into the classroom holding a bunch of fresh flowers.

examples.zh: 别总是捧别人，要有自己的看法。
examples.pinyin: Bié zǒngshì pěng biérén, yào yǒu zìjǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.en: Don't always flatter others; have your own opinions.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zài lùshang pèngjiàn le lǎoshī.
examples.en: I ran into my teacher on the road today.

examples.en: The boss hasn't signed off on this application yet.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèngzài pī zuòyè.
examples.en: The teacher is marking homework right now.

examples.pinyin: Zhè pī huò míngtiān dào.
examples.en: This batch of goods arrives tomorrow.

examples.en: She has a red scarf draped over her shoulders.

examples.en: This piece of wood is too hard to split.

examples.pinyin: Pīfājià bǐ língshòujià piányi hěn duō.
examples.en: The wholesale price is much cheaper than the retail price.

examples.zh: 他在文章里批判了这种浪费行为。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wénzhāng lǐ pīpàn le zhè zhǒng làngfèi xíngwéi.
examples.en: In his article he criticised this kind of wasteful behavior.

examples.zh: 我们应该理性地批判，而不是随便指责。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi lǐxìng de pīpàn, ér bú shì suíbiàn zhǐzé.
examples.en: We should critique calmly rather than blame carelessly.

examples.zh: 老师批判了他的错误，但也鼓励了他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī pīpàn le tā de cuòwù, dàn yě gǔlì le tā.
examples.en: The teacher pointed out his mistake but also encouraged him.

examples.en: Your application hasn't been approved yet.

examples.en: The school approved our trip to the museum.
