examples.en: My room is very small.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de wūzi zài jǐ lóu?
examples.en: Which floor is your room on?

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ wú rén.
examples.en: There is nobody in the room.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐ wúsè wúwèi.
examples.en: This kind of water is colorless and odourless.

examples.pinyin: Wúshù de xīngxing zài tiān shang.
examples.en: Countless stars are in the sky.

examples.pinyin: Māma de ài shì wúbǐ de.
examples.en: A mother's love is beyond compare.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi de wúbǐ.
examples.en: The scenery here is incomparably beautiful.

examples.zh: 能和你们在一起，我感到无比幸福。
examples.pinyin: Néng hé nǐmen zài yìqǐ, wǒ gǎndào wúbǐ xìngfú.
examples.en: Being together with all of you makes me unbelievably happy.

examples.pinyin: Tā wúcháng wèi shèqū fúwù.
examples.en: He serves the community without pay.

examples.zh: 这家医院为贫困家庭提供无偿检查。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn wèi pínkùn jiātíng tígōng wúcháng jiǎnchá.
examples.en: This hospital offers free checkups to poor families.

examples.zh: 献血是无偿的，你愿意吗？
examples.pinyin: Xiànxuè shì wúcháng de, nǐ yuànyì ma?
examples.en: Blood donation is free of charge, are you willing to give?

examples.zh: 他撒谎还不承认，真无耻。
examples.pinyin: Tā sāhuǎng hái bù chéngrèn, zhēn wúchǐ.
examples.en: He lied and wouldn't admit it, how shameless.

examples.zh: 这种无耻的行为让大家很生气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wúchǐ de xíngwéi ràng dàjiā hěn shēngqì.
examples.en: This shameless behavior made everyone angry.

examples.zh: 他竟然偷了朋友的钱，真是无耻。
examples.pinyin: Tā jìngrán tōule péngyou de qián, zhēnshi wúchǐ.
examples.en: He actually stole his friend's money, how shameless.

examples.zh: 这个问题太复杂，我无从下手。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài fùzá, wǒ wúcóng xiàshǒu.
examples.en: This problem is so complicated that I don't know where to start.

examples.zh: 事情发生得太突然，我们无从解释。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing fāshēng de tài tūrán, wǒmen wúcóng jiěshì.
examples.en: Things happened so suddenly that we had no way to explain them.

examples.zh: 我们无从知道他去了哪里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúcóng zhīdào tā qùle nǎlǐ.
examples.en: We have no way of knowing where he went.

examples.zh: 他听完我的话，依然无动于衷。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngwán wǒ de huà, yīrán wúdòngyúzhōng.
examples.en: He remained unmoved after hearing what I said.

examples.zh: 面对别人的困难，她却无动于衷。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì biérén de kùnnan, tā què wúdòngyúzhōng.
examples.en: Faced with other people's troubles, she showed no feeling at all.

examples.zh: 别对这件事无动于衷，我们来想想办法。
examples.pinyin: Bié duì zhè jiàn shì wúdòngyúzhōng, wǒmen lái xiǎngxiang bànfǎ.
examples.en: Don't just sit there unconcerned about this, let's think of a solution.

examples.zh: 他的意思无非是让我们早点走。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yìsi wúfēi shì ràng wǒmen zǎodiǎn zǒu.
examples.en: What he meant was simply that we should leave early.

examples.zh: 无非是迟到几分钟，别生气了。
examples.pinyin: Wúfēi shì chídào jǐ fēnzhōng, bié shēngqì le.
examples.en: It's only a few minutes late, so don't get angry.

examples.zh: 我们吃饭，无非就是为了聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chīfàn, wúfēi jiùshì wèile liáotiān.
examples.en: We eat together mainly just to chat.

examples.zh: 他今天看起来无精打采的。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān kàn qǐlái wújīngdǎcǎi de.
examples.en: He looks listless today.

examples.zh: 这么晚了，大家都无精打采的。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, dàjiā dōu wújīngdǎcǎi de.
examples.en: It's so late and everyone looks worn out.

examples.zh: 睡眠不足，所以我上课时无精打采。
examples.pinyin: Shuìmián bùzú, suǒyǐ wǒ shàngkè shí wújīngdǎcǎi.
examples.en: I didn't sleep enough, so I was listless in class.

examples.zh: 对于这件事，他只回答无可奉告。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhè jiàn shì, tā zhǐ huídá wúkěfènggào.
examples.en: On this matter, he simply said no comment.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì mùqián wúkěfènggào.
examples.en: There is no comment on this matter for now.

examples.zh: 面对记者的追问，经理只说无可奉告。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì jìzhě de zhuīwèn, jīnglǐ zhǐ shuō wúkěfènggào.
examples.en: Faced with the reporters' questions, the manager only said no comment.

examples.zh: 他无可奈何地摇了摇头。
examples.pinyin: Tā wúkěnàihé de yáole yáo tóu.
examples.en: He shook his head helplessly.

examples.zh: 航班取消了，我们只能无可奈何地等待。
examples.pinyin: Hángbān qǔxiāo le, wǒmen zhǐ néng wúkěnàihé de děngdài.
examples.en: The flight was canceled, so we could only wait with no other choice.

examples.zh: 对于这个结果，我们只能无可奈何。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhège jiéguǒ, wǒmen zhǐ néng wúkěnàihé.
examples.en: We had no choice but to accept this result.

examples.zh: 他是个无赖，专门骗人钱财。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì ge wúlài, zhuānmén piàn rén qiáncái.
examples.en: He is a scoundrel who makes a living by cheating people out of money.

examples.pinyin: Bié gēn nà zhǒng wúlài jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.en: Don't try to reason with that kind of scoundrel.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuǎ wúlài, bù kěn fù qián.
examples.en: He is playing dirty and refuses to pay.

examples.pinyin: Háizi è le jiù wúlǐqǔnào.
examples.en: When a child is hungry, they throw a tantrum for no reason.

examples.zh: 你别无理取闹，好好说话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié wúlǐqǔnào, hǎohāo shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't make a fuss for no reason, just speak properly.

examples.zh: 他总是无理取闹，大家都不愿意和他一起工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì wúlǐqǔnào, dàjiā dōu bú yuànyì hé tā yìqǐ gōngzuò.
examples.en: He always makes unreasonable demands, so nobody wants to work with him.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge rén hěn wúliáo.
examples.en: I feel bored being on my own.

examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng hěn wúliáo.
examples.en: This film is really boring.

examples.pinyin: Bié shuō wúliáo de huà.
examples.en: Don't say silly things.

examples.zh: 无论发生什么事，我都支持你。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, wǒ dōu zhīchí nǐ.
examples.en: No matter what happens, I'll support you.

examples.zh: 无论下雨还是下雪，我都去。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn xià yǔ háishi xià xuě, wǒ dōu qù.
examples.en: Whether it rains or snows, I'm going.

examples.zh: 无论你去哪儿，我都跟你去。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn nǐ qù nǎr, wǒ dōu gēn nǐ qù.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll go with you.

examples.pinyin: Tā wúnài de yáo le yáo tóu.
examples.en: He shook his head helplessly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yě wúnài, zhǐhǎo děngzhe.
examples.en: I had no choice, so I just waited.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge wúnài de juédìng.
examples.en: It was a reluctant decision.

examples.zh: 我尽力了，但对这件事实在无能为力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìnlì le, dàn duì zhè jiàn shì shízài wúnéngwéilì.
examples.en: I did my best, but there was really nothing I could do about this.

examples.zh: 看到他生病，我感到无能为力。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tā shēngbìng, wǒ gǎndào wúnéngwéilì.
examples.en: Seeing him ill, I felt powerless to help.

examples.zh: 面对这场灾难，人们常常无能为力。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhè chǎng zāinàn, rénmen chángcháng wúnéngwéilì.
examples.en: Faced with this disaster, people often feel helpless.

examples.pinyin: Yǔzhòu shì wúqióngwújìn de.
examples.en: The universe is endless.

examples.zh: 工作无穷无尽，总是做不完。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò wúqióngwújìn, zǒngshì zuò bù wán.
examples.en: There is an endless amount of work, and it never gets finished.

examples.zh: 我们的问题好像无穷无尽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de wèntí hǎoxiàng wúqióngwújìn.
examples.en: Our problems seem never-ending.

examples.pinyin: Tiānshang yǒu wúshù de xīngxing.
examples.en: There are countless stars in the sky.

examples.zh: 他为这个问题想了无数次。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhège wèntí xiǎng le wúshù cì.
examples.en: He thought about this problem countless times.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu wúshù de lìzi.
examples.en: This book has countless examples.

examples.zh: 妈妈对我无微不至地照顾。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì wǒ wúwēibùzhì de zhàogù.
examples.en: Mom looks after me with the utmost care.

examples.zh: 护士照顾病人无微不至。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi zhàogù bìngrén wúwēibùzhì.
examples.en: The nurse looked after the patients with great attention to detail.

examples.zh: 他的服务无微不至，大家都很满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fúwù wúwēibùzhì, dàjiā dōu hěn mǎnyì.
examples.en: His service was extremely attentive, and everyone was satisfied.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草地上玩得无忧无虑。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng wán de wúyōuwúlǜ.
examples.en: The children played carefree on the grass.

examples.zh: 大学时光是我最无忧无虑的日子。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué shíguāng shì wǒ zuì wúyōuwúlǜ de rìzi.
examples.en: University years were the most carefree days of my life.

examples.zh: 他过着无忧无虑的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā guòzhe wúyōuwúlǜ de shēnghuó.
examples.en: He lived a carefree life.

examples.zh: 无知会让人做出错误的判断。
examples.pinyin: Wúzhī huì ràng rén zuòchū cuòwù de pànduàn.
examples.en: Ignorance leads people to make wrong judgments.

examples.zh: 他对这个领域十分无知。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège lǐngyù shífēn wúzhī.
examples.en: He knows nothing about this field.

examples.zh: 年轻人的无知有时很可爱。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén de wúzhī yǒushí hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: A young person's naivety can be endearing at times.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǔ diǎn xiàbān.
examples.en: I finish work at five o'clock.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le wǔ ge píngguǒ.
examples.en: I bought five apples.

examples.pinyin: Wǔ kuài qián, nǐ yǒu ma?
examples.en: Do you have five yuan?

examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo xuéxí Zhōngguó wǔdǎo.
examples.en: She has been studying Chinese dance since she was little.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan kàn wǔdǎo biǎoyǎn ma?
examples.en: Do you enjoy watching dance performances?

examples.pinyin: Zhège wǔdǎo de jiézòu hěn kuài.
examples.en: The rhythm of this dance is very fast.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen shǒu lǐ méiyǒu wǔqì.
examples.en: They had no weapons in their hands.

examples.pinyin: Wǔqì hěn wēixiǎn, bú yào pèng.
examples.en: Weapons are dangerous; don't touch them.

examples.pinyin: Zhīshi shì zuì hǎo de wǔqì.
examples.en: Knowledge is the best weapon.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào wǔrǔ biéren de réngé.
examples.en: Don't insult other people's dignity.

examples.zh: 他觉得这句话是对他的侮辱。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde zhè jù huà shì duì tā de wǔrǔ.
examples.en: He felt that this remark was an insult to him.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu fǎnduì wǔrǔ biéren.
examples.en: Everyone opposes insulting others.

examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo xué wǔshù.
examples.en: He has studied martial arts since childhood.

examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu rén zài liàn wǔshù.
examples.en: Some people are practising martial arts in the park.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan kàn wǔshù biǎoyǎn ma?
examples.en: Do you like watching martial arts shows?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan kàn wǔxiá xiǎoshuō.
examples.en: I really like reading martial arts novels.

examples.zh: 武侠电影里的动作很精彩。
examples.pinyin: Wǔxiá diànyǐng lǐ de dòngzuò hěn jīngcǎi.
examples.en: The action in martial arts films is thrilling.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù wǔxiá jù hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: This martial arts drama is very popular.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhīshi wǔzhuāngle zìjǐ.
examples.en: He armed himself with knowledge.

examples.zh: 我们要用新技术武装企业。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yòng xīn jìshù wǔzhuāng qǐyè.
examples.en: We want to equip our business with new technology.

examples.zh: 他把自己武装成一个专业的工程师。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ wǔzhuāng chéng yí ge zhuānyè de gōngchéngshī.
examples.en: He equipped himself to become a professional engineer.

examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang yǒu hěn dà de wù.
examples.en: There's thick fog this morning.

examples.pinyin: Wù tài dà le, kàn bu qīng lù.
examples.en: The fog is too thick to see the road.

examples.pinyin: Wù kuài sàn le.
examples.en: The fog is about to clear.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng wù xīyān.
examples.en: No smoking.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng wù dǎrǎo, xièxie.
examples.en: Do not disturb, thank you.

examples.zh: 天气不好，出门勿忘带伞。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì bù hǎo, chūmén wù wàng dài sǎn.
examples.en: The weather is bad, so don't forget your umbrella when you go out.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wùbì zhǔnshí dào.
examples.en: Be sure to arrive on time tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这份文件务必今天交上去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn wùbì jīntiān jiāo shàngqù.
examples.en: This document must be handed in today.

examples.zh: 出门在外，务必注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén zài wài, wùbì zhùyì ānquán.
examples.en: When you're away from home, be sure to stay safe.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yíqì de wùchā hěn xiǎo.
examples.en: This instrument has a very small margin of error.

examples.zh: 测量时难免会有误差吗？
examples.pinyin: Cèliáng shí nánmiǎn huì yǒu wùchā ma?
examples.en: Is there always going to be some error in measurements?

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cèshì méiyǒu wùchā.
examples.en: There was no error in this test.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge wùhuì.
examples.en: This is a misunderstanding.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wùhuì nǐ le.
examples.en: Sorry, I misunderstood you.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào wùhuì tā de yìsi.
examples.en: Don't misread what he means.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wùjiě wǒ de yìsi le.
examples.en: You've misunderstood what I meant.

examples.zh: 别误解，我只是随便问问。
examples.pinyin: Bié wùjiě, wǒ zhǐshì suíbiàn wènwen.
examples.en: Don't get me wrong, I'm just asking casually.

examples.zh: 我们之间的误解已经消除了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhījiān de wùjiě yǐjīng xiāochú le.
examples.en: The misunderstanding between us has been cleared up.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de dìdi xǐhuan wùlǐ.
examples.en: My younger brother likes physics.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yǒu wùlǐ kè.
examples.en: We have physics class today.

examples.pinyin: Wùlǐ lǎoshī hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: The physics teacher is very interesting.

examples.zh: 这家超市的东西物美价廉，我经常来买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de dōngxi wù měi jià lián, wǒ jīngcháng lái mǎi.
examples.en: This supermarket's goods are good value, so I shop here often.

examples.zh: 这种衣服物美价廉，很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yīfu wù měi jià lián, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: This kind of clothing is good quality at a low price, so it's very popular.

examples.zh: 物美价廉的商品不一定是最好的，要看看质量。
examples.pinyin: Wù měi jià lián de shāngpǐn bù yídìng shì zuì hǎo de, yào kànkan zhìliàng.
examples.en: Cheap goods of good quality aren't always the best, so check the quality.

examples.zh: 他做事很务实，不喜欢空谈。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn wùshí, bù xǐhuan kōngtán.
examples.en: He is practical in his work and dislikes empty talk.

examples.zh: 我们要务实，不能只想着理想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wùshí, bù néng zhǐ xiǎngzhe lǐxiǎng.
examples.en: We need to be practical and not just dream about ideals.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hěn wùshí.
examples.en: This plan is very practical.

examples.pinyin: Shuǐ shì yì zhǒng wùzhì.
examples.en: Water is a substance.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wùzhì shì shénme?
examples.en: What is this substance?

examples.pinyin: Tā bú tài zhòngshì wùzhì.
examples.en: He doesn't care much about material things.

examples.zh: 救援队带来了大量的物资。
examples.pinyin: Jiùyuándùi dàilái le dàliàng de wùzī.
examples.en: The rescue team brought in a large amount of supplies.

examples.zh: 学校需要购买一些学习物资。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào xūyào gòumǎi yìxiē xuéxí wùzī.
examples.en: The school needs to buy some study materials.

examples.zh: 这些物资要尽快运到山区去。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wùzī yào jǐnkuài yùn dào shānqū qù.
examples.en: These supplies need to be sent to the mountain area as soon as possible.

examples.pinyin: Tā jiā zài chéngshì xībian.
examples.en: His home is on the west side of the city.

examples.zh: 北京的西边是什么地方？
examples.pinyin: Běijīng de xībian shì shénme dìfang?
examples.en: What's to the west of Beijing?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàng xī zǒu ba.
examples.en: Let's head west.

examples.zh: 山里有一条清澈的小溪。
examples.pinyin: Shān lǐ yǒu yì tiáo qīngchè de xiǎoxī.
examples.en: There is a clear little stream in the mountains.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yánzhe xiǎoxī sànbù.
examples.en: We took a walk along the stream.

examples.zh: 溪边的石头都被水冲得很光滑。
examples.pinyin: Xībiān de shítou dōu bèi shuǐ chōng de hěn guānghuá.
examples.en: The stones by the stream have been worn smooth by the water.

examples.zh: 他跪下来，膝盖碰到了地面。
examples.pinyin: Tā guì xiàlai, xīgài pèngdàole dìmiàn.
examples.en: He knelt down, and his knees touched the ground.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuāidǎo le, xīgài cāpò le.
examples.en: I fell over and grazed my knee.

examples.zh: 他坐久了，膝盖有点儿疼。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò jiǔ le, xīgài yǒudiǎnr téng.
examples.en: He had sat for a long time, and his knee hurt a little.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī xīguā.
examples.en: I like eating watermelon the most.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xīguā hěn dà.
examples.en: This watermelon is very big.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi yí ge xīguā ba.
examples.en: Let's buy a watermelon.

examples.zh: 我喜欢吃西红柿炒鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn.
examples.en: I like stir-fried eggs with tomato.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xīhóngshì hěn tián.
examples.en: This tomato is sweet.

examples.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng le, gōngzuò yòu chū le wèntí, zhēnshi xuě shàng jiā shuāng.
examples.en: He fell ill, and then his work ran into trouble too; it was adding insult to injury.

examples.zh: 下大雨的时候，又刮起了大风，真是雪上加霜。
examples.pinyin: Xià dàyǔ de shíhou, yòu guā qǐ le dàfēng, zhēnshi xuě shàng jiā shuāng.
examples.en: It rained hard and then the wind picked up, making things even worse.

examples.zh: 成绩不好，又生病了，真是雪上加霜。
examples.pinyin: Chéngjì bù hǎo, yòu shēngbìng le, zhēnshi xuě shàng jiā shuāng.
examples.en: His grades were poor, and then he got sick; things just kept piling up.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yào jiǎnchá wǒ de xuè.
examples.en: The doctor wants to test my blood.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào kěyǐ bǔ xuè.
examples.en: This medicine helps build up your blood.

examples.zh: 你的血检查结果出来了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xuè jiǎnchá jiéguǒ chūlái le ma?
examples.en: Are your blood test results out yet?

examples.zh: 医生每次都量我的血压。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng měi cì dōu liáng wǒ de xuèyā.
examples.en: The doctor checks my blood pressure every time.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xuèyā zhèngcháng ma?
examples.en: Is your blood pressure normal?

examples.pinyin: Tā de xuèyā bù gāo.
examples.en: His blood pressure is not high.

examples.zh: 在书香的家庭里长大，孩子会受到熏陶。
examples.pinyin: Zài shūxiāng de jiātíng lǐ zhǎngdà, háizi huì shòudào xūntáo.
examples.en: Growing up in a bookish family, children absorb its influence.

examples.zh: 长期的艺术熏陶让她很有气质。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de yìshù xūntáo ràng tā hěn yǒu qìzhì.
examples.en: Years of artistic influence have given her real grace.

examples.zh: 在音乐的熏陶下，他从小就喜欢弹琴。
examples.pinyin: Zài yīnyuè de xūntáo xià, tā cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuan tán qín.
examples.en: Steeped in music from an early age, he has loved playing the piano since childhood.

examples.zh: 血液在身体里不断循环。
examples.pinyin: Xuèyè zài shēntǐ lǐ búduàn xúnhuán.
examples.en: Blood keeps circulating through the body.

examples.zh: 季节是按照一定的规律循环的。
examples.pinyin: Jìjié shì ànzhào yídìng de guīlǜ xúnhuán de.
examples.en: The seasons cycle according to a fixed pattern.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lùxiàn shì yí ge xúnhuán.
examples.en: This route is a loop.

examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài jiē shàng xúnluó.
examples.en: Police patrol the streets.

examples.zh: 保安每晚都会在小区里巡逻。
examples.pinyin: Bǎo ān měi wǎn dōu huì zài xiǎoqū lǐ xúnluó.
examples.en: The security guard patrols the housing estate every night.

examples.pinyin: Chuánduì zài húmiàn shàng xúnluó.
examples.en: A fleet of boats patrols the lake.

examples.zh: 他在街上寻觅着合适的房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jiē shàng xúnmì zhe héshì de fángzi.
examples.en: He has been searching the streets for a suitable apartment.

examples.zh: 我寻觅了很久，还是没找到那本书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xúnmì le hěn jiǔ, háishi méi zhǎodào nà běn shū.
examples.en: I searched for a long time, but still couldn't find that book.

examples.pinyin: Māo zài yuànzi lǐ xúnmì lǎoshǔ.
examples.en: The cat hunted for mice in the yard.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng fúwùyuán xúnwèn jiàgé.
examples.en: He asked the waiter about the price.

examples.zh: 你有什么问题要询问吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí yào xúnwèn ma?
examples.en: Do you have any questions to ask?

examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu xúnwèn wǒ de yìjiàn.
examples.en: He didn't ask for my opinion.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ yào xún xù jiàn jìn.
examples.en: Learning a foreign language should proceed step by step.

examples.zh: 训练要循序渐进，不能太急。
examples.pinyin: Xùnliàn yào xún xù jiàn jìn, bù néng tài jí.
examples.en: Training should progress gradually, not too hurriedly.

examples.zh: 孩子的阅读能力要循序渐进地提高。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de yuèdú nénglì yào xún xù jiàn jìn de tígāo.
examples.en: A child's reading ability should improve gradually.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xúnzhǎo wǒ de yàoshi.
examples.en: I'm looking for my keys.

examples.zh: 我们正在寻找一个新办公室。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài xúnzhǎo yí ge xīn bàngōngshì.
examples.en: We're looking for a new office.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài xúnzhǎo shénme?
examples.en: What are you looking for?

examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán měi tiān dōu yào xùnliàn.
examples.en: Athletes have to train every day.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xùnliàn hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.en: This training is very tough.

examples.zh: 你们的训练什么时候结束？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen de xùnliàn shénme shíhou jiéshù?
examples.en: When does your training finish?

examples.pinyin: Tā xùnsù pǎochūle fángjiān.
examples.en: He quickly ran out of the room.

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biànhuà de hěn xùnsù.
examples.en: The weather changes very quickly.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng xùnsù zuòwán ma?
examples.en: Can you finish it quickly?

examples.pinyin: Zūfáng shí yào jiāo yì bǐ yājīn.
examples.en: You have to pay a deposit when renting a flat.

examples.zh: 退房的时候，房东退还了押金。
examples.pinyin: Tuìfáng de shíhou, fángdōng tuìhuán le yājīn.
examples.en: When we checked out, the landlord returned the deposit.

examples.zh: 借这辆自行车需要先付押金。
examples.pinyin: Jiè zhè liàng zìxíngchē xūyào xiān fù yājīn.
examples.en: You need to pay a deposit before borrowing this bicycle.

examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò de yālì hěn dà.
examples.en: The pressure at work is huge.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yālì tài dà le.
examples.en: He is under too much pressure.

examples.zh: 不要给自己太大的压力。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào gěi zìjǐ tài dà de yālì.
examples.en: Don't put too much pressure on yourself.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān yǒudiǎn yāpògǎn.
examples.en: This room feels a bit oppressive.

examples.zh: 他的眼神给人很大的压迫。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnshén gěi rén hěn dà de yāpò.
examples.en: His stare puts a lot of pressure on people.

examples.zh: 长时间的工作让我感到压迫。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān de gōngzuò ràng wǒ gǎndào yāpò.
examples.en: Working long hours leaves me feeling under pressure.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，爷爷给了我压岁钱。
examples.pinyin: Guònián de shíhou, yéye gěi le wǒ yāsuìqián.
examples.en: At New Year, Grandpa gave me red-envelope money.

examples.zh: 我把压岁钱存进了银行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yāsuìqián cún jìn le yínháng.
examples.en: I put my New Year money into the bank.

examples.zh: 你的压岁钱打算怎么用？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yāsuìqián dǎsuàn zěnme yòng?
examples.en: What do you plan to spend your New Year money on?

examples.zh: 这个文件太大了，要先压缩一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wénjiàn tài dà le, yào xiān yāsuō yíxià.
examples.en: This file is too big, so compress it first.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yāsuō kāizhī.
examples.en: We need to cut our spending.

examples.zh: 行李太多，需要压缩一下。
examples.pinyin: Xínglǐ tài duō, xūyào yāsuō yíxià.
examples.en: There's too much luggage, so it needs squashing down a bit.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xīnqíng hěn yāyì.
examples.en: He felt very oppressed.

examples.zh: 长期压抑自己的感受，对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī yāyì zìjǐ de gǎnshòu, duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
examples.en: Keeping your feelings bottled up for a long time is bad for your health.

examples.zh: 这个房间很小，让人感觉很压抑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn xiǎo, ràng rén gǎnjué hěn yāyì.
examples.en: This room is so small that it feels oppressive.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù néng yāzhà gōngrén.
examples.en: A boss must not squeeze his workers dry.

examples.zh: 把橙子压榨成果汁很简单。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ chéngzi yāzhà chéng guǒzhī hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: Pressing oranges into juice is easy.

examples.zh: 这些花生可以压榨出油。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē huāshēng kěyǐ yāzhà chū yóu.
examples.en: These peanuts can be pressed for oil.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào yāzhì háizi de xìngqù.
examples.en: Don't stifle a child's interests.

examples.zh: 他把自己的情绪压制了下去。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zìjǐ de qíngxù yāzhì le xiàqu.
examples.en: He suppressed his feelings.

examples.zh: 声音太大，把别人的声音都压制住了。
examples.pinyin: Shēngyīn tài dà, bǎ biérén de shēngyīn dōu yāzhìzhù le.
examples.en: The noise was so loud that it drowned out everyone else's voices.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yágāo yòng wán le.
examples.en: I've run out of toothpaste.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī yágāo hěn piányi.
examples.en: This toothpaste is very cheap.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi yágāo le ma?
examples.en: Did you buy toothpaste?

examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì bǐsài dé le yàjūn.
examples.en: He finished second in this competition.

examples.zh: 她跑得很快，拿到了亚军。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, nádào le yàjūn.
examples.en: She ran very fast and took second place.

examples.zh: 第一名和亚军的差距很小。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī míng hé yàjūn de chājù hěn xiǎo.
examples.en: The gap between first and second place is very small.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó zài Yàzhōu.
examples.en: China is in Asia.

examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu yǒu hěn duō guójiā.
examples.en: There are many countries in Asia.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù guò Yàzhōu ma?
examples.en: Have you been to Asia?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kuài kàn ya!
examples.en: Look quickly!

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhēn hǎo ya!
examples.en: The weather is really nice!

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr ya?
examples.en: Where are you off to?

examples.zh: 春节的晚上，外面到处都是烟花爆竹的声音。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié de wǎnshang, wàimiàn dàochù dōu shì yānhuā bàozhú de shēngyīn.
examples.en: On Spring Festival night, you can hear fireworks and firecrackers everywhere outside.

examples.zh: 很多城市现在都禁止燃放烟花爆竹了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō chéngshì xiànzài dōu jìnzhǐ ránfàng yānhuā bàozhú le.
examples.en: Many cities now ban setting off fireworks and firecrackers.

examples.zh: 你家过年放烟花爆竹吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā guònián fàng yānhuā bàozhú ma?
examples.en: Does your family set off fireworks at New Year?

examples.pinyin: Dàshuǐ yānmò le zhěnggè cūnzi.
examples.en: The floodwater submerged the entire village.

examples.zh: 人群很多，他的声音被淹没在欢呼声里。
examples.pinyin: Rénqún hěn duō, tā de shēngyīn bèi yānmò zài huānhūshēng lǐ.
examples.en: The crowd was huge, and his voice was drowned out by the cheering.

examples.zh: 大雨下个不停，路面都被积水淹没了。
examples.pinyin: Dàyǔ xià ge bù tíng, lùmiàn dōu bèi jīshuǐ yānmò le.
examples.en: The rain kept falling, and the road was covered with standing water.

examples.pinyin: Tāng lǐ xūyào fàng yìdiǎn yán.
examples.en: The soup needs a little salt.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cài yán tài duō le.
examples.en: This dish has too much salt.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yìdiǎn yán.
examples.en: Please pass me some salt.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yáncháng jiàqī.
examples.en: We want to extend the holiday.

examples.zh: 图书馆延长了开放时间。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn yáncháng le kāifàng shíjiān.
examples.en: The library extended its opening hours.

examples.zh: 你能延长会议的时间吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng yáncháng huìyì de shíjiān ma?
examples.en: Can you extend the meeting time?

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng hěn yángé.
examples.en: The teacher is very strict with students.

examples.zh: 这家医院的检查很严格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de jiǎnchá hěn yángé.
examples.en: This hospital's checks are very strict.

examples.zh: 你对自己要严格一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì zìjǐ yào yángé yìdiǎnr.
examples.en: Be a bit stricter with yourself.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù zài yánhǎi de chéngshì.
examples.en: We live in a coastal city.

examples.zh: 沿海地区的海鲜很新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Yánhǎi dìqū de hǎixiān hěn xīnxiān.
examples.en: The seafood in coastal areas is very fresh.

examples.zh: 夏天的时候，很多人去沿海度假。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, hěn duō rén qù yánhǎi dùjià.
examples.en: In summer many people go to the coast for holidays.

examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān de běifāng fēicháng yánhán.
examples.en: Winters in the north are bitterly cold.

examples.zh: 严寒的天气让人不想出门。
examples.pinyin: Yánhán de tiānqì ràng rén bù xiǎng chūmén.
examples.en: The bitter cold makes people not want to go outside.

examples.zh: 我们在严寒中等了很久。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài yánhán zhōng děng le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: We waited in the bitter cold for a long time.

examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yánjìn xīyān.
examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the park.

examples.pinyin: Kǎochǎng shàng yánjìn shǐyòng shǒujī.
examples.en: Using cell phones is strictly forbidden in the exam room.

examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ yánjìn dàshēng xuānhuá.
examples.en: Loud noise is strictly forbidden in the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shì yánjiūshēng.
examples.en: My older sister is a graduate student.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài dú yánjiūshēng.
examples.en: He is doing a postgraduate degree.

examples.pinyin: Yánjiūshēng de xuéxí hěn máng.
examples.en: Graduate students are very busy with their studies.

examples.pinyin: Mùqián de xíngshì fēicháng yánjùn.
examples.en: The current situation is very grave.

examples.zh: 他面对严峻的考试，依然很冷静。
examples.pinyin: Tā miànduì yánjùn de kǎoshì, yīrán hěn lěngjìng.
examples.en: Facing a tough exam, he stayed calm.

examples.zh: 这次的问题很严峻，我们必须马上解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de wèntí hěn yánjùn, wǒmen bìxū mǎshàng jiějué.
examples.en: This problem is serious, and we must solve it right away.

examples.zh: 老师对学生要求很严厉。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng yāoqiú hěn yánlì.
examples.en: The teacher is very strict with the students.

examples.zh: 他的父亲很严厉，但是很爱我。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùqīn hěn yánlì, dànshì hěn ài wǒ.
examples.en: His father is strict, but he loves him very much.

examples.zh: 经理严厉地批评了迟到的员工。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yánlì de pīpíng le chídào de yuángōng.
examples.en: The manager sternly criticised the employee who was late.

examples.zh: 他的言论引起了大家的讨论。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yánlùn yǐnqǐ le dàjiā de tǎolùn.
examples.en: His remarks sparked everyone's discussion.

examples.zh: 你觉得这种言论合适吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè zhǒng yánlùn héshì ma?
examples.en: Do you think this kind of remark is appropriate?

examples.zh: 我们应该尊重不同的言论。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng bùtóng de yánlùn.
examples.en: We should respect different points of view.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hěn yánmì.
examples.en: This plan is very tight.

examples.zh: 公司的安全措施非常严密。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de ānquán cuòshī fēicháng yánmì.
examples.en: The company's security measures are extremely tight.

examples.zh: 我们要做好严密的准备。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zuòhǎo yánmì de zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: We need to make thorough preparations.

examples.pinyin: Huìyì bèi yánqī dào xià zhōu.
examples.en: The meeting has been postponed until next week.

examples.zh: 因为下雨，比赛延期举行。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, bǐsài yánqī jǔxíng.
examples.en: Because of the rain, the match was postponed.

examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn hūnlǐ néng bu néng yánqī?
examples.en: Could the wedding be postponed?

examples.zh: 夏天的中午，天气非常炎热。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de zhōngwǔ, tiānqì fēicháng yánrè.
examples.en: The weather is scorching at midday in summer.

examples.zh: 这里一年四季都很炎热。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yì nián sì jì dōu hěn yánrè.
examples.en: It's hot here all year round.

examples.zh: 炎热的天气让人没有食欲。
examples.pinyin: Yánrè de tiānqì ràng rén méiyǒu shíyù.
examples.en: The sweltering weather takes away your appetite.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?
examples.en: What color do you like?

examples.pinyin: Zhège yánsè hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This color is very pretty.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yánsè nǐ xǐhuan ma?
examples.en: Do you like this color?

examples.zh: 这条路一直延伸到山里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yìzhí yánshēn dào shān lǐ.
examples.en: This road extends all the way into the mountains.

examples.pinyin: Shùgēn xiàng dìxià yánshēn.
examples.en: The roots extend downward into the ground.

examples.zh: 这个话题可以延伸到很多方面。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huàtí kěyǐ yánshēn dào hěn duō fāngmiàn.
examples.en: This topic can branch out into many areas.

examples.zh: 这座山都是坚硬的岩石。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān dōu shì jiānyìng de yánshí.
examples.en: This whole mountain is made of hard rock.

examples.zh: 孩子们坐在岩石上休息。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zuò zài yánshí shàng xiūxi.
examples.en: The children sat on the rocks to rest.

examples.zh: 海边的岩石被海浪打磨得很光滑。
examples.pinyin: Hǎibiān de yánshí bèi hǎilàng dǎmó de hěn guānghuá.
examples.en: The rocks by the sea have been polished smooth by the waves.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de biǎoqíng hěn yánsù.
examples.en: The teacher looks very serious.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí jiàn hěn yánsù de shì.
examples.en: This is a very serious matter.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yánsù.
examples.en: He speaks very seriously.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chuántǒng yào yánxù xiàqù.
examples.en: This tradition must carry on.

examples.zh: 我们希望友谊能够延续下去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xīwàng yǒuyì nénggòu yánxù xiàqù.
examples.en: We hope our friendship will last.

examples.zh: 这种节日习俗一直延续到现在。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiérì xísú yìzhí yánxù dào xiànzài.
examples.en: This festival custom has continued until now.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bìng hěn yánzhòng.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma yíyàng gāo.
examples.en: I'm as tall as Mom.

examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn zài qiánmiàn.
examples.en: The hospital is up ahead.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
examples.en: He works at a hospital.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma qù yīyuàn le.
examples.en: My mom has gone to the hospital.

examples.pinyin: Tā yízài xiàng wǒ dàoqiàn.
examples.en: He apologized to me again and again.

examples.zh: 老师一再提醒我们别忘带书。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yízài tíxǐng wǒmen bié wàng dài shū.
examples.en: The teacher kept reminding us not to forget our books.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme yízài chídào?
examples.en: Why are you late again and again?

examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài xuéxí.
examples.en: He has been studying all along.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yìzhí zǒu jiù dào le.
examples.en: Keep walking straight and you'll get there.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí hěn máng.
examples.en: I've been busy all the time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de yìjiàn hěn yízhì.
examples.en: Our views are unanimous.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de kànfǎ yízhì.
examples.en: Everyone agrees.

examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge shuōfǎ bù yízhì.
examples.en: The two accounts don't match.

examples.zh: 这栋老房子是爷爷留下的遗产。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lǎo fángzi shì yéye liúxià de yíchǎn.
examples.en: This old house is the inheritance my grandfather left behind.

examples.zh: 这座古城是重要的文化遗产。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng shì zhòngyào de wénhuà yíchǎn.
examples.en: This ancient city is an important cultural heritage.

examples.zh: 他把遗产平均分给了三个孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yíchǎn píngjūn fēn gěi le sān ge háizi.
examples.en: He divided the inheritance equally among his three children.

examples.zh: 眼睛的颜色是由遗传决定的吗？
examples.pinyin: Yǎnjing de yánsè shì yóu yíchuán juédìng de ma?
examples.en: Is eye color determined by heredity?

examples.zh: 这种病有家族遗传的倾向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bìng yǒu jiāzú yíchuán de qīngxiàng.
examples.en: This disease tends to run in families.

examples.zh: 他的音乐天赋可能是遗传的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yīnyuè tiānfù kěnéng shì yíchuán de.
examples.en: His musical talent may be inherited.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào yídòng zhège xiāngzi.
examples.en: Please don't move this box.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē zài mànmàn yídòng.
examples.en: This car is slowly moving.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng yídòng zhè zhāng zhuōzi ma?
examples.en: Can you move this table?

examples.zh: 我很遗憾没能来参加你的生日。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn yíhàn méi néng lái cānjiā nǐ de shēngrì.
examples.en: I'm sorry I couldn't come to your birthday.

examples.pinyin: Zhēn yíhàn, wǒmen méi yíng.
examples.en: What a pity, we didn't win.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yíhàn ma?
examples.en: Do you have any regrets?

examples.zh: 我对他的话感到很疑惑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de huà gǎndào hěn yíhuò.
examples.en: I felt very puzzled by what he said.

examples.zh: 看到这个结果，大家都很疑惑。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào zhège jiéguǒ, dàjiā dōu hěn yíhuò.
examples.en: Everyone was puzzled when they saw this result.

examples.zh: 他眼神里带着疑惑，不太相信我。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǎnshén lǐ dàizhe yíhuò, bú tài xiāngxìn wǒ.
examples.en: There was doubt in his eyes; he didn't quite believe me.

examples.zh: 这个问题是历史遗留下来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shì lìshǐ yíliú xiàlái de.
examples.en: This problem is a legacy of history.

examples.zh: 房间里遗留着一股烟味。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yíliú zhe yì gǔ yānwèi.
examples.en: A smell of smoke is lingering in the room.

examples.zh: 这些旧制度遗留了很多问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù zhìdù yíliú le hěn duō wèntí.
examples.en: These old systems left behind many problems.

examples.pinyin: Tā yì jiā rén xiǎng yímín.
examples.en: His family wants to emigrate.

examples.zh: 很多人都移民去了国外。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu yímín qù le guówài.
examples.en: Many people have emigrated abroad.

examples.pinyin: Tā de péngyou shì yímín.
examples.en: His friend is an immigrant.

examples.zh: 医生用仪器检查了他的心脏。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng yíqì jiǎnchá le tā de xīnzàng.
examples.en: The doctor checked his heart with an instrument.

examples.zh: 实验室里有很多先进的仪器。
examples.pinyin: Shíyànshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiānjìn de yíqì.
examples.en: The lab has a lot of advanced equipment.

examples.zh: 这台仪器需要定期检查。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái yíqì xūyào dìngqī jiǎnchá.
examples.en: This machine needs regular checks.

examples.zh: 我的钱包在地铁上遗失了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài dìtiě shàng yíshī le.
examples.en: I lost my wallet on the subway.

examples.zh: 请保管好您的护照，以免遗失。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎoguǎn hǎo nín de hùzhào, yǐmiǎn yíshī.
examples.en: Please keep your passport safe so you don't lose it.

examples.zh: 这份遗失的文件已经找到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn yíshī de wénjiàn yǐjīng zhǎodào le.
examples.en: The missing document has been found.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼的仪式很隆重。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè diǎnlǐ de yíshì hěn lóngzhòng.
examples.en: The graduation ceremony is very grand.

examples.zh: 开学仪式上，校长讲了话。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué yíshì shàng, xiàozhǎng jiǎng le huà.
examples.en: At the opening ceremony, the principal gave a speech.

examples.zh: 我们参加了一个简单的开幕仪式。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen cānjiā le yí ge jiǎndān de kāimù yíshì.
examples.en: We attended a simple opening ceremony.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǒu yí ge yíwèn.
examples.en: I still have one question.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xīnlǐ yǒu yíwèn.
examples.en: I have doubts about this matter.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yíwèn ma?
examples.en: Do you have any questions?

examples.pinyin: Yǐ duì yíng le.
examples.en: Team B won.

examples.pinyin: Jiǎ yǐ liǎng rén dōu lái le.
examples.en: Both A and B came.

examples.pinyin: Dá'àn xuǎn yǐ.
examples.en: Choose B as the answer.

examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒmen zài shuō ba.
examples.en: Let's talk about it later.

examples.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi wǒ bù zhīdao.
examples.en: He thought I didn't know.

examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ méi qù guo Běijīng.
examples.en: I had never been to Beijing before.

examples.zh: 请留下您的电话，以便我们联系您。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng liúxià nín de diànhuà, yǐbiàn wǒmen liánxì nín.
examples.en: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.

examples.zh: 我们早点出发，以便赶上火车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǎo diǎn chūfā, yǐbiàn gǎnshàng huǒchē.
examples.en: Let's leave early so we can catch the train.

examples.zh: 他把书放在桌上，以便随时阅读。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō shàng, yǐbiàn suíshí yuèdú.
examples.en: He put the book on the table so he could read it at any time.

examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu wǒmen chángcháng jiànmiàn.
examples.en: We'll often meet in the future.

examples.zh: 吃完饭以后，我们去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn yǐhòu, wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: After dinner, let's go and see a film.

examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu nǐ yào zǎodiǎnr lái.
examples.en: Come earlier next time.

examples.zh: 我买了苹果、香蕉以及牛奶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo yǐjí niúnǎi.
examples.en: I bought apples, bananas, as well as milk.

examples.zh: 请告诉我你的名字以及电话号码。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de míngzi yǐjí diànhuà hàomǎ.
examples.en: Please tell me your name and phone number.

examples.zh: 学校的老师以及学生都来了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de lǎoshī yǐjí xuésheng dōu lái le.
examples.en: The school's teachers as well as its students all came.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chī le.
examples.en: I've already eaten.

examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng huí jiā le.
examples.en: He's already gone home.

examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shí diǎn le.
examples.en: It's already ten o'clock now.

examples.zh: 我来中国以来，学会了很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó yǐlái, xuéhuì le hěn duō.
examples.en: Since I came to China, I have learned a lot.

examples.zh: 自从毕业以来，他一直在北京工作。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bìyè yǐlái, tā yìzhí zài Běijīng gōngzuò.
examples.en: Since graduating, he has been working in Beijing.

examples.zh: 这些年以来，我们一直是好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián yǐlái, wǒmen yìzhí shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: We have been good friends all these years.

examples.zh: 出门前带好伞，以免淋雨。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián dài hǎo sǎn, yǐmiǎn lín yǔ.
examples.en: Take an umbrella before you leave so you don't get soaked.

examples.zh: 你早点睡，以免明天没精神。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǎo diǎn shuì, yǐmiǎn míngtiān méi jīngshen.
examples.en: Go to bed early so you won't be tired tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Shuōhuà yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn wùhuì.
examples.en: Watch what you say, so there's no misunderstanding.

examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ bù xǐhuan hē kāfēi.
examples.en: I didn't use to like coffee.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐqián lái guo Běijīng ma?
examples.en: Have you ever been to Beijing before?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ yǐqián de fángjiān.
examples.en: This used to be my room.

examples.zh: 以往这个时候，街上人很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zhège shíhou, jiē shàng rén hěn duō.
examples.en: At this time in the past, the street was always crowded.

examples.zh: 他以往很少迟到，今天却迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐwǎng hěn shǎo chídào, jīntiān què chídào le.
examples.en: He rarely used to be late, but today he is late.

examples.zh: 这里和以往相比变化很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hé yǐwǎng xiāngbǐ biànhuà hěn dà.
examples.en: Compared with before, this place has changed a lot.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bù lái le.
examples.en: I thought you weren't coming.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐwéi wǒ shì shéi?
examples.en: Who do you think I am?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān shì xīngqītiān.
examples.en: I thought today was Sunday.

examples.zh: 他学得太认真了，以至忘了吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué de tài rènzhēn le, yǐzhì wàng le chīfàn.
examples.en: He studied so hard that he forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 声音太大，以至我们听不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shēngyīn tài dà, yǐzhì wǒmen tīng bu qīngchu.
examples.en: The noise was so loud that we couldn't hear clearly.

examples.zh: 天气太热了，以至大家都不想出门。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, yǐzhì dàjiā dōu bù xiǎng chūmén.
examples.en: It was so hot that nobody wanted to go out.

examples.zh: 他没有认真复习，以致考试没及格。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu rènzhēn fùxí, yǐzhì kǎoshì méi jígé.
examples.en: He didn't revise properly, so he failed the exam.

examples.zh: 路上堵车，以致我们迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng dǔchē, yǐzhì wǒmen chídào le.
examples.en: The traffic jam made us late.

examples.zh: 他粗心大意，以致犯了很多错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā cūxīn dàyì, yǐzhì fàn le hěn duō cuòwù.
examples.en: He was careless and made many mistakes as a result.

examples.pinyin: Yǐzi zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where's the chair?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
examples.en: Please sit on the chair.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yǐzi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This chair is very good.

examples.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng yǒu jǐshí yì rén.
examples.en: There are billions of people in the world.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shù shì yí yì.
examples.en: This number is one hundred million.

examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngsī zhí yí yì.
examples.en: His company is worth 100 million.

examples.zh: 他是老师，亦是我的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì lǎoshī, yì shì wǒ de péngyou.
examples.en: He is a teacher and also a friend of mine.

examples.zh: 这里风景美丽，人们亦很友好。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ fēngjǐng měilì, rénmen yì hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.en: The scenery here is beautiful, and the people are friendly too.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yì shì yì zhǒng lèqù.
examples.en: Studying is also a kind of pleasure.

examples.pinyin: Fēijī de jīyì hěn cháng.
examples.en: The wings of the plane are very long.

examples.zh: 这架飞机的双翼是红色的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jià fēijī de shuāngyì shì hóngsè de.
examples.en: The wings of this aeroplane are red.

examples.zh: 老鹰张开翅膀，两翼很宽。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoyīng zhāngkāi chìbǎng, liǎng yì hěn kuān.
examples.en: The eagle spread its wings, which are very broad.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de qìwēn yìcháng gāo.
examples.en: Today's temperature is unusually high.

examples.pinyin: Zhège shùjù yǒu yìcháng.
examples.en: This data shows an anomaly.

examples.zh: 他异常安静，好像有心事。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìcháng ānjìng, hǎoxiàng yǒu xīnshì.
examples.en: He was unusually quiet, as if something was on his mind.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme yìjiàn?
examples.en: Do you have any opinions?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tóngyì nǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.en: I don't agree with your opinion.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ tí yí ge yìjiàn.
examples.en: Please give me your feedback.

examples.zh: 学习外语需要很强的毅力。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào hěn qiáng de yìlì.
examples.en: Learning a foreign language takes great perseverance.

examples.zh: 他靠着毅力坚持了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàozhe yìlì jiānchíle xiàlái.
examples.en: He kept going through sheer willpower.

examples.zh: 跑完马拉松需要超强的毅力。
examples.pinyin: Pǎowán mǎlāsōng xūyào chāoqiáng de yìlì.
examples.en: Finishing a marathon takes extraordinary willpower.

examples.zh: 这个结果大大出乎我的意料。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ dàdà chūhū wǒ de yìliào.
examples.en: This result was far beyond what I expected.

examples.zh: 他的成功完全在我意料之中。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chénggōng wánquán zài wǒ yìliào zhī zhōng.
examples.en: His success was entirely within my expectations.

examples.zh: 意料不到的事情经常发生。
examples.pinyin: Yìliào bú dào de shìqing jīngcháng fāshēng.
examples.en: Unexpected things happen often.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài yìlùn zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Everyone is talking about this matter.

examples.pinyin: Bié zài bèihòu yìlùn biéren.
examples.en: Don't gossip about other people behind their backs.

examples.zh: 他们议论了很久，还是没有结果。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yìlùnle hěn jiǔ, háishi méiyǒu jiéguǒ.
examples.en: They discussed it for a long time, but still reached no outcome.

examples.zh: 她毅然决定辞职去留学。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìrán juédìng cízhí qù liúxué.
examples.en: She resolutely decided to resign and go abroad to study.

examples.zh: 他毅然放弃了舒适的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìrán fàngqìle shūshì de gōngzuò.
examples.en: He resolutely gave up his comfortable job.

examples.zh: 面对困难，我们要毅然前进。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, wǒmen yào yìrán qiánjìn.
examples.en: Faced with difficulties, we should press on resolutely.

examples.zh: 他没有安全意识，常常忘记锁门。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu ānquán yìshí, chángcháng wàngjì suǒ mén.
examples.en: He has no sense of safety and often forgets to lock the door.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào tígāo huánbǎo yìshí.
examples.en: We need to raise our environmental awareness.

examples.zh: 他意识到自己说错了话。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìshídào zìjǐ shuō cuò le huà.
examples.en: He realized he had said the wrong thing.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan yìshù.
examples.en: He loves art.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué xuéxí yìshù.
examples.en: She studies art at university.

examples.zh: 这是一种很特别的艺术。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhǒng hěn tèbié de yìshù.
examples.en: This is a very unusual kind of art.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yìsi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This idea sounds good.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yìsi shì shénme?
examples.en: What do you mean?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu bié de yìsi.
examples.en: I didn't mean anything else.

examples.zh: 他的意图我们都看出来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yìtú wǒmen dōu kàn chūlái le.
examples.en: We all saw through his intention.

examples.zh: 你这样做的意图是什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò de yìtú shì shénme?
examples.en: What is your intention in doing this?

examples.zh: 他并没有伤害别人的意图。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng méiyǒu shānghài biérén de yìtú.
examples.en: He had no intention of hurting anyone.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎndào hěn yìwài.
examples.en: I'm very surprised.

examples.zh: 这次考试的结果很意外。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de jiéguǒ hěn yìwài.
examples.en: The exam result was quite unexpected.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yùdào yìwài le ma?
examples.en: Did you run into any trouble?

examples.zh: 下雨意味着今天不能去爬山了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ yìwèizhe jīntiān bù néng qù páshān le.
examples.en: Rain means we can't go hiking today.

examples.zh: 这个笑容意味着他已经原谅你了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàoróng yìwèizhe tā yǐjīng yuánliàng nǐ le.
examples.en: This smile means he has already forgiven you.

examples.zh: 努力不一定意味着马上成功。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì bù yídìng yìwèizhe mǎshàng chénggōng.
examples.en: Hard work doesn't necessarily mean instant success.

examples.zh: 我们有帮助别人的义务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu bāngzhù biérén de yìwù.
examples.en: We have a duty to help others.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīyuàn zuò yìwù gōngzuò.
examples.en: He does volunteer work at the hospital.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de yìwù.
examples.en: It's my duty.

examples.zh: 对方已经表示出合作的意向。
examples.pinyin: Duìfāng yǐjīng biǎoshì chū hézuò de yìxiàng.

examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn zài yòubian.
examples.en: The shop is on the right.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shū zài zhuōzi yòubian.
examples.en: My book is on the right side of the table.

examples.pinyin: Yòubian de yǐzi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The chair on the right is good.

examples.zh: 我的女儿在幼儿园学画画。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ'ér zài yòu'éryuán xué huà huà.
examples.en: My daughter is learning to paint at kindergarten.

examples.pinyin: Yòu'éryuán de lǎoshī hěn wēnróu.
examples.en: The kindergarten teachers are very gentle.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ suì shàng de yòu'éryuán?
examples.en: How old were you when you started kindergarten?

examples.zh: 这个工作的薪水很有诱惑力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò de xīnshuǐ hěn yǒu yòuhuòlì.
examples.en: The pay for this job is very tempting.

examples.pinyin: Tiándiǎn de xiāngwèi hěn yòuhuò rén.
examples.en: The smell of the dessert is very tempting.

examples.zh: 你不会被这些诱惑打动吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú huì bèi zhèxiē yòuhuò dǎdòng ba?
examples.en: You won't be swayed by these temptations, will you?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ yǒudiǎn yòuzhì.
examples.en: Your idea is a bit naive.

examples.zh: 他的行为很幼稚，大家都笑他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi hěn yòuzhì, dàjiā dōu xiào tā.
examples.en: His behavior was childish, and everyone laughed at him.

examples.pinyin: Bié zhème yòuzhì, hǎohǎo shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't be so childish; talk properly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chī yú.
examples.en: I like eating fish.

examples.pinyin: Zhè yú hěn dà.
examples.en: This fish is very big.

examples.pinyin: Yú hé ròu, nǐ yào nǎ ge?
examples.en: Fish or meat, which would you like?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge yúchǔn de juédìng.
examples.en: That was a foolish decision.

examples.zh: 我真愚蠢，竟然忘了带钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēn yúchǔn, jìngrán wàng le dài yàoshi.
examples.en: I'm so silly; I actually forgot my keys.

examples.zh: 不要因为一点小错就说自己愚蠢。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào yīnwèi yìdiǎn xiǎo cuò jiù shuō zìjǐ yúchǔn.
examples.en: Don't call yourself stupid over one small mistake.

examples.pinyin: Zhù nǐ lǚxíng yúkuài.
examples.en: I hope you have a pleasant trip.

examples.zh: 我们过了一个愉快的周末。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen guò le yí ge yúkuài de zhōumò.
examples.en: We had a happy weekend.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zài yìqǐ hěn yúkuài.
examples.en: Everyone has a good time together.

examples.zh: 周末我们去公园娱乐一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù gōngyuán yúlè yíxià.
examples.en: On the weekend we go to the park to relax.

examples.zh: 看电影是一种很好的娱乐。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de yúlè.
examples.en: Watching movies is a good form of entertainment.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ píngshí yǒu shénme yúlè?
examples.en: What do you usually do for fun?

examples.zh: 这部电影引起了很大的舆论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yǐnqǐle hěn dà de yúlùn.
examples.en: This film sparked a lot of public discussion.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zàiyì biérén de yúlùn.
examples.en: He cares a lot about what other people say.

examples.zh: 网络舆论有时候很难控制。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngluò yúlùn yǒushí hěn nán kòngzhì.
examples.en: Online public opinion is sometimes hard to control.

examples.zh: 我们不能再愚昧下去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zài yúmèi xiàqù le.
examples.en: We can't stay ignorant any longer.

examples.zh: 他的想法很愚昧，应该多读些书。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn yúmèi, yīnggāi duō dú xiē shū.
examples.en: His ideas are very backward; he should read more books.

examples.zh: 这种落后的做法真是愚昧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng luòhòu de zuòfǎ zhēnshi yúmèi.
examples.en: Such backward practices are truly ignorant.

examples.zh: 渔民每天很早就出海了。
examples.pinyin: Yúmín měitiān hěn zǎo jiù chūhǎi le.
examples.en: Fishermen set out to sea very early every day.

examples.zh: 这个小村子里住着很多渔民。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo cūnzi lǐ zhùzhe hěn duō yúmín.
examples.en: Many fishermen live in this small village.

examples.zh: 渔民们把刚捕到的鱼拿到市场上卖。
examples.pinyin: Yúmínmen bǎ gāng bǔdào de yú nádào shìchǎng shàng mài.
examples.en: The fishermen take their fresh catch to the market to sell.

examples.zh: 我等了一会儿，于是走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le yíhuìr, yúshì zǒu le.
examples.en: I waited a while, so I left.

examples.zh: 天下雨了，于是我们回家了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān xià yǔ le, yúshì wǒmen huí jiā le.
examples.en: It started raining, so we went home.

examples.zh: 他听了我的话，于是同意了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīng le wǒ de huà, yúshì tóngyì le.
examples.en: He listened to me, and as a result he agreed.

examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng yǔ xuéxí tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.en: Health and study are equally important.

examples.zh: 我们与老师一起讨论问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǔ lǎoshī yìqǐ tǎolùn wèntí.
examples.en: We discuss problems together with the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ tā shì lǎo péngyou.
examples.en: He and I are old friends.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jùzi de yǔfǎ bú duì.
examples.en: The grammar of this sentence is wrong.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Hànyǔ yǔfǎ bù nán.
examples.en: I don't think Chinese grammar is hard.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xué yǔfǎ le ma?
examples.en: Have you studied grammar?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù dǎ yǔmáoqiú ba.
examples.en: Let's go play badminton.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yǔmáoqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: He's very good at badminton.

examples.zh: 周末你和我一起打羽毛球好吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò nǐ hé wǒ yìqǐ dǎ yǔmáoqiú hǎo ma?
examples.en: Would you like to play badminton with me this weekend?

examples.zh: 与其在家睡觉，不如出去走走。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí zài jiā shuìjiào, bùrú chūqù zǒuzou.
examples.en: Rather than sleeping at home, you'd be better off going out for a walk.

examples.zh: 与其等他，不如我们自己去。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí děng tā, bùrú wǒmen zìjǐ qù.
examples.en: Rather than wait for him, we'd better go ourselves.

examples.zh: 与其说他聪明，不如说他很努力。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqí shuō tā cōngming, bùrú shuō tā hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: Rather than calling him clever, I'd say he works hard.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de yǔqì hěn shēngqì.
examples.en: He sounded very angry when he spoke.

examples.zh: 你的语气能不能好一点？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yǔqì néng bu néng hǎo yìdiǎn?
examples.en: Could you be a bit nicer in your tone?

examples.zh: 听他的语气，好像不高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tīng tā de yǔqì, hǎoxiàng bù gāoxìng.
examples.en: Judging by his tone, he doesn't seem happy.

examples.pinyin: Chéngshì de rénkǒu yǔ rì jù zēng.
examples.en: The city's population keeps growing day by day.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zìxìnxīn yǔ rì jù zēng.
examples.en: His self-confidence grows day by day.

examples.zh: 汉语学习的兴趣与日俱增。
examples.pinyin: Hànyǔ xuéxí de xìngqù yǔ rì jù zēng.
examples.en: My interest in learning Chinese keeps growing.

examples.zh: 冬天我一定要穿羽绒服。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ yídìng yào chuān yǔróngfú.
examples.en: In winter I always wear a down jacket.

examples.zh: 这件羽绒服又轻又暖和。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yǔróngfú yòu qīng yòu nuǎnhuo.
examples.en: This down jacket is light and warm.

examples.zh: 外面很冷，你多穿一件羽绒服吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn lěng, nǐ duō chuān yí jiàn yǔróngfú ba.
examples.en: It's cold outside, so put on another down jacket.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
examples.en: How many languages can you speak?

examples.pinyin: Yǔyán shì jiāoliú de gōngjù.
examples.en: Language is a tool for communication.

examples.zh: 学习一门新语言很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yì mén xīn yǔyán hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: Learning a new language is very interesting.

examples.zh: 公司对表现好的员工予以奖励。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī duì biǎoxiàn hǎo de yuángōng yǔyǐ jiǎnglì.
examples.en: The company rewards staff who perform well.

examples.zh: 对这个问题，我们会予以认真考虑。
examples.pinyin: Duì zhège wèntí, wǒmen huì yǔyǐ rènzhēn kǎolǜ.
examples.en: We will give this question serious thought.

examples.zh: 如果有错误，学校将予以纠正。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu cuòwù, xuéxiào jiāng yǔyǐ jiūzhèng.
examples.en: If there are mistakes, the school will correct them.

examples.pinyin: Yǔzhòu hěn dà.
examples.en: The universe is very vast.

examples.pinyin: Yǔzhòu lǐ yǒu hěn duō xīngxing.
examples.en: There are many stars in the universe.

examples.zh: 你相信宇宙里有别的生命吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiāngxìn yǔzhòu lǐ yǒu bié de shēngmìng ma?
examples.en: Do you believe there is other life in the universe?

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yù lái yù lěng le.
examples.en: The weather keeps getting colder.

examples.pinyin: Tā de bìng zhōngyú yù le.
examples.en: His illness has finally healed.

examples.zh: 这个问题我愈想愈不明白。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒ yù xiǎng yù bù míngbai.
examples.en: The more I think about this problem, the less I understand it.

examples.zh: 听了他的解释，我心里终于熨帖了。
examples.pinyin: Tīng le tā de jiěshì, wǒ xīnlǐ zhōngyú yùtiē le.
examples.en: After hearing his explanation, I finally felt at ease.

examples.zh: 妈妈的话很熨帖，让人听了心里很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Māma de huà hěn yùtiē, ràng rén tīng le xīnlǐ hěn shūfu.
examples.en: Mom's words are so soothing that they feel good to hear.

examples.zh: 这件衣服穿在身上很熨帖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu chuān zài shēnshang hěn yùtiē.
examples.en: This piece of clothing fits smoothly and feels comfortable.

examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān huì xiàyǔ.
examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

examples.zh: 你看过今天的天气预报吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kànguo jīntiān de tiānqì yùbào ma?
examples.en: Have you seen today's weather forecast?

examples.pinyin: Yùbào shuō zhōumò hěn lěng.
examples.en: The forecast says it will be cold on the weekend.

examples.zh: 我今天在路上遇到了老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zài lùshang yùdào le lǎo péngyou.
examples.en: I ran into an old friend on the way today.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài lùshang yùdào shéi le?
examples.en: Who did you run into on the way?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu yùdào tā.
examples.en: I didn't run into him.

examples.zh: 我已经预订了一张机票。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng yùdìngle yì zhāng jīpiào.
examples.en: I've already booked a plane ticket.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yùdìng liǎng ge fángjiān.
examples.en: I'd like to book two rooms.

examples.pinyin: Cāntīng xūyào tíqián yùdìng ma?
examples.en: Does the restaurant need advance booking?

examples.pinyin: Duō xǐshǒu kěyǐ yùfáng gǎnmào.
examples.en: Washing your hands often helps prevent colds.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yùfáng wèntí.
examples.en: We need to prevent problems before they happen.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu yùfáng de bànfǎ?
examples.en: Do you have any way of preventing it?

examples.zh: 这个结果在我的预料之中。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ zài wǒ de yùliào zhī zhōng.
examples.en: This result was within what I expected.

examples.zh: 没有人预料到会下这么大的雨。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén yùliào dào huì xià zhème dà de yǔ.
examples.en: No one expected it to rain this hard.

examples.zh: 比赛的结果出乎大家的预料。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài de jiéguǒ chūhū dàjiā de yùliào.
examples.en: The result of the match surprised everyone.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī kǎo yùmǐ.
examples.en: I like grilled corn the most.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dì zhòng le yùmǐ.
examples.en: This field has corn planted in it.

examples.zh: 玉米可以做成很多好吃的东西。
examples.pinyin: Yùmǐ kěyǐ zuò chéng hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi.
examples.en: Corn can be made into many tasty things.

examples.zh: 这个项目的完成时间比预期早。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de wánchéng shíjiān bǐ yùqī zǎo.
examples.en: The project will be finished earlier than expected.

examples.pinyin: Yíqiè dōu zài yùqī zhī zhōng.
examples.en: Everything is going as expected.

examples.zh: 我们预期这个产品会很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yùqī zhège chǎnpǐn huì hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: We expect this product to be very popular.

examples.zh: 我们班的选手通过了预赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān de xuǎnshǒu tōngguò le yùsài.
examples.en: Our class's contestant passed the preliminary round.

examples.pinyin: Yùsài zài xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.en: The preliminary round begins at two in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 他在预赛中跑出了好成绩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yùsài zhōng pǎo chū le hǎo chéngjì.
examples.en: He ran a good time in the preliminary race.

examples.zh: 这次旅行的预算是三千元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng de yùsuàn shì sān qiān yuán.
examples.en: The budget for this trip is three thousand yuan.

examples.zh: 我们要控制开支，不能超过预算。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào kòngzhì kāizhī, bù néng chāoguò yùsuàn.
examples.en: We need to control spending and not exceed the budget.

examples.zh: 公司每年都会做新的预算。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu huì zuò xīn de yùsuàn.
examples.en: The company makes a new budget every year.

examples.zh: 年轻人对成功有强烈的欲望。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén duì chénggōng yǒu qiángliè de yùwàng.
examples.en: Young people have a strong desire for success.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yùwàng yuèláiyuè dà.
examples.en: His desires keep growing.

examples.zh: 饿的时候，人会有吃东西的欲望。
examples.pinyin: È de shíhou, rén huì yǒu chī dōngxi de yùwàng.
examples.en: When you are hungry, you naturally want to eat.

examples.pinyin: Shàngkè qián yào yùxí.
examples.en: Preview the lesson before class.

examples.zh: 我每天晚上都预习第二天的课。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang dōu yùxí dì èr tiān de kè.
examples.en: Every evening I prepare the next day's lessons.

examples.zh: 你预习了今天的生词吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yùxí le jīntiān de shēngcí ma?
examples.en: Did you preview today's new words?

examples.zh: 请预先告诉我，我好做准备。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng yùxiān gàosu wǒ, wǒ hǎo zuò zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: Please tell me in advance so I can get ready.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yùxiān dìng hǎo le fángjiān.
examples.en: We reserved the room in advance.

examples.zh: 出发前要预先检查一下行李。
examples.pinyin: Chūfā qián yào yùxiān jiǎnchá yíxià xíngli.
examples.en: Check your luggage beforehand, before you set off.

examples.zh: 他预言这家公司会成功。
examples.pinyin: Tā yùyán zhè jiā gōngsī huì chénggōng.
examples.en: He predicted that this company would succeed.

examples.zh: 这个老故事里有很多预言。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǎo gùshi lǐ yǒu hěn duō yùyán.
examples.en: This old story contains many prophecies.

examples.zh: 天气预报的预言不一定都准。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yùbào de yùyán bú yídìng dōu zhǔn.
examples.en: Predictions in weather reports aren't always accurate.

examples.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个寓言。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen jiǎng le yí ge yùyán.
examples.en: The teacher told us a fable.

examples.zh: 这个寓言告诉我们要踏实做事。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yùyán gàosu wǒmen yào tāshi zuò shì.
examples.en: This fable teaches us to work steadily.

examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi shì yì zé yùyán.
examples.en: This story is a fable.

examples.zh: 乌云密布，好像是下雨的预兆。
examples.pinyin: Wūyún mìbù, hǎoxiàng shì xià yǔ de yùzhào.
examples.en: Dark clouds gathered, a sign that it might rain.

examples.zh: 这些奇怪的现象是不好的预兆。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē qíguài de xiànxiàng shì bù hǎo de yùzhào.
examples.en: These strange phenomena are bad omens.

examples.zh: 他觉得今天的好运是个好预兆。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde jīntiān de hǎoyùn shì ge hǎo yùzhào.
examples.en: He takes today's good luck as a good omen.

examples.zh: 他没做坏事，却被冤枉了。
examples.pinyin: Tā méi zuò huàishì, què bèi yuānwang le.
examples.en: He hadn't done anything wrong, but he was wrongly accused.

examples.zh: 花这么多钱买这个，太冤枉了。
examples.pinyin: Huā zhème duō qián mǎi zhège, tài yuānwang le.
examples.en: Spending so much money on this is such a waste.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié yuānwang hǎorén.
examples.en: Don't wrongly accuse innocent people.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuōzi shì yuán de.
examples.en: This table is round.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de yuè hěn yuán.
examples.en: The moon is very full tonight.

examples.pinyin: Yí ge yuányuán de píngguǒ.
examples.en: A round apple.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi shí yuán.
examples.en: This item costs ten yuan.

examples.pinyin: Yuándàn shì yì nián de dì yī tiān.
examples.en: New Year's Day is the first day of the year.

examples.pinyin: Yuándàn wǒmen fàngjià.
examples.en: We're off work on New Year's Day.

examples.pinyin: Yuándàn wǒmen fàngjià yì tiān.
examples.en: We have a day off for New Year's Day.

examples.zh: 元旦那天，我们一起吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn.
examples.en: On New Year's Day, we ate together.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ Yuándàn dǎsuan zuò shénme?
examples.en: What are you planning to do on New Year's Day?

examples.pinyin: Yuángào zài fǎtíng shàng fā le yán.
examples.en: The plaintiff spoke in court.

examples.pinyin: Yuángào de lǜshī hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
examples.en: The plaintiff's lawyer is very experienced.

examples.zh: 这个案子的原告是一位老人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ànzi de yuángào shì yí wèi lǎorén.
examples.en: The plaintiff in this case is an elderly man.

examples.pinyin: Tā méi lái shì shénme yuángù?
examples.en: What was the reason he didn't come?
