examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.en: I study Chinese at school.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù zàihu biéren zěnme shuō.
examples.en: He doesn't care what other people say.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái zàihu tā ma?
examples.en: Do you still care about him?

examples.pinyin: Qián duō qián shǎo, wǒ bú tài zàihu.
examples.en: Whether it's a lot or a little money, I don't mind much.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān jiàn, zàijiàn!
examples.en: See you tomorrow, goodbye!

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, zàijiàn.
examples.en: Goodbye, teacher.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ zàijiàn ba.
examples.en: See you this afternoon, OK?

examples.zh: 比赛输了也没关系，我们再接再厉！
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài shū le yě méi guānxi, wǒmen zài jiē zài lì!
examples.en: It's fine that we lost the game; let's keep pushing harder!

examples.zh: 你已经很努力了，要再接再厉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng hěn nǔlì le, yào zài jiē zài lì.
examples.en: You have already worked hard; keep going.

examples.zh: 他考试没考好，决定再接再厉。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, juédìng zài jiē zài lì.
examples.en: He didn't do well on the test, so he resolved to try even harder.

examples.zh: 我再三劝他，他还是不听。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zàisān quàn tā, tā háishi bù tīng.
examples.en: I urged him again and again, but he still wouldn't listen.

examples.zh: 老师再三提醒我们要小心。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zàisān tíxǐng wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: The teacher reminded us again and again to be careful.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ zàisān de bāngzhù.
examples.en: Thank you for helping me again and again.

examples.zh: 他根本不在意这些小事。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēnběn bú zàiyì zhèxiē xiǎo shì.
examples.en: He simply doesn't care about these small things.

examples.zh: 你为什么这么在意别人的看法？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zhème zàiyì biéren de kànfǎ?
examples.en: Why do you care so much about what others think?

examples.zh: 别在意，他只是开个玩笑。
examples.pinyin: Bié zàiyì, tā zhǐshì kāi ge wánxiào.
examples.en: Don't mind it; he was only joking.

examples.pinyin: Zánmen yìqǐ qù chī fàn ba.
examples.en: Let's go and eat together.

examples.pinyin: Zánmen míngtiān jiàn.
examples.en: See you tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Zánmen shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: We're good friends.

examples.zh: 他每个月都攒一点钱，准备买车。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè dōu zǎn yì diǎn qián, zhǔnbèi mǎi chē.
examples.en: He saves a little money every month to buy a car.

examples.zh: 奶奶攒了很多旧报纸，说以后有用。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zǎn le hěn duō jiù bàozhǐ, shuō yǐhòu yǒuyòng.
examples.en: Grandma has been hoarding old newspapers, saying they'll come in handy one day.

examples.zh: 她攒够了钱，终于买到了那台相机。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǎn gòu le qián, zhōngyú mǎi dào le nà tái xiàngjī.
examples.en: She saved up enough money and finally bought that camera.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zànchéng nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: I agree with your idea.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zànchéng zhège jìhuà.
examples.en: Everyone agrees with this plan.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zànchéng háishi fǎnduì?
examples.en: Do you agree or disagree?

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zànměile tā de zuòwén.
examples.en: The teacher praised her essay.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zànměi tā de hǎoxīn.
examples.en: Everyone praises his kind heart.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zǒngshì zànměi zìjǐ.
examples.en: Don't keep praising yourself.

examples.zh: 这件事暂且不谈，明天再说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zànqiě bù tán, míngtiān zài shuō.
examples.en: Let's not discuss this for now, we can talk tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zànqiě xiāngxìn wǒ ba.
examples.en: For now, just trust me.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zànqiě gē yi gē.
examples.en: Let's set this question aside for the time being.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zànshí bù xiǎng mǎi.
examples.en: I don't want to buy it for the time being.

examples.pinyin: Tā zànshí zhù zài péngyou jiā.
examples.en: He is staying at a friend's place for now.

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zànshí bù jiějué.
examples.en: We won't solve this problem for the time being.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zàntàn tā de huàzuò.
examples.en: Everyone admired his paintings.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zàntàn zhè zuò qiáo?
examples.en: Why do you admire this bridge?

examples.zh: 我们没有赞叹，只是默默地看着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen méiyǒu zàntàn, zhǐshì mòmò de kànzhe.
examples.en: We didn't marvel aloud; we just watched in silence.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ wánquán zàntóng nǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.en: I completely agree with your view.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zàntóng zhège fāng'àn ma?
examples.en: Do you agree with this plan?

examples.zh: 大家都不赞同这种做法。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bú zàntóng zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.en: Nobody agrees with this approach.

examples.zh: 老板赞扬了他的工作态度。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zànyáng le tā de gōngzuò tàidu.
examples.en: The boss praised his work attitude.

examples.zh: 你为什么没有受到赞扬？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme méiyǒu shòudào zànyáng?
examples.en: Why didn't you get any praise?

examples.zh: 不要只会批评，也要多赞扬别人。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào zhǐ huì pīpíng, yě yào duō zànyáng biérén.
examples.en: Don't just criticize; praise others too.

examples.zh: 这家公司赞助了我们的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zànzhù le wǒmen de bǐsài.
examples.en: This company sponsored our competition.

examples.zh: 你愿意赞助这次活动吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì zànzhù zhè cì huódòng ma?
examples.en: Would you be willing to sponsor this event?

examples.zh: 没有人赞助，活动只能取消。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zànzhù, huódòng zhǐ néng qǔxiāo.
examples.en: With no sponsors, the event had to be canceled.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒu hěn zāng.
examples.en: My hands are dirty.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu zāng le.
examples.en: This shirt is dirty.

examples.pinyin: Bié bǎ dì nòng zāng le.
examples.en: Don't get the floor dirty.

examples.pinyin: Zāogāo, wǒ wàng le dài sǎn!
examples.en: Oh no, I forgot my umbrella!

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn zāogāo.
examples.en: The weather today is terrible.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing biàn de zāogāo le.
examples.en: This matter has gotten bad.

examples.zh: 这个地区遭受了严重的干旱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū zāoshòu le yánzhòng de gānhàn.
examples.en: This area suffered a severe drought.

examples.pinyin: Tā zāoshòu le hěn dà de sǔnshī.
examples.en: He took a huge loss.

examples.zh: 这次台风让农民遭受了损失。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng ràng nóngmín zāoshòu le sǔnshī.
examples.en: This typhoon left farmers with heavy losses.

examples.zh: 别糟蹋粮食，吃多少拿多少。
examples.pinyin: Bié zāotà liángshi, chī duōshao ná duōshao.
examples.en: Don't waste food; take only as much as you'll eat.

examples.zh: 他把这么好的机会糟蹋了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhème hǎo de jīhuì zāotà le.
examples.en: He threw away such a good opportunity.

examples.zh: 这些书都被糟蹋得不成样子了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū dōu bèi zāotà de bù chéng yàngzi le.
examples.en: These books have been ruined beyond recognition.

examples.zh: 下大雨的时候，庄稼容易遭殃。
examples.pinyin: Xià dàyǔ de shíhou, zhuāngjia róngyì zāoyāng.
examples.en: When heavy rain falls, crops are easily damaged.

examples.zh: 这个小镇因为洪水遭殃了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo zhèn yīnwèi hóngshuǐ zāoyāng le.
examples.en: This small town suffered from the flood.

examples.zh: 别让我的花因为缺水而遭殃。
examples.pinyin: Bié ràng wǒ de huā yīnwèi quē shuǐ ér zāoyāng.
examples.en: Don't let my flowers suffer from lack of water.

examples.zh: 他在路上遭遇了一场大雨。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài lùshang zāoyù le yì chǎng dàyǔ.
examples.en: He ran into a heavy rain on the way.

examples.zh: 这次旅行遭遇了很多困难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng zāoyù le hěn duō kùnnan.
examples.en: This trip ran into many difficulties.

examples.zh: 她的遭遇让大家很同情。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zāoyù ràng dàjiā hěn tóngqíng.
examples.en: Everyone sympathized with what she went through.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang hē chá.
examples.en: I drink tea in the morning.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, zǎoshang hǎo!
examples.en: Good morning, teacher!

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang xià yǔ le.
examples.en: It rained this morning.

examples.pinyin: Dàyǔ zàochéngle hěn duō máfan.
examples.en: The heavy rain caused a lot of trouble.

examples.zh: 这件事造成了很大的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zàochéngle hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.en: This matter had a big impact.

examples.zh: 你说的话会造成什么结果？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de huà huì zàochéng shénme jiéguǒ?
examples.en: What results could your words cause?

examples.zh: 这群孩子在教室里造反，不肯听老师的话。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qún háizi zài jiàoshì lǐ zàofǎn, bù kěn tīng lǎoshī de huà.
examples.en: These kids rebelled in the classroom and refused to listen to the teacher.

examples.zh: 他的身体好像在造反，今天不太舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ hǎoxiàng zài zàofǎn, jīntiān bú tài shūfu.
examples.en: His body seems to be rebelling; he doesn't feel well today.

examples.pinyin: Bié gēn wǒ zàofǎn, kuài qù shuìjiào!
examples.en: Don't rebel against me, go to bed!

examples.zh: 这个杯子的造型很特别。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēizi de zàoxíng hěn tèbié.
examples.en: This cup has a very unusual shape.

examples.zh: 这家店的服装造型很时髦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de fúzhuāng zàoxíng hěn shímáo.
examples.en: The clothing designs in this shop are very trendy.

examples.zh: 设计师正在做汽车的造型。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī zhèngzài zuò qìchē de zàoxíng.
examples.en: The designer is working on the car's shape.

examples.zh: 楼下的噪音太大了，我睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Lóuxià de zàoyīn tài dà le, wǒ shuì bu zháo.
examples.en: The noise from downstairs is so loud I can't sleep.

examples.zh: 工地的噪音很让人头疼。
examples.pinyin: Gōngdì de zàoyīn hěn ràng rén tóuténg.
examples.en: The construction noise is really a headache.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ méiyǒu zàoyīn, hěn ānjìng.
examples.en: There's no noise here; it's very quiet.

examples.zh: 学习要努力，则会有收获。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yào nǔlì, zé huì yǒu shōuhuò.
examples.en: Work hard at your studies, and you'll reap rewards.

examples.zh: 我喜欢喝茶，他则喜欢喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hē chá, tā zé xǐhuan hē kāfēi.
examples.en: I like tea, whereas he prefers coffee.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù nǔlì, zé hěn nán chénggōng.
examples.en: If you don't try hard, success will be hard to come by.

examples.zh: 妈妈责备我没有按时回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma zébèi wǒ méiyǒu ànshí huí jiā.
examples.en: Mom scolded me for not coming home on time.

examples.zh: 你不要责备他，他已经很难过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú yào zébèi tā, tā yǐjīng hěn nánguò le.
examples.en: Don't blame him, he already feels bad enough.

examples.pinyin: Tā bèi lǎoshī zébèile yí dùn.
examples.en: He got a scolding from the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zéguài zìjǐ.
examples.en: Don't blame yourself.

examples.pinyin: Māma wèishénme zéguài wǒ?
examples.en: Why is Mom scolding me?

examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zéguài rènhé rén.
examples.en: He didn't blame anyone.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de zérèn.
examples.en: This is my responsibility.

examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi yǒu zérèn.
examples.en: Parents have a duty toward their children.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì nǐ de zérèn.
examples.en: This isn't your fault.

examples.pinyin: Chuānghu kāi zhe, xiǎoxīn yǒu zéi.
examples.en: The window is open, so watch out for thieves.

examples.pinyin: Qiánbāo bèi zéi tōu zǒu le.
examples.en: A thief stole my wallet.

examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì zéi, nǐ bié huáiyí tā.
examples.en: He's not a thief, so don't suspect him.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le?
examples.en: What's wrong with you?

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zì zěnme xiě?
examples.en: How do you write this character?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zěnme qù?
examples.en: How shall we get there?

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How was today?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How is this restaurant?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de gōngzuò zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How is your work going?

examples.zh: 这个月我的工资增加了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ de gōngzī zēngjiā le.
examples.en: My pay went up this month.

examples.zh: 最近来这里的人增加了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn lái zhèli de rén zēngjiā le.
examples.en: More people have come here lately.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zēngjiā yùndòng.
examples.en: You should exercise more.

examples.zh: 这束花给房间增添了不少色彩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shù huā gěi fángjiān zēngtiān le bù shǎo sècǎi.
examples.en: This bunch of flowers adds a lot of color to the room.

examples.zh: 他的笑话给聚会增添了不少乐趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiàohua gěi jùhuì zēngtiān le bù shǎo lèqù.
examples.en: His jokes added a lot of fun to the party.

examples.zh: 你想给你的房间增添什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng gěi nǐ de fángjiān zēngtiān shénme?
examples.en: What would you like to add to your room?

examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de jīngjì zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
examples.en: China's economy is growing quickly.

examples.zh: 这里的人口每年都在增长。
examples.pinyin: Zhèli de rénkǒu měinián dōu zài zēngzhǎng.
examples.en: The population here grows every year.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shōurù zēngzhǎng le ma?
examples.en: Has your income gone up?

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zèngsòng miǎnfèi de chá.
examples.en: This shop gives out free tea.

examples.pinyin: Péngyou zèngsòng le wǒ yì běn shū.
examples.en: A friend gave me a book as a present.

examples.zh: 这个礼物不是赠送的，是我买的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǐwù bú shì zèngsòng de, shì wǒ mǎi de.
examples.en: This gift isn't free; I bought it.

examples.pinyin: Wǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō yóuzhā.
examples.en: There are lots of fried pork bits in the bowl.

examples.pinyin: Kāfēi zhā kěyǐ yònglái yǎnghuā.
examples.en: Used coffee grounds can be used to fertilise plants.

examples.zh: 这个饼太干了，一吃就掉渣。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǐng tài gān le, yì chī jiù diàozhā.
examples.en: This cake is so dry that it crumbles as soon as you eat it.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, bié bèi zhēn zhā dào le.
examples.en: Careful, don't get pricked by the needle.

examples.pinyin: Méiguī huā de cì hěn zhā rén.
examples.en: Rose thorns really prick people.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhēn zhā le yíxià shǒuzhǐ.
examples.en: He pricked his finger with a needle.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shùxué jīchǔ hěn zhāshi.
examples.en: His foundation in mathematics is very solid.

examples.zh: 要想进步，就要把基本功学扎实。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng jìnbù, jiù yào bǎ jīběngōng xué zhāshi.
examples.en: To improve, you need to master the basics thoroughly.

examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi de qiáng hěn zhāshi.
examples.en: The walls of this house are very sturdy.

examples.zh: 她眨了眨眼睛，好像在想什么。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎ le zhǎ yǎnjing, hǎoxiàng zài xiǎng shénme.
examples.en: She blinked, as if she were thinking about something.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎzha yǎn, zuò le ge guǐliǎn.
examples.en: He winked and made a funny face.

examples.zh: 这个小孩子眨着大眼睛看我。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo háizi zhǎzhe dà yǎnjing kàn wǒ.
examples.en: The little child looked up at me with wide blinking eyes.

examples.zh: 他被电话诈骗了一笔钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi diànhuà zhàpiàn le yì bǐ qián.
examples.en: He was swindled out of money by a phone scam.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào guo zhàpiàn duǎnxìn ma?
examples.en: Have you ever received a scam text message?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhàpiàn bù róngyì shíbié.
examples.en: This kind of fraud is hard to spot.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù guǒyuán zhāi píngguǒ.
examples.en: We go to the orchard to pick apples.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā shì tā zhāi de.
examples.en: He picked these flowers.

examples.zh: 你能帮我摘下这个帽子吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ zhāixià zhège màozi ma?
examples.en: Can you help me take off this hat?

examples.zh: 文章的摘要写得很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wénzhāng de zhāiyào xiě de hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: The article's abstract is clearly written.

examples.zh: 请你先看一下报告的摘要。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān kàn yíxià bàogào de zhāiyào.
examples.en: Please read the summary of the report first.

examples.zh: 这本书有一个简单的内容摘要。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu yí ge jiǎndān de nèiróng zhāiyào.
examples.en: This book has a short summary of its contents.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn zhǎi.
examples.en: This road is very narrow.

examples.zh: 厨房太窄了，放不下这张桌子。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng tài zhǎi le, fàng bu xià zhè zhāng zhuōzi.
examples.en: The kitchen is too narrow to fit this table.

examples.zh: 这双鞋太窄了，我想换一双。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié tài zhǎi le, wǒ xiǎng huàn yì shuāng.
examples.en: These shoes are too tight, so I want to swap for another pair.

examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yìxiē zhèngfǔ zhàiquàn.
examples.en: He bought some government bonds.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhàiquàn de lìxī hěn gāo.
examples.en: The interest on this kind of bond is high.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ qián cún zài zhàiquàn lǐ.
examples.en: I'd like to put my money into bonds.

examples.zh: 这次能去旅行，我真是沾光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì néng qù lǚxíng, wǒ zhēn shì zhānguāng le.
examples.en: Getting to come on this trip, I really owe it to you.

examples.zh: 他没有立功，却跟着同事沾光。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu lìgōng, què gēnzhe tóngshì zhānguāng.
examples.en: He had done nothing special, but he benefited from his colleagues' success.

examples.zh: 能和名校的学生一起学习，我也跟着沾光。
examples.pinyin: Néng hé míngxiào de xuésheng yìqǐ xuéxí, wǒ yě gēnzhe zhānguāng.
examples.en: Getting to study with students from a famous school, I also benefit by association.

examples.zh: 请把这段话粘贴到这里。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè duàn huà niántiē dào zhèlǐ.
examples.en: Please paste this paragraph here.

examples.zh: 我把照片粘贴在本子上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn niántiē zài běnzi shàng.
examples.en: I stuck the photo onto the notebook.

examples.zh: 我把这张地图粘贴在教室的墙上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè zhāng dìtú niántiē zài jiàoshì de qiáng shàng.
examples.en: I stuck this map on the classroom wall.

examples.zh: 我们去博物馆瞻仰这幅名画。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù bówùguǎn zhānyǎng zhè fú míng huà.
examples.en: We went to the museum to admire this famous painting.

examples.zh: 大家都来瞻仰这位老艺术家的作品。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu lái zhānyǎng zhè wèi lǎo yìshùjiā de zuòpǐn.
examples.en: Everyone came to admire the works of this veteran artist.

examples.zh: 你瞻仰过这座古老的城墙吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhānyǎngguo zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngqiáng ma?
examples.en: Have you ever stood in admiration before this ancient city wall?

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎndīngjiétiě de shuō bú qù.
examples.en: He flatly said he would not go.

examples.zh: 老板斩钉截铁地拒绝了我们的请求。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zhǎndīngjiétiě de jùjuéle wǒmen de qǐngqiú.
examples.en: The boss flatly rejected our request.

examples.zh: 她的回答斩钉截铁，没有一点犹豫。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá zhǎndīngjiétiě, méiyǒu yìdiǎn yóuyù.
examples.en: Her answer was firm and decisive, with no hesitation at all.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ dìtú zhǎn kāi kàn.
examples.en: He unfolded the map to look at it.

examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò yǐjīng quánmiàn zhǎnkāi le.
examples.en: The work has been fully launched.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhǎnkāi yí cì tǎolùn.
examples.en: We're going to start a discussion.

examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn yǒu yí ge huà zhǎnlǎn.
examples.en: The museum has a painting exhibition.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù kàn le yí ge zhǎnlǎn.
examples.en: We went to see an exhibition.

examples.zh: 这个展览什么时候结束？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhǎnlǎn shénme shíhou jiéshù?
examples.en: When does this exhibition end?

examples.zh: 博物馆展示了很多古代的陶器。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn zhǎnshì le hěn duō gǔdài de táoqì.
examples.en: The museum displays many ancient pieces of pottery.

examples.zh: 请你向大家展示你的作品。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiàng dàjiā zhǎnshì nǐ de zuòpǐn.
examples.en: Please show your work to everyone.

examples.zh: 这个软件能展示数据图表。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn néng zhǎnshì shùjù túbiǎo.
examples.en: This software can display data charts.

examples.zh: 我们一起展望明年的计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ zhǎnwàng míngnián de jìhuà.
examples.en: Let's look ahead to next year's plans together.

examples.zh: 专家对经济的未来做了展望。
examples.pinyin: Zhuānjiā duì jīngjì de wèilái zuò le zhǎnwàng.
examples.en: Experts offered an outlook for the future of the economy.

examples.zh: 这个行业前景广阔，展望很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hángyè qiánjǐng guǎngkuò, zhǎnwàng hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This industry has broad prospects and a bright outlook.

examples.zh: 这幅画展现了春天的美。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà zhǎnxiàn le chūntiān de měi.
examples.en: This painting shows the beauty of spring.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiàoróng zhǎnxiàn chū zìxìn.
examples.en: Her smile conveys confidence.

examples.zh: 这座城市在夜里展现出另一面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zài yè lǐ zhǎnxiàn chū lìng yí miàn.
examples.en: At night, this city reveals another side of itself.

examples.zh: 他骑着一辆崭新的自行车。
examples.pinyin: Tā qízhe yí liàng zhǎnxīn de zìxíngchē.
examples.en: He's riding a brand-new bicycle.

examples.zh: 这间房子装修得很崭新。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángzi zhuāngxiū de hěn zhǎnxīn.
examples.en: This flat has been renovated to look brand-new.

examples.zh: 新学期，大家都有崭新的开始。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī, dàjiā dōu yǒu zhǎnxīn de kāishǐ.
examples.en: A new semester gives everyone a fresh start.

examples.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where is the train station?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zài zhèr zhàn yíxià.
examples.en: Please stand here for a moment.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zài chēzhàn děng chē.
examples.en: I wait for the bus at the bus stop every day.

examples.zh: 我每天都要和拖延症战斗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu yào hé tuōyánzhèng zhàndòu.
examples.en: I have to battle procrastination every day.

examples.zh: 这家小公司在市场上战斗了十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo gōngsī zài shìchǎng shàng zhàndòu le shí nián.
examples.en: This small company has fought for its place in the market for ten years.

examples.zh: 他们为了梦想，一直在战斗。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen wèile mèngxiǎng, yìzhí zài zhàndòu.
examples.en: They have kept fighting for their dreams.

examples.zh: 这张桌子占据了大半个房间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi zhànjù le dà bàn ge fángjiān.
examples.en: This table takes up half the room.

examples.zh: 他一个人占据了整个沙发。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zhànjù le zhěnggè shāfā.
examples.en: He took up the whole sofa on his own.

examples.zh: 这个问题占据了我的全部时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí zhànjù le wǒ de quánbù shíjiān.
examples.en: This problem has taken up all my time.

examples.zh: 这个座位已经被别人占领了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zuòwèi yǐjīng bèi biérén zhànlǐng le.
examples.en: This seat has already been taken by someone else.

examples.zh: 大家都占领了草地，我们只能站着。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhànlǐng le cǎodì, wǒmen zhǐ néng zhànzhe.
examples.en: Everyone had taken the grass, so we had to stand.

examples.zh: 这家公司想占领更多的市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī xiǎng zhànlǐng gèng duō de shìchǎng.
examples.en: This company wants to capture more of the market.

examples.zh: 公司正在制定新的发展战略。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zhìdìng xīn de fāzhǎn zhànlüè.
examples.en: The company is drawing up a new development strategy.

examples.zh: 我们需要一个长远的战略。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào yí ge chángyuǎn de zhànlüè.
examples.en: We need a long-term strategy.

examples.zh: 这个战略为什么没有成功？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhànlüè wèishénme méiyǒu chénggōng?
examples.en: Why didn't this strategy succeed?

examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn tiáozhěng le bǐsài zhànshù.
examples.en: The coach adjusted the tactics for the match.

examples.zh: 这个战术很有效，我们赢了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhànshù hěn yǒuxiào, wǒmen yíng le.
examples.en: This tactic worked well, and we won.

examples.zh: 你的谈判战术太明显了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de tánpàn zhànshù tài míngxiǎn le.
examples.en: Your negotiating tactics are far too obvious.

examples.pinyin: Diànhuà zhànxiàn, qǐng shāohòu zài dǎ.
examples.en: The line is busy; please call back later.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì, dōu zhànxiàn.
examples.en: I called several times, but the line was always busy.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒujī yìzhí zhànxiàn.
examples.en: His phone keeps being busy.

examples.zh: 这次营销战役效果很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yíngxiāo zhànyì xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This marketing campaign worked very well.

examples.zh: 为了这次市场战役，团队准备了很久。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhè cì shìchǎng zhànyì, tuánduì zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ.
examples.en: The team spent a long time preparing for this market campaign.

examples.zh: 这场战役的胜利来自团队的努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhànyì de shènglì, láizì tuánduì de nǔlì.
examples.en: The success of this campaign came from the team's efforts.

examples.zh: 他占有公司百分之二十的股份。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhànyǒu gōngsī bǎi fēn zhī èrshí de gǔfèn.
examples.en: He owns twenty percent of the company's shares.

examples.zh: 这块地被一家公司占有了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dì bèi yì jiā gōngsī zhànyǒu le.
examples.en: This plot of land is owned by a company.

examples.zh: 他不愿意占有别人的东西。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì zhànyǒu biérén de dōngxi.
examples.en: He doesn't want to take other people's things for himself.

examples.zh: 这本历史书讲了一场战争。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn lìshǐ shū jiǎng le yì chǎng zhànzhēng.
examples.en: This history book describes a war.

examples.zh: 人们都希望和平，不喜欢战争。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen dōu xīwàng hépíng, bù xǐhuan zhànzhēng.
examples.en: People all hope for peace and dislike war.

examples.zh: 你读过关于战争的书吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dú guo guānyú zhànzhēng de shū ma?
examples.en: Have you read any books about war?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi hěn dà.
examples.en: This table is very big.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào.
examples.en: I bought two tickets.

examples.zh: 我们的桌子上有一张报纸。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì zhāng bàozhǐ.
examples.en: There's a newspaper on our table.

examples.zh: 这个俱乐部的章程很简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jùlèbù de zhāngchéng hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: This club's rules are very simple.

examples.zh: 进入公司前，要先看一下员工章程。
examples.pinyin: Jìnrù gōngsī qián, yào xiān kàn yíxià yuángōng zhāngchéng.
examples.en: Before joining the company, read the staff regulations.

examples.zh: 大家都要遵守学校的章程。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu yào zūnshǒu xuéxiào de zhāngchéng.
examples.en: Everyone must follow the school rules.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn gāo.
examples.en: He has grown very tall.

examples.pinyin: Háizi zhǎng dà le.
examples.en: The child has grown up.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen xuéxiào de xiàozhǎng.
examples.en: He is the principal of our school.

examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn càijià zhǎng le bù shǎo.
examples.en: Vegetable prices have gone up quite a bit recently.

examples.pinyin: Héshuǐ zhǎng le hěn duō.
examples.en: The river has risen a lot.

examples.pinyin: Fángzū yòu zhǎng le.
examples.en: The rent has gone up again.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，我要向长辈问好。
examples.pinyin: Guònián de shíhou, wǒ yào xiàng zhǎngbèi wènhǎo.
examples.en: At New Year, I greet my elders.

examples.pinyin: Wǎnbèi yīnggāi zūnzhòng zhǎngbèi.
examples.en: Juniors should respect their elders.

examples.zh: 长辈们都很关心我的学习。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎngbèimen dōu hěn guānxīn wǒ de xuéxí.
examples.en: The elders in the family all care about my studies.

examples.zh: 你要尽快掌握这门技术。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jǐnkuài zhǎngwò zhè mén jìshù.
examples.en: You need to master this skill quickly.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi zhǎngwò zhèxiē shēngcí.
examples.en: I haven't got these new words down yet.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì zhǎngwò shíjiān.
examples.en: He's very good at managing his time.

examples.zh: 他没有语言障碍，学得很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu yǔyán zhàng'ài, xué de hěn kuài.
examples.en: He has no language barrier and learns quickly.

examples.zh: 路上的积雪成了车辆的障碍。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng de jīxuě chéng le chēliàng de zhàng'ài.
examples.en: Snow on the road became an obstacle for vehicles.

examples.zh: 克服困难，才能跨越障碍。
examples.pinyin: Kèfú kùnnan, cái néng kuàyuè zhàng'ài.
examples.en: Only by overcoming difficulties can we clear obstacles.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhàngfu shì yīshēng.
examples.en: My husband is a doctor.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zhàngfu zài gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.en: Her husband works at a company.

examples.pinyin: Zhàngfu hé qīzi dōu hěn máng.
examples.en: The husband and wife are both busy.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kāi yí ge yínháng zhànghù.
examples.en: I want to open a bank account.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zhànghù mìmǎ shì shénme?
examples.en: What is your account password?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhànghù lǐ méiyǒu qián le.
examples.en: There's no money left in my account.

examples.zh: 我们在草地上搭了一顶帐篷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài cǎodì shàng dā le yì dǐng zhàngpeng.
examples.en: We put up a tent on the grass.

examples.zh: 这顶帐篷很轻，很好携带。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dǐng zhàngpeng hěn qīng, hěn hǎo xiédài.
examples.en: This tent is very light and easy to carry.

examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ.
examples.en: At night we sleep in the tent.

examples.pinyin: Māma zài jiā lǐ zhāodài péngyou.
examples.en: Mom is entertaining friends at home.

examples.zh: 饭馆的服务员招待得很周到。
examples.pinyin: Fànguǎn de fúwùyuán zhāodài de hěn zhōudào.
examples.en: The restaurant staff looked after us very well.

examples.zh: 你不用招待我，我自己来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú yòng zhāodài wǒ, wǒ zìjǐ lái.
examples.en: You don't need to look after me; I'll help myself.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zhāopìn xīn yuángōng.
examples.en: The company is recruiting new staff.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhāopìn sījī.
examples.en: This company is hiring drivers.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàndào zhāopìn guǎnggào le ma?
examples.en: Did you see the job ad?

examples.pinyin: Zhè qún niánqīngrén zhāoqìpéngbó.
examples.en: This group of young people is full of energy.

examples.zh: 孩子们朝气蓬勃地跑来跑去。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zhāoqìpéngbó de pǎo lái pǎo qù.
examples.en: The children ran around full of energy.

examples.zh: 这个团队充满了朝气蓬勃的精神。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tuánduì chōngmǎnle zhāoqìpéngbó de jīngshen.
examples.en: This team is full of youthful vitality.

examples.zh: 这所学校今年招收了三百名新生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào jīnnián zhāoshōu le sānbǎi míng xīnshēng.
examples.en: This school admitted three hundred new students this year.

examples.zh: 公司计划招收更多的年轻员工。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà zhāoshōu gèng duō de niánqīng yuángōng.
examples.en: The company plans to recruit more young staff.

examples.zh: 他们不再招收十八岁以下的学生。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bú zài zhāoshōu shíbā suì yǐxià de xuésheng.
examples.en: They no longer take students under the age of eighteen.

examples.zh: 这个项目要通过公开招投标来选择承包商。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yào tōngguò gōngkāi zhāo tóu biāo lái xuǎnzé chéngbāoshāng.
examples.en: This project will choose its contractor through an open tender.

examples.zh: 招投标的过程要公开透明。
examples.pinyin: Zhāo tóu biāo de guòchéng yào gōngkāi tòumíng.
examples.en: The tendering process must be open and transparent.

examples.zh: 公司正在准备这次招投标的材料。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài zhǔnbèi zhè cì zhāo tóu biāo de cáiliào.
examples.en: The company is preparing the documents for this tender.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zháojí.
examples.en: Don't worry.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn zháojí, chē hái méi lái.
examples.en: I'm worried, the bus still hasn't come.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn zháojí.
examples.en: Everyone is anxious.

examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng, bié zháoliáng le.
examples.en: It's cold, so don't catch a chill.

examples.zh: 他昨天着凉了，今天在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān zháoliáng le, jīntiān zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.en: He caught a chill yesterday, so he's resting at home today.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān hòu yìdiǎn, bié zháoliáng.
examples.en: Wear something thicker so you don't catch cold.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen duì kǒnglóng hěn zháomí.
examples.en: The kids are fascinated by dinosaurs.

examples.zh: 你为什么对这本书这么着迷？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme duì zhè běn shū zhème zháomí?
examples.en: Why are you so hooked on this book?

examples.zh: 她一看书就着迷，常常忘了吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí kàn shū jiù zháomí, chángcháng wàngle chī fàn.
examples.en: Once she starts reading she gets absorbed and often forgets to eat.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào wǒ de shǒujī.
examples.en: I can't find my phone.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhǎo shénme?
examples.en: What are you looking for?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù zhǎo lǎoshī.
examples.en: I'm going to find the teacher.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn zhǎozé lǐ yǒu hěn duō niǎo.
examples.en: There are many birds in this marsh.

examples.zh: 走路时要小心，别踩进沼泽。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, bié cǎijìn zhǎozé.
examples.en: Be careful when walking, and don't step into the swamp.

examples.pinyin: Zhǎozédì de shēngtài hěn tèbié.
examples.en: The ecology of the wetlands is very special.

examples.zh: 虽然下雨，商店照常营业。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ, shāngdiàn zhàocháng yíngyè.
examples.en: Even though it rained, the shops opened as usual.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zhàocháng qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: I get up at seven as usual every day.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ zhàocháng shàngbān ma?
examples.en: Will you go to work as usual tomorrow?

examples.pinyin: Māma zhàogu wǒ.
examples.en: Mom takes care of me.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhàogu hǎo zìjǐ.
examples.en: Look after yourself.

examples.zh: 请你照顾一下我的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhàogu yíxià wǒ de háizi.
examples.en: Please look after my child for a moment.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān zhàokāi huìyì.
examples.en: A meeting will be held tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāng zhàokāi xīn de huìyì.

examples.en: The school decided to hold a parents' meeting.

examples.zh: 奶奶生病了，我每天照料她。

examples.en: Grandma is ill, so I look after her every day.

examples.pinyin: Shéi lái zhàoliào zhèxiē huā?
examples.en: Who is going to look after these flowers?

examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zhàoliàozhe sān ge háizi, hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.en: He looks after three children on his own, and it's hard work.

examples.en: Let's look at this photo.

examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn lǐ de rén shì nǐ ma?
examples.en: Is that you in the photo?

examples.en: I bought a new camera.

examples.en: This camera is expensive.

examples.en: It rained, but he still went running.

examples.zh: 虽然放假了，他照样每天早起学习。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán fàngjià le, tā zhàoyàng měitiān zǎo qǐ xuéxí.
examples.en: Even though it's the holidays, he still gets up early every day to study.

examples.zh: 我的口味变了，但你照样做我最爱吃的菜吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de kǒuwèi biàn le, dàn nǐ zhàoyàng zuò wǒ zuì ài chī de cài ba.
examples.en: My tastes have changed, but why not make my favorite dishes anyway?

examples.zh: 月光照耀着安静的湖面。
examples.pinyin: Yuèguāng zhàoyàozhe ānjìng de húmiàn.
examples.en: Moonlight shines over the calm surface of the lake.

examples.zh: 阳光照耀着大地，万物都醒了。
examples.pinyin: Yángguāng zhàoyàozhe dàdì, wànwù dōu xǐng le.

examples.zh: 灯光照耀着舞台，观众都安静下来了。

examples.en: The stage lights shone on the stage, and the audience fell silent.

examples.zh: 你出门在外，要互相照应。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chūmén zàiwài, yào hùxiāng zhàoyìng.
examples.en: When you're away from home, look out for each other.

examples.zh: 请你照应一下家里，我出差几天。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhàoyìng yíxià jiālǐ, wǒ chūchāi jǐ tiān.
examples.en: Please keep an eye on things at home while I'm away on business for a few days.

examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng qiánhòu zhàoyìng de hěn hǎo.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zhēdǎng qiánmian de píngmù.
examples.en: Please don't block the screen in front.

examples.zh: 他为了搬家折腾了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile bānjiā zhēteng le yì zhěng tiān.
examples.en: He ran around all day getting ready to move house.

examples.zh: 这台老电脑总是折腾人，经常死机。

examples.en: This piece of clothing is 20 percent off, which is a good deal.

examples.pinyin: Bú yào zhémó zìjǐ, fàngsōng yíxià ba.

examples.en: What's your philosophy of life?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì nǎinai liú xiàlái de zhēnguì lǐwù.
examples.en: This is a precious gift that Grandma left behind.

examples.pinyin: Shíjiān shì zuì zhēnguì de dōngxi, bú yào làngfèi.

examples.en: Is what you're saying true?

examples.en: The photo looks very real.

examples.en: This bird is very rare and hard to see.

examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhēnxī de gǔdǒng.
examples.en: The museum has many rare antiques.

examples.pinyin: Měi ge yuè de zhīchū yào jìlù xiàlái.
examples.en: Write down your spending every month.

examples.zh: 这个月的支出比收入多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè de zhīchū bǐ shōurù duō.
examples.en: This month we spent more than we earned.

examples.zh: 公司要控制不必要的支出。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yào kòngzhì bú bìyào de zhīchū.
examples.en: The company needs to keep unnecessary spending under control.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdao nǐ de míngzi.
examples.en: I know your name.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdao tā shì shéi ma?
examples.en: Do you know who he is?

examples.zh: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdao míngtiān huì bú huì xià yǔ.
examples.en: I don't know whether it will rain tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shíwù zhīfáng hěn shǎo.
examples.en: This food is very low in fat.

examples.zh: 运动可以帮助减少身体里的脂肪。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ bāngzhù jiǎnshǎo shēntǐ lǐ de zhīfáng.
examples.en: Exercise helps reduce body fat.

examples.zh: 牛肉里的脂肪比鸡肉多。
examples.pinyin: Niúròu lǐ de zhīfáng bǐ jīròu duō.
examples.en: Beef has more fat than chicken.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuāidǎo hòu shīqùle zhījué.
examples.en: He lost consciousness after falling.

examples.zh: 这种药会让手指失去知觉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào huì ràng shǒuzhǐ shīqù zhījué.
examples.en: This medicine can make your fingers go numb.

examples.pinyin: Tā duì wēixiǎn méiyǒu zhījué.
examples.en: He has no awareness of danger.

examples.zh: 这条小河是大河的支流。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiǎo hé shì dà hé de zhīliú.
examples.en: This little river is a tributary of the big river.

examples.zh: 我们沿着支流一直走，就能看到湖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yánzhe zhīliú yìzhí zǒu, jiù néng kàndào hú.
examples.en: If we follow the tributary, we'll see the lake.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo zhīliú de shuǐ hěn qīng.
examples.en: The water in this tributary is very clear.

examples.zh: 他把时间支配得很合理。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shíjiān zhīpèi de hěn hélǐ.
examples.en: He manages his time very sensibly.

examples.zh: 不要让情绪支配你的行为。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào ràng qíngxù zhīpèi nǐ de xíngwéi.
examples.en: Don't let your emotions control your behavior.

examples.zh: 每月的零用钱，由他自己支配。
examples.pinyin: Měi yuè de língyòngqián, yóu tā zìjǐ zhīpèi.
examples.en: He decides how to spend his monthly pocket money himself.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhīpiào fù le qián.
examples.en: He paid with a cheque.

examples.zh: 你能开一张支票给我吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng kāi yì zhāng zhīpiào gěi wǒ ma?
examples.en: Can you write me a cheque?

examples.zh: 现在很多人不用支票了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn duō rén bú yòng zhīpiào le.
examples.en: Many people no longer use cheques these days.

examples.zh: 读书可以学到很多知识。
examples.pinyin: Dúshū kěyǐ xuédào hěn duō zhīshi.
examples.en: Reading lets you gain a lot of knowledge.

examples.pinyin: Tā duì diànnǎo zhīshi hěn liǎojiě.
examples.en: He knows a lot about computers.

examples.zh: 你有没有这方面的知识？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu zhè fāngmiàn de zhīshi?
examples.en: Do you have any knowledge in this area?

examples.zh: 志愿者们来支援我们的活动。
examples.pinyin: Zhìyuànzhěmen lái zhīyuán wǒmen de huódòng.
examples.en: Volunteers came to support our event.

examples.zh: 朋友们在比赛时一直支援我。
examples.pinyin: Péngyoumen zài bǐsài shí yìzhí zhīyuán wǒ.
examples.en: My friends cheered me on throughout the match.

examples.zh: 公司决定支援新项目的资金。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng zhīyuán xīn xiàngmù de zījīn.
examples.en: The company decided to fund the new project.

examples.zh: 父母是他生活中的精神支柱。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì tā shēnghuó zhōng de jīngshén zhīzhù.
examples.en: His parents are his emotional mainstay in life.

examples.zh: 帐篷的支柱断了，我们只能重新搭。
examples.pinyin: Zhàngpeng de zhīzhù duàn le, wǒmen zhǐ néng chóngxīn dā.
examples.en: The tent pole snapped, so we had to put the tent up again.

examples.zh: 经济是城市发展的重要支柱。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì shì chéngshì fāzhǎn de zhòngyào zhīzhù.
examples.en: The economy is a key pillar of the city's development.

examples.zh: 他很知足常乐，从不抱怨。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zhīzú chánglè, cóng bú bàoyuàn.
examples.en: He is content with what he has and never complains.

examples.zh: 我们要知足常乐，不要总和别人比。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhīzú chánglè, bú yào zǒng hé biérén bǐ.
examples.en: We should be content with what we have and stop comparing ourselves to others.

examples.zh: 知足常乐的人，生活往往更轻松。
examples.pinyin: Zhīzú chánglè de rén, shēnghuó wǎngwǎng gèng qīngsōng.
examples.en: People who are content with what they have often lead more relaxed lives.

examples.pinyin: Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu.
examples.en: Keep walking straight ahead.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn zhí.
examples.en: He speaks very bluntly.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn zhí.
examples.en: This road is very straight.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ zhíbān.
examples.en: I'm on duty tonight.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zuówǎn zhíbān, hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.en: The doctor was on duty last night, and it was hard work.

examples.pinyin: Shéi jīntiān zhíbān?
examples.en: Who is on duty today?

examples.zh: 今晚的足球比赛会在电视上直播。
examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn de zúqiú bǐsài huì zài diànshì shàng zhíbō.
examples.en: Tonight's football match will be broadcast live on TV.

examples.zh: 他在网上直播自己做饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng zhíbō zìjǐ zuò fàn.
examples.en: He streams himself cooking online.

examples.zh: 这场演唱会的直播画面很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǎnchànghuì de zhíbō huàmiàn hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: The live stream of this concert has very clear picture quality.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn zhíde dú.
examples.en: This book is well worth reading.

examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng zhíde kàn.
examples.en: This film is worth watching.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bù zhíde mǎi.
examples.en: This item of clothing isn't worth buying.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhíjiē qù jīchǎng ba.
examples.en: Let's go straight to the airport.

examples.zh: 他没有直接回答我的问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē huídá wǒ de wèntí.
examples.en: He didn't answer my question directly.

examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ zhíjiē wèn wǒ.
examples.en: If you have a question, just ask me directly.

examples.zh: 这座小岛以前是一个殖民地。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò xiǎodǎo yǐqián shì yí ge zhímíndì.
examples.en: This small island used to be a colony.

examples.zh: 博物馆里有很多殖民地时代的老照片。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhímíndì shídài de lǎo zhàopiàn.
examples.en: The museum has many old photos from the colonial era.

examples.zh: 这本小说讲的是一个殖民地小镇的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jiǎng de shì yí ge zhímíndì xiǎozhèn de gùshi.
examples.en: This novel tells the story of a small town in a colony.

examples.zh: 厨房的职能是准备食物。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng de zhínéng shì zhǔnbèi shíwù.
examples.en: The kitchen's job is to prepare food.

examples.zh: 每个部门都有自己的职能。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge bùmén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de zhínéng.
examples.en: Every department has its own function.

examples.zh: 你知道这个机构的职能吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhège jīgòu de zhínéng ma?
examples.en: Do you know what this organization is responsible for?

examples.zh: 这个职位需要有经验的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhíwèi xūyào yǒu jīngyàn de rén.
examples.en: This position requires someone with experience.

examples.zh: 他申请了一个新的职位。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēnqǐngle yí ge xīn de zhíwèi.
examples.en: He applied for a new position.

examples.zh: 他升职了，职位比以前高多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngzhí le, zhíwèi bǐ yǐqián gāo duō le.
examples.en: He was promoted, and his position is much higher than before.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhíwù.
examples.en: I like plants.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: This kind of plant is very pretty.

examples.pinyin: Zhíwù xūyào shuǐ hé yángguāng.
examples.en: Plants need water and sunlight.

examples.zh: 他担任公司的财务职务。
examples.pinyin: Tā dānrèn gōngsī de cáiwù zhíwù.
examples.en: He holds a finance post at the company.

examples.zh: 这个职务的工作很繁重。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhíwù de gōngzuò hěn fánzhòng.
examples.en: The duties of this post are very heavy.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zhíwù shì shénme?
examples.en: What is your job title?

examples.zh: 我们要认真执行这个计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào rènzhēn zhíxíng zhège jìhuà.
examples.en: We need to carry out this plan seriously.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de mìnglìng bìxū zhíxíng.
examples.en: The boss's orders must be carried out.

examples.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn hái méiyǒu zhíxíng.
examples.en: This proposal hasn't been put into action yet.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zhíyè shì shénme?
examples.en: What's your occupation?

examples.zh: 老师是一个很好的职业。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shì yí ge hěn hǎo de zhíyè.
examples.en: Teaching is a very good profession.

examples.zh: 他选择了医生这个职业。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuǎnzé le yīshēng zhège zhíyè.
examples.en: He chose medicine as his career.

examples.zh: 他终于拿到了驾驶执照。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú nádào le jiàshǐ zhízhào.
examples.en: He finally got his driver's license.

examples.pinyin: Kāi chē yào yǒu zhízhào.
examples.en: You need a license to drive.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zhízhào zài nǎlǐ?
examples.en: Where is your license?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí ge gēge.
examples.en: I only have one older brother.

examples.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: That dog is very cute.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo shì wǒ de.
examples.en: This cat is mine.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu zhǐ nà ge rén.
examples.en: He pointed at that person with his hand.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒuzhǐ hěn téng.
examples.en: My finger hurts.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhǐ yíxià lù.
examples.en: Please show me the way.

examples.zh: 今年的销售指标已经完成了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de xiāoshòu zhǐbiāo yǐjīng wánchéng le.
examples.en: This year's sales target has already been met.

examples.zh: 我们必须达到这个月的指标。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū dádào zhège yuè de zhǐbiāo.
examples.en: We must hit this month's target.

examples.zh: 这些数据是衡量经济的重要指标。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùjù shì héngliáng jīngjì de zhòngyào zhǐbiāo.
examples.en: These figures are important indicators for measuring the economy.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐdǎo wǒ xiě lùnwén.
examples.en: My teacher guides me in writing my thesis.

examples.zh: 教练指导我们练习游泳。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn zhǐdǎo wǒmen liànxí yóuyǒng.
examples.en: The coach is teaching us to swim.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de zhǐdǎo.
examples.en: Thank you for your guidance.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhǐdìng de dìfang tíngchē.
examples.en: Please park in the designated area.

examples.zh: 老师指定我们读这本书。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhǐdìng wǒmen dú zhè běn shū.
examples.en: The teacher assigned us this book to read.

examples.zh: 你必须按时到指定地点报到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū ànshí dào zhǐdìng dìdiǎn bàodào.
examples.en: You must check in at the designated place on time.

examples.pinyin: Tiān tài wǎn le, wǒ zhǐhǎo huí jiā.
examples.en: It was too late, so I had no choice but to go home.

examples.zh: 车没有了，我们只好走路。
examples.pinyin: Chē méiyǒu le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zǒulù.
examples.en: There were no more buses, so we had to walk.

examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu qián, zhǐhǎo jiè qián.
examples.en: He had no money, so he had to borrow some.

examples.zh: 他指挥大家把箱子搬走。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐhuī dàjiā bǎ xiāngzi bān zǒu.
examples.en: He directed everyone to carry the boxes away.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī zhǐhuī yuèduì.
examples.en: This teacher conducts the orchestra.

examples.zh: 交通警察在路口指挥车辆。
examples.pinyin: Jiāotōng jǐngchá zài lùkǒu zhǐhuī chēliàng.
examples.en: The traffic police direct vehicles at the junction.

examples.zh: 妈妈每周都会帮我剪指甲。
examples.pinyin: Māma měi zhōu dōu huì bāng wǒ jiǎn zhǐjia.
examples.en: Mom trims my nails every week.

examples.zh: 他的指甲很长，该修剪了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhǐjia hěn cháng, gāi xiūjiǎn le.
examples.en: His nails are very long; they need trimming.

examples.zh: 洗手以后，要注意清理指甲缝。
examples.pinyin: Xǐshǒu yǐhòu, yào zhùyì qīnglǐ zhǐjiafèng.
examples.en: After washing your hands, make sure to clean under your nails.

examples.zh: 电脑接收到了关机的指令。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo jiēshōu dào le guānjī de zhǐlìng.
examples.en: The computer received the command to shut down.

examples.zh: 机器人按照程序的指令行动。
examples.pinyin: Jīqìrén ànzhào chéngxù de zhǐlìng xíngdòng.
examples.en: The robot acts according to the program's instructions.

examples.zh: 请按照指令一步一步操作。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào zhǐlìng yí bù yí bù cāozuò.
examples.en: Please follow the instructions and operate step by step.

examples.zh: 出门爬山时，最好带一个指南针。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén páshān shí, zuìhǎo dài yí ge zhǐnánzhēn.
examples.en: When you go hiking, it's best to take a compass.

examples.zh: 他用指南针找到了回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhǐnánzhēn zhǎodào le huíjiā de lù.
examples.en: He used a compass to find his way home.

examples.zh: 古代人发明了指南针，对航海很重要。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài rén fāmíng le zhǐnánzhēn, duì hánghǎi hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: Ancient people invented the compass, which was very important for seafaring.

examples.zh: 老板的指示我们要认真执行。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de zhǐshì wǒmen yào rènzhēn zhíxíng.
examples.en: We must carry out the boss's instructions carefully.

examples.zh: 他用手指示了一下方向。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shǒu zhǐshì le yíxià fāngxiàng.
examples.en: He pointed the way with his hand.

examples.zh: 按照说明书的指示，把零件装好。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shuōmíngshū de zhǐshì, bǎ língjiàn zhuāng hǎo.
examples.en: Follow the manual's instructions and assemble the parts.

examples.zh: 我不指望他能帮我，自己做吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhǐwàng tā néng bāng wǒ, zìjǐ zuò ba.
examples.en: I don't expect him to help me; I'll do it myself.

examples.zh: 这次考试你可别指望能拿满分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì nǐ kě bié zhǐwàng néng ná mǎnfēn.
examples.en: Don't count on getting full marks in this exam.

examples.zh: 大家都指望他能带领公司走出困境。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhǐwàng tā néng dàilǐng gōngsī zǒuchū kùnjìng.
examples.en: Everyone is counting on him to lead the company out of its difficulties.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
examples.en: As long as you come, I'll be happy.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan, jiù mǎi ba.
examples.en: If you like it, just buy it.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù.
examples.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.

examples.zh: 大家不要随便指责别人。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā bú yào suíbiàn zhǐzé biérén.
examples.en: Everyone should not blame others carelessly.

examples.zh: 他被同事指责工作不认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi tóngshì zhǐzé gōngzuò bù rènzhēn.
examples.en: His colleagues criticised him for not taking his work seriously.

examples.zh: 面对别人的指责，他没有生气。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì biérén de zhǐzé, tā méiyǒu shēngqì.
examples.en: He didn't get angry when others criticised him.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de zhì'ān hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Public order in this area is very good.

examples.zh: 城市的治安需要大家共同维护。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì de zhì'ān xūyào dàjiā gòngtóng wéihù.
examples.en: Everyone needs to work together to maintain public order in the city.

examples.zh: 夜里小区的治安让人放心。
examples.pinyin: Yè lǐ xiǎoqū de zhì'ān ràng rén fàngxīn.
examples.en: Security in the neighborhood at night gives people peace of mind.

examples.zh: 违反规则的人会受到制裁。
examples.pinyin: Wéifǎn guīzé de rén huì shòudào zhìcái.
examples.en: People who break the rules will face sanctions.

examples.zh: 他因为作弊受到了制裁。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zuòbǐ shòudào le zhìcái.
examples.en: He was punished for cheating.

examples.zh: 公司对违规的员工进行了制裁。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī duì wéiguī de yuángōng jìnxíng le zhìcái.
examples.en: The company disciplined the staff who broke the rules.

examples.zh: 校长在开学典礼上致辞。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài kāixué diǎnlǐ shang zhìcí.
examples.en: The principal gave a speech at the opening ceremony.

examples.pinyin: Xiànzài qǐng bānzhǎng zhìcí.
examples.en: Now let's hear a speech from the class monitor.

examples.zh: 婚礼上，他的致辞很感人。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shang, tā de zhìcí hěn gǎnrén.
examples.en: At the wedding, his speech was very moving.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhìdìng xuéxí jìhuà.
examples.en: We need to draw up a study plan.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhìdìng le xīn de guīdìng.
examples.en: The company drew up new regulations.

examples.zh: 你为什么没有制定目标？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme méiyǒu zhìdìng mùbiāo?
examples.en: Why haven't you set a goal?

examples.zh: 我们要制订一个学习计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhìdìng yí ge xuéxí jìhuà.

examples.en: He refuses to lose his dignity for money.

examples.zh: 老师要尊重学生的尊严。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào zūnzhòng xuésheng de zūnyán.
examples.en: Teachers should respect students' dignity.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnzhòng biérén.
examples.en: We should respect other people.

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn zūnzhòng lǎoshī.
examples.en: He respects his teachers a great deal.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zūnzhòng zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: You should respect your own ideas.

examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xià yǔ le.
examples.en: It rained yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān zuò shénme le?
examples.en: What did you do yesterday?

examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: Yesterday's movie was really good.

examples.pinyin: Zuǒbian shì wǒ de shū.
examples.en: The book on the left is mine.

examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn zài zuǒbian.
examples.en: The shop is on the left.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xuéxiào zài zuǒbian.
examples.en: Our school is on the left.

examples.pinyin: Tā dàgài sānshí suì zuǒyòu.
examples.en: He's about thirty years old.

examples.zh: 我们每天花一个小时左右学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān huā yí ge xiǎoshí zuǒyòu xuéxí.
examples.en: We study for about an hour a day.

examples.zh: 会议室左右各有一扇门。
examples.pinyin: Huìyìshì zuǒyòu gè yǒu yí shàn mén.
examples.en: There is a door on each side of the meeting room.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò shénme?
examples.en: What are you doing?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò fàn hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: My mom's cooking is very tasty.

examples.pinyin: Tā huì zuò Zhōngguó cài.
examples.en: She can cook Chinese food.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò zhèr ba.
examples.en: Sit here, why don't you.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
examples.en: I'm sitting on a chair.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.
examples.en: We're flying to Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo hěn cháng.
examples.en: This bridge is very long.

examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài yǒu yí zuò dà shān.
examples.en: There's a big mountain outside the window.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò fángzi shì wǒ de.
examples.en: This house is mine.

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shí bù néng zuòbì.
examples.en: You must not cheat in exams.

examples.zh: 他因为作弊被老师批评了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zuòbì bèi lǎoshī pīpíng le.
examples.en: He was told off by the teacher for cheating.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu chéngnuò bú zuòbì.
examples.en: Everyone promised not to cheat.

examples.zh: 今天我做东，大家随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ zuòdōng, dàjiā suíbiàn chī.
examples.en: Today I'm the host, so everyone eat as much as you like.

examples.zh: 老同学聚会，他做东请客。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo tóngxué jùhuì, tā zuòdōng qǐngkè.
examples.en: At the old classmates' reunion, he hosted and paid.

examples.zh: 这次吃饭由你来做东吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chīfàn yóu nǐ lái zuòdōng ba.
examples.en: You should be the host for this meal.

examples.pinyin: Guòqī de piào yǐjīng zuòfèi le.
examples.en: The expired ticket is no longer valid.

examples.zh: 如果不付钱，这张卡就会作废。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bú fù qián, zhè zhāng kǎ jiù huì zuòfèi.
examples.en: If you don't pay, this card will become invalid.

examples.zh: 这份旧合同作废了，我们重新签。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn jiù hétong zuòfèi le, wǒmen chóngxīn qiān.
examples.en: This old contract is void, so we'll sign a new one.

examples.zh: 这家公司的工作作风很严谨。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gōngzuò zuòfēng hěn yánjǐn.
examples.en: This company has a very rigorous working style.

examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòfēng hěn tāshi.
examples.en: His style of working is very steady.

examples.zh: 老板的作风让人很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de zuòfēng ràng rén hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: The boss's style is very appealing.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì tā zuì yǒumíng de zuòpǐn.
examples.en: This is his most famous work.

examples.zh: 这位作家的作品我都读过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn wǒ dōu dú guo.
examples.en: I've read all of this writer's works.

examples.zh: 这些作品是学生们一起完成的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zuòpǐn shì xuéshengmen yìqǐ wánchéng de.
examples.en: These works were completed by the students together.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài Běijīng zuò shēng yì.
examples.en: He does business in Beijing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ yǐqián zuò shēng yì.
examples.en: My parents used to run a business.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò shēng yì shùnlì ma?
examples.en: Is your business going smoothly?

examples.zh: 作为学生，我们要努力学习。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi xuésheng, wǒmen yào nǔlì xuéxí.
examples.en: As students, we should study hard.

examples.zh: 他作为老师，很受学生欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòwéi lǎoshī, hěn shòu xuésheng huānyíng.
examples.en: As a teacher, he's very popular with students.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū kěyǐ zuòwéi lǐwù.
examples.en: This book can be given as a gift.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zhège zuòwèi.
examples.en: Please take this seat.

examples.pinyin: Zhège zuòwèi yǒu rén ma?
examples.en: Is this seat taken?

examples.pinyin: Fēijī shang de zuòwèi hěn xiǎo.
examples.en: The seats on the plane are very small.

examples.zh: 今天老师让我们写一篇作文。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě yì piān zuòwén.
examples.en: Today the teacher asked us to write an essay.

examples.zh: 这篇作文我写了两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén wǒ xiě le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: I spent two hours on this essay.

examples.zh: 你的作文为什么这么短？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zuòwén wèishénme zhème duǎn?
examples.en: Why is your essay so short?

examples.zh: 我们要保持规律的作息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎochí guīlǜ de zuòxī.
examples.en: We need to keep a regular routine.

examples.zh: 他的作息时间很不规律。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuòxī shíjiān hěn bù guīlǜ.
examples.en: His daily routine is very irregular.

examples.zh: 健康的作息对身体很重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng de zuòxī duì shēntǐ hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: A healthy routine matters a lot for your body.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi zuò zuòyè.
examples.en: I haven't done my homework yet.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè hěn duō.
examples.en: There's a lot of homework today.

examples.zh: 作业做完了，我们去玩吧。
examples.pinyin: Zuòyè zuò wán le, wǒmen qù wán ba.
examples.en: Once the homework is done, let's go out and play.

examples.pinyin: Yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu zuòyòng.
examples.en: Exercise has a good effect on the body.

examples.pinyin: Zhège yào méiyǒu shénme zuòyòng.
examples.en: This medicine doesn't do much.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de zuòyòng hěn dà.
examples.en: Teachers play a big role.

examples.zh: 勤能补拙是我的座右铭。
examples.pinyin: Qínnéng bǔzhuō shì wǒ de zuòyòumíng.
examples.en: Diligence makes up for a lack of talent is my personal motto.

examples.zh: 他把这句话当作自己的座右铭。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè jù huà dàngzuò zìjǐ de zuòyòumíng.
examples.en: He treats this saying as his personal motto.

examples.zh: 这句话是老师送给我的座右铭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jù huà shì lǎoshī sòng gěi wǒ de zuòyòumíng.
examples.en: This saying is the motto my teacher gave me.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì shéi?
examples.en: Who wrote this book?

examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi hǎo zuòzhě.
examples.en: He is a good writer.

examples.zh: 我很喜欢这个作者的书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhège zuòzhě de shū.
examples.en: I really like this author's books.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ zìjǐ zuòzhǔ ba.
examples.en: You decide this one yourself.

examples.zh: 这些小事，我可以自己做主。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē xiǎoshì, wǒ kěyǐ zìjǐ zuòzhǔ.
examples.en: I can make these small decisions myself.

examples.zh: 公司的大事，由老板做主。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de dàshì, yóu lǎobǎn zuòzhǔ.
examples.en: The boss makes the big decisions for the company.
